bam po brgyad cu drug pa;
[gleng gzhi]
Chapter 1. The Setting
The Setting

bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa'i dze ta'i tshal/ skyabs med pa la zas sbyin pa'i kun dga' ra ba'i nang / pho brang brtsegs pa bkod pa rgya chen po can na/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po dang / 'jam dpal la sogs pa 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes pa dam pa'i ye shes dang / brtan pa dam pa'i ye shes dang; chags med dam pa'i ye shes dang / me tog dam pa'i ye shes dang / nyi ma dam pa'i ye shes dang / zla ba dam pa'i ye shes dang / dri med dam pa'i ye shes dang / rdo rje dam pa'i ye shes dang / rdul med dam pa'i ye shes dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnam par snang mdzad dam pa'i ye shes dang /

The Bhagavat was in a greatly adorned kūṭāgāra in Jetavana, Anāthapiṇḍada’s park, in Śrāvastī, together with the bodhisattvas Samantabhadra, Mañjuśrī, and others, including the bodhisattva mahāsattvas Jñānottarajñānin,[38] Sattvottarajñānin,[39] Asaṅgottarajñānin, Kusumottarajñānin, Sūryottarajñānin, Candrottarajñānin, Vimalottarajñānin, Vajrottarajñānin, Virajottarajñānin, and the bodhisattva Vairocanottarajñānin;

THUS HAVE I HEARD. At one time the Blessed One was in Sravasti, in a magnificent pavilion in the garden of Anathapindada in the Jeta grove, together with five thousand enlightening beings, led by Samantabhadra, the universally good enlightening being, and Manjushri. The names were Endowed with Perspicacious Knowledge, Endowed with Essential Knowledge, Endowed with Unattached Knowledge, Endowed with Blossoming Knowledge, Endowed with Sunlike Knowledge, Endowed with Moonlike Knowledge, Endowed with Undefiled Knowledge, Endowed with Adamantine Knowledge, Endowed with Unemotional Knowledge, Endowed with Radiant Knowledge,

byang chub sems dpa' skar ma'i rgyal mtshan dang / ri rab rgyal mtshan dang / rin chen rgyal mtshan dang / chags med rgyal mtshan dang / me tog rgyal mtshan dang / dri med rgyal mtshan dang / nyi ma'i rgyal mtshan dang / mdzes pa'i rgyal mtshan dang / rdul med rgyal mtshan dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnam par snang ba'i rgyal mtshan dang /
the bodhisattvas Jyotirdhvaja, Merudhvaja, Ratnadhvaja, Asaṅgadhvaja, Kusumadhvaja, Vimaladhvaja, Sūryadhvaja, Ruciradhvaja, Virajadhvaja, and the bodhisattva Vairocanadhvaja;
Starlike, Mountainlike, Jewellike, Unattached, Flowerlike, Undefiled, Sunlike, Resplendent, Dispassionate, Radiant,

byang chub sems dpa' rin chen gzi brjid dang / blo gros chen po'i gzi brjid dang / ye shes rdo rje'i gzi brjid dang / dri ma med pa'i gzi brjid dang / chos kyi nyi ma'i gzi brjid dang / bsod nams ri bo'i gzi brjid dang / ye shes snang ba'i gzi brjid dang / kun nas dpal gyi gzi brjid dang / kun nas 'od dpal gzi brjid dang / byang chub sems dpa' phyogs bcu snang bas rgyas par 'gengs pa'i gzi brjid dang /

the bodhisattvas Ratnatejas, Mahātejas,[40] Jñānavajratejas, Vimalatejas, Dharmasūryatejas, Puṇyaparvatatejas, Jñānāvabhāsatejas, Samantaśrītejas,[41] Samantaprabhaśrītejas, and the bodhisattva Daśadikprabhaparisphuṭa;[42]

Jewel Energy, Great Energy, Knowledge Thunderbolt Energy, Undefiled Energy, Energy of the Sun of Truth, Virtue Mountain Energy, Energy of the Light of Knowledge, Universal Glorious Energy, Universal Light Energy,

byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po dang / nam mkha'i snying po dang / pad+mo'i snying po dang / rin po che'i snying po dang / nyi ma'i snying po dang / yon tan rnam dag snying po dang / chos rgya mtsho'i snying po dang / rnam par snang ba'i snying po dang / gtsug gi snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' pad+mo'i dpal gyi snying po dang /
the bodhisattvas Dhāraṇīgarbha, Gaganagarbha, Padmagarbha, Ratnagarbha, Sūryagarbha, Guṇaviśuddhigarbha, Dharmasamudragarbha, Vairocanagarbha, Nābhigarbha, and the bodhisattva Padmaśrīgarbha;
Earth Matrix, Sky Matrix, Lotus Calyx, Jewel Matrix, Sun Matrix, Matrix of Virtues, Matrix of the Ocean of Truths, Matrix of Radiance, Matrix of Origination, Matrix of Lotus Splendor,

byang chub sems dpa' bzang po'i mig dang / rnam par dag pa'i mig dang / dri ma med pa'i mig dang / chags pa med pa'i mig dang / kun nas blta ba'i mig dang / shin tu rnam par blta ba'i mig dang / ut+pa la'i mig dang; rdo rje'i mig dang / rin po che'i mig dang / byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i mig dang /
the bodhisattvas Sunetra, Viśuddhanetra, Vimalanetra, Asaṅganetra, Samantadarśananetra, Suvilokitanetra,[43] Avalokitanetra, Utpalanetra, Vajranetra, Ratnanetra, and the bodhisattva Gagananetra;[44]
Good Eye, Pure Eye, Undefiled Eye, Unobstructed Eye, All-Seeing Eye, Perceptive Eye, Observant Eye, Lotus Eye, Adamantine Eye, Jewel Eye, Space Eye, Universal Eye,

byang chub sems dpa' lha'i cod pan dang / chos kyi dbyings snang ba'i blo gros cod pan dang / byang chub sems dpa' dam pa'i cod pan dang / phyogs rnam par snang ba'i cod pan dang / sangs rgyas thams cad yang dag par byung ba'i snying po'i cod pan dang / 'jig rten thams cad las mngon par 'phags pa'i cod pan dang / kun nas rnam par snang ba'i cod pan dang / zil gyis non pa med pa'i cod pan dang; de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi seng ge'i khri 'dzin pa'i cod pan dang / byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi dbyings nam mkha' kun nas snang ba'i cod pan dang /

the bodhisattvas[45] Devamukuṭa, Dharmadhātupratibhāsamaṇimukuṭa, Bodhimaṇḍamukuṭa, Digvairocanamukuṭa, Sarvabuddhasaṃbhūtagarbhamaṇimukuṭa, Sarvalokadhātūdgatamukuṭa, Samantavairocanamukuṭa, Anabhibhūtamukuṭa, Sarvatathāgatasiṃhāsanasaṃpratiṣṭhitamaṇimukuṭa, and the bodhisattva Samantadharmadhātugaganapratibhāsamukuṭa;

Celestial Crown, Crown of Jewels Which Give Birth to All Buddhas, Crown Beyond All Worlds, All-Illumining Crown, Invincible Crown, Crown of Jewels Illuminating All Things in the Cosmos, Crown of the Essence of Enlightenment, Radiant Crown, Crown of Jewels Inset with the Lion Thrones of All Buddhas, Crown Illuminating the Space of the Whole Cosmos,

byang chub sems dpa' tshangs pa'i dbang po'i gtsug phud dang / klu'i dbang po'i gtsug phud dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sprul pa snang ba'i gtsug phud dang / byang chub dam pa'i gtsug phud dang / smon lam rgya mtsho thams cad rab tu sgrogs pa'i rin chen rgyal po'i gtsug phud dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rab tu 'gyed pa'i nor bu rin chen 'brug sgra'i gtsug phud dang / nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad tha mi dad par rnam par dmigs pa'i rin chen rgyal pos brgyan pa'i gtsug phud dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rnam par 'phrul pa snang ba'i rgyal mtshan rin po che'i rgyal po dra bas kun nas yog pa'i gtsug phud dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo sgrog pa'i gtsug phud dang / byang chub sems dpa' dus gsum gyi ming thams cad rab tu sgrog pa'i gtsug phud dang /

the bodhisattvas[46] Brahmendracuḍa, Nāgendracūḍa, Sarvabuddhanirmāṇapratibhāsacūḍa, Bodhimaṇḍacūḍa, Sarvapraṇidhānasāgaranirghoṣamaṇirājacūḍa, Sarvatathāgataprabhāmaṇḍalapramuñcanamaṇiratnanigarjitacūḍa, Sarvākāśatalāsaṃbhedavijñaptimaṇiratnavibhūṣitacūḍa, Sarvatathāgatavikurvitapratibhāsadhvajamaṇirājajālasaṃchāditacūḍa, Sarvatathāgatadharmacakranirghoṣacūḍa, and the bodhisattva Sarvatryadhvanāmacakranirghoṣacūḍa;

Crest of Lord Brahma, Crest of the Lord of Dragons, Crest of Lights Emanated by All Buddhas, Crest of the Essence of Enlightenment, Crest of Most Excellent Jewels of the Sound of the Ocean of All Vows, Crest of a Spew of Jewels Emanating the Halos of All Buddhas, Crest Adorned with Jewels Showing the Nondifferentiation of All Surfaces of Space, Crest Covered with a Net of the Finest Jewels Representing the Lights Magically Produced by All Buddhas, Crest of Sounds of the Wheel of Teaching of All Buddhas, Crest Uttering the Names of Everything in Past, Present, and Future,

byang chub sems dpa' rgya chen po'i 'od dang / gzi brjid dri ma med pa'i 'od dang / rin po che'i 'od dang / rdul dang bral ba'i 'od dang / skar ma'i 'od dang / chos kyi 'od dang / zhi ba'i 'od dang / nyi ma'i 'od dang; rnam par 'phrul ba'i 'od dang / byang chub sems dpa' lha'i 'od dang /
the bodhisattvas[47] Mahāprabha, Vimalaprabha,[48] Vimalatejaḥprabha, Ratnaprabha, Virajaprabha, Jyotiṣprabha, Dharmaprabha, Śāntiprabha, Sūryaprabha, Vikurvitaprabha, and the bodhisattva Devaprabha;
Great Light, Undefiled Light, Light of Undefiled Energy, Jewel Light, Dispassionate Light, Star Light, Light of Truth, Light of Peace, Sun Light, Magical Light, Celestial Light,

byang chub sems dpa' bsod nams dpal dang / ye shes dpal dang / chos kyi dpal dang / mngon par shes pa'i dpal dang / 'od kyi dpal dang / me tog dpal dang / rin po che'i dpal dang / byang chub kyi dpal dang / tshangs pa'i dpal dang / byang chub sems dpa' kun nas snang ba'i dpal dang /
the bodhisattvas[49] Puṇyaketu, Jñānaketu, Dharmaketu, Abhijñāketu, Prabhāketu, Kusumaketu, Maṇiketu,[50] Bodhiketu, Brahmaketu, and the bodhisattva Samantāvabhāsaketu;
Torch of Virtue, Torch of Knowledge, Torch of Truth, Torch of Superknowledge, Torch of Light, Flower Torch, Torch of Enlightenment, Torch of Brahma, Torch of Universal Illumination, Jewel Torch,

byang chub sems dpa' tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang / rgya mtsho'i dbyangs dang / sa sgra'i dbyangs dang / 'jig rten dbang po'i dbyangs dang / ri dbang rgyal po 'thab pa'i dbyangs dang / chos kyi dbyings kun tu rgyas pa'i dbyangs dang / chos rgya mtsho thams cad rab tu sgrog pa'i dbyangs dang / bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad rab tu 'dul ba'i dbyangs dang / snying rje chen po'i tshul gyi sprin rab tu sgrog pa'i dbyangs dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba thams cad sdug bsngal rab tu zhi bar bya bas dbugs 'byin pa'i dbyangs dang /

the bodhisattvas[51] Brahmaghoṣa, Sāgaraghoṣa, Dharaṇīnirnādaghoṣa, Lokendraghoṣa, Śailendrarājasaṃghaṭṭanaghoṣa, Sarvadharmadhātuspharaṇaghoṣa, Sarvadharmadhātusāgaranigarjitaghoṣa,[52] Sarvamāramaṇḍalapramardaṇaghoṣa, Mahākaruṇānayameghanigarjitaghoṣa, and the bodhisattva Sarvajagadduḥkhapraśāntyāśvāsanaghoṣa;

Brahma Sound, Ocean Sound, Earth Roaring Sound, Voice of a World Leader, Sound of Mountains Colliding, Voice Pervading All Universes, Sound Emitted by the Ocean of All Universes, Sound of Crushing All Armies of Demons, Sound Emitted by All Didactic Devices of Great Compassion, Sound of Stopping the Sufferings of All Worlds and Giving Comfort,

byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi 'phags pa dang / khyad par gyis 'phags pa dang / ye shes kyis 'phags pa dang / bsod nams ri bos 'phags pa dang / yon tan gyi tshogs kyis 'phags pa dang / grags pas 'phags pa dang / kun du snang bas 'phags pa dang / byams pa chen pos 'phags pa dang / ye shes rgya mtshos 'phags pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyud kyi gdung gis 'phags pa dang /
the bodhisattvas[53] Dharmodgata, Viśeṣodgata, Jñānodgata, Puṇyasumerūdgata, Guṇaprabhāvodgata, Yaśodgata, Samantāvabhāsodgata, Mahāmaitryudgata, Jñānasaṃbhārodgata, and Tathāgatakulagotrodgata;

Born of Truth, Born of Excellence, Born of Knowledge, Born of a Polar Mountain of Virtue, Born of Radiance of Virtues, Born of Splendor, Born of Universal Illumination, Born of Great Kindness, Born of a Store of Knowledge, Born of the Family of Buddhas,

byang chub sems dpa' 'od kyi dpal dang / mchog gi dpal dang / kun tu 'phags pa'i dpal dang / rnam par snang ba'i dpal dang / chos kyi dpal dang / zla ba'i dpal dang / nam mkha'i dpal dang / rin po che'i dpal dang / dpal gyi dpal dang / byang chub sems dpa' ye shes kyi dpal dang /
the bodhisattvas[54] Prabhāśrī, Pravaraśrī, Samudgataśrī, Vairocanaśrī, Dharmaśrī, Candraśrī, Gaganaśrī, Ratnaśrī, Ketuśrī, and the bodhisattva Jñānaśrī;
Glowing Splendor, Preeminent Splendor, Exalted Splendor, Radiant Splendor, Splendor of Truth, Splendor of the Moon, Splendor of the Sky, Jewel Splendor, Splendor of Brilliance, Splendor of Knowledge,

byang chub sems dpa' ri'i dbang po'i rgyal po dang / chos kyi dbang po'i rgyal po dang / 'gro ba'i dbang po'i rgyal po dang / tshangs pa'i dbang po'i rgyal po dang / tshogs kyi dbang po'i rgyal po dang / lha'i dbang po'i rgyal po dang / zhi pa'i dbang po'i rgyal po dang / mi g.yo ba'i dbang po'i rgyal po dang / khyu mchog dbang po'i rgyal po dang / byang chub sems dpa' mchog gi dbang po'i rgyal po dang /
the bodhisattvas[55] Śailendrarāja, Dharmendrarāja, Jagadindrarāja, Brahmendrarāja, Gaṇendrarāja, Devendrarāja, Śāntendrarāja, Acalendrarāja, Ṛṣabhendrarāja, and the bodhisattva Pravarendrarāja;
Mountain Lord, Lord of Truth, Lord of the World, Lord Brahma, Lord of the Masses, Lord of Gods, Lord of Peace, Immutable Lord, Mighty Lord, Eminent Lord,

byang chub sems dpa' rab tu zhi ba'i sgra dang / chags pa med pa'i sgra dang / sa'i dbyangs kyi sgra dang / rgya mtsho'i 'brug gi sgra dang / sprin gyi dbyangs kyi sgra dang / chos snang ba'i sgra dang / nam mkha'i dbyings kyi sgra dang / sems can kun gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba rab tu sgrogs pa'i sgra dang / sngon gyi smon lam yongs su bskul ba'i sgra dang / byang chub sems dpa' bdud kyi dkyil 'khor bcom zhing med par byed pa'i sgra dang /

the bodhisattvas[56] Praśāntasvara, Asaṅgasvara, Dharaṇīnirghoṣasvara, Sāgaranigarjitasvara, Meghanirghoṣasvara, Dharmāvabhāsasvara, Gagananirghoṣasvara, Sarvasattvakuśalamūlanigarjitasvara, Pūrvapraṇidhānasaṃcodanasvara, and the bodhisattva Māramaṇḍalanirghoṣasvara;

Supremely Tranquil Voice, Unobstructed Voice, Voice of Earth, Voice of the Ocean, Voice of Thunder, Voice of the Light of Truth, Voice of Space, Voice of the Roots of Goodness of All Beings, Voice of Encouragement of All Past Vows,

byang chub sems dpa' rin po che'i blo dang / ye shes ri bo'i blo dang / nam mkha'i blo dang / dri ma med pa'i blo dang / chags pa med pa'i blo dang / rnam par sangs rgyas pa'i blo dang / dus gsum snang ba'i blo dang / yangs pa'i blo dang / kun du snang ba'i blo dang / byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi dbyings su snang ba'i blo dang /

and the bodhisattvas[57] Ratnabuddhi, Jñānabuddhi,[58] Gaganabuddhi, Vimalabuddhi, Asaṅgabuddhi,[59] Viśuddhabuddhi, Tryadhvāvabhāsabuddhi, Viśālabuddhi, Samantāvalokabuddhi, and the bodhisattva Dharmadhātunayāvabhāsabuddhi,

Jewel Awareness, Knowing Awareness, Spacelike Awareness, Unattached Awareness, Undefiled Awareness, Purified Awareness, Awareness of All Times, Powerful Awareness, All-Observing Awareness, Awareness of Ways to the Reality Realm.

de dag la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' lnga stong tsam ste/ kun kyang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa dang / smon lam gyi byung ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad rgyas par 'geng [?] pa chags pa med pa'i spyod yul can de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi drung du 'dong bas lus mtha' yas pa'i byin gyi rlabs dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul pa yongs su bstan pa/ rnam par dmigs par bya ba la bsgribs pa med pa'i mig gi dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'i tshe/ nye bar 'dong pa rgyun mi gcod pas tshad med par phyin pa/ chos rgya mtsho'i tshul thams cad la ye shes snang ba rab tu thob pas snang ba mtha' yas pa dang ldan pa/ tha dad pa yang dag par shes pa rnam par dag pas/ bskal pa mtha' yas par shin tu ston pa mi zad pa/ 'gro ba'i bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gzugs kyi lus yongs su ston pas/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyis klas pa'i ye shes kyi spyod yul rnam par dag cing mi gnas pa/ sems can gyi khams sems can med pa dang / srog med pa yongs su shes pas rab rib med pa/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad du 'od zer gyi dra bas rgyas par 'gengs pas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa sha stag dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs so/ /

and so on. There were five thousand bodhisattvas in all who had all arisen from[60] completely good bodhisattva conduct and prayers,[61] who had unimpeded fields of activity because they pervaded all buddha realms, who had the blessing of infinite bodies because they came into the presence of all tathāgatas, who had the pure orbs of unobscured eyes because they saw the manifestations of all the buddhas, who had gone to receive measureless proclamations[62] because they unceasingly came into the presence of all tathāgatas when they attained buddhahood, who possessed infinite radiance through having attained the radiance of wisdom in all the ways of the ocean of the Dharma of the buddhas,[63] who taught good qualities[64] unceasingly throughout infinite kalpas because of their pure analytic knowledge, who had unrestricted[65] conduct of wisdom as far as the ends of space because they manifested physical bodies in accordance with the aspirations of beings, whose sight was free from defect because they knew that the realm of beings has no souls and no beings, and who had wisdom[66] as vast as space because they pervaded the realm of phenomena with a network of light rays.

Beginning with these, there were five thousand great enlightening beings, all of whom had undertaken the acts and vows of universally good enlightening beings and were unhindered in their sphere of action, pervading all buddha-lands. They manifested boundless bodies, going to all buddhas. The sphere of their unobstructed eye was pure, seeing the miracles of all buddhas. They had attained to infinity in revelations, ceaselessly approaching the entries into enlightenment of all buddhas. Their illumination was measureless, having attained the light of knowledge of principles and didactic devices of the ocean of teachings of all buddhas. They could explain virtues forever, through purity of intellectual powers. They were unfettered in the purity of the realm of knowledge vaster than space, being able to appear in the world in any physical form they wished. They were clear-sighted, knowing the realm of beings to be void of beings or souls. They had spacelike knowledge, pervading all universes with a net of lights.
nyan thos rdzu 'phrul chen po dang ldan pa lnga brgya ste/
There were five hundred śrāvakas endowed with miraculous powers,
There were also five hundred hearers with great spiritual powers,
thams cad kyang bden pa'i tshul gyis rang bzhin mngon par khong du chud pa/
all of whom had realized the nature of the way of the truths;
all of them perfectly aware of the essence of true reason and the principles of truth.
yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon sum du gyur pa/
directly perceived the true finality;
They had arrived at direct witness of the limit of reality,
chos kyi rang bzhin la zhugs pa/
comprehended the nature of phenomena;
had penetrated the nature of phenomena,
srid pa'i rgya mtsho las gyen du 'phags pa/
transcended the ocean of existence;
had gotten out of the ocean of existence
de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs su 'gyur ba'i spyod yul can kun nas sbyor ba dang /
had the range of activity of the tathāgatas that is as extensive as space;[67]
and into the realm of space of those who have arrived at suchness,
bag la nyal ba dang / bcings pa rnam par bzlog pa/
had ended fetters, predispositions, and bondage;
had stopped their propensities and habits and were beyond regression,
chags pa med pa'i gnas la brten pa
remained in an unobstructed state;
dwelled in the abode of nonattachment and nonobstruction,
nam mkha' ltar zhi ba la rnam par spyod pa/
dwelled in a peace that was like space;
were in a state as tranquil as space,
sangs rgyas la the tshom dang / nem nur dang yid gnyis yongs su chad pa;
had eliminated doubts, uncertainty, and equivocation concerning the buddhas;
had cut off all doubt in Buddha,
sangs rgyas kyi ye shes rgya mtsho la mos pa'i lam du zhugs pa sha stag dang /
and followed the path of aspiration for the ocean of the wisdom of the buddhas.
and had entered the path intent on the ocean of buddha-knowledge.
'jig rten gyi dbang po sngon gyi rgyal ba la bya ba byas pa/
There were lords of the world who had served previous jinas,
There were also world rulers, who had served past buddhas,
'gro ba thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i don du zhugs pa/
who were dedicated to bringing benefit and happiness to all beings,
who had accomplished the welfare and happiness of all beings,
gsol ba ma btab par dge ba'i bshes gnyen du gyur pa/
who became good guides without being asked,
who were unsolicited benefactors,
sems can gzhan bsrung ba la zhugs pa/
who were dedicated to protecting other beings,
who had accomplished the protection of others,
'jig rten thams cad las 'phags pa'i khyad par dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyi sgo la zhugs pa/
who had attained the gateway[68] to wisdom that transcends the world,
who had entered into the bliss of the highest knowledge in the world,
sems can thams cad yongs su mi gtong ba'i sems dang ldan pa/
who had the motivation of never abandoning all beings,
who were never indifferent toward sentient beings,
sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bstan pa'i spyod yul la byung ba/
who had originated from[69] the field of activity of the teaching of all buddhas,
who issued from the realm of the buddha-teaching,
de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa yongs su bsrung ba la zhugs pa/
who were dedicated to protecting the teachings of the tathāgatas,
who had accomplished the preservation of the buddha-teaching,
sangs rgyas kyi rigs yang dag par gzung ba'i smon lam gyis yang dag par skyes pa/
who were born through prayers to be within the family of the buddhas,
who vowed to sustain the lineage of buddhas,
de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung gi rgyud du 'byung ba mngon du gyur pa/
who had attained being within the family lineage of the tathāgatas,
who were oriented toward birth in the family of buddhas,
thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la mngon par mos pa sha stag dang yang thabs gcig go /
and who aspired to omniscience.
who sought omniscient knowledge.
de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa de dag dang / nyan thos rdzu 'phrul chen po dang ldan pa de dag dang / 'jig rten gyi dbang po 'khor dang bcas pa de dag 'di snyam du gyur te/
Then those bodhisattvas and their followers, and the śrāvakas who had miraculous powers and the lords of the world and their followers thought,
At that time it occurred to those enlightening beings and their companions, to those hearers of great spiritual powers, and to those world rulers and their companions,

de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi spyod yul dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mi bsnyengs pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par spyod pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mnga' dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes dang /

“the Tathāgata’s domain, the scope of the Tathāgata’s wisdom, the Tathāgata’s blessing, the Tathāgata’s strengths, the Tathāgata’s fearlessness, the Tathāgata’s samādhi, the Tathāgata’s conduct, the Tathāgata’s state,[70] the Tathāgata’s supremacy, the Tathāgata’s body,[71] or the Tathāgata’s wisdom,

“the sphere of the enlightened, the realm of knowledge of the enlightened, the basis, the power, the fearlessness, the concentration, the state, the mastery, the body, or the knowledge of the enlightened,

de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs dang; de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthu dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sngon gyi smon lam dang / sngon legs par spyad pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang; dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi skyabs dang / dad pa'i mig yongs su dag pa dang / rgya chen po la mos pa'i snang bar rab tu thob pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa dang / bsam pa thag pas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du smon cing / yang dag par zhugs pa ma gtogs par

Without the Tathāgata’s blessing, without the Tathāgata’s manifestations, without the Tathāgata’s power, without the Tathāgata’s past prayers, without a past excellent practice of the roots of merit, without the guidance of a kalyāṇamitra, without the pure eyes of faith, without the attainment of the radiance of a vast aspiration, without the pure superior motivation of a bodhisattva, and without the determined aspiration for omniscience,

Except by the support, the magic, the empowerment, and the past vows of the enlightened, by having the qualities of roots of goodness perfected by past buddhas, by being in the charge of spiritual benefactors, by purification of faith, liberative means, and knowledge, by attainment of illumination of higher devotion, by purification of the higher will of enlightening beings, and by the proceeding of the higher will on the undertaking of realizing omniscience,

lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis 'jug pa'am/ khong du chud pa'am/ yid ches pa'am/ yongs su shes pa'am/ rnam par rtogs pa'am/ gzung ba'am/ rnam par dpyad pa'am/ rnam par bsgom pa'am/ rnam par dbye ba'am; rnam par grol ba'am/ rab tu brjod pa'am/ sems can pha rol gyi rgyud du phyin par bya bar ni mi nus na/

it is not possible for worldly beings and devas to comprehend, or understand, or believe in, or know, or conceive of, or grasp, or analyze, or meditate on, or classify, or reveal, or describe, or establish within other beings.

it is not possible for celestials or humans to understand or enter into or focus on or know or cognize or think about or perceive clearly or distinguish or elucidate or establish in the body and mind of other beings. .

bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis bdag cag byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsam pa'i tshul ji lta ba dang / sems can bsam pa rnam pa tha dad pa dang / mos pa sna tshogs dang / shes pa sna tshogs kyi tshig dang brda sna tshogs su gyur pa/ dbang bsgyur ba'i sa gzhan dang gzhan la gnas pa/ dbang po sna tshogs su rnam par dag pa/ bsam pa dang sbyor ba rnam pa gzhan dang gzhan can/ sems dang bsam pa'i yul gzhan dang gzhan can/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan gzhan dang gzhan la gnas pa/ chos bstan pa gzhan dang gzhan la mos pa dag la/

“May the Bhagavat[72] teach us‍—we who have the aspirations of bodhisattvas‍—as well as all beings, who‍—because of[73] their various aspirations, different kinds of motivations, and different kinds of knowledge‍—use different kinds of words and terms, are on different levels of power, and have different purity of faculties, different kinds of motivation and conduct, different ranges of thought, different kinds of reliance on the qualities of the tathāgatas, and different kinds of interest in the teaching of the Dharma.

May the Buddha show us, enlightening beings and sentient beings—according to our dispositions, different mental capacities, different orientations, different perceptions, different languages, different attainments, different masteries, different stages, different purity of faculties, different mental efforts, different realms of thought, focus on different qualities of buddhahood, and orientation toward various teachings—
sngon thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du zhugs pa lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang /
“May he teach us how in the past he set out to attain omniscience.
his past procedure toward omniscience,
sngon byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam mngon par bsgrubs pa lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang /
May he teach us how in the past he accomplished the aspiration of a bodhisattva.
and show us his past undertaking of the vows of enlightening beings,
sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su dag pa lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang /
May he teach us how in the past he had a pure field of the perfections of a bodhisattva.
his past purification of the spheres of the transcendent ways of enlightening beings,
sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa'i sa yongs su mnan pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang /
May he teach us how in the past he had the miraculous manifestations of having reached the level of a bodhisattva.
the wonder of his past accession to the stages of enlightening beings,
sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon par bsgrubs pa yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang /
May he teach us how in the past he had completely accomplished the field of conduct of a bodhisattva.
his past fulfillment of the undertakings of the spheres of practices of enlightening beings,
sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa'i tshul mngon par bsgrubs pa rnam par phye ba'i snang ba lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang /
May he teach us how in the past he had displayed accomplishing the way of a bodhisattva.
the appearance of his past accomplishment of the vehicle of enlightening beings,
sngon byang chub sems dpa'i lam gyi bkod pa yongs su dag par mdzad pa lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang /
May he teach us how in the past he had a pure display[74] of the bodhisattva’s path.
his past purification of the embellishment of the path of enlightening beings,
sngon byang chub sems dpa'i 'byung ba'i tshul rgya mtsho mngon par bsgrubs pa lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang /
May he teach us how in the past he displayed the accomplishment of an ocean of a bodhisattva’s ways of going forth.
the arrays of his past accomplishments of the ocean of ways of emancipation of enlightening beings,
sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa'i yang dag par bsgrub pa dang; rnam par 'phrul pa'i bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang /
May he teach us how in the past he perfectly displayed[75] an ocean of the miraculous manifestations that are a bodhisattva’s attainments.[76]
the splendors of the ocean of spiritual transformations he experienced in the past as an enlightening being,
byang chub sems dpa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba rgya mtsho lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang /
May he teach us how in the past he had an ocean of a bodhisattva’s practices.
the oceans of his past efforts as an enlightening being,
mngon par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi sgos rnam par 'phrul ba lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang /
May he teach us how he has an ocean of miraculous manifestations through attaining enlightenment.
the oceans of his spiritual transformations on the threshold of perfect enlightenment,
de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor pa'i rnam par 'phrul ba dang / khyu mchog gi mthu lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang /
May he also teach us how he has manifested the most powerful miraculous manifestation of turning a tathāgata’s wheel of the Dharma.
the power of his spiritual manifestations in turning the wheel of truth as a buddha,
de bzhin gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa dang / rnam par 'phrul ba lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang /
May he also teach us how he has an ocean of the miraculous manifestations of purifying a tathāgata’s buddha realm.
the oceans of spiritual transformations involved in buddha-land purification,
de bzhin gshegs pa'i sems can gyi khams gdul ba'i thabs kyi sgo lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang /
May he also teach us how he has the gateway of methods for guiding the realm of beings.
the Buddha’s methods of guiding sentient beings to liberation,
de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi chos kyi grong khyer la mnga' mdzad pa lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang /
May he also teach us how he has sovereignty over the city of the Dharma of an omniscient tathāgata.
the Buddha’s lordship of the city of principles of omniscience,
de bzhin gshegs pa sems can thams cad kyi lam snang bar mdzad pa lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang /
May he also teach us how he has a tathāgata’s illumination of the path for all beings.
the Buddha’s revelations of the paths of all sentient beings,
de bzhin gshegs pa sems can thams cad kyi gnas su gshegs shing / rnam par 'phrul pa mdzad pa lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang /
May he also teach us how he has a tathāgata’s miraculous manifestation of entering into the existences of beings.
the Buddha’s transfigurations entering into the states of all beings,
de bzhin gshegs pa sems can thams cad kyi yon bzhes pa mdzad pa lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang /
May he also teach us how he receives the offerings of beings for a tathāgata.
the Buddha’s receiving of gifts from beings,
de bzhin gshegs pa sems can thams cad kyi bsod nams dang / yon ston pa'i cho 'phrul mdzad pa lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang /
May he also teach us how he has a tathāgata’s miracle of teaching merit and offerings[77] to all beings.
the Buddha’s presentations of teachings on right giving to all sentient beings,
de bzhin gshegs pa sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi tshul la/ sangs rgyas kyi gzugs brnyan dmigs pa mdzad pa lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang /
May he also teach us how the Tathāgata has created the perceived image of a buddha within the mental processes of all beings.
the Buddha’s projection of the image of Buddha into the mental states of all beings,
de bzhin gshegs pa sems can thams cad la rnam par 'phrul pa'i cho 'phrul mdzad pa lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang /
May he also teach us how the Tathāgata has created magical manifestations for all beings.
the Buddha’s displays of miracles to sentient beings,
de bzhin gshegs pa sems can thams cad la yongs su bstan pa dang / rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul mdzad pa lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang /
May he also teach us how the Tathāgata has created the magical appearances of teachings and instructions for all beings.
the Buddha’s miracles of teaching and admonishing sentient beings,
de bzhin gshegs pa sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod yul bsam gyis mi khyab pas rnam par 'phrul pa mdzad pa lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang snyam pa dang /
May he also teach us the Tathāgata’s manifestations of the inconceivable range of the samādhis of buddhahood for all beings.”
and the Buddha’s inconceivable manifestations of the realms of concentration of Buddha to all beings — may the Buddha show us these things.”

de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi sems kyi yongs su rtogs pa thugs kyis mkhyen nas/ seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin nam mkha' dang mnyam pas dpe med pa/ 'gro ba thams cad du rnam par snang ba'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ thugs rje chen po'i sgo'i rang bzhin can/ thugs rje chen po'i sgo dang ldan pa/ thugs rje chen po'i sngon du 'gro ba/ thugs rje chen po'i chos can la mnyam par bzhag go/

Then the Bhagavat, knowing the thoughts in the minds of those bodhisattvas, rested in the samādhi called the gaping lion, which is as extensive as space and therefore[78] is beyond example and has adornments that appear to all beings,[79] has the nature of being the gateway to great compassion, possesses the gateway to great compassion, precedes great compassion, and has the quality of great compassion.

Then the Buddha, knowing what the enlightening beings were thinking, entered the concentration known as “the coming forth of the lion,” a world-illumining manifestation, of which the body is great compassion, the entryway is great compassion, the guide is great compassion, the means of access to the sky of truth is great compassion.
bcom ldan 'das kyis de ltar mnyam par bzhag ma thag tu/
As soon as the Bhagavat rested in that meditation,
As soon as the Buddha had entered this concentration,
pho brang brtsegs pa rgyan chen po can yang mtha' dang dbus med par yangs shing /
there appeared a kūṭāgāra that was greatly adorned and so vast that it had no end or center,
the magnificent pavilion became boundlessly vast:
rdo rje thub pa med pa'i rgyan mtshan gyis sa'i gzhi rab tu brgyan pa dang /
with invincible vajra banners arranged on the ground,
the surface of the earth appeared to be made of indestructible diamond,
nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po thams cad kyi dra ba kun du bkram pa/
arrayed in networks of all kings of precious jewels,

rin po che du ma'i me tog sil mas chal par gang ba/

bai DUr+ya'i ka bas mdzes par byas pa/

it was adorned with sapphire pillars,

with kings of jewels as an arranged display of ornaments that illuminated the world,
with well-proportioned decorations of world-illumining pearls of the finest water,
rin po che bzang po mang po dang ldan pa'i nor bu rin po che/
having a multitude of excellent jewels,[80]
with all kinds of gems, combined in pairs,
'dzam bu'i chu klung gi phung pos shin tu brgyan pa dang /
having heaps of precious jewels from the Jambu River,
adorned with heaps of gold and jewels,
rin po che thams cad las sgo gang dang /
with porches,
with a dazzling array of turrets,
rta babs dang;
toraṇas,
arches,
pu shu dang /
pinnacles,
chambers,
skar khung byas shing /
and windows made of all jewels,
windows,
khri 'phang grangs med pa rnam par dag pas brgyan pa dang /
adorned by countless pure balconies,
and balconies, made of all kinds of precious stones,
'jig rten gyi dbang po thams cad dang 'dra ba'i nor bu rin po che'i rgyan dang ldan pa dang /
with an array of precious jewels that resembled all the lords of worlds,
arrayed with jewels in the forms of all world rulers,
'gro ba rgya mtsho'i nor bu rin po che rnam par phye ba dang /

and embellished with oceans of worlds of jewels,

covered with all kinds of jewels, with flags, banners,
sgo dang / rta babs thams cad las 'od zer chos kyi dbyings su rgyas par 'gengs pa rab tu 'byung bas rnam par mdzes par byas pa dang /
and beautified by gateways and toraṇas emitting light rays that completely filled the realm of phenomena;
and pennants flying in front of all the portals, the adornments pervading the cosmos with a network of light.
phyi rol gyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i gzhi stegs bu brjod du med pas brgyan pa dang /
the external ground was beautified by indescribable daises for the surrounding assembly,
Outside the grounds where the inexpressibly vast circle of the assembly was, there was a magnificent array of balustrades,
phyogs kun nas them skabs kyi phreng ba nor bu rin po ches brtsegs shing / shin tu rnam par phye bas rab tu mdzes par kun nas gnas par gyur to/ /
and in all directions there were stairways of heaps of jewels and beautifully arranged adornments.
and in each direction was a stairway consisting of a mass of jewels, adorned superbly in a well-ordered fashion.

dze ta'i tshal thams cad kyang / chu zheng gab par shin tu yangs shing rgya che bar kun nas gnas par gyur te/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams kyang / chu zheng kun du rgya che zhing yangs pa dang / rin po che thams cad kyi rgyan sna tshogs dang ldan zhing / sa'i gzhi nor bu rin po che sna tshogs brjod du med pas kun nas grub pa dang / nor bu rin po che grangs med pa'i bas kun nas bskor ba dang / rin po che sna tshogs kyi shing ta la'i phreng bas mdzes pas brgyan par kun nas gnas par gyur to/ /

Through the power of the Buddha, there were present buddha realms, to the number of the atoms in countless buddha realms, that were immense and vast in length and breadth, possessed various adornments made of all jewels, had grounds made of an indescribable variety of precious jewels, were encircled by walls of countless precious jewels, and were adorned by lines of palm trees made of various jewels.

Also the Jeta grove and buddha-fields as numerous as atoms in untold buddha-fields all became coextensive, vastly expanded, by the power of Buddha. There appeared varied arrays of all kinds of jewels, plains variously set with untold jewels, fences of uncountable jewels set around, and palm trees of various jewels arrayed in rows.

sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na spos chu'i chu klung tshad med pa klong mtha' yas par 'khyil ba'i spos kyi chus yongs su gang ba/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi me tog mang po dang 'dres par gyur la g.yas phyogs su 'khyil zhing 'bab pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad dbyangs su sgrog pas rab tu brgyan pa dag kyang kun nas gnas par gyur to/ /

Those buddha realms were adorned by immeasurable rivers of scented water that were filled with an unceasing volume of scented water that was mixed with many flowers made of a variety of jewels, flowing and turning to the right, and resounding with descriptions of all the qualities of buddhahood.

Also in those lands were innumerable rivers of fragrant water, winding endlessly, filled with perfumed water, with turbulent rapids of flowers of all jewels, whirling to the right, producing the sounds of the sayings of all buddhas.
rin po che'i me tog puN+Da ri ka'i phreng ba dang /

There were also inconceivable rows of jewel white lotuses,
rin po che'i shing gam yo rin po che thams cad kyi pad+mo rab tu rgyas shing / shin tu 'phags pas mdzes par bkod pa dang /
precious trees beautifully adorned by the blossoms of superior lotuses made from all jewels,
trees adorned with arrays of lotus blossoms made of jewels,
rin po che sna tshogs kyi khang pa brtsegs pa'i phreng ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa nor bu rin po che thams cad kyi dra bas kun nas yog pa/
rows of countless kūṭāgāras made of various jewels covered in shining networks of every kind of precious jewel,

nor bu rin po che grangs med pa'i dra ba kun du snang bas brgyan cing mdzes pa dang /
arrays of countless jewels radiating webs of light,
nor bu rin po che'i gzhal med khang nor bu rin po che thams cad kyis brgyan pa grangs med pa/

countless arrays of all kinds of jewels, of celestial chariots of jewels,
spos thams cad kyi ngad kun nas 'byung ba/ bdug spos kyi sprin gyi rgyan dang ldan pa dag kyang kun nas gnas par gyur to/ /
the aroma of countless incenses spread everywhere, and the adornment of clouds of incense,
and arrays of chests of all kinds of incense releasing banks of all fragrances.
rin po che'i rgyal mtshan grangs med pa dang /
countless banners of jewels,

emblems of nets of small bells made of all kinds of jewels,
rin po che'i rgyal po'i gdugs kyi rgyal mtshan dang /
banners that were parasols of kings[83] of jewels,
emblems of parasols of the finest gems,
nor bu rin po che snang bas kun du rgyas par 'gengs pa'i rgyal mtshan dang /

emblems of jewels pervading everywhere with their radiance,

emblems of the finest jewels resounding with the names of all buddhas,
nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po seng ge yid du 'ong ba'i rgyal mtshan dang /
banners of delightful lions made of the kings of precious jewels,
emblems of the finest jewels of leonine splendor,

banners of the kings of precious jewels that proclaimed the past practices of all the tathāgatas,
emblems of the finest jewels bespeaking the past efforts of all buddhas,
nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po chos kyi dbyings thams cad rab tu snang ba'i rgyal mtshan dang /
and banners of the kings of precious jewels that illuminated the entire realm of phenomena,
emblems of reflections of all objects, arrays of emblems of the finest jewels,
rgyal mtshan gyi rgyan rnam par phye ba thams cad phyogs kun nas rgyan du gyur pa dag kyang kun nas gnas par gyur to/ /
and all directions were adorned with every kind of adorning banner.
well-distributed arrays of ornaments of all kinds of emblems, standing in all quarters.
dze ta'i tshal gyi nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad kyang lha'i gzhal med khang gi sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pas brgyan par kun nas gnas par gyur to/ /

dze ta'i tshal nyid kyang spos sna tshogs kyi shing grangs med pa'i sprin byis kun nas yog cing brgyan pa dang /

untold sweet sounds of clouds of music and songs of praise of all buddhas,

untold clouds of towers of ruddy pearls,
rdo rje lta bur sra ba'i mu tig gi sprin brjod du med pa'i char mngon par 'bab pas rab tu brgyan par kun nas gnas par gyur to/ /
It was adorned by an indescribable rainfall from clouds of pearls that were as hard as vajras.
and untold clouds of diamond-raining ornaments.
de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /
Why was this? It was because of the inconceivable roots of merit of a tathāgata.
What was the reason for that? So inconceivable is the virtue of the Buddha,
de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos dkar po'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /
It was because of the inconceivable good qualities of a tathāgata.
the mass of pure qualities of Buddha,
de bzhin gshegs pa'i khyu mchog gi mthu dang / byin gyi rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /
It was because of the inconceivable sovereign power and blessing of a tathāgata.
the mighty power of Buddha,
de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gcig 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du rgyas par 'gengs pa rnam par 'phrul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /
It was because of a tathāgata’s inconceivable miraculous manifestations whereby his one body could pervade all world realms.
the miracle of Buddha’s pervasion of all worlds with one body,
de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gcig tu zhugs pas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par phye ba thams cad la yang dag par gzhol ba'i byin gyi rlabs yongs su ston pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /
It was because of the inconceivable display of the spiritual power through which all the tathāgatas could enter one body that appears throughout the entire array of buddha realms.
the display by all buddhas of the array of all buddha-lands in one body,
de bzhin gshegs pa rnams rdul shin tu phra ba gcig la chos kyi dbyings thams cad kyi gzugs brnyan rnam par dmigs par yongs su ston par mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /
It was because of the inconceivable manifestations of the tathāgatas through which they can show the perceivable image of the entire realm of phenomena within a single atom.
the buddhas’ display of the reflections of all phenomena in a single atom,
de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ba spu'i bu ga gcig tu sngon gyi mtha' de bzhin gshegs pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa yongs su ston par mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /
It was because of the inconceivable manifestations of the tathāgatas through which they can show the entire succession of tathāgatas of the past within a single pore.
the buddhas’ display of the succession of all buddhas of past ages in one pore,
de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi 'od zer gcig gi sgo nas 'jig rten gyi khams 'byams klas pa snang bar 'gyur ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /
It was because of the tathāgatas’ inconceivable ability to illuminate infinite world realms with a single ray of light.
the buddhas’ illumination of the stream of atoms in all worlds with a single beam of light,

de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ba spu'i rtse mo gcig las sprul pa'i sprin 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /

It was because of the tathāgatas’ inconceivable ability to pervade all buddha realms, which are as numerous as the atoms that comprise all world realms, with a cloud of emanations from a single body hair.
the buddhas’ pervasion of all buddha-lands with clouds as numerous as atoms in all worlds emitted from one pore,
de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ba spu'i sgo gcig nas 'jig rten gyi khams 'du ba dang / 'jig pa'i bskal pa yongs su ston pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /
It was because of the tathāgatas’ inconceivable ability to reveal the kalpas of the creation and destruction of world realms from a single body hair.
and the buddhas’ display of the ages of becoming and decay of all worlds in a single pore:

ji ltar dze ta'i tshal de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pas yongs su dag par kun nas gnas par gyur pa de bzhin du/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa thams cad kyang yongs su dag par kun nas gnas shing rab tu brgyan pa dang / shin tu spud pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i skus yongs su rgyas pa dang / dze ta'i tshal du yang dag par gzhol ba dang /

Just as Jetavana was in this way a buddha realm and was completely purified by being a pure realm, in that same way the world realms in the ten directions to the limits of the realm of phenomena, to the limits of space, were also completely purified, adorned, beautified, and with emanated bodies of tathāgatas, and had become similar to Jetavana.

as the Jeta grove was in this way purified as a buddha-field, so were all worlds in the ten directions, throughout the space of the cosmos, likewise purified, appearing adorned, decorated, with the body of the Buddha clearly manifest therein, all together in the Jeta grove,

byang chub sems dpas yongs su rgyas pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho shin tu rnam par gnas pa dang / rgyan thams cad kyi sprin gyi char mngon par 'bab pa dang / rin po che thams cad kyi 'od kyis rab tu snang ba dang / rin po che sna tshogs thams cad kyi sprin gyi char mngon par 'bab pas brgyan pa dang / zhing thams cad kyi bkod pa'i sprin gyis kun nas yog par brgyan pa dang / lha rdzas kyi lus thams cad kyi sprin gyi char rab tu 'bab pas brgyan pa dang / me tog sna tshogs thams cad kyi sprin shin tu rgyas pa'i lhun gyis kun tu rgyas shing brgyan pa dang /

They were filled with bodhisattvas; had ocean-like assemblies of followers of tathāgatas; had rainfalls from clouds made of every kind of adornment; were completely illuminated by the lights of all jewels; were adorned by rainfall from clouds made of the entire variety of jewels; were adorned by a covering of clouds made of the adorning features of all realms; were adorned by rainfalls of every kind of divine material;[84] were adorned by a profusion of clouds of every kind of flower;[85]

filled with enlightening beings, with the ocean of Buddha’s audience standing in orderly ranks, clouds raining all kinds of adornments, lights of energy of all jewels, decorations raining from clouds of all jewels, decorations covered with clouds of arrays of all lands, ornaments raining from clouds of all celestial bodies, ornaments raining from clouds of all flowers, flowery ornaments pervading space,

gos thams cad kyi shing gi sprin gyi mdzod nas gos kha dog sna tshogs su mdzes pa'i char rab tu 'bab pas brgyan pa dang / phreng ba dang / lda ldi dang / se mo do'i rgyan thams cad kyi sprin gyi char rgyun mi 'chad par mngon par 'bab pas brgyan pa dang / spos sna tshogs kyi bdug spos phyogs kun nas 'thul ba'i sprin dang / na bun gyi char thams cad kyi lus kyi dbyibs ltar mngon par 'bab pas brgyan pa dang / rin po che thams cad kyi me tog gi dra ba'i sprin las rin po che'i rgyal po'i phye ma zhib bu'i char rgyun mi 'chad par rab tu 'bab pa dang /

were adorned by a beautiful rainfall of clothes of every color falling from a treasure of clouds of trees[86] of every kind of clothing; were adorned by a continuous rainfall from clouds made of every kind of garland, tassel, and string of beads; were adorned by a rain from masses of clouds as extensive as the universe[87] that were made of various kinds of incense and perfume that pervaded all the directions; were adorned by a continuous rain of a fine powder of networks[88] of jewels from clouds of networks of flowers made from every kind of jewel;

clouds of all kinds of cloth raining robes of various colors, ornaments continuously showering densely from clouds of all kinds of garlands and wreaths, ornaments showering in the forms of all beings from clouds of various incenses hovering everywhere, ornaments of fine powders, dense webs of jewels, raining from clouds of webs of flowers made of all jewels,

rin po che thams cad kyi rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan gyi sprin lha'i bu mo'i lag na khyer ba/ nam mkha'i dbyings kun du rgyu zhing 'khor bas brgyan pa dang / rin po che thams cad kyi pad+mo rin po che sna tshogs kyi 'dab ma'i dkyil 'khor can; chu ba mthon po dang ldan pa'i ze ba la rol mo bkod pa/ kun nas sgra 'byin cing dbyangs snyan par sgrog pas brgyan pa dang / rin po che'i 'bru sna tshogs kyi dra ba dang / rin po che seng ge'i dra ba sna tshogs rnam pa tha dad pa'i phreng ba dang / se mo dos [?] brgyan par kun nas gnas shing snang bar gyur to/ /

were adorned by clouds of banners and flags made of every kind of jewel and held in the hands of divine maidens who moved to and fro throughout the extent of space; were adorned with a variety of lotuses made from all jewels and with circles of precious petals, tall stems, and pericarps that resounded with the beautiful sounds of music; and were adorned with nets of disks[89] of every kind of jewel, nets of lions made of jewels, and various kinds of garlands and strings of beads.

ornaments of clouds of all kinds of precious banners and pennants held by celestial maidens and carried around the sky, ornaments of lotuses of all jewels with circles of leaves of various gems set atop poles with filaments hanging down, their rustling producing sweet sounds, and ornaments of garlands of various jewels on the body of Buddha, a network of images of all jewels—all of these appeared there.

de ltar bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin chen po seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa de la mnyam par bzhag ma thag tu/ de'i tshe shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi pha rol gyi 'jig rten gyi khams/ gser gyi sprin sgron ma'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad dpal gyi gzi brjid rgyal po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnam par snang ba'i smon lam gyi gtsug gi 'od zer snang ba zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das des gnang nas/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho de nas 'phags te/ nam mkha'i dbyings rgyan sna tshogs kyi sprin gyis brgyan pa dang /

In that way, as soon as the Bhagavat rested in the samādhi called the gaping lion, at that time, in the eastern direction, beyond an ocean of world realms as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, there was the world realm Kanakameghapradīpadhvajā, the Tathāgata Vairocanaśrītejorāja’s buddha realm, where the bodhisattva Vairocanapraṇidhānanābhiraśmiprabha, together with bodhisattvas to the number of atoms in countless buddha realms, with the permission of the Bhagavat, rose up from that ocean of the assembly of followers, came to the Sahā world realm, and adorned the sky with clouds of various kinds of adornments:

As soon as the Buddha had entered this “coming forth of the lion” concentration of buddhas, from the buddha-land of a buddha named King of Splendorous Illuminating Radiance, in the world Golden Cloud Lamp Emblem, which was to the east, beyond as many oceans of worlds as atoms in untold buddha-lands, a great enlightening being named Light from the Origin of the Vows of the Illuminator, given leave by that buddha, left that vast assembly and came to this world Endurance along with as many enlightening beings as atoms in untold buddha-lands, adorning the sky with clouds of various magnificent arrays,

lha rdzas kyi me tog gi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang / lha rdzas kyi spos kyi sprin gyi char rab tu dgye ba dang / lha rdzas kyi rin po che'i pad+mo'i sprin gyi char mngon par gtor ba dang / lha rdzas kyi phreng ba'i sprin gyi char rab tu btang ba dang / lha rdzas kyi rin po che'i sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang / lha rdzas kyi rgyan gyi sprin gyi char mngon par gtor ba dang / lha rdzas kyi rin po che'i gdugs kyi sprin gyi char mngon par bsgrub pa dang / kha dog sna tshogs rnam pa tha dad cing shin tu phra ba'i lha rdzas kyi gos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang / lha rdzas kyi rin po che'i rgyal mtshan dang ba dan gyi sprin nam mkha'i dbyings las byin gyi rlabs pa dang / rin po che sna tshogs kyi sprin gyi rgyan yid du 'ong bas nam mkha'i dbyings rgyas par 'gengs par byed cing / mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang na ba der lhags nas/

clouds of divine flowers from which a rain of flowers fell, clouds of divine perfume from which a rain of perfume was released, clouds of divine jewel lotuses from which a rain of lotuses was scattered, clouds of divine garlands from which a rain of garlands was produced, clouds of divine jewels from which a rain of jewels fell, clouds of divine jewelry from which a rain of jewelry fell, clouds of divine precious parasols from which a rain of parasols was produced, clouds of divine flowers from which a rain of flowers fell, clouds of various kinds of fine divine clothing in different colors from which a rain of clothing fell, clouds of divine precious banners and flags that stood[90] in the sky, and an array of clouds of every kind of jewel that filled the sky.

showering a rain of clouds of celestial flowers, celestial perfumes, celestial jewel lotuses, celestial garlands, celestial gems, celestial ornaments, celestial jewel parasols, and fine celestial robes of various colors, setting up clouds of celestial jewel banners and pennants in the sky, filling the sky with beautiful arrays of clouds of all jewels;

bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste; 'khor dang bcas pas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas/ shar phyogs su brten te khang pa brtsegs pa rgyan kun dang ldan zhing / nor bu rin po che'i dra bas kun nas khyab pa dang / seng ge'i khri nor bu rin po che phyogs rab tu snang ba'i pad+mo'i snying po can dag mngon par sprul nas/ nor bu rin po che yid bzhin gyi rgyal po'i dra ba'i rgyan gyis kun nas brgyan pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lus su byin gyis brlabs nas/ skyil mo krung bcas te 'khod do/ /

Together with his entourage, he approached the Bhagavat, bowed to the Bhagavat, and in the eastern direction emanated perfectly adorned kūṭāgāras that were covered with a net of precious jewels, each containing a lion throne and a lotus made of precious jewels that shined light in all directions, and he and his entourage seated themselves cross-legged upon the lotuses, their bodhisattva bodies adorned with a network of the kings of precious wish-fulfilling jewels.

having come to the buddha with these, the great enlightening being and the company of enlightening beings paid respects to the Buddha, then, going to the east, magically produced towers covered with nets of jewels arranged all around, and lion thrones inside of lotuses made of the finest radiant gems, and sat on them, after having covered their bodies with ornamental webs of wish-fulfilling jewels.

lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi pha rol gyi 'jig rten gyi khams rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi snying po zhes bya ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa dpal gyi snying po kun nas snang ba'i rgyal po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus kyi shugs thub par dka' ba'i rgyal po zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das des gnang nas/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho de nas 'phags te/

In the southern direction, beyond an ocean of world realms as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, there was the world realm Vajrasāgaragarbhā, the Tathāgata Samantāvabhāsaśrīgarbharāja’s buddha realm, where the bodhisattva Duryodhanavīryavegarāja, together with bodhisattvas to the number of atoms in countless buddha realms, with the permission of the Bhagavat, rose up from that ocean of the assembly of followers and came to the Sahā world realm.

From the south, beyond as many oceans of worlds as atoms in untold buddha-lands, from the land of the buddha King of the Treasury of All-Illumining Radiance, in the world of Diamond Ocean Womb, a great enlightening being named King of Invincible Energy, together with a company of as many enlightening beings as atoms in untold buddha-lands, given leave by that buddha and having disappeared from that assembly, came to this world Endurance,
'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho thams cad spos kyi lda ldi dang dra bas kun du 'brel bar byin gyis brlab pa dang /
They manifested a network of tassels of every perfume that covered all the oceans of world realms.
causing all oceans of worlds to appear decked with webs of all fragrances,
sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'byams klas pa thams cad rin po che sna tshogs kyi lda ldi dang / /dra ba chen pos kun du 'brel bar byin gyis brlab pa dang /
They manifested a network of tassels of strings of every kind of jewel extending throughout all infinite buddha realms.
causing every place in all buddha-lands to appear decked with webs of garlands of all jewels,
sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rgyud thams cad me tog thams cad kyi lda ldi dang / phreng ba'i dra bas kun nas 'brel bar byin gyis brlab pa dang /
They manifested a network of tassels and garlands made of every kind of flower that existed throughout all successive buddha realms.
causing all groups of lands to appear decked with webs of garlands of all flowers,
sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi 'khor thams cad phreng ba dang / lda ldi dang / se mo do'i dra bas kun nas 'brel bar byin gyi brlab pa dang /
They manifested a network of garlands, tassels, and strings of beads that connected all buddha realms.[91]
causing the locations of all buddha-lands to appear decked with webs of braids of all kinds of garlands,
sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi dkyil 'khor thams cad 'og gi gzhi rten rdo rje thams cad kyi phreng bas yongs su gzung bar byin gyis brlab pa dang / /
They manifested a network of chains of vajras that holds the ground beneath all the disks of buddha realms.
causing the congregations in all buddha-lands to be supported by a diamond ground,
sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi tshul thams cad nor bu rin po che sna tshogs kyi dra bas kun nas 'brel bas byin gyis brlab pa dang /
They manifested the way that all buddha realms possess networks of various kinds of precious jewels.
causing the structures of all buddha-lands to be joined with webs of all kinds of jewels,
'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gos sna tshogs kyi lda ldis kun nas yongs su blangs shing gzung bar byin gyis brlab pa dang /
They manifested all world realms having acquired and possessing tassels of various kinds of cloth.
causing all worlds to appear swathed in all kinds of cloth,

sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad rin po che sna tshogs kyi lus kyi phreng ba dang / lda ldi mang po'i dra ba kun nas 'brel bar mngon par bsgrub pa dang / zhing thams cad nor bu rin po che dpal gyi 'od zer gyi lda ldi dang phreng ba'i dra bas kun nas 'brel bar byin gyis brlab pa dang /

They manifested all buddha realms being possessed of networks of many tassels and garlands of a variety of jewels, and all realms possessing a network of tassels and garlands made of the light rays of glorious precious jewels.
conjuring up images of all buddha-lands decked with webs of bundles of garlands bearing images of all jewels,
sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad rin po che rnam par snang ba'i lda ldi dang dra bas kun du 'brel bar byin gyis brlab pa dang /
causing all lands to appear decked with webs of strings of the finest radiant jewels illumining all their adornments,
'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi gzhi nor bu rin po che seng ge yid du 'ong ba'i phreng ba dang lda ldi'i dra bas yongs su gzung bar byin gyis brlab pa byed cing /
And they manifested the ground of all world realms having a network of tassels and garlands of precious jewels and beautiful lion images.
and causing all worlds to appear held by a foundation of webs of strings of the most excellent jewels.

mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang na ba der lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste/ 'khor dang bcas pas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas/ lho phyogs su brten te/ nor bu rin po che 'gro ba la rnam par snang ba'i khang pa brtsegs pa dang / seng ge'i khri nor bu rin po che phyogs kun tu snang ba'i pad+mo'i snying po can dag mngon par sprul te/ rin po che thams cad kyi me tog gi dra ba'i rgyan gyis kun nas brgyan pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lus su byin gyis brlabs nas/ skyil mo krung bcas te 'khod do/ /

Together with his entourage, he approached the Bhagavat, bowed to the Bhagavat, and in the southern direction emanated kūṭāgāras made of precious jewels that illuminated the world, each containing a lion throne and a lotus made of precious jewels, which shined light into all directions, and he and his entourage seated themselves cross-legged upon the lotuses, their bodhisattva bodies adorned with a network of flowers made from every kind of jewel.

The great enlightening being and company came and presented all this to the Buddha, then went to the south, magically produced towers of world-illumining jewels with lion thrones inside radiant jewel lotuses, and sat thereon, covering the enlightening beings’ bodies with ornamental webs of flowers made of all kinds of jewels.

nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi pha rol gyi 'jig rten gyi khams rin po che'i ri rab rnam par snang ba'i rgyal mtshan mar me zhes bya ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes sgron ma'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas/

In the western direction, beyond an ocean of world realms as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, there was the world realm Maṇisumerūvirocanadhvajapradīpā, the Tathāgata Dharmadhātujñānapradīpa’s buddha realm,

From the west, beyond as many oceans of worlds as atoms in untold buddha-lands, from the land of the buddha Lamp of Knowledge of the Realms of the World and the Realm of Reality, in the world Lamp Representing the Radiance of a Polar Mountain of Jewels,
byang chub sems dpa' dpal kun nas 'phags pa'i gzi brjid ces bya ba/
where the bodhisattva Samantaśrīsamudgatatejorāja,[92]
a great enlightening being named King of Fiery Energy of Universal Splendor,
byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das des gnang nas/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho de nas 'phags te/
together with bodhisattvas to the number of atoms in countless buddha realms, with the permission of the Bhagavat, rose up from that ocean of the assembly of followers,
together with a company of as many enlightening beings as atoms in untold oceans of worlds, given leave by that buddha and having disappeared from that assembly,
came to the Sahā world realm,
came to this world Endurance,

chos kyi dbyings thams cad [rgyal mtshan] spos kha dog sna tshogs dang / dri sna tshogs su ldan pa'i ri rab kyi sprin sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis rgyas par dgang ba dang /

and manifested the entire realm of phenomena being filled with clouds of Sumerus of banners,[93] with various kinds of colors and with various kinds of perfume, that were as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms;
filling all universes with clouds of mountains of fragrant banners of various colors, as many as atoms in untold buddha-lands,
chos kyi dbyings thams cad [me tog] spos kha dog sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i ri rab kyi sprin/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis rgyas par dgang ba dang /
the entire realm of phenomena being filled with clouds of Sumerus of flowers,[94] with various kinds of colors and with various kinds of scents, as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms;
filling all universes with clouds of flowers of various scents,
chos kyi dbyings thams cad bdug spos kha dog dang dri du mar ldan pa'i ri rab kyi sprin/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis rgyas par dgang ba dang /
mountainous clouds of aromatic smoke of many kinds of incense,
chos kyi dbyings thams cad spos kha dog sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i ri rab kyi sprin/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis rgyas par dgang ba dang /
clouds of fragrances of various kinds,

chos kyi dbyings thams cad nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po mdangs 'byung ba/ sa thams cad kyi rdul gyi kha dog dang 'dra ba'i ri rab kyi sprin/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis rgyas par dgang ba dang /

the entire realm of phenomena being filled with clouds of Sumerus of kings of jewels, as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, in forms resembling every kind of requisite, that have arisen from the brilliance of his pores;[95]
mountainous clouds of the finest jewels formed by lights from every hair in the shapes of all utensils,

chos kyi dbyings thams cad nor bu rin po che skar ma'i rgyal mtshan 'od kyi dkyil 'khor sna tshogs kyi bkod pa dang ldan pa'i ri rab kyi sprin/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis rgyas par dgang ba dang /
mountainous clouds of jewels like stars adorned with various spheres of light,

chos kyi dbyings thams cad rin po che'i rgyal po rdo rje'i snying po kha dog sna tshogs can/ bkod pa rnam pa tha dad pa'i yul dang ldan pa'i ri rab kyi sprin/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis rgyas par dgang ba dang /
mountainous clouds of spheres of various arrays of diamonds,

chos kyi dbyings thams cad nor bu rin po che 'dzam bu'i chu klung / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du snang ba'i yul dang ldan pa'i ri rab kyi sprin/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis rgyas par dgang ba dang /

the entire realm of phenomena being filled with clouds of Sumerus of precious jewels from the Jambu River that brilliantly illuminate all world realms, as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms;
mountainous clouds of jewels illumining all worlds,

nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po chos kyi dbyings thams cad rab tu snang ba'i ri rab kyi sprin/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis kun nas khyab par byin gyis brlab pa dang /
mountainous clouds of the finest jewels reflecting the elements of all mountains covering the sky,

sems can gyi khams kyi yul thams cad nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mtshan rab tu snang ba'i ri rab kyi sprin/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis rgyas par dgang ba dang /
mountainous clouds of the finest jewels reflecting the appearances of all buddhas,

chos kyi dbyings thams cad kyi nam mkha' rin po che'i rgyal po/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sngon gyi sbyor ba rab tu snang bar yongs su ston cing / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i sgra 'byin pa'i ri rab kyi sprin/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis rgyas par dgang ba dang /
mountainous clouds of jewels resounding with the practices of enlightening beings showing the images of the past efforts of all buddhas,

phyogs bcu thams cad rin po che'i rgyal po/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po byang chub rab tu snang ba'i 'od dang ldan pa'i ri rab kyi sprin/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis rgyas par 'gengs pa byed cing /
and the ten directions being filled with clouds of Sumerus of kings of jewels, as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, that formed the images of the bodhimaṇḍas of all tathāgatas.
and mountainous clouds of the finest jewels reflecting the summits of enlightenment of all buddhas, all these clouds as numerous as atoms in untold buddha-lands, filling all universes.
mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang na ba der lhags nas/
[…see above…]
[…see above…]

bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste/ 'khor dang bcas pas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas nub phyogs su brten te/ khang pa brtsegs pa spos kyi rgyal po thams cad kyi lhun dang ldan pa/ mu tig gi dra bas kun nas khyab pa dang / seng ge'i khri nor bu rin po che lha'i dbang po rab tu snang ba'i rgyal mtshan gyi pad+mo'i snying po can dag mngon par sprul nas/ rin po che gser gyi dra bas kun nas brgyan pa dang / yid bzhin gyi rgyal po'i cod pan bcings pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lus su byin gyis brlabs nas/ skyil mo krung bcas te 'khod do/ /

Together with his entourage, he approached the Bhagavat, bowed to the Bhagavat, and in the western direction emanated kūṭāgāras covered by the kings of perfumes and by networks of strings of pearls, each having in its center a lotus made of precious jewels like the banner of Devendra upon a lion throne, and he and his entourage seated themselves cross-legged upon the lotuses, with their bodhisattva bodies adorned with a precious network of gold and a crown of kings of wish-fulfilling jewels bound onto their heads.

These the great enlightening being and company brought and presented to the Buddha; they then went to the west and magically produced towers of the finest fragrances covered with nets of pearls, and lion thrones in lotuses made of jewels presenting the appearances of the lord of gods, and sat thereon, having covered their bodies with gold and jewels and put on crowns of wish-fulfilling gems.

byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi pha rol gyi 'jig rten gyi khams/ rin po che'i gos yongs su snang ba zhes bya ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi dbyings nam mkha'i dpal rnam par snang ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas/ byang chub sems dpa' chags pa med pa'i dpal gyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das des gnang nas/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho de nas 'phags te/ nam mkha'i dbyings rin po che'i snam bu'i sprin gyi rgyan gyis brgyan par byin gyis brlab pa dang /

In the northern direction, beyond an ocean of world realms as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, there was the world realm Ratnavastrāvabhāsadhvajā,[96] the Tathāgata Dharmadhātugaganaśrīvairocana’s buddha realm, where the bodhisattva Asaṅgaśrīrāja, together with bodhisattvas to the number of atoms in countless buddha realms, with the permission of the Bhagavat, rose up from that ocean of the assembly of followers, came to the Sahā world realm, and manifested the sky being adorned by clouds of precious cloth;

From the north, beyond as many oceans of worlds as atoms in untold buddha-lands, from the land of the buddha Glorious Illuminator of the Space of the Cosmos, in the world Luminous Banner of Jewel Cloth, a great enlightening being named King of Unobstructed Splendor, together with a company of as many enlightening beings as atoms in untold oceans of worlds, given leave by that buddha and having disappeared from that assembly, came to this world Endurance, producing in the sky ornamental clouds of diadems of all jewels,
nam mkha'i dbyings rin po che'i gos kha dog ser po dang / mdog ser po'i sprin gyi rgyan gyis brgyan par byin gyis brlab pa dang /
manifested the sky being adorned by clouds of precious clothing of yellow color, yellow in appearance;
ornamental clouds of jeweled robes of yellow color, with a yellow glow,
nam mkha'i dbyings rin po che'i gos/ spos sna tshogs kyis dri zhim por byas pa'i sprin gyi char rab tu 'bab pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan par byin gyis brlab pa dang /
manifested the sky being adorned by clouds of precious clothing perfumed by various scents;
ornamental showers from clouds of jeweled robes emitting various fragrances,
nam mkha'i dbyings rin po che'i rgyal po nyi ma'i rgyal mtshan gyi sprin gyi rgyan gyis brgyan par byin gyis brlab pa dang /
manifested the sky being adorned by clouds of clothing[97] made of the kings of jewels that were like the banner of the sun;
ornamental clouds of robes of the finest sunlike jewels,
nam mkha'i dbyings nor bu rin po che gser gyi mdog shin tu 'bar ba'i sprin gyis rgyan gyis brgyan par byin gyis brlab pa dang /
manifested the sky being adorned by clouds of clothing[98] made of the kings of jewels that shone with the splendor of gold;
ornamental clouds of robes of jewels blazing with golden splendor,
nam mkha'i dbyings nor bu'i rgyal po rin po che 'bar ba'i gos kyis sprin gyi rgyan gyis brgyan par byin gyis brlab pa dang /
manifested the sky being adorned by clouds of clothing made of the kings of jewels that shone with jewels;
ornamental clouds of robes of fiery jewels,
nam mkha'i dbyings rin po che skar ma thams cad kyi gzugs brnyan gyis sna tshogs su gyur ba'i gos kyi sprin gyi rgyan gyis brgyan par byin gyis brlab pa dang /
manifested the sky being adorned by clouds of precious clothing in the manifold forms of all the stars;
ornamental clouds of robes of various jewels reflecting all the stars,
nam mkha'i dbyings phyogs bcu kun nas/ nor bu rin po che snam bu khra bo'i rdo ltar snang ba'i sprin gyis yongs su rgyas par byin gyis brlab pa dang /
manifested the ten directions of the sky being filled with clouds of clothing[99] made of precious jewels that were like cloth[100] of shining crystal;[101]
clouds of robes of jewels of pale radiance bursting into view everywhere,
nam mkha'i dbyings phyogs bcu kun nas rin po che'i rgyal po rnam par snang ba'i dpal rab tu 'bar ba'i 'od dang ldan pa'i gos kyi sprin gyis yongs su rgyas par byin gyis brlab pa dang /
manifested the ten directions of the sky being filled with clouds of clothing made of kings of jewels that shone with glorious brightness;
clouds of robes of the finest jewels blazing with radiant splendor bursting into view everywhere,
nam mkha'i dbyings phyogs bcu kun nas nor bu'i rgyal po snang ba shin tu gsal bas phyogs kyi dbyings rnam par snang ba'i gos kyi sprin gyis yongs su rgyas par byin gyis brlab pa dang /
and clouds of robes of the finest jewels illumining everywhere with a radiant glow bursting into view everywhere,
nam mkha'i dbyings rin po che'i rgyal po rgya mtsho'i rgyan gyi gos kyi sprin gyis kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa byed cing /
and manifested the sky being covered by clouds of clothing made of kings of jewels as an ocean of adornments.
causing the sky to appear veiled in clouds of robes of jewels in oceanic arrays.

mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang na ba der lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste/ 'khor dang bcas pa bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas byang phyogs su brten te/ rin po che'i rgyal po rgya mtsho yongs su 'byung ba'i khang pa brtsegs pa dang / seng ge'i khri bai DUr+ya'i pad+mo'i snying po can dag mngon par sprul nas/ nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po seng ge mdzes pa'i dra bas yongs su brgyan pa dang / rin po che skar ma'i rgyal mtshan mgo la thogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lus su byin gyis brlabs nas; skyil mo krung bcas te 'khod do/ /

Together with his entourage, he approached the Bhagavat, bowed to the Bhagavat, and in the northern direction emanated kūṭāgāras of precious jewels that had emerged from oceans, each having in its center a lotus made of precious jewels like the banner of Devendra upon a lion throne, and he and his entourage seated themselves cross-legged upon the lotuses, with their bodhisattva bodies adorned with a network of beautiful lion images made of the kings of precious jewels and with precious star banners above their heads.

These the great enlightening being and company offered to the Buddha; they then went to the north and magically produced towers made of the finest pearls from the sea, as well as lion thrones inside jewel lotuses, and sat thereon, having covered their bodies with nets of majestic jewels and tied starlike pearls in their topknots.

byang dang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi khams rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi pha rol gyi 'jig rten gyi khams sa chen po thams cad du mdzes pa'i rin po che'i 'od zer gyi dra ba rab tu 'gyed pa zhes bya ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa mi dmigs pa'i spyan gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas/ byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi dbyings su shin tu 'phrul ba'i smon lam zla ba zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das des gnang nas/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho de nas 'phags te/

In the northeastern direction, beyond an ocean of world realms as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, there was the world realm Sarvamahāpṛthivīrājamaṇiraśmijālapramuktā, the Tathāgata Anilambhacakṣuṣa’s[102] buddha realm, where the bodhisattva Dharmadhātusunirmitapraṇidhicandra, together with bodhisattvas to the number of atoms in countless buddha realms, with the permission of the Bhagavat, rose up from that ocean of the assembly of followers,

From the northeast, beyond as many oceans of worlds as atoms in untold buddha-lands, from the land of the buddha Independent Eye, in the world Emanating Webs of Light Beams from All the Finest Jewels of the Earth, a great enlightening being named Supreme Moon of Vows Emanated through the Cosmos, together with a company of as many enlightening beings as atoms in untold oceans of worlds, given leave by that buddha and having disappeared from that assembly,
came to the Sahā world realm,
came to this world Endurance,
'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams thams cad rin po che'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i sprin gyis kun nas khebs par byin gyis brlab pa dang /
