and manifested all infinite world realms being covered by clouds of kūṭāgāras of precious materials;
'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams thams cad spos kyi khang pa brtsegs pa'i sprin gyis kun nas khebs par byin gyis brlab pa dang /
manifested all infinite world realms being covered by clouds of kūṭāgāras of perfumes;
'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams thams cad bdug spos kyi khang pa brtsegs pa'i sprin gyis kun nas khebs par byin gyis brlab pa dang /
manifested all infinite world realms being covered by clouds of kūṭāgāras of incense;
'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams thams cad tsan dan gyi khang pa brtsegs pa'i sprin gyis kun nas khebs par byin gyis brlab pa dang /
manifested all infinite world realms being covered by clouds of kūṭāgāras of sandalwood;
causing all worlds to be completely covered with clouds of sandalwood towers,
'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams thams cad me tog gi khang pa brtsegs pa'i sprin gyis kun nas khebs par byin gyis brlab pa dang /
manifested all infinite world realms being covered by clouds of kūṭāgāras of flowers;
clouds of flower towers,
'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams thams cad rin po che'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i sprin gyis kun nas khebs par byin gyis brlab pa dang /
manifested all infinite world realms being covered by clouds of kūṭāgāras of jewels;
clouds of pearl towers,
'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams thams cad rdo rje'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i sprin gyis kun nas khebs par byin gyis brlab pa dang /
manifested all infinite world realms being covered by clouds of kūṭāgāras of vajras;
clouds of diamond towers,
'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams thams cad gser gyi khang pa brtsegs pa'i sprin gyis kun nas khebs par byin gyis brlab pa dang /
manifested all infinite world realms being covered by clouds of kūṭāgāras of gold;
clouds of gold towers,
'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams thams cad gos kyi khang pa brtsegs pa'i sprin gyis kun nas khebs par byin gyis brlab pa dang /
manifested all infinite world realms being covered by clouds of kūṭāgāras of clothing;
clouds of towers of robes,
'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams thams cad pad+mo'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i sprin gyis kun nas khebs par byin gyis brlab pa byed cing /
and manifested all infinite world realms being covered by clouds of kūṭāgāras of lotuses.
and clouds of lotus towers.

mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang na ba der lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste/ 'khor dang bcas pas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas/ byang dang shar gyi phyogs mtshams su brten te/ nor bu rin po che'i khang pa brtsegs pa sgo chos kyi dbyings thams cad la mngon par lta ba dang / seng ge'i khri rin po che'i rgyal po spos mtshungs pa med pa'i pad+mo'i snying po can dag mngon par sprul nas/ rin po che'i rgyal po'i me tog gi dra bas yongs su brgyan pa dang / rin po che'i rgyal po mdzod sna tshogs kyi dra ba'i cod pan bcings pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lus su byin gyis brlabs nas/ skyil mo krung bcas te 'khod do/ /

Together with his entourage, he approached the Bhagavat, bowed to the Bhagavat, and in the northeastern direction emanated kūṭāgāras of precious jewels[103] that had gateways that looked out upon the entire realm of phenomena, each having in its center, upon a lion throne, a lotus of precious jewels and unequaled perfume, and he and his entourage seated themselves cross-legged upon the lotuses, with their bodhisattva bodies adorned with a network of flowers made of the kings of precious jewels and turbans that were like a network of various treasures of kings of jewels bound upon their heads.

The great enlightening being and company presented these to the Buddha, then went to the northeast and magically produced towers of enormous jewels, with turrets with doors looking on all things, and lion thrones in jewel lotuses of incomparable fragrance, and sat thereon, having covered their bodies with nets of the finest flowers and put on crowns of various interlaced jewels.

shar dang lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi pha rol gyi 'jig rten gyi khams spos kyi sprin bkod pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa klu dbang rgyal po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas/ byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi 'od 'phro ba dang ldan pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das des gnang nas/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho de nas 'phags te/

In the southeastern direction, beyond an ocean of world realms as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, there was the world realm Gandhameghavyūhadhvajā, the Tathāgata Nāgeśvararāja’s buddha realm, where the bodhisattva Dharmārciṣmattejorāja, together with bodhisattvas to the number of atoms in countless buddha realms, with the permission of the Bhagavat, rose up from that ocean of the assembly of followers,

From the southeast, beyond as many oceans of worlds as atoms in untold buddha-lands, from the land of the buddha Dragon King, in the world Banner of Arrays of Clouds of Fragrance, an enlightening being named King of Fiery Energy of Truth, together with as many enlightening beings as atoms in untold oceans of worlds, given leave by that buddha and having disappeared from that assembly,
came to the Sahā world realm,
came to this world Endurance,
nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i sprin gyi kha dog kun tu khyab par bya ba dang /
and covered the entire sky with clouds of disks of light the color of gold,
covering the whole sky with clouds of spheres of golden light,
nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad rin po che kha dog mtha' yas pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin gyis kun tu khyab par bya ba dang /
covered the entire sky with clouds of disks of light the infinite colors of jewels,
clouds of spheres of light of jewels of infinite colors,
nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzod spu'i kha dog gi 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin gyis kun tu khyab par bya ba dang /
covered the entire sky with clouds of disks of light the color of the ūrṇā hair of the tathāgatas,
clouds of spheres of light the color of the curl of hair between the Buddha’s eyebrows,
nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad rin po che sna tshogs kyi kha dog lta bu'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin gyis kun tu khyab par bya ba dang /
covered the entire sky with clouds of disks of light the color of various jewels,
clouds of spheres of light of various jewel colors,
nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad pad+mo'i snying po'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin gyis kun tu khyab par bya ba dang /
covered the entire sky with clouds of disks of light the color of the center of lotuses,
clouds of spheres of light the color of the inside of lotuses,
nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad nor bu'i rgyal po/ rin po che'i shing gi yal ga'i dkyil 'khor lta bu'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin gyis kun tu khyab par bya ba dang /
covered the entire sky with clouds of disks of light the color of disks made of the branches of trees made of the precious kings of jewels,
clouds of spheres of light the color of superb jewels like circles of branches of jewel trees,
nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor lta bu'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin gyis kun tu khyab par bya ba dang /
covered the entire sky with clouds of disks of light the color of the uṣṇīṣas of the tathāgatas,
clouds of spheres of light like the knot on the head of Buddha,
nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad 'dzam bu'i chu klung gi gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin gyis kun tu khyab par bya ba dang /
covered the entire sky with clouds of disks of light the color of Jambu River gold,
clouds of spheres of light the color of fine gold,
nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad nyi ma'i kha dog lta bu'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin gyis kun tu khyab par bya ba dang /
covered the entire sky with clouds of disks of light the color of the sun,
clouds of spheres of light the color of the sun,
nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad zla ba dang / skar ma'i tshogs kyi kha dog lta bu'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin gyis kun tu khyab par byed cing /
and covered the entire sky with clouds of disks of light the color of the moon and the stars.
and clouds of forms of the discs of the sun and moon and stars.
mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang na ba der lhags nas/
[…see above…]
[…see above…]

bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste/ 'khor dang bcas pas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas/ shar dang lho'i phyogs mtshams su brten te/ rin po che rdul dang bral zhing rnam par snang ba phun sum tshogs pa'i me tog gi khang pa brtsegs pa dang / seng ge'i khri rin po che seng ge rdo rje'i pad+mo'i snying po can dag mngon par sprul nas/ nor bu'i rgyal po rin po che'i 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba'i dra bas yongs su brgyan pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lus su byin gyis brlabs nas skyil mo krung bcas te 'khod do/ /

Together with his entourage, he approached the Bhagavat, bowed to the Bhagavat, and in the southeastern direction emanated kūṭāgāras of perfect shining flowers of pristine jewels, each having in its center a lotus of lion-vajra jewels upon a lion throne, and he and his entourage seated themselves cross-legged upon the lotuses, their bodhisattva bodies adorned with a network of precious kings of brightly shining jewels.

The great enlightening being and company brought and presented these to the Buddha, then went to the southeast and magically produced towers of flowers of coolly shining pearly radiance, and lion thrones in lotuses of excellent diamonds, and sat there, having covered their bodies with the finest pearls blazing with jewel light.

lho dang nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi pha rol gyi 'jig rten gyi khams rin po che'i nyi ma rab tu snang ba'i snying po zhes bya ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi 'khor lo'i ye shes kun tu snang ba'i rgyal po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas/ byang chub sems dpa' bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad rnam par 'thor ba'i ye shes rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das des gnang nas/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho de nas 'phags te/

In the southwestern direction, beyond an ocean of world realms as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, there was the world realm Maṇisūryapratibhāsagarbhā, the Tathāgata Dharmacandrasamantajñānāvabhāsarāja’s buddha realm, where the bodhisattva Sarvamāramaṇḍalavikiraṇajñānadhvaja, together with bodhisattvas to the number of atoms in countless buddha realms, with the permission of the Bhagavat, rose up from that ocean of the assembly of followers,

From the southwest, beyond as many oceans of worlds as atoms in untold buddha-lands, from the land of the buddha King of Universal Light of Knowledge of the Moon of Truth, in the world Filled with Jewel Sunlight, a great enlightening being named Standard of Knowledge Scattering All Bands of Demons, together with a company of as many enlightening beings as atoms in untold oceans of worlds, given leave by that buddha and having disappeared from that world,
came to the Sahā world realm,
came to this world Endurance,
ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas me tog 'od 'phro ba'i sprin/ nam mkha'i dbyings ltar yangs pa rab tu dgye ba dang /
and emanated from all his pores clouds of light rays from flowers, which were as vast as the element of space;
from every pore issuing, to the farthest reaches of space, shining clouds of flowers,
ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas rol mo 'od 'phro ba'i sprin nam mkha'i dbyings ltar yangs pa rab tu dgye ba dang /
emanated from all his pores clouds of light rays from musical instruments, which were as vast as the element of space;
shining clouds of all kinds of music,
ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas nor bu rin po che 'od 'phro ba'i sprin nam mkha'i dbyings ltar yangs pa rab tu dgye ba dang /
emanated from all his pores clouds of light rays from precious jewels, which were as vast as the element of space;
shining clouds of jewels,
ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas rin po che'i gos 'od 'phro ba/ spos dang bdug spos sna tshogs kyis rnam par bdug pa'i sprin nam mkha'i dbyings ltar yangs pa rab tu dgye ba dang /
emanated from all his pores clouds of light rays from precious clothing perfumed by incenses and perfumes of all kinds,[104] which were as vast as the element of space;
shining clouds of precious robes emitting aromatic vapors of various scents,
ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas klus rnam par sprul pa'i glog 'od 'phro ba'i sprin nam mkha'i dbyings ltar yangs pa rab tu dgye ba dang /
emanated from all his pores clouds of light rays from lightning emanated by nāgas, which were as vast as the element of space;
shining clouds of lightning produced by water spirits,
ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas nor bu rin po che rnam par snang ba 'od 'phro ba'i sprin nam mkha'i dbyings ltar yangs pa rab tu dgye ba dang /
emanated from all his pores clouds of light rays from bright, precious jewels, which were as vast as the element of space;
shining clouds of radiant jewels,
ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas nor bu rin po che gser rab tu 'bar ba 'od 'phro ba'i sprin nam mkha'i dbyings ltar yangs pa rab tu dgye ba dang /
emanated from all his pores clouds of light rays from shining gold and precious jewels, which were as vast as the element of space;
shining clouds of blazing gold jewels,
ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas rin po che'i rgyal po dpal gyi snying po 'bar ba 'od 'phro ba'i sprin nam mkha'i dbyings ltar yangs pa rab tu dgye ba dang /
emanated from all his pores clouds of light rays from shining kings of jewels that were the essence of splendor, which were as vast as the element of space;
shining clouds of the blaze of diamonds from splendorous mines,

ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas nor bu rin po che de bzhin gshegs pa'i dgongs pa rgya mtsho ltar dus gsum gyi rgyud rab tu snang ba'i tshul dang ldan pa 'od 'phro ba'i sprin nam mkha'i dbyings ltar yangs pa rab tu dgye ba byed cing /

and emanated from all his pores clouds of light rays from precious jewels that had the nature of illuminating the extent of the three times, like the ocean of the awareness of the tathāgatas, spreading throughout the element of space.
and shining clouds of eye-jewels illumining the seeds of events of past, present, and future, like the ocean of memory of the enlightened.
mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang na ba der lhags nas/
[…see above…]
[…see above…]

bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste/ 'khor dang bcas pas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas/ lho dang nub kyi phyogs mtshams su brtan te/ nor bu rin po che chen po 'od zer gyi dra ba phyogs kun tu mngon par gzhol ba'i thig les chos kyis dbyings thams cad du rab tu snang ba'i khang pa brtsegs pa dang / seng ge'i khri nor bu rin po che spos kyi sgron ma'i 'od 'phro ba'i pad+mo'i snying po can dag mngon par sprul nas; rin po che'i rgyal po dri ma med pa'i snying po'i dra bas yongs su brgyan pa dang / rin po che'i rgyal po sems can thams cad rab tu 'dzud pa'i dbyangs dang ldan pa'i cod pan bcings pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lus su byin gyis brlabs nas skyil mo krung bcas te 'khod do/ /

Together with his entourage, he approached the Bhagavat, bowed to the Bhagavat, and in the southwestern direction emanated kūṭāgāras with networks of great precious jewels that illuminated the entire realm of phenomena, each having in its center a lotus that radiated light rays of perfumed lamps upon a lion throne, and he and his entourage seated themselves cross-legged upon the lotuses, with their bodhisattva bodies adorned with networks of the stainless essences of kings of jewels and with turbans of kings of jewels that emitted words that guided all beings[105] bound upon their heads.

The great enlightening being and company presented these to the Buddha, then withdrew to the southwest and magically produced towers of great jewels illumining the cosmos, particles of a web of light beams radiating in all directions, and lion thrones in lotuses of shining jewels like fragrant lamps, whereon they sat, having covered their bodies with nets of the finest jewels from pure mines and put on crowns of the finest jewels reverberating with the sounds of the abodes of all beings.

nub dang byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi pha rol gyi 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po zhes bya ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa dpal gyi ri bo kun nas rnam par snang ba'i rgyal po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnam par snang ba'i smon lam ye shes dpal zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das des gnang nas/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho de nas 'phags te/ mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po thams cad dang / ba spu'i sgo thams cad dang / lus thams cad nas dus gsum du gshegs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gzugs brnyan gyi sprin kun tu dgye ba dang / mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po thams cad dang / ba spu'i sgo thams cad dang / lus thams cad nas dus gsum du byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi lus kyi gzugs brnyan gyi sprin kun tu dgye ba dang / mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po thams cad dang / ba spu'i sgo thams cad dang / lus thams cad nas dus gsum du gshegs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi lus kyi gzugs brnyan gyi sprin kun tu dgye ba dang /

In the northwestern direction, beyond an ocean of world realms as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, there was the world realm Vairocanaśrīpraṇidhigarbhā,[106] the Tathāgata Samantavairocanaśrīmerurāja’s buddha realm, where the bodhisattva Vairocanapraṇidhijñānaketu, together with bodhisattvas to the number of atoms in countless buddha realms, with the permission of the Bhagavat, rose up from that ocean of the assembly of followers, came to the Sahā world realm, and emanated, from all his signs and features of a great being, all his pores, and his entire body, clouds of images of the bodies of all the tathāgatas who appear in the three times; emanated, from all his signs and features of a great being, all his pores, and his entire body, clouds of images of the bodies of all the bodhisattvas who appear in the three times; emanated, from all his signs and features of a great being, all his pores, and his entire body, clouds of images of the bodies of all the assemblies of followers of all the tathāgatas who appear in the three times;

From the northwest, beyond as many oceans of worlds as atoms in untold buddha-lands, from the land of the buddha Majestic King of Radiant Splendor, in the world Containing Vows of Illumination, a great enlightening being named Flame of Knowledge of Vows of Illumination, together with a company of as many enlightening beings as atoms in untold oceans of worlds, given leave by that buddha and having disappeared from that assembly, came to this world Endurance, emanating from every physical characteristic, every pore, every part of the body, clouds of physical images of the buddhas of past, present, and future, clouds of physical images of the enlightening beings of past, present, and future, clouds of physical images of the audiences of the buddhas of past, present, and future,

mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po thams cad dang / ba spu'i sgo thams cad dang / lus thams cad nas dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sprul ba'i tshogs kyi gzugs brnyan mang po'i sprin kun tu dgye ba dang / mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po thams cad dang / ba spu'i sgo thams cad dang / lus thams cad nas dus gsum du gshegs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sngon gyi sbyor ba'i gzugs brnyan mang po'i sprin kun tu dgye ba dang / mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po thams cad dang / ba spu'i sgo thams cad dang / lus thams cad nas dus gsum du byung ba'i nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi lus kyi gzugs brnyan rab tu dgye ba dang / mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po thams cad dang / ba spu'i sgo thams cad dang / lus thams cad nas dus gsum du gshegs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po byang chub dang / byang chub kyi shing gi gzugs kyi gzugs brnyan gyi sprin kun du dgye ba dang / mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po thams cad dang / ba spu'i sgo thams cad dang / lus thams cad nas dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul ba'i gzugs brnyan mang po'i sprin kun tu dgye ba dang / mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po thams cad dang / ba spu'i sgo thams cad dang / lus thams cad nas dus gsum du byung ba'i 'jig rten gyi dbang po thams cad kyi lus kyi gzugs brnyan gyi sprin kun tu dgye ba dang / mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po thams cad dang / ba spu'i sgo thams cad dang / lus thams cad nas dus gsum du byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa thams cad kyi gzugs brnyan gyi sprin kun tu dgye bas

emanated, from all his signs and features of a great being, all his pores, and his entire body, clouds of images of the bodies of all the hosts of emanations of all the tathāgatas who appear in the three times; emanated, from all his signs and features of a great being, all his pores, and his entire body, clouds of images of all the past practices of all the tathāgatas who appear in the three times; emanated, from all his signs and features of a great being, all his pores, and his entire body, clouds of images of the bodies of all śrāvakas and pratyekabuddhas who appear in the three times; emanated, from all his signs and features of a great being, all his pores, and his entire body, clouds of images of the forms of all the bodhimaṇḍas and Bodhi trees of all the tathāgatas who appear in the three times; emanated, from all his signs and features of a great being, all his pores, and his entire body, clouds of the many images of the miracles of all the tathāgatas who appear in the three times; emanated, from all his signs and features of a great being, all his pores, and his entire body, clouds of images of the bodies of all world-lords who appear in the three times; and emanated, from all his signs and features of a great being, all his pores, and his entire body, clouds of images of the pure realms of the buddhas who have appeared in the three times.

clouds of images of the spheres of emanations of the buddhas of past, present, and future, clouds of embodiments of images of the past efforts of the buddhas of past, present, and future, clouds of physical images of all hearers and individual illuminates of past, present, and future, clouds of images of the bodies of the buddhas of all times and the forms of the trees at their sites of enlightenment, clouds of embodiments of images of the miracles of the buddhas of past, present, and future, clouds of physical images of the rulers of the worlds of past, present, and future, and clouds of all the purified buddha-lands of past, present, and future, these all pervading space from moment to moment.

skad cig skad cig tu nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad rgyas par 'gengs shing / mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang na ba der lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste/ 'khor dang bcas pas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas; nub dang byang gi phyogs mtshams su brtan te/ rin po che'i rgyal po phyogs kun nas rnam par snang ba'i snying po'i seng ge'i khri rin po che 'gro ba rnam par snang ba'i pad+mo'i snying po can dag mngon par sprul nas/ mu tig 'od thub pa med pa'i dra bas yongs su brgyan pa dang / rin po che 'od kun tu snang ba'i cod pan bcings pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lus su byin gyis brlabs nas/ skyil mo krung bcas te 'khod do/ /

Instantly these filled the entire element of space, and together with his entourage, he approached the Bhagavat, bowed to the Bhagavat, and in the northwestern direction emanated kūṭāgāras with the essence of the kings of jewels that illuminated every direction, each having in its center, upon a lion throne, a precious lotus that illuminated the directions, and he and his entourage seated themselves cross-legged upon the lotuses, with their bodhisattva bodies adorned with networks of the invincible light of pearls and with turbans that had the illuminating light of all jewels bound upon their heads.

The great enlightening being and company came to the Buddha, presented these, then withdrew to the northwest and magically produced towers containing the finest jewels illumining all quarters and lion thrones in lotuses made of jewels illuminating the world, and sat thereon, having covered their bodies with nets emanating unstoppable light and put on crowns of jewels whose radiance illumined everywhere.

'og gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi pha rol gyi 'jig rten gyi khams/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par snang ba zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes nam mkha' lta bur chags pa med pa'i dpal gyi rgyal mtshan rgyal po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas/ byang chub sems dpa' bsgribs pa thams cad rnam par 'thor ba'i ye shes kyis rnam par gnon pa zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das des gnang nas/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho de nas 'phags te/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas 'gro ba thams cad kyi skad dang / sgra dang / dbyangs dang / nges pa'i tshig mngon par bsgrubs pa rgya mtsho rab tu brjod pa dang /

In the downward direction, beyond an ocean of world realms as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, there was the world realm Sarvatathāgataprabhāmaṇḍalavairocanā, the Tathāgata Asaṅgajñānaketudhvajarāja’s buddha realm, where the bodhisattva Sarvāvaraṇavikiraṇajñānavikrāmin, together with bodhisattvas to the number of atoms in countless buddha realms, with the permission of the Bhagavat, rose up from that ocean of the assembly of followers, came to the Sahā world realm, and there resounded,[107] from all his pores, an ocean of the languages,[108] sounds, speech, and word definitions of all beings;

From the nadir, beyond as many oceans of worlds as atoms in untold buddha-lands, from the land of the buddha King of the Banner of the Torch of Unobstructed Knowledge, in the world Radiance of the Halos of All Buddhas, a great enlightening being named Valiant One with Knowledge to Dissolve All Barriers, together with a company of as many enlightening beings as atoms in untold oceans of worlds, given leave by that buddha and having disappeared from that assembly, came to this world Endurance, emitting from every pore the sounds of utterances of the ocean of all incantations in the world,
dus gsum gyi byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'byung ba'i tshul rgya mtsho'i sprin gyi 'brug sgra rab tu bsgrags pa dang /
there resounded the thunder of an ocean of clouds of the descriptions of how all the bodhisattvas in the three times originated;
the sounds of the clouds of the oceans of instruction of the enlightening beings of past, present, and future,
byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi smon lam mngon par bsgrub pa'i tshul rgya mtsho'i dbyangs rab tu bsgrags pa dang /
there resounded an ocean of clouds of the descriptions of how all the bodhisattvas in the three times fulfilled their aspirations;
sounds of the ocean of vows, undertakings, and methods of all enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i tshul rgya mtsho'i sprin gyis sgra rab tu bsgrags pa dang /
there sounded an ocean of clouds of the descriptions of how all bodhisattvas correctly accomplished the perfections;
sounds of the ocean of enlightening beings’ means of pervading all lands with their spheres of action,
byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor zhing thams cad du rgyas par 'gengs pa'i tshul rgya mtsho'i dbyangs rab tu bsgrags pa dang /
there resounded clouds of oceans of descriptions of how the field of conduct of all bodhisattvas pervaded all realms;
sounds of the clouds of the oceans of all enlightening beings’ means of purification and fulfillment of the ways of transcendence,
byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi yang dag par bsgrub pa dang / rnam par 'phrul pa'i tshul rgya mtsho'i dbyangs rab tu bsgrag pa dang /
there sounded an ocean of clouds of the descriptions of the accomplishments and miracles of all bodhisattvas;
sounds of the ocean of means of the accomplishments and spiritual effects of all enlightening beings,

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad byang chub pa'i snying por gshegs pa dang / bdud kyi dkrugs ma rnam par 'thor ba dang / byang chub pa'i snying por rnam par 'tshang rgya ba dang / rnam par 'phrul pa mdzad pa'i dbyangs rgya mtsho rab tu bsgrag pa dang /
there resounded an ocean of descriptions of how all tathāgatas went to the bodhimaṇḍa, dissipated the disturbances of Māra, attained buddhahood at the bodhimaṇḍa, and manifested miracles;
oceans of expressions of the spiritual transformations by means of which all buddhas go to the summit of enlightenment, disperse the opposition of demons, and realize enlightenment,
de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / mdo sde'i tshul dang / ming rgya mtsho'i dbyangs kyi sprin gyi 'brug sgra bsgrag pa dang /
there resounded[109] the thunder of an ocean of clouds of the descriptions of the ways and names of the sūtras and how all tathāgatas turned the wheel of the Dharma;
clouds of sounds of the ocean of words used by all buddhas in turning the wheel of the teaching,
'gro ba 'dul ba thams cad dus la bab pa'i 'khor los 'dul ba'i chos kyi tshul dang thabs kyi sgra rab tu bsgrag pa dang /
there resounded descriptions of the ways and methods of the guiding Dharma that guides all beings through its timely wheel;
expressions of the expedient means of teaching and training used to guide all people at the appropriate times,

ye shes thams cad khong du chud par bya ba'i phyir/ smon lam ji ltar btab pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba'i khyad par dang / dus dang / thabs dang / chos kyi tshul rgya mtsho'i dbyangs rab tu bsgrag pa byed cing /
and there resounded an ocean of descriptions of the aspirations that were made, the particular roots of merit, the time, the methods, and the Dharma, in order to gain the realization of all wisdom.
sounds of the ocean of means of teaching using methods appropriate to the aspiration, excellence of roots of goodness, and time, in order to lead to all-knowledge. Emanating these sounds,

mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang na ba der lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste/ 'khor dang bcas pas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas/ 'og gi phyogs su brtan te; de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gzhal med khang gzugs brnyan rab tu snang ba'i rin po che sna tshogs thams cad kyi mdzod kyi khang pa brtsegs pa dang / seng ge'i khri rin po che thams cad kyi gzugs kyi pad+mo'i snying po yongs su bzung ba dag mngon par sprul nas/ rin po che'i snying po byang chub thams cad kyi gzugs brnyan rab tu snang ba'i rgyal mtshan gyi cod pan mgo la bcings pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lus su byin gyis brlabs nas/ skyil mo krung bcas te 'khod do/ /

He approached the Bhagavat, bowed to the Bhagavat, and in the downward direction emanated kūṭāgāras that were treasures of all the various kinds of shining jewels in the image of the aerial palaces of all the tathāgatas, each having in its center a lotus of every kind of jewel upon a lion throne. He and his entourage seated themselves cross-legged upon the lotuses, with turbans that were banners shining with the images of all precious bodhimaṇḍas bound upon their heads.[110]

the great enlightening being and company came to the Buddha and offered them in respect, then withdrew to the nadir, magically produced towers of various mines of all kinds of jewels from the matrix of light of the palaces of all buddhas, as well as lion thrones in spaces held by lotuses inset with all jewels, upon which they sat, having put on crests of jewel emblems reflecting images of all sites of enlightenment and covered their bodies with nets of the finest jewels illumining all lands.

steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi pha rol gyi 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi rigs mi zad pa shin tu ston pa zhes bya ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor kun tu snang ba'i dbyings kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas/ byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi dbyings kyi smon lam gyi gzhi rab tu rtogs pa zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das des gnang nas/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho de nas 'phags te/

In the upward direction, beyond an ocean of world realms as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, there was the world realm Akṣayabuddhavaṃśanirdeśā, the Tathāgata Samantajñānamaṇḍalapratibhāsanirghoṣa’s buddha realm, where the bodhisattva Dharmadhātupraṇidhitalanirbheda, together with bodhisattvas to the number of atoms in countless buddha realms, with the permission of the Bhagavat, rose up from that ocean of the assembly of followers,

From the zenith, beyond as many oceans of worlds as atoms in untold buddha-lands, from the land of the buddha Voice Revealing the Sphere of Universal Knowledge, in the world Description of the Inexhaustible Lineage of Buddhas, a great enlightening being named Revealing the Base of Cosmic Aspiration, together with a company of as many enlightening beings as atoms in untold oceans of worlds, given leave by that buddha and having disappeared from that assembly,
came to the Sahā world realm,
came to this world Endurance,

mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po thams cad dang / ba spu'i sgo thams cad dang / lus thams cad dang / yan lag dang nying lag thams cad dang / tshig gi lam thams cad dang / gos dang / smad g.yogs thams cad nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor thams cad dang / bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad dang / sngon gyi mtha'i mur thug pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa 'das pa thams cad dang / phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa lung bstan pa dang / lung ma bstan pa dang / ma byon pa thams cad dang / da ltar byung ba phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab 'byams thams cad na bzhugs pa rnams kyi sngon sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mdzad pa dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba rgya mtsho dang / len pa dang / sbyin pa'i dngos po thams cad kyi gzugs brnyan mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po dang / ba spu'i sgo dang / lus thams cad dang / yan lag dang / nying lag dang / tshig gi lam dang / gos dang / smad g.yogs thams cad la rab tu snang bar gyur par rnam par bstan pa dang /

and from all his signs and features of a great being, all his pores, his entire body, all his limbs, his fingers and toes, the words he spoke, and his robe and his skirt he revealed, within all his signs and features of a great being, all his pores, his entire body, all his limbs, his fingers and toes, the words he spoke, and his robe and his skirt, the images of an ocean of the past practice of engaging in the perfection of generosity, and all the recipients and the gifts[111] of all of the assemblies of bodhisattvas, of himself, of the Bhagavat Vairocana, of all the tathāgatas throughout the past, of all prophesied and unprophesied tathāgatas throughout the future who have yet to come, and of all who in the present reside in infinite buddha realms in the ten directions.

from every physical feature, every pore, every part of the body, every limb and joint, every utterance, every article of clothing and adornment, showing images of the oceans of past efforts of all buddhas past, present, and future connected with transcendent giving which took place in all lands of the ten directions, as well as images of the receivers and the gifts, reflected in every mark and embellishment, every pore, every part of the body, every limb and joint, every utterance, every article of clothing and adornment of the company of enlightening beings as well as the buddha Vairocana;
tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba rgya mtsho dag kyang rab tu snang bar yongs su bstan pa dang /
He made visible the images of an ocean of the entire past practice of engaging in the perfection of correct conduct.
showing reflections of the oceans of their past efforts involved in transcendent morality,
bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa/ yan lag dang / nying lag thams cad 'thub pa rab tu bstan pa dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba rgya mtsho rab tu snang bar gyur pa yongs su bstan pa dang /
He made visible the images of an ocean of the past practice of engaging in the perfection of patience through his limbs, his fingers, and his toes being cut off.
in transcendent tolerance—even involving showing amputation of limbs,
byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi brtson 'grus dang / drag shul dang / rnam par gnon pa dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba rgya mtsho rab tu snang bar gyur pa yongs su bstan pa dang /
He made visible the images of an ocean of the past practice of the diligence, vehemence, and prowess of all bodhisattvas.
in the transcendent energy of all enlightening beings, surging boldly forward,
de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bsam gtan rgya mtsho yongs su tshol zhing rab tu bsgrub pa dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba rgya mtsho rab tu snang bar gyur pa yongs su bstan pa dang /
He made visible the images of an ocean of the past practice of seeking the dhyāna of all the tathāgatas.
in the seeking and attainment of the ocean of meditations of all buddhas,
de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshul yongs su bsgrub cing chos yongs su tshol ba dang ldan pa dang / bdog pa thams cad yongs su gtong zhing /
He revealed the images of an ocean of the past practices of engaging in perfecting the way of the Dharma wheel of all the tathāgatas,
in the seeking of the ultimate truth to which the wheel of teaching of all buddhas leads,
shin tu zhe non pa'i lus dang / ngo'i gzugs brnyan rnam par dmigs par bya bas sngon gyi sbyor ba rgya mtsho rab tu snang bar gyur pa yongs su bstan pa dang /
and he revealed the bodies and faces of those seeking the Dharma with great resolve giving away all possessions.
in the manifestation of the embodiment of great determination which relinquishes all there is,

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mthong zhing dga' ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi lam la 'gro ba thams cad mngon par mos par byed pa dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba rgya mtsho rab tu snang bar gyur pa yongs su bstan pa dang /
He revealed the appearances of an ocean of the past practices of rejoicing in seeing all the tathāgatas, the path of all bodhisattvas, and bringing illumination[112] to all beings.
in the joy of the vision of all buddhas, the path of all enlightening beings, and pleasing all beings,
byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi smon lam rgya mtsho mngon par grub pa'i sgo yongs su dag pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba rgya mtsho rab tu snang bar gyur pa yongs su bstan pa dang /
He revealed the appearances of an ocean of the past practices of the fulfillment of an ocean of prayers by all bodhisattvas through which there is a display[113] of perfect purification.
in the arrangements of purification of means of accomplishment of the ocean of vows of all enlightening beings,

byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rab tu grub pa dang / rnam par mngon pa dang / rnam par dag par byas pa dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba rgya mtsho rab tu snang bar gyur pa yongs su bstan pa dang /
He revealed the appearances of an ocean of the past practice of engaging in the accomplishment, prowess, and purification of the perfection of strength of all bodhisattvas.
in the purification of the strength of the attainment of transcendent power of all enlightening beings;

chos kyi dbyings rgya chen po rnam par 'phrul pa thams cad kyi sprin gyis rgyas par bkang ste/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba rgya mtsho rab tu snang bar gyur pa yongs su bstan pa byed cing /

Filling the vast expanse of the realm of phenomena with clouds of all miraculous manifestation, he revealed the appearances of an ocean of the past practice endowed with the domain of the wisdom of all bodhisattvas.

and showing images of the oceans of past efforts involved in the sphere of knowledge of all enlightening beings—all these reflected images bursting into plain view by clouds of all kinds of miraculous displays throughout the cosmos.
mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang na ba der lhags nas/
[…see above…]
[…see above…]

bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste/ 'khor dang bcas pas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas/ steng gi phyogs su brten te/ rdo rje dbang po sna tshogs thams cad kyi rgyan gyi snying po can gyi khang pa brtsegs pa dang / seng ge'i khri rdo rje dang / in+d+ra nI la'i pad+mo'i snying po can dag mngon par sprul nas nor bu'i rgyal po rin po che thams cad rab tu 'bar ba'i dra bas kun nas brgyan pa dang / rin po che'i rgyal po dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan dang dbyangs su sgrog pa'i phreng ba rab tu 'phyang ba dang / mgo la rin po che'i cod pan thogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lus su byin gyis brlabs nas; skyil mo krung bcas te 'khod do// //

He approached the Bhagavat, bowed to the Bhagavat, and in the upward direction emanated kūṭāgāras that were adorned by all kinds of lords of vajras, each having in its center a lotus of sapphires upon a lion throne. He and his entourage, their blessed bodies adorned by a network of all shining precious kings of jewels and hung with necklaces of the kings of jewels from which sounded the names of the tathāgatas of the three times, and their heads bound by precious turbans, seated themselves cross-legged upon the lotuses.

The great enlightening being and company offered these to the Buddha, then went to the zenith, magically produced towers of various arrays of diamonds as well as lion thrones of the universally good enlightening being inside emerald lotuses, and sat thereon, having covered their bodies with nets of fiery jewels and put on crowns of jewels with crests of trailing strings of diamonds vibrating with the names of the buddhas of past, present, and future.
ba ma po brgyad cu bdun pa/
byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang 'khor dang bcas par/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa dang / smon lam gyis byung ba/
All those bodhisattvas and their entourages had become so through the completely good conduct and prayer of bodhisattvas.
All those enlightening beings, with their retinues, were born of the practices and vows of the Universally Good enlightening being;
de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhabs kyi drung nas zhal du lta ba ye shes yongs su dag pa'i mig dang ldan pa/
They had been at the feet of all tathāgatas and gazed upon their faces. They possessed the completely pure eyes of wisdom.
they had the pure eye of knowledge to see all buddhas face to face;
de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo dang / mdo sde'i tshul gyis gsung rgya mtsho la rna ba yongs su gzhol ba/
The ocean of the teaching of the way of the sūtras and the wheel of the Dharma of all the tathāgatas had entered their ears.
they were endowed with the acute ears to hear the ocean of teachings of all buddhas;
byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dbang rab tu thob par bya ba la pha rol tu phyin pa'i mchog thob pa/
They had perfectly perfected the perfections that bring the attainment of the power of all bodhisattvas.
they had reached the ultimate transcendent attainment of the masteries of all enlightening beings;
de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi drung du 'dong ba/ skad cig skad cig tu yongs su bstan par rnam par 'phrul pas byung ba/
In each instant they manifested the miracle of going into the presence of all tathāgatas.
from moment to moment they issued manifestations of going to all buddhas;
'jig rten gyi khams thams cad lus gcig gis rgyas par dgang ba'i yul dang ldan pa/
They had the range of pervading all worlds with a single body.
they were in the range of pervading all worlds with one body;
de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du lus su mngon par 'byung zhing /
They manifested the appearance of their bodies being present in the assemblies of the pupils of all tathāgatas.
they had luminous bodies appearing in the circles of the congregations of all buddhas;
rnam par snang ba rdul shin tu phra ba gcig la 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khams gcig tu snang zhing khongs su chud par yang dag par ston pa'i yul dang ldan pa/
They had the range of activity of manifesting all worlds being included within one world that is within a single atom.
they were in the realm of showing the reflections of all worlds and one world contained in each other in a single atom;
'gro ba thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang / gdul ba'i dus la sdod par gzhol ba/
They ripened all beings, being present at the exact time for guiding them.
they had the power to guide and develop all people with appropriate timing;
de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo'i sprin gyi 'brug sgra/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas rab tu sgrog pa'i yul dang ldan pa/
They had the range of activity of emitting from all their pores the thunder of the clouds of the Dharma wheel of all the tathāgatas.
they were in the realm of emitting clouds of teachings of all buddhas from every pore;
sems can gyi khams thams cad sgyu ma lta bur yongs su shes pa rab tu thob pa/
They had attained the knowledge that all the realms of beings were like magical tricks.
they had attained the knowledge that all realms of beings are like illusions;
de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mig yor lta bur khong du chud pa/
They had realized that all the tathāgatas are like illusions.
they had realized that all buddhas are like reflections;
srid pa'i rgyud du skye ba thams cad rmi lam lta bu shes par byung ba/
They were purified by the knowledge that all rebirths within the continuation of existence were like dreams.
they knew that all existence, states of beings, and births are like dreams;
las dang rnam par smin pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bur shes pas rnam par dag pa/
they had pure knowledge that all developments of actions are like images in a mirror;
ye shes mngon par grub pa thams cad smig rgyu lta bur mngon par shes pa/
They knew that all accomplishments of wisdom are like mirages.
they were intensely aware that all becoming is like a mirage;
'jig rten gyi khams 'byams klas pa thams cad sprul pa lta bur khong du chud pa/
They had realized that all infinite worlds are like illusory manifestations.
they perceived that all worlds are like emanations;
de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / ye shes kyi snang ba rab tu thob pa/
They had attained the ten strengths of the tathāgatas and the light of wisdom.
they had attained the illumination of the knowledges of the ten powers of buddhas;
mi 'jigs pa'i khyu mchog dang / seng ge'i nga ros rnam par gnon pa/
They were supreme beings of fearlessness and had the forcefulness of the lion’s roar.
they were fearless and mighty, able to roar the lion’s roar;
tha dad pa yang dag par shes pa/ mi zad pa'i rgya mtshor zhugs pa/
They had entered the inexhaustible ocean of unique knowledge.
they had entered the inexhaustible ocean of analytic knowledge;
'gro ba thams cad kyi skad rgya mtsho dang / chos kyi nges pa'i tshig gi ye shes rab tu thob pa/
They had obtained the ocean of the languages of beings and the wisdom of the meaning of the words of the Dharma.
they had attained knowledge of expressions of principles of the ocean of instruments of thought of all people;
chos kyi dbyings dang nam mkha' ltar chags pa med pa'i ye shes kyi spyod yul dang ldan pa/
They possessed an unimpeded scope of wisdom that was as vast as the realm of phenomena and space.
they coursed in the knowledge of the unobstructed space of the reality realm;
chos thams cad la bsgribs pa med pa'i ye shes rab tu thob pa/
they had attained unimpeded knowledge of all things;
byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi mngon par shes pa ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa/
They possessed the pure domain of the wisdom of the clairvoyances of all bodhisattvas.
they had purified the spheres of superknowledges of all enlightening beings;
bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad rnam par dkrug pa'i brtson 'grus dang ldan pa/
They possessed the diligence that disrupts the domain of all the māras.
they had the rigor to roust out all bands of demons;
dus gsum thams cad shes pa'i stobs la rab tu gnas pa/
They were established in the power of knowing the three times.
they stood firm in the power of knowledge of past, present, and future;
chos thams cad la ye shes bsgribs pa med pa rab tu thob pa/
They had attained the unobscured wisdom of all phenomena.
they had attained unobstructed omniscience;
gnas med pas nam mkha'i spyod yul dang ldan pa/
They had the field of activity of space without any base.
they coursed in the space of independence;
thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa len pa med pa/ nam mkha' lta bu'i brtson 'grus dang ldan pa/
They had everlasting[114] omniscience. They had diligence as vast as space.[115]
they were powerful in the space of the effortless stage of omniscience;
srid pa thams cad mi dmigs pa'i ye shes kyi spyod yul can/
They had the range of wisdom that did not focus on all existences as its object.
they coursed in knowledge of the ungraspability of all existence;
chos kyi dbyings thams cad kyi tshul rgya mtsho la rab tu zhugs pa/
They had the pervading wisdom[116] of the ocean of processes of the entire realm of phenomena.
they had exposed the knowledge of the ocean of principles of all realms of reality;
'jig rten gyi khams thams cad tha mi dad pa'i ye shes kyi sgor zhugs pa/
They had entered through the gateway of the nondifferentiating wisdom of all world realms.
they had entered the door of nondiscriminatory knowledge of all worlds;
'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gcig nas gcig tu gzung ba'i rnam par 'phrul pas byung ba/
They demonstrated the miracle of all the worlds being connected, one with the other.
they demonstrated the mutual interpenetration of all worlds;
'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud thams cad du skyes pa'i lus yongs su ston pa/
They demonstrated bodies that were born in all kinds of world realms.
they manifested incarnation in all realms of being;
'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi dbyibs phra ba dang / rgya che ba dang / yangs pa dang / dog pa sna tshogs rab tu tshogs pa/
They had the knowledge of the small and vast, wide and narrow shapes of all world realms.
they knew the various forms of all worlds, subtle and gross, broad and narrow;
shin tu phra zhing rgya chen po yang dag par gzud pa'i ye shes khong du chud pa/
They had realized the wisdom of the small being the vast.
they had attained knowledge of the interpenetration of minute objects
dmigs pa rgya chen po shin tu phra bar shes pa dang ldan pa/
They had the knowledge of the vast being the small.
and immense lands;
sangs rgyas thams cad dang sems kyi skad cig la 'grogs pa rab tu thob pa/
They had attained being in the presence of all buddhas in a single instant of mind.
they could reach all buddhas in a single moment of thought;
de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs kyi ye shes kyi lus dang ldan pa/
They possessed bodies that had been blessed by all the tathāgatas.
they had the body of knowledge of all buddhas;
phyogs rgya mtsho thams cad du mgo rmongs pa med pa'i ye shes rab tu thob pa/
They had attained the ignorance-free wisdom in all the oceans of the directions.
they had attained unconfused knowledge of all regions;
sems kyi skad cig gis phyogs rgya mtsho thams cad du rnam par 'phrul pas rgyas par 'gengs pa sha stag ste/
They pervaded all the oceans of the directions with emanations in an instant of mind.
they could pervade the ocean of all locations in a single moment of thought by mystic metamorphosis.
de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis de lta bu'i yon tan tshad med pa dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sha stag gis dze ta'i tshal thams cad yongs su rgyas par gyur kyang;
These bodhisattvas who all had such limitless qualities through the blessings of the tathāgatas filled the entirety of Jetavana.
The whole Jeta grove became filled with enlightening beings of such immeasurable attainments, by the power of the buddhas.

nyan thos chen po shA ri'i bu dang / mo'u dgal gyi bu dang / 'od srung chen po dang / nam gru dang / rab 'byor dang / 'gag med dang / mos pa dang / ka t+ya'i bu dang / byams gang gi bu la sogs pas dze ta'i tshal na 'khod bzhin du/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa de dag ma mthong ngo/ / sangs rgyas kyi bkod pa de dag dang / sangs rgyas kyi khyu mchog gi mthu dang / sangs rgyas kyi rnam par rol pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi cho 'phrul dang / sangs rgyas kyi mnga' chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa'i rnam par 'phrul ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang / sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa yang ma mthong ngo/ /

The great śrāvakas, such as Śāriputra, Maudgalyāyana, Mahākāśyapa, Revata, Subhūti, Aniruddha, Nandika, Kapphiṇa,[117] Kātyāyana, and Pūrṇa Maitrāyaṇīputra, were present in Jetavana but did not see those miraculous manifestations of the Tathāgata. Neither did they see the miraculous displays of the Buddha, the majesty[118] of the Buddha, the manifestations of the Buddha, the miracles of the Buddha, the supremacy of the Buddha, the miraculous conduct[119] of the Buddha, the power of the Buddha, the blessing of the Buddha, or the pure realm of the Buddha.

The great disciples, however—Shariputra, Maudgalyayana, Mahkashyapa, Revata, Subhuti, Aniruddha, Nandika, Kapphina, Katyayana, Purnamaitrayaniputra, and so so—did not see the transfiguration of the Buddha in the Jeta grove, the adornments of the Buddha, the majesty of the Buddha, the freedom of the Buddha, the magic of the Buddha, the mastery of the Buddha, the miracle performed by the Buddha, the light of the Buddha, the power of the Buddha, or the Buddha’s purification of the land;

byang chub sems dpa'i yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' kun nas 'ongs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' kun nas 'dus pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' kun nas tshogs pa dang byang chub sems dpa' nye bar 'ongs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnam par 'phrul pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i cho 'phrul dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang / byang chub sems dpa'i phyogs su 'khod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i seng ge'i khri bkod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i khang pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par spyod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gyis rnam par rtse ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par lta ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par bsgyings pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par gnon pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i de bzhin gshegs pa mchod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lung bstan pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i yongs su smin par gyur pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sngon du 'dor ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i chos kyi lus rnam par dag pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes kyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam gyi lus rnam par dmigs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs kyi lus yongs su grub pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i mtshan phun sum tshogs pa yongs su dag pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor kha dog mtha' yas pa'i bkod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 'od zer gyi dra ba rab tu 'gyed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa'i sprin kun tu 'gyed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i phyogs kyi dra ba rgyas par 'gengs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor rnam par sprul pa yang ma mthong ngo/ /

Nor did they see the inconceivable range of activity of the bodhisattvas, the coming of the bodhisattvas, the arrival of the bodhisattvas, the gathering of the bodhisattvas, the approach of the displays of paranormal powers of the bodhisattvas, the circle of the assembly of bodhisattvas, the bodhisattvas arranging themselves in the directions, the display of the lion thrones of the bodhisattvas, the dwellings of the bodhisattvas, the activities of the bodhisattvas, the display of the power of the samādhis of the bodhisattvas, the gaze of the bodhisattvas, the awesomeness of the bodhisattvas, the forcefulness of the bodhisattvas, the offerings made to the Tathāgata by the bodhisattvas, the prophecies given to the bodhisattvas, the ripening of the bodhisattvas, the renunciation[120] of the bodhisattvas, the purified Dharma bodies of the bodhisattvas, the fulfilled wisdom bodies of the bodhisattvas, the proclaimed[121] aspiration bodies of the bodhisattvas, the created form bodies of the bodhisattvas, the pure, perfect features of the bodhisattvas, the display of the auras of infinite colors of the bodhisattvas, the network of light rays emanated by the bodhisattvas, the spreading clouds emanated by the bodhisattvas, or the network of the directions being pervaded by the bodhisattvas, nor did they see the miraculous realm of the conduct of the bodhisattvas.

nor did they see the inconceivable sphere of the enlightening beings, the descent of the enlightening beings, the gathering of the enlightening beings, the descent of the enlightening beings, the approach of the enlightening beings, the miracle of the enlightening beings, the magic of the enlightening beings, the circles of the enlightening beings, the locations of the enlightening beings, the array of lion thrones of the enlightening beings, the mansions of the enlightening beings, the deportment of the enlightening beings, the enlightening beings’ mastery of concentration, the enlightening beings’ observation, the enlightening beings’ emergence, the enlightening beings’ vigor, the enlightening beings’ offerings to the Buddha, the enlightening beings’ bequest of enlightenment, the enlightening beings’ development, the enlightening beings’ strength, the enlightening beings’ clarification of the reality-body, the enlightening beings’ fulfillment of the body of knowledge, the enlightening beings’ manifestation of the body of vows, the enlightening beings’ perfection of the physical body, the enlightening beings’ purification of excellence of attributes, the enlightening beings’ array of spheres of light of eternal power, the enlightening beings’ radiation of networks of light beams, the enlightening beings’ emission of clouds of emanations, the enlightening beings’ pervasion of the network of all regions, or the transfiguration of the sphere of actions of enlightening beings.
de ci'i phyir zhe na/
Why was that?
Why didn’t the disciples see any of this?

dge ba'i rtsa ba mi mtshungs ba'i phyir te/ de dag gis ni sngon sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa mthong ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bsags so/ / de dag la ni sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams su gtogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi yon tan dang / rgyan yongs su dag pa yang dag par bstan pa ma mdzad do/ / de dag la ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa yang dag brjod pa ma mdzad do/ / de dag gis ni sngon 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i tshe/ sems can rnams bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par bskul ba ma byas so/ / de dag gis ni gzhan gyi sems kyi rgyud la byang chub tu sems bskyed pa rab tu bzhag pa ma byas so/ / de dag gis ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung rgyun mi 'chad pa'i phyir zhugs pa ma yin no/ / de dag gis ni sems can thams cad yongs su bsdu ba'i phyir brtson pa ma yin no/ / de dag gis ni byang chub sems dpa' rnam pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par bskul ba ma byas so/ / de dag gis ni sngon 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i tshe/ 'gro ba thams cad las khyad par du 'phags pa'i ye shes kyi sa la dmigs pa ma byas so/ /

Because they did not have the same roots of merit. They had not accumulated in the past the roots of merit that are the cause for seeing the miracles of a buddha; they had not in the past taught the qualities and pure display of the buddha realms included within the world realms in the ten directions; they had not described the buddha miracles of the buddha bhagavats; and they had not in the past encouraged beings continuing in saṃsāra to attain the highest, complete enlightenment. They had not established in the minds of others the aspiration to enlightenment; they had not engaged in preventing the discontinuation of the family lineage of the tathāgatas; they did not have the diligence to gather all beings as pupils; they did not encourage bodhisattvas to practice the perfections; and when they were continuing in saṃsāra, they did not have as their goal the level of wisdom that transcends that of all beings.

Because of lack of corresponding roots of goodness. For they had not accumulated the roots of goodness conducive to vision of the transfiguration of all buddhas, and they had not had the purifications of the arrays of qualities of all buddha-lands in the ten directions described to them, and they had not had the various wonders of all buddhas described to them by the buddhas, and they had not established beings in supreme perfect enlightenment while they were involved in the world, and they had not instilled in others’ minds the determination for enlightenment, and they were not capable of perpetuating the lineage of buddhas, and they were not engaged in the salvation of all beings, and they had not exhorted enlightening beings to practice transcendent ways, and while they were involved in the world they had not focused their minds on the stage of knowledge superior to all worldlings,

de dag gis ni thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'gyur ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba nye bar bsags pa ma byas so/ / de dag gis ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su ma bsgrubs so/ / de dag gis ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa thams cad du rnam par 'phrul pa'i mngon par shes pa khong du ma chud do/ / de dag gis ni byang chub sems dpa'i mig gi lam gyis rnam par dmigs par bya ba 'jig rten las 'das pa thun mong ma yin pa'i byang chub tu dmigs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam chen po las byung ba khong du chud do/ /

They had not accumulated the roots of merit to become omniscient. They had not accomplished the roots of merit of a tathāgata who transcends the world. They had not realized the clairvoyance that perceives the miracles in all the pure realms of the buddhas. They did not know the roots of merit from focusing upon the exceptional enlightenment that transcends the world, which is perceived by the vision of the bodhisattvas and originates from the great aspirations of the bodhisattvas.

and they had not developed the foundations of goodness conducive to omniscience, and they had not perfected the transmundane roots of goodness of buddhas, and they had not realized the miraculous superknowledge to purify all buddha-lands, and they did not know the source of the great vow of enlightening beings, which is the good root of concentration on unique world-transcending enlightenment that represents the range of vision of enlightening beings, and they were not born of the magical essence emanating from the power of the enlightened,

nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kun gyis ni byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i ye shes kyi mig gi lam gyis rnam par dmigs pa thun mong ma yin pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs las byung ba'i sgyu ma'i rnam pa'i chos nyid kyis grub pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'du shes sna tshogs yongs su 'dzin pa byin gyis rlob pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i dga' ba'i shugs chen po rnam par 'phel bar byed pa khong du ma chud do/ /

Nor did all the śrāvakas and pratyekabuddhas know the exceptional perception of the vision of the wisdom eyes of the completely good bodhisattvas. Nor did they know the attainments[122] of the bodhisattvas through the illusory nature of phenomena, which arise from the blessing of the tathāgatas;[123] or the blessing of possessing the various dream-like[124] perceptions of bodhisattvas; or the increasing great power of the joy of bodhisattvas.

and because hearers and individual illuminates do not share in the knowledge of enlightening beings’ control over holding various perceptions as in dreams, the growth of the current of joy of enlightening beings, and the manifestations of the range of the eye of knowledge of the universally good enlightening being.

de bas na nyan thos chen po mchog gi zung dang / bzang po'i zung la sogs pa de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul ba de mi mthong ngo/ / mi thos so/ / mi shes so/ / khong du mi chud do/ / mi rtogs so/ / mi rig go /yid mi ches so/ / mi sems so/ / rnam par mi lta'o/ / rtogs par mi lta'o/ / nges par mi lta'o/ / nye bar mi sems so/ /

Therefore, the great śrāvakas, such as the supreme pair, the excellent pair,[125] and so on, did not see the miracles of the Tathāgata; they did not hear of them, did not know them, did not comprehend them, did not understand them, were not aware of them, did not believe in them, did not think of them, did not regard them, did not consider them, did not dwell upon them, and did not reflect upon them.

Because of that, those great disciples, who were the best of the best, did not see the miracle of the Buddha, did not hear it, know it, realize it, penetrate it, did not fix their minds on it, did not notice it, did not focus their attention on it, did not observe it, did not examine it, did not reflect on it, did not contemplate it.
de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni sangs rgyas kyi spyod yul te/ nyan thos kyi spyod yul ma yin no/ /
Why was that? Because the scope of a buddha’s wisdom[126] is not the same as that of the śrāvaka.
Why? Because that is the sphere of buddhas, not the sphere of disciples.

de bas na nyan thos chen po de dag dze ta'i tshal de nyid na 'khod kyang / sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa de dag mi mthong ste/ de dag la de dang mthun pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba med do/ / de dag gis sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa de dag mthong du/ de lta bu'i ye shes kyi mig rnam par ma dag go /dmigs pa chung ngu la rgya chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis 'jug tu ting nge 'dzin de lta bu med do/ / de dag shes pa dang / lta ba'am/ khong du chud par bya ba'am/ rtogs par bya ba'am/ rgyas par dgang bar bya ba'am/ 'jug par bya ba'am/ rnam par blta ba'am/ nyams su myong bar bya ba'am/ gnan ba'am/ rnam par mnan pa'am/ gzhan gyis thos par bya ba'am/ bstan par bya ba'am/ smos par bya ba'am/ yang dag par bstan par bya ba'am/ bstab par bya ba'am/ sbyin par bya ba'am/ de la sems can rnams yongs su bskul bar bya ba'am/ sbyar bar bya ba'am/ rab tu dgod par bya ba'am/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa'i chos nyid la sems can dgod par bya bar yang de dag la de lta bu'i rnam par thar pa med do/ / de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul med do/ / de lta bu khyu mchog gi mthu med do/ / de lta bu'i stobs med do/ / de lta bu'i dbang med do/ / de lta bu'i gnas med do/ / de lta bu'i 'du shes med do/ / de lta bu'i mig gi mthu med do/ / de lta bu'i ye shes med do/ /

Therefore, even though the great śrāvakas were present in Jetavana, they did not see the Buddha’s miracles. They did not have the roots of merit that would accord with that. They did not have the pure vision for seeing the Buddha’s miracles. They did not have the samādhi that realizes the power for causing something vast to be within a small object of perception. They did not have the liberation, the miraculous powers, the supremacy, the power, the mastery, the state, the perception, the vision, or the wisdom through which they could know, see, comprehend, understand, fathom, realize, view, experience, grasp, surmount, hear from others, teach, describe, reveal, praise, bestow, inspire beings toward, connect beings with, bring beings to, or establish beings in the nature of the Buddha’s miracles.

Therefore even though the disciples were in the very same Jeta grove, they did not see those miracles of the Buddha. For indeed they did not have the corresponding roots of goodness, they did not have that purity of the eye of knowledge, whereby they could have seen the miracles of Buddha. They did not know the concentration whose minute point of focus would have given them access to those vast magical manifestations. They did not know that liberation or that spiritual capacity or that might or that power or that mastery or that state or that perception or that power of vision whereby they might recognize or see or penetrate or approach or discover or head for or observe or experience or reveal to others or explain or show or describe or make visible or arrive at or produce or lead beings into the cultivation and realization of the realities of the miracles of Buddha. That knowledge did not belong to them.

de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de dag ni de ltar nyan thos kyi theg pas byung ba/ nyan thos kyi lam gyis yongs su grub pa/ nyan thos kyi spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa/ nyan thos kyi 'bras bu la gnas pa/ bden pa snang ba shes pas nges par rtogs pa/ yang dag pa'i mtha' la gnas pa/ shin tu zhi ba'i mthar thug pa/ snying rje chen po'i bsam pa med pa/ 'jig rten thams cad la mi lta mi sdod pa/ rang gi don grub pa dag ste/

Why was that? Because they had become what they were through the Śrāvakayāna, had accomplished the path of the śrāvakas, had fulfilled the range of the conduct of the śrāvakas, had gained the result of the śrāvakas, had gained the knowledge of the illumination of the truths, were established in the summit of existence, had attained absolute peace, had minds that were devoid of great compassion, had no regard for all the world realms, and had accomplished their own benefit.

Why? Because they were emancipated by the vehicle of hearers, they had realized the path of hearers, they had fulfilled the sphere of practices of hearers, they were fixed in the fruit of hearers; they rested on the knowledge of the light of truth, they were fixed at the limit of reality, they had gone to the state of eternal peace, they had no thought of great compassion and had no pity for the beings of the world; they had accomplished what they had to do for themselves.

de dag ni dze ta'i tshal de nyid du kun nas 'dus te 'khod la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga dang / g.yas g.yon dang / snam logs na bcom ldan 'das la mngon du lta bar gnas kyang / dze ta'i tshal der sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa de dag mthong bar ma gyur to/ /
They had gathered and were present in Jetavana before, to the left, to the right, and to the rear of the Bhagavat, but they did not see those miracles of the Buddha.

They had gathered in the Jeta grove and were sitting there, in front of, behind, and to the left and right of the Buddha, in his presence, yet they did not see the miracles of the Buddha in the Jeta grove.

de ci'i phyir zhe na; thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yang dag par ma bsgrubs pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yang dag par ma bsdus pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la yang dag par ma zhugs pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la smon lam yang dag par ma btab pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mngon par ma bsgrubs pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yongs su ma bsgoms pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes ma sbyangs pa de dag gis ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam par 'phrul pa de la 'jug cing rtogs par bya ba'am/ blta zhing khong du chud par bya bar mi nus so/ /

Why was that? They had not attained omniscient wisdom; they had not accomplished omniscient wisdom; they were not established in omniscient wisdom; they had not prayed for omniscient wisdom; they had not realized omniscient wisdom; they had not become imbued with omniscient wisdom; and they had not become purified in omniscient wisdom and therefore were not able to observe, to know, to see, or to realize the miracles from the Buddha’s samādhi.

Why? It is not possible for those who have not developed omniscient knowledge, have not accomplished omniscient knowledge, have not set out for omniscient knowledge, have not resolved on omniscient knowledge, have not undertaken omniscient knowledge, have not penetrated omniscient knowledge, have not purified omniscient knowledge, to understand or become aware of or see or discover the miraculous manifestation of the concentration of the Buddha.

de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni byang chub sems dpa' rigs dang ldan pa rnams kyi mig gi lam gyis blta ba yin gyi/ nyan thos kyi mig gis blta ba ma yin no/ / de bas na nyan thos chen po de dag dze ta'i tshal de nyid na 'khod kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' kun nas 'dus pa'ang mthong bar ma gyur to/ /

Why was that? Because they could be seen through the vision of those who were in the family of bodhisattvas and not through the vision of śrāvakas. Therefore, those great śrāvakas were present in Jetavana but did not see the Tathāgata’s miracles, the Tathāgata’s power, the Tathāgata’s pure realm, or the gathering of the bodhisattvas.

Why? Because that is discernible only to the range of the vision of developed enlightening beings, not to the range of the vision of hearers. That is why the great disciples, the great hearers, though in the Jeta grove, did not see the transfiguration of the Buddha, the magical appearances of the Buddha, the purifications of the buddha-land, the gathering of the enlightening beings.

de 'ang 'di lta ste/ dper na; gang+gA'i chu klung chen po'i ngogs pha rol tshu rol du yi bkres pa dang / skom pas rab tu mnar ba/ gcer ba/ gos med pa/ lus kyi mdog dang / kha dog tshig cing 'chums pa dang / rlung dang nyi mas bskams pa/ bya rog mang pos gtse ba/ spyang ki dang / was mtho btsam pa brgya stong mang po kun nas 'dus kyang / gang+gA'i chu klung chen po mi mthong ste/ sgrib pa'i las kyis bsgribs pa'i phyir/ la las ni bskams te chu med par mthong ngo/ / la las ni thal bas yongs su gang bar mthong ngo/ / de bzhin du nyan thos chen po gnas brtan de dag dze ta'i tshal de nyid na 'khod kyang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs ma rig pa'i ling rtog gis mig kun nas khebs pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba'i mthus yongs su ma bzung ba'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa de dag ma mthong / ma shes so/ /

By analogy, many hundreds of thousands of pretas, suffering from thirst and hunger, naked, without clothing, their skin the color of being burned, shriveled by the wind and sun, attacked by flocks of crows, and terrified by wolves and jackals,[127] do not see the great Ganges River even though they are gathered on its opposite banks, because they are obscured by obscuring karma. Some of them see a dry riverbed without water, and some of them see it filled with ashes. In that same way, although the sthaviras, the great śrāvakas, were present in Jetavana, their vision was obscured by the cataracts of the ignorance that is contrary to omniscience. And this is because they did not possess the power of the root of merit of the level of omniscience.

The situation was like that of hundreds of thousands of ghosts gathered on the bank of the great river Ganges, hungry and thirsty, naked, without shelter, emaciated, dehydrated by the wind and heat, attacked by flocks of crows, terrorized by wolves and jackals—they do not see the Ganges River, or they may see it as dry, without water, or full of ashes, because they are shrouded by actions that blind them. In the same way the old great disciples there in the Jeta grove did not see or penetrate the transfigurations of the Buddha, because they rejected omniscience and their eyes were veiled by ignorance.

'di lta ste/ dper na/ 'dun ma chen po 'dus pa'i skye bo mang po dbus su/ mi la la zhig gnyid kyis myos te log par gyur nas/ de gnyid kyis log pa'i rmi lam du gnas de nyid na/ lha'i grong rdal brgya byin gyi gnas blta na mdzes pa dang / ri rab kyi steng shing dang bcas pa/ bza' shing gi ra ba'i 'khor dang bcas pa/ lha'i bu mo bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gis gang ba/ lha'i bu khrag khrig brgya phrag stong snyed gnas pa/ lha'i me tog sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba dang / yid bzhin gyi shing lha rdzas kyi gos dang / mu tig gi phreng ba dang / rin po che'i rgyan dang / se mo do sna tshogs mang po 'byin pa dang / lha rdzas kyi sil snyan rnam pa sna tshogs rlung gis yongs su bskyod cing / sgra dbyangs yid du 'ong la snyan pa 'byin pa'i sil snyan gyi shing mang po dang / dga' ba'i rtsed mo'i bkod pa/ rnam pa sna tshogs mthong bar gyur la; lha'i bu mo mang pos glu blangs pa dang / lha rdzas kyi rol mo byas pa'i sgra yid du 'ong zhing snyan pa thos par gyur te/ bdag nyid kyang de na 'dug pa snyam byed la/ lha rdzas kyi bkod pas klubs pa'i gnas de dag thams cad mthong bar gyur kyang / skye bo'i tshogs mang po de dag gis gnas de nyid na 'khod bzhin du mi mthong / mi shes/ khong du mi chud do/ /

By analogy, a man who is in the middle of a great gathering of many people becomes drowsy. He falls asleep, and in a dream he sees in that place the divine city that is Śakra’s beautiful residence, which is upon the summit of Sumeru and has trees; is encircled by a wall of fruit trees;[128] is filled with a quintillion female devas and filled with a quintillion male devas; has wish-fulfilling trees that emit divine clothing, strings of pearls, precious ornaments, and various kinds of necklaces; has many trees of musical instruments that emit beautiful music when the divine instruments of various kinds are moved by the breezes; and has an array of all kinds of joyful amusements. He hears the melodious, beautiful sounds made by the female devas who are singing and playing the divine musical instruments, and he thinks that he is there. Even though he sees that everywhere this place is adorned by an array of divine things, the many people who are gathered in that same place do not see it, do not know it, and do not perceive it.

It was like the case of a man who has dozed off in the daytime in the midst of a large group of people and while asleep sees a celestial city with beautiful mansions appearing there in his dream, and sees the whole summit of the polar mountain, with groves and gardens, with innumerable nymphs all around, innumerable godlings living there, and various celestial flowers scattered about, and sees wish-fulfilling trees providing various celestial garments, jewel ornaments, and flower garlands, and sees musical trees producing all kinds of sweet celestial sounds, and many kinds of forms of pleasure and diversion, and hears the sweet sounds of the music and singing of the heavenly nymphs, and perceives himself as being there, seeing the adornment of the celestial arrays all over the place. The group of people who are there in the same place do not see this, are not aware of it, do not observe it,
de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni skyes bu gnyid kyis log pa de nyid kyi rmi lam gyis blta ba yin gyi/ gnas de nyid na 'khod kyang skye bo mang po de dag gis blta ba ma yin no/ /
Why is that? Because it is perceived in a dream by the man who is asleep. Although those many people are in the same place, they do not see it.
because it is the vision of the man in his dream, not the vision of the group of people in the same place.
