Then the great enlightening being Universally Good, having looked over the host of enlightening beings everywhere, to further analyze, discuss in detail, explain, reveal, elucidate, bring to light, illumine, and point out, by means of the cosmos of truths, equal to the realm of space, equal to past, present, and future, equal to the realm of realities, equal to the realm of beings, equal to the realm of all worlds, equal to all sets of actions, equal to the dispositions of beings, equal to the interests of beings, equal to the specific illustrations of truth, equal to the appropriate times for the maturation of beings, and equal to the faculties of all beings, elucidated this “lion emergence” concentration of Buddha by means of ten indications:
bcu gang zhe na/
What were those ten ways?
'di lta ste; chos kyi dbyings thams cad du gtogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba rnams la/ sangs rgyas gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa bstan pa dang /
1. The teaching of the entire succession of buddhas and succession of buddha realms[180] in the atoms of all the buddha realms that are included within the entire realm of phenomena.
indication of the succession of all buddhas and the succession of lands in the atoms of the buddha-lands throughout all universes;
'di lta ste/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyis klas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa'i bskal par de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan rjes su brjod pa bstan pa dang /
2. The teaching of describing the qualities of a tathāgata until the end of future kalpas in all the buddha realms to the ends of the element of space.
indication of the seeking and following of virtues of the buddhas in all buddha-lands in space throughout the future;

'di lta ste sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su skye ba dang / mtha' dang dbus med pa'i mngon par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi sgo rgya mtsho yongs su brjod cing bstan pa dang /
3. The teaching that describes the appearance of tathāgatas in all the buddha realms and the ocean of gateways to enlightenment that have no middle or edge.
indication of buddhas emerging in all buddha-lands and showing the ocean of infinitely various doors of enlightenment;

'di lta ste/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyis klas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun snying po byang chub la mngon du gyur pa'i gnas bstan pa dang /
4. The teaching of the saṅghas of bodhisattvas, the circles of the assemblies of the tathāgatas, who are facing the bodhimaṇḍas[181] in all the buddha realms to the ends of the element of space.
indication of the hosts of enlightening beings in the circles of the buddhas in the buddha-lands throughout space facing the terrace of enlightenment;
'di lta ste/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi sku dang 'dra bar sprul pa/ ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas sems skad cig la rab tu dgye zhing chos kyi dbyings rgyas par dgang ba bstan pa dang /
5. The teaching of emanations that are like the bodies of the buddhas of the three times that are emanated from all the pores in one instant of mind and pervade the realm of phenomena.
indication of pervading the cosmos in a moment of thought with emanations in the forms of the buddhas of past, present, and future, emitted from every pore;
'di lta ste/ phyogs rgya mtsho thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi zhing rgya mtsho gzhi mnyam par byin gyis brlab cing / lus gcig gis rgyas par dgang ba bstan pa dang /
6. The teaching of the ocean of buddha realms in the ocean of directions being blessed as having the same ground and having one body pervading them.
indication of the light of magical pervasion of all multitudes of lands in all the oceans in all directions equally with one body;
'di lta ste/ dmigs pa'i gzhi thams cad la sangs rgyas kyis rnam par sprul pa dus gsum thams cad yang dag par gzhol bar 'gyur ba'i byin gyi rlabs yang dag par bstan pa dang /
7. The teaching of the power of buddha manifestations appearing on all supporting surfaces[182] in all three times.
indication of revelation of the power of concentration of all pasts, presents, and futures of the transfigurations of the state of buddhahood in the surfaces of all objects;

'di lta ste/ zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba rnams la/ dus gsum gyi zhing gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa dang / bskal pa rgya mtsho yongs su bshad cing bstan pa dang /
8. The teaching of the manifestations of the buddhas in the succession of realms, as numerous as the atoms of all realms,[183] throughout the three times in an ocean of kalpas.
indication of manifestation of the oceans of eons of various successive transfigurations of Buddha in the lands of past, present, and future, equal to the atoms in all lands;

'di lta ste/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi smon lam rgya mtsho thams cad ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas rab tu brjod pa phyi ma'i mthar byin gyis brlabs pas/ byang chub sems dpa' yang dag par 'byung ba bstan pa dang /
9. The teaching of the power of an entire ocean of the prayers of the buddhas of the three times being expressed from all pores and causing the appearance of bodhisattvas.
indication of the birth of enlightening beings from the endless power emanating from every pore by the ocean of vows of all buddhas of past, present, and future;

'di lta ste/ chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i seng ge'i khri dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang / byang chub sems dpa'i snying po'i rgyan tha mi dad pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo rnam pa tha dad pa rab tu bskor pa phyi ma'i mthar byin gyis brlab pa bstan pa'o/ /

10. The teaching of the power of buddhas, lion thrones, assembled circles of bodhisattvas, the adornment of the bodhimaṇḍa, and the turning of the different Dharma wheels being as extensive as the realm of phenomena.

indication of endless manifestation of varied expositions of truth amid equal adornments of sites of enlightenment with circles of enlightening beings around lion thrones equal in extent to the cosmos:

kye rgyal ba'i sras/ de ltar seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di la bstan pa bcu po 'di dag la sogs pa shin tu bstan pa/ sangs rgyas rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed de/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi spyod yul lo/ /

“Oh jinaputras, the teachings on this samādhi of the gaping lion, such as these ten teachings, are as numerous as the atoms in uncountable buddha realms. “Oh jinaputras, that is the field of activity of the wisdom of the tathāgatas.”

“These ten, O offspring of the Victor,” said Samantabhadra, the Universally Good enlightening being, “are the first ten of as many expressions of the ‘lion emergence’ concentration as atoms in untold buddha-lands, which I follow. However, these are the sphere of knowledge of those who arrive at Thusness.”

de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin chen po seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa 'di nyid kyi don gyi phyogs bstan pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal du blta zhing / 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho thams cad la rnam par bltas nas/ sangs rgyas kyi yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam par 'phrul pa mtha' dad dbus med pa la rnam par bltas te/ 'jig rten gyi khams bsam gyis mi khyab par yang dag par gzhol pa la rnam par bltas nas/ ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgyu ma'i chos nyid la rnam par bltas te/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas mnyam pa nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa la rnam par bltas nas mtha' dang dbus med pa'i ngag gi lam dang / nges pa'i tshig dang / chos kyi tshul thams cad la rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshig su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /

The bodhisattva Samantabhadra, in order to teach an aspect of the meaning of the Tathāgata’s samādhi of the gaping lion, through the blessing of the Buddha looked upon the Tathāgata’s face, looked upon the ocean of the circle of the assembly, looked upon the inconceivable field of activity of the Buddha and the manifestations of the Tathāgata’s samādhi, which have no center or limit, looked at his entry into inconceivable numbers of world realms, looked at the nature of the illusory manifestations of inconceivable wisdom, looked upon the inconceivable equality of the buddhas of the three times, looked upon all his speech, definitions, and ways of the Dharma, which have no center or limit, and recited these verses:

Then the enlightening being Universally Good, illuminating the expression of the meaning of the “lion emergence” concentration of Buddha, by the empowerment of Buddha, while gazing on the face of Buddha, observing the ocean of assemblies everywhere, observing the infinitely various transfigurations of the concentration of Buddha in the inconceivable sphere of the enlightened, observing the magical nature of inconceivable knowledge, and observing all teachings expressed in an inconceivably infinite variety of manners of speaking, then uttered these verses:
pa spu gcig la rgya mtsho rgyal ba'i zhing / / zhing kun shin tu phra ba'i rdul dang mnyam/ / de ni sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor/ / kun gyis yongs bskor sangs rgyas gdan la bzhugs/ /

“On each body hair there is an ocean of the realms of jinas[184] As numerous as the atoms in all realms. There,[185] buddhas are seated on their buddha thrones, Surrounded by assemblies of bodhisattvas. {1}
Like the atoms of all lands are the oceanic buddha-lands on a single hairtip: Surrounded by a circle of enlightening beings, there Buddha rests on the throne of the enlightened.
spu gcig rtse la zhing mang rgya mtsho'i rnams/ / snying po byang chub pad+mo'i gdan gnas pas/ / chos dbyings rgya chen yongs su rgyas bkang zhing / / shing drung dam pa kun na mgon po snang / /

“There appears an ocean of many realms on each body hair, In each of which appears a guide at the foot of the supreme tree, Seated upon a lotus seat on the bodhimaṇḍa, Filling the vastness of the realm of phenomena. {2}
In the ocean of buddha-lands on a single hair, on a lotus throne at the site of enlightenment Extended throughout the cosmos, the Guide is seen at the trees of enlightenment.
zhing rnams kun gyi rdul phran rab mang snyed/ / rgyal ba spu rtse gcig la yongs bzhugs pa/ / byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyis yongs su bskor/ / kun kyang bzang po'i spyod pa ston pa mdzad/ /
“On each single body hair reside jinas As numerous as the atoms in all the realms. They are encircled by assemblies of bodhisattvas And all teaching good conduct. {3}
Like the atoms in all lands are the buddhas assembled on a single hair: Surrounded by a host of enlightening beings, they expound all good actions.
zhing mchog gcig na rgyal ba bzhugs gyur kyang / / byang chub sems dpa'i sprin mang mi zad pa/ / de dag phyogs bcu ma lus thams cad nas/ / rab 'byams zhing kun bkang zhing kun kyang 'ong / /
“A jina resides in each supreme realm With as many unending clouds of bodhisattvas, Who filled all infinite realms, having come From all of the ten directions without exception. {4}
Buddha sits in one land pervading all lands; Endless hosts of enlightening beings go there from everywhere.
zhing rnams bye ba'i rdul phran mnyam pa yi/ / byang chub sems dpa' yon tan rgya mtsho 'od/ / phyogs bcu'i chos dbyings rgyas par kun bkang zhing / / ston pa de la kun kyang 'khor nas ldang / /

“Bodhisattvas, shining with an ocean of qualities, As numerous as the atoms in ten million realms, Who filled the realm of phenomena’s ten directions, Have all appeared as the assembly of the teachers. {5}
Like atoms in countless lands, enlightening beings, radiant seas of virtue, Should appear in the audiences of the Teachers, throughout the cosmos.
zhing rnams kun tu gzugs brnyan rab tu ston/ / chos kyi rgyal po rgyal ba'i ye shes mtsho/ / de dag kun kyang bzang po'i spyod la gnas/ / sangs rgyas kun gyi 'khor du nye bar 'dong / /
“Throughout all realms appear the images Of an ocean of the kings of Dharma, the wisdom of the jinas. All who are maintaining good conduct Have come to be the assemblies of all the buddhas. {6}
Appearing like reflections in all lands, oceans of knowledge of buddhas, Established in good practices, they arrive in the assemblies of all buddhas.
rab 'byams zhing rnams kun na 'khod spyod cing / / byang chub sems dpa'i dga' ba rab gnas te/ / chos kyi sprin mnyan dpa' bo de dag ni/ / zhing gcig tu'ang bskal pa bye bar spyod/ /

“Those who maintain the delightful conduct of bodhisattvas,[186] Who dwell throughout all infinite realms, Those heroes who listen to clouds of the Dharma, Practice that conduct for ten million kalpas in each realm. {7}
Assembled everywhere in all lands, in the realm of the joy of enlightening practice, Delighted in hearing the myriad teachings, they pass millions of eons in each land.
byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa byed/ / chos kyi gangs chen mtsho spyod rnam par snang / / smon lam rgya mtsho kun la rab tu 'jug / de dag sangs rgyas sa yi spyod yul gnas/ /

“The bodhisattvas who are practicing their conduct Are radiant with the practice of an ocean[187] of Dharma. They engage in the entire ocean of prayers And remain within the field of conduct of buddhahood. {8}
Enlightening beings carry out their practices coursing in the ocean of truth, emanating light; They enter the oceans of vows, established in the sphere of buddhahood.
rgyal ba'i chos rnams gzhan dang gzhan byung ba'i/ / de dag kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa shes/ / sangs rgyas yon tan legs pa rgya mtsho dang / / rnam par 'phrul pa rgya chen yangs la 'jug /

“They who have originated from this and that Dharma of the jinas Have the knowledge of completely good conduct. They enter into the extensive miraculous appearance Of oceans of the excellent qualities of the buddhas.[188] {9}
Born of the teachings of the buddhas, acting with universal good in mind, They enter the oceans of qualities of buddhas, in vast transfigurations.
bde gshegs chos dbyings kun tu rgyas bkang zhing / / zhing rnams kun gyi rdul phran ji snyed pa'i/ / sku yi sprin rnams rtag tu 'gyed mdzad cing / / chos kyi char gyis byang chub rab la dgod// //

“The sugatas[189] pervade the entirety of the realm of phenomena, Continuously emanating clouds of bodies As numerous as the atoms in all realms, Bringing a rain of Dharma that leads to enlightenment.” {10}
Pervading the refuge of the reality realm, they constantly emanate a cloud of bodies, Many as atoms in all lands, with the rain of truth, for enlightenment.
bam po brgyad cu rtsa brgyad pa/

de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' de dag sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa 'di nyid la/ de bas kyang brnan te dgod par mdzad pa'i don du/ smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu'i nang nas/ chos kyi dbyings sgo kun nas rnam par dmigs pas dus gsum snang ba zhes bya ba'i 'od zer chen po/ 'od zer gyi 'khor sangs rgyas kyi zhing brngod [*brjod?] du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang ldan pa bkye ste/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho thams cad kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'byams klas pa thams cad snang bar mdzad do/ /

Then the Bhagavat, in order to further[190] establish those bodhisattvas in this samādhi of the gaping lion, emanated from the ūrṇā hair between his eyebrows a great ray of light called illumination of the three times focused on all the entrances into the realm of the Dharma, and he was accompanied by an entourage of light rays as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms. They illuminated all the infinite buddha realms in all the oceans of world realms in the ten directions.

Then the blessed Buddha, wanting to establish those enlightening beings in this lion emergence concentration of buddhas, went on to emanate from the circle of hair between his brows a light called “illumining past, present, and future, showing all ways into the reality realm,” accompanied by as many beams of light as atoms in untold buddha-lands, with which he illumined all lands in all oceans of worlds in the ten directions.

de nas byang chub sems dpa' dze ta'i tshal du tshogs pa de dag gis/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad du gtogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing / nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthas klas pa thams cad dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba'i khongs su chud pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba dag la/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi ming du bya ba kha dog sna tshogs dang / rnam pa sna tshogs su rnam pa dag pa dang / gzhi sna tshogs dang / dbyibs sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' snying po byang chub tu phyin te seng ge'i khri la 'dug pa/ 'jig rten gyi dbang po thams cad kyis shin tu mchod pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis kun nas bskor ba/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya bar mthong ste/

Then those bodhisattvas who were assembled in Jetavana saw all the buddha realms that were included within the realm of phenomena, which extended to the limits of space, and the buddha realms that were in the atoms of all buddha realms that were as numerous[191] as the atoms in all buddha realms. In these buddha realms, which had different names and colors,[192] different levels of purification, different kinds of grounds,[193] and different kinds of appearances, there were those who had come to a bodhimaṇḍa, were seated upon a bodhisattva’s lion throne, were being offered to by the lords of the world, and were encircled by a supreme assembly of bodhisattvas and were attaining the highest, complete enlightenment of buddhahood.

Then the enlightening beings who had gathered at the Jeta grove saw, in every buddha-land in all universes throughout the farthest reaches of space, in groups of buddha-lands within atoms of buddha-lands as numerous as atoms in all buddha-lands, in buddha-lands of various powers, various purities, various locations, and various conditions, an enlightening being at the summit of enlightenment sitting on a lion throne, attended by all world rulers, surrounded by a multitude of enlightening beings, attaining unexcelled supreme perfect enlightenment,

la la na ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa tsam du shin tu yangs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor na/ chos kyi dbyings rgyas par khyab pa'i dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba mthong ngo/ / la la na ni lha'i gnas na 'dug /la la na ni klu'i gnas na 'dug /la la na ni gnod sbyin gyi gnas na 'dug /la la na ni lha ma yin gyi gnas na 'dug /la la na ni nam mkha' lding gi gnas na 'dug /la la na ni mi'am ci'i gnas na 'dug /la la na ni lto 'phye chen po'i gnas na 'dug /la la na ni mi'i dbang po'i gnas na 'dug/ la la na ni mi'i 'jig rten gyi grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang / ljongs dang / khams dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor dag na rnam par 'phrul pa sna tshogs dang / spyod lam sna tshogs dang; lus sna tshogs dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo rnam par dmigs pa sna tshogs dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi mngon par shes pa sna tshogs dang / rigs dang rgyud sna tshogs su byung ba dang / kha dog rnam par dmigs pa sna tshogs dang / 'od kyi dkyil 'khor sna tshogs dang / 'od zer gyi dra ba dgye ba sna tshogs dang / dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor sna tshogs dang / gtam gyi skyes bu'i gzhi sna tshogs dang / bstan pa'i gzhi sna tshogs dang / tshig dang / nges pa'i tshig sna tshogs kyis 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor sna tshogs na chos ston pa mthong bar gyur to/ /

They saw in countless buddha realms some who were turning the wheel of the Dharma with an extent of speech that filled the vastness of the realm of phenomena. They saw some who were in the abodes of the devas; some who were in the abodes of the nāgas; some who were in the abodes of the yakṣas; some who were in the abodes of the asuras; some who were in the abodes of the garuḍas; some who were in the abodes of the kinnaras; some who were in the abodes of the mahoragas; some who were in the abodes of lords of humans; some who were in the villages, towns, market towns, districts, countries, and capitals in the world of humans; with various miraculous powers, various conducts, various bodies; demonstrating various entrances to samādhi; with the various clairvoyances of samādhi; appearing in various families and castes; manifesting various colors; having various kinds of asuras; emanating various networks of light rays; having various extents of voice, various humans that are being spoken to, and various audiences for their teaching; and teaching the Dharma to the gathered assemblies with various words, expressions,[194] and definitions.

here teaching in circles as vast as untold buddha-lands with a sphere of sound pervading the cosmos, there gone to the various realms of existence, or in the cities, towns, communities, and nations of the human world, teaching the truth by means of various miracles, various modes of conduct, various embodiments, various indications of ways of concentration, various superknowledges from concentration, appearing in various castes and races, with various auras of light, radiating various webs of light beams, with various spheres of sound, in various congregations, setting up various interlocutors, setting up various instructions, in various words and expressions.
byang chub sems dpa' ji snyed kyis [***]
As many bodhisattvas as there were[195] saw in each of those gathered assemblies[196] a tathāgata’s profound miracles from a buddha’s samādhi.
And, as those enlightening beings saw the transfigurations of the profound concentration of the Buddha in all those assemblies,

'jig rten gyi khams chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa/ phyogs bcu na rnam par gnas pa/ phyogs kyi rgyud mtha' yas pas 'dus pa/ phyogs rgya mtsho thams cad du gtogs pa/ chos sna tshogs kyi sgo dang ldan pa/ phyogs kyi ming du bya ba sna tshogs su gtogs pa/ phyogs sna tshogs kun tu gzhol ba; phyogs cha rnam pa tha dad par gtogs pa/ phyogs sna tshogs kyi rjes su song ba/ phyogs rgya mtsho sna tshogs su gtogs pa/

They saw the arising of the images of the miracles of the samādhis of tathāgatas in as many world realms as there are throughout the realm of phenomena and as far as the limits of space, that are present in the ten directions, that are all around in the infinite directions, that are in the entire ocean of directions, that are in the directions[197] of various gateways into the Dharma, that are conceived to be in the various directions, that are assembled in the various directions, that are divided among the various directions, that belong to the various directions, that are included within the ocean of the various directions,

they saw transfigurations of Buddha throughout the cosmos, in all worlds throughout space, in the arrays of the ten directions, in the sets of cycles in all places, in the confluence of all spaces, in the media of principles in the various regions, in the various realms of conception, in the conjunctions of the various regions, in the specific spaces of the various regions, in the oceans of all regions—

'di lta ste/ shar phyogs dang / lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs dang / byang dang shar gyi phyogs mtshams dang / shar dang lho'i phyogs mtshams dang / lho dang nub kyi phyogs mtshams dang / nub dang byang gi phyogs mtshams dang / 'og dang / steng gi phyogs kyi

which means in the eastern direction, in the southern direction, in the western direction, in the northern direction, in the northeastern direction, in the southeastern direction, in the southwestern direction, in the northwestern direction, in the upward direction and the downward direction,
that is, in the north, south, east, west, northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest, nadir, and zenith—

zhing gi lhun gyi phyogs dang / sems can gyi lus kyi phyogs dang / sems can gyi ming du bya ba'i phyogs/ sngon gyi mtha'i mur thug pa'i phyogs dang / phyogs bcu da ltar byung ba'i phyogs dang / nam mkha'i khong thams cad du skra'i rtse mo shin tu phra ba dgod pas dmigs pa'i phyogs dang / zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i phyogs la 'jug pa khong du chud par bya ba'i phyogs dang /

in the directions of groups of realms, in the directions of groups[198] of beings, in the directions of the conceived categories[199] of beings, in the directions of the furthest past, in the ten directions of the present, in the directions that are focused on a very fine hair tip located within the entire expanse of space, in the directions of the succession of atoms in all realms,[200] in the directions that are included within directions,

in the places of the body of lands, in the places of the body of beings, in the places that are in the conceptions of beings, in the regions of past ages, in the regions of the present in the ten directions, in every point in all realms of space, in the locus of each and every atom of all lands, in the points of entry of all spaces,
las kyi 'du byed sna tshogs kyis yongs su grub pa'i phyogs dang /
in the directions where the creation of various kinds of karma is accomplished,
in the locations of occurrence of performance of various actions,

skra'i rtse mo gcig la mtha' dang dbus med pa'i nam mkha'i dbyings kyi ming du bya bar gtogs pa'i phyogs kyi khong du chud pa'i dus gsum gyi dbyings mnyam pa nyid du gzhol bas/ kun tu gtogs pa'i 'gro ba thams cad tha mi dad pas sems can thams cad kyi 'du shes kyi rnam pa la mnyam pa'i sgra dbyangs su gyur pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kyi sems la gzugs brnyan rab tu snang bar gyur pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin rnam par 'phrul pa/ sems can thams cad kyi lus la mngon par blta pa dmigs par bya bas/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad du 'gro ba'i tshul dang ldan pa/

in the directions where space, which has no middle or edge, is perceived as being in a single hair tip,[201] in the minds of beings where the three times are united in the state of equality and all beings are within a state of equality, where there is no differentiation between the perceptions of all beings, and where there is the equality of all sounds. They saw within the groups[202] of beings the approach of the forms of the tathāgatas before the assemblies that directly perceive them.

in the conceptual locations of infinite surfaces of space in a point the size of a hairtip, those transfigurations reflected in the minds of all living beings, using their languages, in the perceptions of all living beings, without discrimination among beings, equal in past, present, and future, coming forth equally everywhere as a whole, with physical forms coming to all assemblies, descending into the presence of all bodies of beings,

bskal pa thams cad la ye shes tha mi dad pa/ zhing thams cad la kun tu snyoms pas/ sems can gyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gzugs mngon sum du bstan pa/ rnam par dmigs pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yang dag par bstan pas sems can thams cad 'dul ba rgyun mi 'chad pa mthong bar gyur pa/

They saw the sameness of wisdom within all kalpas. They saw in all the realms how equally everywhere there was the perception of the appearance before them of the forms of the tathāgatas in accordance with the aspirations of all beings. They saw their teaching of all the Dharmas of the buddhas so that there was a continuous guiding of all beings. They saw the miraculous activities of the tathāgatas.

with the same knowledge in all ages, appearing to all beings according to their mentalities, equally, everywhere in all lands, elucidating the teachings of buddhas and guiding sentient beings ceaselessly.

de dag thams cad ni/ sngon bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis dge ba'i spyod pa bskal pa mnyam pa dang / bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis yongs su bsdus pa mthong ba dang / mnyam pa dang / rjes su dran pa dang / bsnyen bkur bas yongs su smin par byas pa dag go /

The Bhagavat Vairocana, through the four methods of gathering pupils and through their corresponding previous practice of good actions, had adopted all of them as pupils. They were ripened through teaching, hearing,[203] remembering, and reverence.
All of them were united by the blessed Vairocana Buddha, by the four integrative methods, by equality of past virtuous actions; they were fully developed by seeing, hearing, and remembering;
sngon bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed du btsud pa dag go /de bzhin gshegs pa de dang de dag gi drung du gshegs pa'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa bas yongs su bsdus pa dag ste/

They had in the past developed the aspiration to attain the highest supreme enlightenment. When they had come before this and that tathāgata, they had been adopted as their pupils because of their roots of merit.
they had already set their minds on supreme enlightenment; going to the buddhas here and there, they were united by fundamental virtues:

de ltar dge ba'i rtsa ba bskal ba mnyam pas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su smin par 'gyur ba'i thabs kyis yongs su shin tu bzung ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam par 'phrul pa chos kyi dbyings ltar yangs shing / nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthas gtugs par gyur pa dag kyang mthong zhing khong du chud par gyur pa yin te/

In that way, through having the corresponding roots of merit and because they were adopted as pupils through the methods of ripening them for omniscience, they saw and perceived the miracles of the samādhi of the Bhagavat Vairocana, which are vast, extending to the limits of space.

in accord with the sameness of their roots of goodness and adoption of means of developing omniscience, the enlightening beings gained access to the projections of the concentration of the blessed Vairocana, which extended throughout the cosmos, to the farthest reaches of space.

la la ni chos kyi sku la 'jug go / la la ni gzugs kyi sku la 'jug go / la la ni sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa'i yongs su bsgrub pa la 'jug go / la la ni pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs pa la 'jug go / la la ni spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su dag pa'i rgyan la 'jug go / la la ni byang chub sems dpa'i sa'i rnam par 'phrul pa la 'jug go / la la ni mngon par byang chub pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa la 'jug go / la la ni sangs rgyas rnam par spyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin tha mi dad pa rnam par 'phrul pa la 'jug go / la la ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dang mi bsnyengs pa la 'jug go / la la ni sangs rgyas kyi tha dad pa yang dag par mkhyen pa rgya mtsho la 'jug go /

Some perceived the Dharma body. Some perceived the form body. Some perceived his past bodhisattva accomplishment. Some perceived his completion of the perfections. Some perceived the display of his pure field of conduct. Some perceived the miracles of the bodhisattva level. Some perceived the miracles of enlightenment. Some perceived miracles that were not different from the samādhi practiced by a buddha. Some perceived the strengths and fearlessnesses of the tathāgatas. Some perceived the ocean of the realization of a buddha,

Some comprehended the reality-body, some the form-body, some the past attainment of Vairocana as an enlightening being, some the fulfillment of the ways of transcendence, some the pure adornment of the sphere of action, some the mystic projection of the stages of enlightening, some the mystical projection of perfect enlightenment, some the unconfused mystical projection of the concentrations in which buddhas sojourn, some the powers and fearlessnesses of buddhas, and some comprehended the ocean of analytic powers of buddhas—

de dag la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa rgya mtsho/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la 'jug ste/ mos pa sna tshogs dang / lam sna tshogs dang / sgo sna tshogs dang / 'jug pa sna tshogs dang / 'bab pa sna tshogs dang / tshul sna tshogs dang / rjes su 'brang ba sna tshogs dang / phyogs sna tshogs dang / snod sna tshogs dang / yul sna tshogs dang / 'jig rten sna tshogs dang / khong du chud pa sna tshogs dang / tshogs sna tshogs dang / rnam par 'phrul pa sna tshogs dang / thabs sna tshogs dang / ting nge 'dzin sna tshogs kyis sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa rgya mtsho de dag la 'jug go /

and so on, perceiving an ocean of a buddha’s miracles as numerous as the incalculable number of atoms in ten buddha realms.[204] They perceived an ocean of buddha miracles through various aspirations, various paths, various gateways, various entries, various ingresses, various ways, various observances, various directions, various vessels, various regions, various worlds, various attainments, various accumulations, various miracles, and various methods.

they entered into as many such oceans of mystical projections of Buddha as there are atoms in ten inexpressible numbers of buddha-lands. They entered those oceans of mystical projections of Buddha by way of various devotions, various paths, various doors, various entries, various penetrations, various methods, various approaches, various directions, various capacities, various places, various worlds, various attainments, various provisions, various transformations, various means, and various concentrations.
ting nge 'dzin sna tshogs kyis 'jug pa 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos kyi dbyings kun nas brgyan pa dang /
The bodhisattvas perceived the ocean of miracles of the Bhagavat Vairocana through various samādhis, which were the bodhisattva samādhi the display of the entire realm of phenomena,

Those enlightening beings gained access to the mystical projections, the miraculous transfigurations, of the blessed Buddha Vairocana by means of such enlightening beings; concentrations as these—adornment of the entire cosmos,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin dus gsum thams cad la thogs pa med par yul snang bar byed pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the radiance of the range of the unimpeded wisdom of all three times,
illumination of the realm of unobstructed knowledge of all times,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos kyi dbyings kyi gzhi tha mi dad pa'i ye shes snang ba dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the radiance of the wisdom that is inseparable from the basis of the realm of phenomena,
light of knowledge of the continuity of the planes of the cosmos,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul gyi dbyings la 'jug pa dang /
entry into the plane of the sphere of those who realize Thusness,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin nam mkha'i dbyings su snang ba dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the radiance of the sky,
illumination of the plane of space,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu 'thob pas rnam par 'byed pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi expansion through the attainment of the Buddha’s ten strengths,
free access to the ten powers of buddhas,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas kyi bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba'i rgyan gyis rnam par gnon cing rnam par bsgyings pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the expanding prowess of the display of the fearlessness of buddhahood,
bold emergence adorned by the fearlessness of the enlightened,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul thams cad kyi klong gi snying po dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the essence of the extent of all ways in the realm of phenomena,
whirlpool of the principles of the reality realm,
byang chub sems dpa' ting nge 'dzin chos kyi dbyings thams cad du thogs pa med par sgra sgrogs pas rgyas par 'gengs pa'i zla ba dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the moon that pervades the entire realm of phenomena with unimpeded sound,
moon pervading all universes with unhindered sound,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos kyi dbyings mnyam pa nyid kyis brgyan pa'i 'od kyis
and the bodhisattva samādhi the light of the adornment of the equality of the realm of phenomena.
and light of principles of universal order.

byang chub sems dpa'i de dag bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa rgya mtsho de dag la rab tu 'jug go/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po'i thabs chags pa med pa'i rgyal mtshan dang /
The bodhisattvas perceived the ocean of miracles of the Bhagavat Vairocana through various samādhis, which were the bodhisattva samādhi the banner of the unimpeded methods of the king of the Dharma,

Those enlightening beings also entered the oceans of mystical projections of buddhahood of the blessed Vairocana by way of such enlightening concentrations as those known as emblem of the king of truth crowned by nonattachment,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin dmigs pa thams cad la sangs rgyas rgya mtsho rnam par lta ba dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the vision of an ocean of buddhas in all objects of perception,[205]
seeing oceans of buddhas in all objects,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin 'jig rten gyi rgyud thams cad du tha mi dad pa'i lus snang ba'i rgyal mtshan dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the banner of the appearance of bodies that are not different from the existences in all worlds,
emblem of reflection of the different bodies of all realms of being,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku tha dad pa'i yul la 'dug pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the entry into the field that is not different[206] from the bodies of the Tathāgata,
entry into the unalloyed sphere of the body of those who arrive at Thusness,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin 'jig rten thams cad kyi rgyud kyis rjes su 'jug pa snying rje'i snying po can dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the essence of compassion for the continuing suffering in all worlds,
container of compassion going along with the whirl of all worlds,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos thams cad kyi gnas la rten pa'i byin gyi rlabs dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the blessing based upon the foundation of all phenomena,[207]
founded on the power based on all truths,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting 'dzin shin tu zhi la rab tu zhi bas kun tu snang ba'i dkyil 'khor dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the appearance of the domain of tranquility in absolute peace,
sphere of revelation of ultimately quiescent indifferent equality,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sprul pa bzang po dmigs su med pas kun tu 'phrul pa'i gzugs brnyan dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the appearance of the complete manifestation of unimpeded nondependent manifestations,
universally projected reflection emanated purely without attachment,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin zhing thams cad yongs su 'du ba'i byin gyi rlabs dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the blessing that completely unites all realms,
occult manifestation of the unity of all lands,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting 'dzin zhing thams cad du mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'i rnam pa mngon par bsgrub pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the attainment of the outer form of enlightenment in all buddha realms,
effectuation of the manifestation of attainment of enlightenment in all buddha-lands,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin 'gro ba thams cad du dbang po kha dog gis rnam par spyod pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the conduct[208] of the power over the senses among all beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin 'gro ba thams cad du khyad par du 'phags pa'i dkyil 'khor chags pa med pas rnam par spyod pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the unimpeded domain of conduct that is superior among all beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad skyed pa las byung ba'i byin gyi rlabs dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the blessing that comes from the birth of the tathāgatas,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin yon tan rgya mtsho thams cad la nan tan gyis 'jug pa dang / /
the bodhisattva samādhi the comprehension of the attainment[209] of the entire ocean of qualities,
comprehension of embodiment of all oceanic virtues,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin dmigs pa ma lus pa thams cad du rnam par 'phrul pa mngon par bsgrub pas phyi ma'i mthar byin gyis rlob pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the blessing for the future accomplishment of all perceivable miracles without exception,
endless spiritual power to effect the mystical transfiguration of all objects,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sngon gyi sbyor ba rgya mtsho la 'jug pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the comprehension of the ocean of past practices of all tathāgatas,
entry into the ocean of past practices of all buddhas,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin phyi ma'i mthar de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs yang dag par 'dzin pa'i byin gyi rlabs dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the blessing for the future possession of the lineages[210] of all tathāgatas,
basis of eternal preservation of the lineage of buddhas,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin phyogs bcu'i zhing rgya mtsho da ltar byung ba thams cad yongs su dag par mos pa'i byin gyi rlabs dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the blessing of the aspiration for the entire ocean of pure realms in the ten directions in the present,
power of devotion to purification of the ocean of all lands in the ten directions of the present,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sems kyi skad cig gcig la sangs rgyas thams cad dang rnam par spyod cing 'grogs pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the appearance and presence[211] of all the buddhas in one instant of mind,
illumination of the states of all buddhas in a single moment of thought,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin dmigs pa thams cad la chags pa med pa'i mthar 'jug pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the entry into the apex of nonattachment to objects of perception,
entry into ultimate freedom from attachment to all objects,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad sangs rgyas kyi zhing gcig tu byin gyis rlob pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the blessing of all world realms as a single buddha realm,
causing all worlds to appear in one buddha-field,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas thams cad kyi skur 'phrul pa mngon par bsgrub pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the accomplishment of the emanation of the bodies of all the buddhas,
production of emanations of all embodiments of buddhas,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin dbang po rgya mtsho rdo rje'i dbang po lta bu thams cad khong du chud pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the realization of the ocean of the powers of the vajra lord,
adamantine knowledge of the ocean of all faculties,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sku gcig pa'i snying bo'i byin gyi rlabs dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the blessing of the essence of the single body of all tathāgatas,
causing all buddhas to appear within a single body,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sems kyi skad cig gcig gi cha la chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul thams cad khong du chud pas khom par gnas pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi remaining within observation of the processes of the entire realm of phenomena within the fraction of an instant of the mind,
instantaneous state of discovering the principle of all things in the point of a moment of thought,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos kyi dbyings thams cad du zhing 'byams klas pa bsgrub pa yongs su ston pa'i byin gyi rlabs dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the blessing that reveals the creation of infinite realms throughout the entire realm of phenomena,
spiritual power of manifesting nirvana in all realms in the cosmos,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin spyi'u tshugs gzhi la rnam par spyod pa'i byin gyi rlabs dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the blessing of the ground on which the crown of the head is placed,
power to roam on the highest plane,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi sems can gyi lus tha mi dad par byin gyis rlob pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the blessing of there being no difference between the bodies of beings in all the buddha realms,
magical manifestation of the differentiation of the bodies of beings in all buddha-lands,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin ye shes kyi klong thams cad la mngon sum du yang dag par gzhol ba dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the concentrated approach to all of wisdom’s revolving,[212]
entry into the presence of the whirl of all knowledge,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin dang mtshan nyid yongs su shes pas rab tu 'byed pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the knowledge and differentiation of the characteristics of the nature of all phenomena,
complete knowledge and *
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin dus gsum sems kyi skad cig la tha mi dad pa'i dkyil 'khor dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the domain of the differentiation[213] of the three times in a single instant of mind,
differentation of past, present, and future in a single instant,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sems kyi skad cig thams cad chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul gyi rang bzhin dam pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the supreme nature[214] of the processes of the realm of phenomena in all instants of the mind,
containing the body of principles of the cosmos in every moment of thought,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i ye shes kyis rnam par gnon pa'i seng ge dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the lion that has the prowess of following the lineages of all the tathāgatas,
lion following the lineage of all buddhas,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin dmigs pa thams cad chos kyi dbyings su shes pa'i mig gi dkyil 'khor dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the domain of the eyes that know the entire perceivable realm of phenomena,
sphere of the eye of wisdom seeing the cosmos in all objects,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin stobs bcu'i rtsal gyis rnam par gnon pas yang dag par rtsom pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi undertaking the prowess of the force of the ten strengths,
vigorous undertaking of approach to the ten powers,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin dmigs pa thams cad kun nas mthong ba'i mig gi dkyil 'khor dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the domain of the eyes that see all perceivable objects,
sphere of the eye of universal vision of all objects,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin kha dog thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor gyis 'gro ba shin tu mdzes pa mngon par bsgrub pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the accomplishment of the beauty of beings through the field of all colors,
illumination of beings in all spheres of form,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin klong mi g.yo ba'i snying po dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the essence of the unwavering revolving,
space of an unmoving whirl,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos gcig la chos thams cad yongs su 'du bar ston pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the revelation of all phenomena being contained within one phenomenon,

byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos gcig gi tshig gi lam la nges pa'i ngag gi tshig tu 'byed pas
and the bodhisattva samādhi the distinguishing of definitions within a single description of one phenomenon.
verbal analysis of truth.

byang chub sems dpa' de dag /bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis sangs rgyas kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis rnam par 'phrul pa rgya mtsho de dag la rab tu 'jug go / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rgyal mtshan gyi byin gyi rlabs kyis chos ston pa dang /

Those bodhisattvas perceived the ocean of miracles of the Bhagavat Vairocana through entering bodhisattva samādhis as numerous as the atoms in countless realms, such as the bodhisattva samādhi the teaching of the Dharma through the blessing of the banner of all the buddhas,

Those enlightening beings also entered the oceans of mystic projections of Buddha made by Vairocana by way of such enlightening beings’ concentrations as exposition of truth setting up the standard of all buddhas,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin dus gsum gyi mu la mthar thug pa med pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the unimpeded illumination of the furthest reaches of the three times,[215]
illumination unattached to the borders of past, present, and future,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin bskal pa thams cad khong du chud pas tha mi dad pa'i ye shes dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the wisdom that comprehends without differentiation all kalpas,
continuous knowledge of all ages,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin tshul shin tu phra bas stobs bcu khong du chud pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the realization of the ten strengths in a subtle manner,
entry into the ten powers by subtle means,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin mi 'phrogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bskal pa thams cad du mngon par bsgrub pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the uninterrupted[216] accomplishment of bodhisattva conduct throughout all kalpas,
accomplishment of unbreakable practice of the essence of enlightenment through all ages,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin phyogs thams cad kun du shugs kyis mngon du 'char ba'i sprin dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi swift clouds throughout[217] every direction,
clouds swiftly appearing everywhere,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'i rnam par 'phrul pa rnam par bsgrub pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the accomplishment of the miracles of enlightenment,
creation of magical appearances of attainment of enlightenment,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin tshor ba thams cad kyis reg pa med pas bde ba'i rgyal mtshan dang;
the bodhisattva samādhi the banner of the happiness of being untouched by any sensation,
characterized by all pleasures of feeling,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyan thams cad du nam mkha'i rgyan mngon par bsgrub pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the accomplishment of the entire display of the adornments of space,
adornment of space with all kinds of magnificent arrays,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin skad cig skad cig la 'gro ba snyed kyi sprul pa'i gzugs brnyan gyi sprin mngon par bsgrub pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the accomplishment in every instant of clouds of emanations of images of worlds,
moment to moment producing clouds of crested images like beings of the world,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i 'od nam mkha' ltar rdul dang bral ba dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the moonlight of the tathāgatas that is as immaculate as space,
light of the moon of realization of Thusness pure as space,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad nam mkha' ltar byin gyis rlob pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the blessing of all the tathāgatas as being like space,
spacelike base of all who realize Thusness,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos thams cad la dbang po'i rgyan rab tu snang ba dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the radiance of the display of power over all phenomena,
radiance of all spiritual faculties,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos thams cad kyi don rnam par 'byed pa'i sgron ma dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the lamp that distinguishes the meaning of all phenomena,
lamp revealing the meanings of all things,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin stobs bcu'i dkyil 'khor snang ba dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the radiance of the field of the ten strengths,
illumination of the sphere of the ten powers,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dpal gyi rgyal mtshan dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the banner of the splendor of the buddhas of the three times,
characterized by the brilliance of the buddhas of all times,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa'i snying po dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the essence of the union of all the buddhas,
the unique source of all buddhas,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin skad cig skad cig la brtsams pa thams cad mthar phyin par byed pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the fulfillment of all undertakings in every instant,
accomplishing undertakings in every passing moment,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin bsod nams mi zad pa'i snying po dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the essence of inexhaustible merit,
source of inexhaustible blessing,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas mtha' yas pa mthong ba'i yul rab tu snang ba dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the radiance of the guidance[218] of the vision of infinite buddhas,
illumination of guidance of endless vision of Buddha,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos thams cad la rdo rje'i seng ge ltar rab tu gnas pa dang /

supreme adamantine basis of all truths,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sprul pa yongs su bstan pas/ kun tu rnam par dmigs pa mngon par bsgrub pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the accomplishment of the complete perception of the vision of the manifestations of all tathāgatas,
production of universal manifestations of the emanations of all buddhas,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mnan pa'i nyi ma gnon pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the ascent to the sun that has been ascended to by all the tathāgatas,[219]
consummating the course of the sun of all buddhas,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin dus gsum gcig tu spyod pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi practicing[220] the three times as one,
instantly illuminating past, present, and future,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rab tu zhi bar sgra dbyangs kun tu sgrog pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the resounding of the voice that emits the complete illumination[221] of the peace that is the nature of all phenomena,
sound of the voice emitting universal light illumining the natural quiescence of all things,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas thams cad mthong ba'i sa mtshams 'dzin pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi passing over[222] the boundary of seeing all buddhas,
march to the boundary of vision of all buddhas,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad kyi gnas kyi pad+mo'i tshal rab tu rgyas pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the entire realm of phenomena without exception being a blossoming bed of lotuses,
aware of all things like a collection of lotuses,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gnas med pa'i chos kyi nam mkha' la rnam par lta ba dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi looking upon the baseless phenomena of space,
observation of phenomena as baseless like the sky,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin phyogs gcig tu phyogs bcu rgya mtsho yongs su sdud pa'i klong dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the process of the coming together of the ocean of the ten directions into one direction,
whirlpool of concentration of the ocean of all spaces in one space,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos kyi dbyings kyi gzhi thams cad kyi sgor 'jug pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi entering the gateway of the entire basis of the realm of phenomena,
entering directly into the ground of all phenomena,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos rgya mtsho thams cad dang ldan pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the possession of the essence[223] of the entire ocean of phenomena,
oceanic source of all things,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sems can thams cad la 'od rab tu 'gyed pas rab tu zhi ba'i lus su 'gyur ba dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the body of peace that emits light for all beings,
tranquil body shining light on all beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sems kyi skad cig gcig la mngon par shes pa dang / smon lam thams cad mngon par bsgrub pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the accomplishment of all clairvoyances and aspirations in a single instant of mind,
accomplishment of the will for all higher knowledge in a single moment of thought,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin rtag par thams cad du kun nas mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i byin gyi rlabs dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the blessing of complete enlightenment everywhere at all times,
eternal manifestation of the attainment of enlightenment equally everywhere,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyan gcig tu khong du chud par 'jug pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the entry into the realization of all phenomena as a single display,
entering into all universes by comprehending them as one single array,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas thams cad dran pa'i rang bzhin gyi rab tu snang ba dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the appearance of the body[224] that has the memory of all the buddhas,
illumination of the body of recollection of all buddhas,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin 'gro ba thams cad du khyad par chen po dang ldan pa'i ye shes mngon par shes pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the realization of the wisdom that is vastly different from that of beings,
intuition of vast higher knowledge of all worlds,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sems kyi skad cig gcig gis chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul mtha' yas pa rang gi lus kyis rgyas par 'gengs pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi one’s own body’s pervasion in a single instant of the infinite ways of the realm of phenomena,
merging one’s being with the infinite cosmic principle in a single mental instant,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos kyi dbyings tshul gcig gis/ chos thams cad tshul gcig par rnam par dgod pa'i 'od dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the light of the display of the single way of all phenomena through the single way of the realm of phenomena,
illumination of the homologous order of all things in homologous universes,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gzi brjid kyi byin gyi rlabs dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the blessing of the brilliance of the wheel of the field of the Dharma of all[225] the buddhas,
mystical manifestation of the fiery energy of the spheres of all Buddha teachings,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sems can gyi khams mig 'phrul lta bu yongs su bsdu ba'i smon lam dang / spyod pa byin gyis rlob pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the blessing of practicing the aspiration to perceive the realms of beings as illusions,
basis of the determination and action taking all realms of beings into the net of Indra,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos kyi dbyings kyi gzhi thams cad tha mi dad pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the nondifferentiation of the basis of all world realms,
continuity of the ground of all worlds,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin pad+mo'i byin rnam par 'phrul pas kun tu rnam par gnon pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the prowess of manifesting the magnificence of lotuses,
traveling everywhere by mystic projections of lotuslike splendor,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sems can thams cad kyi lus kyi rgyud khong du chud pas mngon par shes pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the clairvoyant knowledge of the successive bodies of all beings,
intuitive knowledge of the cycles of the bodies of all beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin lus sems can thams cad la mngon du byin gyis rlob pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the blessing of bodies that come to all beings,
magical materialization in the presence of all beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sems can thams cad kyi dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtshor 'gro ba thams cad kyi skad yongs su 'byed pa'i tshul mngon par shes pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the clairvoyance that differentiates the language of all beings in an ocean of the aspects of the voices of all beings,
superknowledge of the means of analyzing mundane speech in the ocean of utterances of all beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin 'gro ba'i gzhi tha dad pa thams cad khong du chud pas mngon par shes pa dang /
superknowledge of the distinctions of the seeds of all worlds,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin snying rje chen po'i mdzod tha mi dad pa'i snying po dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the essence of the faith that is no different from the treasure of great compassion,
unalloyed incorruptible matrix of great compassion,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas thams cad de bzhin nyid du rtogs pa'i mtha' la 'jug pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the comprehension of the ultimate realization of the true nature by all the buddhas,
entry of all buddhas into the goal of realization of Thusness,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rnam par thar pa'i pho brang la rnam par lta bas seng+ge rnam par bsgyings pa dang /
the bodhisattva samādhi the supremacy of the lion gazing on the palace of liberation, and other samādhis.
and lionlike emergence to behold the abode of liberation of all buddhas.

de dag la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi lam la 'jug pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa rgya mtsho de dag la rab tu 'jug go / sems kyi skad cig re re la chos kyi dbyings thams cad du rgyas par 'gengs par 'jug pa'i tshul gyis sngon skal pa mnyam par spyad pa yang rjes su dran no/ /

Those bodhisattvas, through entering the path of samādhis such as those, which were as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, perceived the Tathāgata Vairocana’s oceans of miracles of buddhahood, and they remembered the same kinds of miracles that he had performed in the past, with their comprehension pervading the entirety of the realm of phenomena in each instant of mind.[226]

By entry into as many of the concentrations of enlightening beings as atoms in untold buddha-lands, beginning with these, those enlightening beings entered into the ocean of the blessed Vairocana’s mystical projections of buddhahood, and they accordingly remembered equivalent transformations carried out in the past. Furthermore, by the mental-moment-to-mental-moment entry, pervading the whole cosmos,
de ltar byang chub sems dpa' de dag dze ta'i tshal du phyin cing / bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga na 'khod pa/
Those bodhisattvas had come to Jetavana and were assembled before the Bhagavat;
of those enlightening beings, who were in the presence of Buddha in the Jeta grove,
seng ge'i khri rin po che sna tshogs kyi pad+mo'i snying po can/ 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang mnyam par yangs pa la 'khod pa/
they were seated upon lotuses made of various jewels[227] in the centers of lion thrones, which were as extensive as world realms and as numerous as the atoms in ten buddha realms;
sitting on lion thrones in lotuses of various jewels as vast as worlds as numerous as atoms in ten buddha-lands,
ye shes dang mngon par shes pa chen po'i rnam par 'phrul pas byung ba/
they had appeared through the miracle of great wisdom and knowledge;
born of the occult transformation of great knowledge and insight,
ye shes dang mngon par shes pa rno ba dang ldan pa'i sa rjes su thob pa/
they had attained the level of sharp wisdom and knowledge;
having attained the stage of penetrating knowledge and insight,
ye shes kyi kun tu rnam par spyod pa/
they had completely analyzed through wisdom;
contemplating with universal knowledge,
shes rab kyi 'byung gnas kyi rigs su byung ba/
they had appeared in the family that is the origin of wisdom;
born of the source of wisdom,
thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la mngon du gyur pa/
they were facing[228] omniscient wisdom;
on the brink of omniscience,
ye shes kyi mig rab rib med pa dang ldan pa/
they had the undimmed eyes of wisdom;
having unclouded eyes of knowledge,
sems can gyi kha lo sgyur ba'i rang bzhin thob pa/
having arrived at the state of leaders of beings,
sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam pa nyid kyi rjes su song ba/
they approached the equality of all buddhas;
having approached equality with all buddhas,
rtag tu rnam par rtog pa med par chos la spyod pa/
they continuously engaged with phenomena without conceptualization;
always carrying out the principle of nondiscrimination,
chos kyi dmigs pa thams cad rab tu rtogs pa/
they had understood all perceived phenomena;
with specific knowledge of all objects,
chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis zhi bar dmigs pa;
they had the perception of the peace that is the nature of all phenomena;
relating to all things as naturally calm,
'jig rten thams cad shin tu zhi bas gnas tha dad pa med pa la rab tu gzhol ba/
they had the supreme basis for the nirvāṇa that is the pacification of all worlds;[229]
in the ultimate asylum of the quiescence and nirvana of all worlds
'jig rten tha dad pa thams cad du rab tu zhugs pa/
they were present in the variety of all worlds;
yet upholding the variety of all worlds,
gnas med par zhing thams cad du 'dong ba/
they did not dwell anywhere but went to all realms;
going to all lands without attachment,
chos kyi gnas thams cad la bstan pa med par
they were not based upon the level of phenomena;[230]
in the midst of all things without reliance on anything,
chos thams cad bla gab med pa'i gzhal med khang du byin pa/
they were based[231] within the divine palace of the unconcealed nature of all phenomena;
effortlessly establishing the measures of all teachings,
'gro ba thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang gdul ba la zhugs pa/
they followed the disciplined conduct through which they ripened all beings;[232]
knowing how to develop and guide all people,
sems can thams cad la bde ba'i lam ston pa/
they taught all beings the path to bliss;
showing all beings the state of peace and serenity,
ye shes dang rnam par thar pa shin tu 'phags pa'i gnas kyi spyod yul can/
they had the field of activity that is the abode of the superior wisdom and liberation;
risen to the realm of the abode of knowledge and liberation,
'dod chags dang bral ba'i mthar phyin pa'i ye shes kyi lus dang ldan pa/
they had the wisdom bodies that have reached the apex of the absence of desire;
embodying knowledge gone to the limit of dispassion,
srid pa'i rgya mtsho thams cad las gyan [*gyen?] du 'phags pa/
they rose above the ocean of all existences;
having emerged from the ocean of all existences,
'gro ba thams cad la yang dag pa'i mtha' rnam par ston pa/
they revealed the summit of existence to all beings;
observing the limit of reality of all worlds,
chos rgya mtsho'i shes rab snang ba'i dkyil 'khor can/
they had the disk that illuminated the ocean of the Dharma;
in the sphere of light of knowledge of the ocean of truths,
ting nge 'dzin gangs chen mtsho dang ldan pa'i dbyings la shin tu mnyam par bzhag cing snying rje chen po rab tu sems pa/
they rested in the essence of the samādhi that is like an ocean;[233] they had minds endowed with great compassion;
with great compassionate minds perfectly unified by oceanic concentration,
chos kyi tshul sgyu ma'i rnam pa lta bu rab tu rtogs pa/
they had realized the nature of phenomena to be like that of an apparition;
thoroughly aware of the principle of the illusoriness of phenomena,
'jig rten gyi khams thams cad la rmi lam lta bur zhugs pa/
they comprehended all worlds to be like dreams;
having comprehended that all worlds are like dreams,
de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba thams cad mig yor lta bur khong du chud pa/
they understood that the vision of all the tathāgatas is like an illusion;
knowing the vision of all buddhas are like reflections,
sgra skad dang / dbyangs thams cad sgra brnyan lta bur rnam par rig pa/
they knew all speech and sound to be like echoes;
aware that all utterances are like echoes,
chos thams cad mngon par sgrub pa'i ye shes sprul pa lta bur rab tu rtogs pa/
they had attained the knowledge that the creation of phenomena is like a magical manifestation;
knowing that the effects of all things are like magic productions,
khyad par du 'phags pa'i smon lam shin tu bsags pa/
they had the excellent acquisition of aspirations;
determined to reach the sphere of fulfillment,
ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor kun nas rnam par dag pa'i mkhas pa dang ldan pa/
they possessed the skillfulness of the pure domain of wisdom;
following skillful methods of purification of the sphere of universal knowledge,
sems shin tu zhi zhing rab tu zhi ba dang ldan pa/
they had minds of complete peace, perfect peace;
with ultimately peaceful and calm minds,
gzugs kyi rgyud thams cad kyi ye shes kyi yul dang ldan pa/
they possessed the field of wisdom of all the classes of dhāraṇīs;
with knowledge of all families of mystic spells,
ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs kyis dogs pa med pa kun nas rab tu gnon pa/
they had the complete prowess of the power of unfailing samādhi;
with fearless, even force of the the power of concentration,
chos kyi dbyings kyi gnas kyi mthar phyin pa'i mig dang ldan pa;
they had the sight that has reached the limits of the nature of phenomena;
with the eye reaching the limit of the cosmos,
chos thams cad la dmigs pa med par rnam par spyod pa rab tu thob pa/
they had attained the conduct that has no dependence on any phenomenon;
in the stage of ungraspability of all things,
shes rab rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa la rnam par spyod pa/
they had traversed an endless ocean of wisdom;
contemplating the infinite ocean of wisdom,
ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i pha rol tu son pa/
gone to the farther shore of transcendence by knowledge,
shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i stobs dang shugs thob pa/
they had attained the strength and power of the perfection of wisdom;
having attained the sustaining power of transcendent wisdom,
rdzu 'phrul gyi pha rol tu phyin pas 'gro ba thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/
they had reached the highest state among all beings through their perfection of miraculous powers;
gone beyond all worlds by consummation of transcendent spiritual powers,
ting nge 'dzin gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dbang du gyur pa/
they had attained dominion over the perfection of samādhi;
masters of transcendent concentration,
de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi don mkhas pa la phyin ci log med pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa/
they possessed the irreversible wisdom of being skillful in the goals of all the tathāgatas;
with correct knowledge of all buddhas’ skillfullness in respect to meanings,
chos kyi mdzod dbye ba'i cho ga la mkhas pa/
they were wise in the methods of illuminating the treasure[234] of the Dharma;
with knowledge of the means of skillful elucidation of truth,
nges pa'i tshig shes pa la mngon par mkhas pa/
they were learned in the knowledge of etymologies;
with extraordinary knowledge of expression,
spobs pa'i stobs dang / chos kyi sprin zad mi shes pa dang ldan pa/
they possessed the unceasing clouds of Dharma and the power of eloquence;
being clouds of teaching with inexhaustible power of eloquence,
mi 'jigs pas khyu mchog dang / seng ge'i nga ro 'byin pa/
they possessed the lion’s roar of the fearless bull;
roaring the fearless, mighty lion’s roar,
gnas med pa'i chos kyi dga' ba la dga' bas mos pa/
they had the joyous aspiration in the joy of phenomena having no basis;
enjoying the unequaled bliss of nonreliance,
chos thams cad la rab rib med pa'i mig gis blta ba/
they saw all phenomena with undimmed sight;
having unclouded eyes seeing into all things,
'jig rten thams cad kyi 'byung ba dang / 'jig pa shes pa'i zla bar gyur pa/
they were moons with the knowledge of the arising and destruction of worlds;[235]
moons of knowledge of the state of intellect of all beings,
shes rab kyi dkyil 'khor gyis bden pa'i tshul thams cad la rnam par spyod pa'i 'od zer can/
they were disks of wisdom with the light rays that practiced all the ways of truth;
beams of light of designations of principles of all truths from the sphere of wisdom,
ye shes kyi rdo rje bsod nams kyi khor yug tu gyur pa/
they were turning wheels of the vajra merit of wisdom;
mountains of virtue with diamonds of knowledge,
dper bya ba thams cad las shin tu 'das pa/
they transcended all analogies;
beyond all comparison,
chos thams cad la dbang po dang / ye shes kyi myu gu rab tu skyes pa/
they were the growing sprouts of the wisdom that has[236] power over all phenomena;
sprouting the knowledge of all spiritual faculties,
dpa' bo'i rgyal mtshan dang ldan pa/
they were the victory banners of heroes;
bdud thams cad kyi rgyal mtshan rab tu snyol ba la dpa' ba/
they had the heroism that overthrows the banners of all the māras;
heroic conquerors of all demons,
ye shes mtha' yas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gzi brjid can/
they had the brilliance of the sun[237] of infinite wisdom;
full of the energy of the sphere of endless knowledge,
'gro ba thams cad las mngon par 'phags pa'i lus dang ldan pa/
they had bodies that transcended those of all beings;
physically beyond all worldlings,
chos thams cad la shes rab sgrib pa med pa/
they had the unobscured knowledge of all phenomena;[238]
with unhindered insight into all things,
zad pa dang mi zad pa'i mtha'i ye shes kyis rnam par sangs rgyas pa/
they had awakened to the knowledge that is the apex of all that is ceasing and unceasing;
aware of the bounds of finiteness and infinity,
yang dag pa'i mtha' kun gyi mthar phyin pa la gnas pa/
they were summit dwellers through having reached every summit;
standing on the limit of reality, tallying with the universal limit,
mtshan ma med pa la rnam par lta ba'i ye shes kyi mig mngon sum can
they had the sight of the knowledge that is attentive to the practice[239] that has no features;
having the eye of knowledge observing signlessness,
byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad mngon par bsgrub pa'i rgyu la mkhas pa/
they were skilled in the causes[240] of the accomplishment of all bodhisattva conduct;
skilled in the causes of accomplishment of all practices of enlightening beings,
mi gnyis pa'i ye shes kyi spyod yul dang ldan pa/
they possessed the range of nondual wisdom;
coursing in nondualistic knowledge,
'jig rten gyi rgyud thams cad la rnam par lta ba/
they discerned all the existences in worlds;
observing all worldly trends,
sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rgyud gnas med pa thams cad du gzugs brnyan snang bar gyur pa/
there appeared to them the images of all the existences in buddha realms that have no locations;
appearing in all buddha-lands without dwelling,
chos thams cad la mun pa dang rnam par bral ba/
they were devoid of all the darkness of phenomena;
free from obscurity in regard to all things,
ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor mun pa med pa la rab tu zhugs pa/
they had reached the sun disks[241] of wisdom that are free of darkness;
having reached the sphere of knowledge without darkness,
phyogs kun tu chos kyi snang ba rab tu bkye ba/
they shined the radiance of the Dharma in every direction;
engaged in the illumination of truth everywhere,
'gro ba thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing mchog tu gyur pa/
they were the supreme fields of merit for all beings;
excellent fields of blessings for all beings,
thos pa dang / mthong ba dang; smon lam don yod pa'i zla ba/
they were moons of fruitful hearing, seeing, and aspiration;
moons of fulfillment of the wishes of all who see or hear of them,
bsod nams kyi ri rab 'jig rten thams cad las mngon par 'phags pa/
they were Sumerus of merit that had transcended all worlds;
mountains of virtue rising above all worlds,
phas kyi rgol ba'i tshogs thams cad tshar gcod pa la shin tu dpa' ba/
they were heroes who had vanquished the hosts of opponents;
bravely subduing all challengers,
sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du sgra skad dang / dbyangs kyi nga ro 'byin pa/
they made the sounds of their voices resound throughout all the buddha realms;
making their voices heard in all buddha-lands,
sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku mthong bas mi ngoms pa/
they gazed insatiably upon the bodies of all the buddhas;
tirelessly watching all the buddhas,
sangs rgyas kyi sku'i gzugs brnyan gyi dbang bsgyur ba dang ldan pa/
they possessed the power of the appearance of the bodies of[242] the buddhas;
able to control reflections of the bodies of all buddhas,
'gro ba 'dul ba dang mthun pa'i lus su byin gyis rlob pa/
they magically manifested[243] the bodies that were appropriate for guiding beings;
adopting appropriate forms to guide all beings,
zhing 'byams klas pa thams cad du lus gcig gis rgyas par 'gengs pa/
they filled all the widespread realms with their one body;
pervading all lands with one body,
mngon par 'du bya ba med pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi dkyil 'khor yongs su dag pa
they had pure orbits of accomplishment;[244]
having purified their spheres of accomplishment,
thogs pa med par 'gro ba'i ye shes chen po'i theg pa'i gru dang ldan pa/
they were ships that are vehicles of great wisdom moving without impediment;[245]
having the capacity for the vehicle of great knowledge unobstructed as space,
ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gyis chos kyi dbyings thams cad du lus rab tu snang ba/
they were orbs of wisdom that illuminated all the bodies in the realm of phenomena;
reflecting the bodies of all things in their sphere of knowledge,
ye shes kyi nyi ma 'gro ba thams cad du shar ba/
they were suns of wisdom that rose over all beings;
suns of knowledge appearing in all worlds,
'gro ba thams cad bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du dga' ba'i kha dog dang ldan pa/
they had pleasing forms[246] in accordance with the wishes of beings;
having the power to adapt to all worlds at will,
'gro ba thams cad kyi bsam pa dang dbang po rab tu rtogs pa'i ye shes can/
they had the wisdom that discerned the motivations and faculties of all beings;
having specific knowledge of the various dispositions and faculties of all beings,
chos thams cad bsgribs pa med pa'i yul du khong du chud pa/
they had attained the unobscured domain of all phenomena;
having arrived at all truths with unobstructed perspective,
chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin skye ba med pa rnam par rig pa/
they had understood the unborn nature of all phenomena;
apprised of the inherent nature of all things being birthlessness,
phra ba dang yangs pa phan tshun du yongs su bsdu ba la dbang bsgyur ba
they had the mastery of uniting the minute and the vast;
mature in the knowledge of the mutual interpenetration of the subtle and gross,
sangs rgyas kyi sa zab mo'i tshul nges par rtogs pa/
they had definitive knowledge of the profound way of buddhahood;
resolved on the goal of the profound state of buddhahood,
don zab mo'i tshig dang / yi ge'i tha snyad la mkhas pa/
they were skilled in profound meanings and the usage of terms;
knowing the verbal designations of profound meaning,
tshig dang / yi ge dang / don mi zad pa rab tu brjod pa/
they communicated with unending words, terms, and meanings;
eloquently telling the meanings of endless words and expressions,
mdo sde rgya mtsho thams cad tshig gcig tu chud par rab tu ston pa/
they taught the entire ocean of sūtras condensed into one word;
expounding entry into the ocean of all scriptures by one word,
gzungs dang ye shes kyi lus rgya chen po byin gyis rlob pa/
they had the miraculous power of a vast body of dhāraṇīs and wisdom;
supporting the vast body of knowledge of mystic formulae,
bskal pa mtha' yas par yongs su 'dzin pa'i gzungs dang ldan pa'i byin gyi rlabs can/
they had the power of possessing the mental retention of infinite kalpas;
having the power to hold them forever,
sems kyi skad cig gcig gis bskal pa brjod du med par gnas pa rab tu rtogs pa'i ye shes can/
they had the wisdom that was aware, in one instant of mind, of dwelling in countless kalpas;[247]
knowing specifically their abodes over untold ages in a single moment of thought,
sems kyi skad cig gcig gis dus gsum shes pa/ 'jig rten thams cad mngon par shes pa/
they had the knowledge of all worlds through knowing the three times in one instant of mind;
having occult knowledge of all worlds, knowing present,past, and future in a single moment of thought,
chos kyi gzungs kyi sangs rgyas kyi chos rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa dran zhing spobs pa/
through the dhāraṇīs of the Dharma, they had the memory and eloquence of an endless ocean of the Buddhadharma;
reflecting the infinite ocean of buddha-teachings in mystic formulae holding all principles,
'gro ba thams cad kyis shes par 'gyur ba'i thabs kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba las phyir mi ldog pa/
they unceasingly turned the Dharma wheel in accordance with their knowledge of all beings;
tirelessly turning the wheel of teaching leading all beings to knowledge,
sangs rgyas kyi yul la ye shes snang ba rab tu thob pa/
they had attained the illumination through wisdom of the domain of the buddhas;
