To the southeast I see in the world Glow of Fragrant Flames a buddha named Fragrant Lamp, with the whole group of enlightening beings there, led by Supreme Intellect Differentiating the Planes of All Realms of Reality.

lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams nyi ma'i 'od zer ltar snang ba na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgo kun nas ye shes rnam par snang ba'i dbyangs zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' me tog gi 'od kun nas 'phro bar gtsug phud rab tu 'phyang ba la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs pa yang mig lam du snang ngo/ /

“To my eyes appeared the tathāgata arhat samyaksaṃbuddha named Samantamukhajñānavirocanaghoṣa in the southwestern world realm called Sūryakesaranirbhāsā. He was accompanied by an assembly that was all bodhisattvas, such as the bodhisattva Samantakusumārciḥpralambacūḍa.

To the southwest I see in a world Sunny Golden Shining a buddha named Illuminating Voice of Universal Knowledge, with the whole group of enlightening beings there, led by Hanging Crest of Radiant Flowery Flames.

nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams spos kyi rgyan yid du 'ong ba dge ba'i snying po na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yon tan rgya mtsho tshad med pa'i 'od ces bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' lus kyi 'od zer thogs pa med pa'i gzi brjid rgyal po blo gros la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs pa yang mig lam du snang ngo/ /

“To my eyes appeared the tathāgata arhat samyaksaṃbuddha named Apramāṇaguṇasāgaraprabha in the northwestern world realm called Gandhālaṃkāraruciraśubhagarbhā. He was accompanied by an assembly that was all bodhisattvas, such as the bodhisattva Asaṅgakāyaraśmitejomati.[443]

To the northwest I see in the land Brilliant Shining Treasury with Fragrant Adornments a buddha named Light of a Measureless Ocean of Virtue, with the whole group of enlightening beings there, led by Mind Blazing with Light in a Body Free from Attachments.

'og gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rin po che'i seng ge snang zhing 'phar ba na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od zer chos kyi dbyings su snang ba zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi dbyings 'od 'phro zhing rnam par snang bar byung ba'i blo gros la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs pa yang mig lam du snang ngo/ /

“To my eyes appeared the tathāgata arhat samyaksaṃbuddha named Dharmadhātuvidyotitaraśmi in the world realm below called Ratnasiṃhāvabhāsajvalanā. He was accompanied by an assembly that was all bodhisattvas, such as the bodhisattva Dharmadhātvarcirvairocanasaṃbhavamati.

In the nadir I see in the world Blaze of Lights from Jewel Lions a buddha named Beam of Light Illumining the Cosmos, with the whole group of enlightening beings there, led by Mind Born of the Light of the Cosmos.

steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams mtshan gyi 'od rnam par snang ba na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yon tan grags pa thogs pa med pa'i rnam par thar pa'i 'od kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' stobs dang brtson 'grus thogs pa med pa'i blo gros la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs pa yang mig lam du snang ngo/ /

“To my eyes appeared the tathāgata arhat samyaksaṃbuddha named Apratihataguṇakīrtivimokṣaprabharāja in the world realm above called Akṣaṇaruciravairocanā. He was accompanied by an assembly that was all bodhisattvas, such as the bodhisattva Asaṅgabalavīryamati.

In the zenith I see in the world Radiant with Splendor of Appearance a buddha named Light of Liberation of Indestructible Virtue and Glory, with the whole group of enlightening beings there, led by Mind of Energy of Unobstructed Power.

rigs kyi bu/ de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa 'di dag la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed mthong yang de bzhin gshegs pa de dag kyang 'dir mi byon/ kho bo yang der 'gro ba med de/

“Noble one, in that way, in addition to these ten[444] tathāgatas, I see in the ten directions tathāgata arhat samyaksaṃbuddhas as numerous as the atoms in the buddha realms in the ten directions, but those tathāgatas have not come here and I have not gone there.
Beginning with these, I see as many buddhas in the ten directions as atoms in ten buddha-lands: and yet those buddhas do not come here and I do not go there.

nam 'dod pa de na/ bde ba yod pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams na de bzhin gshegs pa 'od snang mtha' yas bzhugs pa yang mthong ngo/ / tsan dan yod pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od snang rdo rje bzhugs pa yang mthong ngo/ / spos dri yod pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od snang rin chen bzhugs pa yang mthong ngo/ / pad+mo yod pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams na; de bzhin gshegs pa 'od snang rin chen pad+mo bzhugs pa yang mthong ngo/ / gser yod pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od snang zhi ba bzhugs pa yang mthong ngo/ / mngon par dga' ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ de bzhin gshegs pa mi sgul ba bzhugs pa yang mthong ngo/ / shin tu brtan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge bzhugs pa yang mthong ngo/ / me long gi dkyil 'khor ltar snang ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ de bzhin gshegs pa blo gros zla ba bzhugs pa yang mthong ngo/ / rin chen dpal gyi dad pas brgyan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad bzhugs pa yang mthong ngo/ /

“When I wish to, I see the Tathāgata Amitābha in the buddha realm Sukhāvatī, I see the Tathāgata Vajrābha in the buddha realm Candanavatī, I see the Tathāgata Ratnābha in the buddha realm Gandhavatī, I see the Tathāgata Ratnapadmābha in the buddha realm Padmavatī, I see the Tathāgata Śantābha in the buddha realm Kanakavatī, I see the Tathāgata Akṣobhya in the buddha realm Abhiratī, I see the Tathāgata Siṃha in the buddha realm Supratiṣṭhā, I see the Tathāgata Candrabuddhi in the buddha realm Ādarśamaṇḍalanibhāsā, and I see the Tathāgata Vairocana in the buddha realm Ratnaśrīhaṃsacitrā.[445]

Also, whenever I want to see the buddha Infinite Light in the world Blissful, I see the buddha Diamond Light in the world Like Sandalwood, I see the buddha Jewel Light in the world Fragrant, I see the buddha Jewel Lotus Light in the world Lotuslike, I see the buddha Silent Light in the world Golden, I see the buddha Imperturbable in the world Joy, I see the buddha Lion in the world Standing Well, I see the buddha Moonlike Awareness in the world Mirror Globe Light, I see the buddha Luminous in the world Pure Clarity of Jewellike Splendor.

rigs kyi bu/ de ltar kho bos ni phyogs gang dang gang na/ 'jig rten gyi khams gang dang gang gi de bzhin gshegs pa gang dang gang mthong bar 'dod pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa de dang de dag kyang mthong ngo/ / dus gang dang gang du dmigs pa gang dang gang la sngon gyi spyod pa gang dang gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bar 'dod pa dang / rnam par 'phrul pa gang dang gang gi don dang / sems can 'dul ba gang dang gang gi don du de bzhin gshegs pa gang dang gang mthong bar 'dod pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa de dang de dag kyang mthong ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag kyang 'dir gshegs pa ma yin/ bdag kyang der phyin pa ma yin no/ /

“Noble one, in that way, I see whatever tathāgata I wish to, in whatever direction, in whatever world realm. I see whatever tathāgata I wish to, in whatever time, in whatever location,[446] in whatever past conduct. I see whatever tathāgata I wish to, wherever he is accomplishing miracles or wherever he is guiding beings. And those tathāgatas have not come here, nor have I gone there.

In this way I see whatever buddha I wish in whatever world in whichever direction. I see whatever buddha I wish to see in whatever time in whatever abode involved in whatever past practice, whatever buddha I wish to see in whatever miraculous performances, in whatever teaching activity: and yet the buddhas do not come here, nor do I go there.

rigs kyi bu/ de ltar kho bos de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ga las kyang byon pa med par shes la/ rang gi lus kyang gar yang 'gro ba med par shes pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams rnam par dmigs pa yang rmi lam lta bur shes la/ rang gi sems rnam par dmigs pa yang rmi lam dang 'dra bar rgyu bar shes pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams rnam par dmigs pa yang gzugs brnyan lta bur shes la/ rang gi sems rnam par dmigs pa yang chu'i snod gsal ba lta bur shes pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams rnam par dmigs pa yang sgyu mas byas pa'i gzugs brnyan lta bur shes la/ rang gi sems rnam par dmigs pa yang sgyu ma lta bur shes pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung yang sgra brnyan ri'i brag ca lta bur brjod par shes la/ rang gi sems rnam par dmigs pa yang sgra brnyan lta bur shes pas/

“Noble one, in that way, I know that the tathāgatas have not come from anywhere. I know my own body has not gone anywhere. I know that perceiving the tathāgatas is like a dream, and I know that perceiving the activity of my own mind is like having a dream. I know that the perception of the tathāgatas is like a reflection, and I know that my own mind’s perception is like a bowl of clear water. I know that the perception of the tathāgatas is like that of forms created by a magical illusion, and I know that my own mind’s perception is like a magical illusion. I know that the speech of the tathāgatas is like echoes that sound in the mountains, and I know that my own mind’s perception is like an echo.

Without discerning any coming from anywhere on the part of the buddhas, without discerning any going on the part of my own body, knowing the buddhas as like a dream, knowing my own mind as dreamlike thought, knowing the buddhas as like a reflection, knowing my own mind as like a vessel of clear water, knowing the buddhas as like magically produced forms, knowing my mind as like magic, knowing the nature of voices of the buddhas as the reverberation of the sound of echoes in the mountains, knowing my own mind as like an echo,

byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad ni/ rang gi sems kyi byin gyi rlabs las 'byung ngo zhes bya bar rjes su rtogs shing khong du chud do/ / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa thams cad kyang rang gi sems kyi byin gyi rlabs so/ / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yang rang gi sems kyi byin gyi rlabs so/ / sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang / gdul ba yang rang gi sems kyi byin gyi rlabs so/ / byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam mngon par bsgrubs pa yang rang gi sems kyi byin gyi rlabs so/ / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi grong khyer du phyin par bya ba yang rang gi sems kyi byin gyi rlabs so/ / rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas rnam par rtse ba yang rang gi sems kyi byin gyi rlabs so/ / sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba yang rang gi sems kyi byin gyi rlabs so/ / chos kyi dbyings kun nas 'dus par khyu mchog gi mthu 'byung zhing / rnam par 'phrul pa yang rang gi sems kyi byin gyi rlabs so/ / bskal pa thams cad shin tu phra bar bsdu ba'i ye shes kyang rang gi sems kyi byin gyi rlabs so/ / zhes bya bar khong du chud cing rjes su rtogs so/ /

“It is thus that I understand, thus that I know that the entire Buddhadharma of the bodhisattvas arises from the blessing of one’s own mind. All the pure buddha realms are the blessing of one’s own mind. The bodhisattva conduct also is the blessing of one’s own mind. The ripening and guidance of all beings is the blessing of one’s own mind. The fulfillment of the aspirations of the bodhisattvas is the blessing of one’s own mind. Arriving at the city of omniscience is the blessing of one’s own mind. Delighting in inconceivable liberations is the blessing of one’s own mind. At attainment, the enlightenment of buddhahood is the blessing of one’s own mind. The miraculous manifestation of the powerful majesty of uniting the entire realm of phenomena is the blessing of one’s own mind. The wisdom that unites all kalpas into a brief time is the blessing of one’s own mind.

I realize, I am mindful, that all enlightenment principles of enlightening beings are based on one’s own mind, that all their purification of buddha-lands, all enlightening practices, all development and guidance of sentient beings, all undertaking of the vows of enlightening beings, all attainment to the ocean of omniscience, roaming in the inconceivable liberation of enlightening beings, attainment of the enlightenment of buddhas, spiritual communion with the cosmos, and knowledge of subtle communion with all ages, all are based on one’s own mind.

rigs kyi bu/ de la kho bo 'di snyam du sems te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyis ni rang gi sems nyid nye bar brtan par bya'o/ / chos kyi sprin gyis ni rang gi sems nyid yongs su brlan par bya'o/ / sgrib pa'i chos rnams las ni rang gi sems nyid yongs su sbyang bar bya'o/ / brtson 'grus kyis ni rang gi sems nyid brtan par bya'o/ / bzod pas ni rang gi sems nyid mnyam par bya'o/ / ye shes khong du chud par bya ba la ni rang gi sems nyid gzhol bar bya'o/ / shes rab kyis ni rang gi sems nyid yongs su sbyang bar bya'o/ / dbang rnams la ni rang gi sems nyid mngon par bsgrub par bya'o/ / sangs rgyas dang mnyam pa nyid la ni rang gi sems nyid rgyas par bya'o/ / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcus ni rang gi sems nyid snang bar bya'o snyam mo/ /

“Noble one, this is what I think: one’s own mind should be supported by all roots of merit, one’s own mind should be moistened by the clouds of the Dharma, one’s own mind should be purified of obscuring phenomena,[447] one’s own mind should be made firm by diligence, one’s own mind should be made tranquil by patience, one’s own mind should be cultivated by the comprehension of knowledge, one’s own mind should be refined by wisdom, one’s own mind should have accomplishment in power, one’s own mind should be made vast in the equality of the buddhas, and one’s own mind should be illuminated by the ten strengths of the tathāgatas.

“In this connection, I think that one’s own mind should be supported by roots of goodness, moistened by the clouds of the Teaching, purified by principles that should be focused on, made firm by vigor, made calm by forbearance, guided by following knowledge, clarified by wisdom, developed in spiritual powers, expanded to equality with the buddhas, illumined by the ten powers of the enlightened.

rigs kyi bu/ kho bo ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par thar pa thogs pa med pa'i rgyan 'di shes te/ blangs shing yongs su 'dzin par zad na/ kho bos byang chub sems dpa'i chags pa med pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ chags pa med pa rnam par spyod pa'i spyod yul dang ldan pa/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i ting nge 'dzin rab tu thob pa/ mya ngan las 'da' ba med pa'i mtha' la gnas pa'i rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi sgo'i ting nge 'dzin rab tu thob pa/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du gyur pa/ gzhi kun nas phyed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod yul gyi tshul shes pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du lus rnam par bkram pa/ sangs rgyas kyi yul tha mi dad pa la rnam par spyod pa/ phyogs thams cad du mngon par phyogs pa'i spyod yul dang ldan pa/ phyin phyogs med pa'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gyis rnam par lta ba de dag gi lus la 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 'jig cing 'du bar snang yang / de dag la bdag dang 'jig rten gyi khams su gnyis kyi 'du shes med pa de dag gi spyod pa shes pa'am/ yon tan brjod par nus re skan/

“Noble one, I know, have adopted, and keep this liberation called the unimpeded display of the tathāgatas, but how could I know or describe the qualities of dwelling without impediment in the field of activity of the unimpeded minds of the bodhisattvas; the attainment of the samādhi of the direct perception of all the buddhas in the present; the attainment of the samādhi gateway to the enlightenment that has reached the apex that is without passing into nirvāṇa; the attainment of the sameness of the three times; the knowledge of the way of the field of activity of the samādhi of the completely undivided basis; the bodies distributed throughout all buddha realms; the presence in the indivisible ranges of the buddhas; the field of activity that is oriented toward all directions; the view of the domain of undivided wisdom; and the conduct that is free of the dualistic conceptions of self and world, even though in their bodies there appears the destruction and creation of all world realms?

“I know this buddha-liberation of unobstructed manifestation, and go in and out of it; how can I know the practice or tell of the virtues of enlightening beings whose minds are unobstructed, whose sphere is a state free from obstruction, who have attained concentration focused on the teachings of all buddhas of the present, who have attained concentration leading into enlightenment that does not become ultimately extinct, who have realized the equality of past, present, and future, who know the science of the sphere of concentration on the continuity of all planes, who distribute their bodies throughout all buddha-lands, who abide in the unfragmented state of buddhas, whose perspective faces in all directions, who observe the sphere of all-inclusive knowledge, who know the becoming and disintegration of all worlds in their own bodies, without any dualistic notions regarding their bodies or the worlds.

song / rigs kyi bu/ lho phyogs kyi rgyud 'di nyid kyi 'dzam bu'i gling gi mgo 'gebs pas rgyas par 'gengs pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de na dge slong rgya mtsho'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba 'dug gi /de'i gan du song la/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa la bslab par bya ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bya ba dris shig /

“Now depart, noble one. On this road to the south, at the tip of Jambudvīpa, there is Milaspharaṇa. There dwells a bhikṣu by the name of Sāgaradhvaja. Go to him and ask him, ‘How should a bodhisattva train in bodhisattva conduct? How should a bodhisattva proceed?’ ”

“Go south, to Milaspharana, on the tip of the continent. A monk named Saradhvaja lives there. Go to him and ask how an enlightening being is to learn and undertake the practice of enlightening beings.”

de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang gis tshong dpon btang brjod kyi rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ tshong dpon btang brjod la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas/ yang dang yang bltas te/ tshong dpon btang brjod kyi yon tan grangs med pa la snyan par brjod de brtag pa dang / mos par bya ba dang / mi btang bar bya ba sems shing du ste/ smre sngags bton nas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen sdug par sems shing dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rjes su 'brang ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsnyen bkur bar mos pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis bsgo ba dang mi 'gal bar byed pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rag lus par rjes su lta ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rjes su bsam pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen la g.yo sgyu med par spyod pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi sems kyi dbang du 'gro bar bya ba dang ldan pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams gnod pa thams cad yongs su spong bar byed pas ma tsam du sems/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yongs su bskyed pas pha tsam du sems shing / tshong dpon btang brjod kyi drung nas song ngo/ /

Then Sudhana, the head merchant’s son, bowed his head to the feet of the head merchant Muktaka, circumambulated the head merchant Muktaka a hundred thousand times, keeping him to his right, and, looking back again and again, beautifully describing, examining, and aspiring to the countless qualities of the head merchant Muktaka, thinking of Muktaka, he was weeping and wailing as he departed from head merchant Muktaka; he was thinking of kalyāṇamitras with affection, trusting in them, longing to honor the kalyāṇamitras, maintaining obedience to the instructions of kalyāṇamitras, and seeing omniscience as dependent upon the kalyāṇamitras; his thoughts focused on the kalyāṇamitras, his conduct faithful to the kalyāṇamitras, and being in the power of the minds of the kalyāṇamitras, by avoiding anything that would be harmful to the kalyāṇamitras he regarded them as his mother and, by developing all the qualities of roots of merit, regarded them as his father.

Then Sudhana, paying his respects to Muktaka, eulogizing, contemplating, desiring, and dwelling on Muktaka’s countless virtues, with love for spiritual benefactors, taking refuge in spiritual benefactors, seeking to please spiritual benefactors, not contesting the knowledge of spiritual benefactors, seeing omniscience as realized by following spiritual benefactors, obedient to spiritual benefactors, to be spiritually healed by the techniques of spiritual benefactors, his thoughts following the direction of spiritual benefactors, thinking of spiritual benefactors as a mother because they get rid of all that is not beneficial, thinking of spiritual benefactors as a father because they produce all good qualities, Sudhana left Muktaka.
[dge slong rgya mtsho'i rgyal mtshan]
Chapter 9. Sāgaradhvaja
Saradhvaja

de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang / tshong dpon btang brjod kyis bstan pa de la rjes su sems shing / tshong dpon btang brjod kyi gdams ngag la nan tan du bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rjes su 'brang bar bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa rjes su dran par bya ba dang / chos kyi dbyings la 'jug cing 'bab pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa khong du chud par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yongs su 'du bar bya ba'i tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa la 'jug par bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rjes su blta bar bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su bsdu ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mos par bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyi rgyan rjes su sbyang ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rnam par thar pa'i rnam par dgod pa dang / khyu mchog gi mthu phyung ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa la yongs su brtag pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams tha dad pa la bsgribs pa med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa la 'jug pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i las la bsam pa shin tu brtan pa de la nan tan du bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i las dang smon lam gyi rgyud bsam gyis mi khyab pa de'i rjes su spyod cing /

Sudhana, the head merchant’s son, contemplated the teaching of the head merchant Muktaka and dedicated himself to the instructions of the head merchant Muktaka. He followed the inconceivable bodhisattva liberations. He called to mind the inconceivable radiance of bodhisattva wisdom. He practiced entering and comprehending the inconceivable realm of the Dharma. He comprehended the inconceivable bodhisattva methods of gathering pupils. He reflected on the inconceivable miracles of the tathāgatas. He aspired to the inconceivable aggregation of buddha realms. He contemplated the display of the blessings of the buddhas. He examined the inconceivable majestic power of the display of samādhis and liberations. He was dedicated to entering inconceivable separate, unobscured world realms. He developed the aspiration for inconceivable, enduring bodhisattva activity. And he adopted the inconceivable continuum of bodhisattva activity and prayer.

Then Sudhana, reflecting on the instruction of the eminent Muktaka, following Muktaka’s direction, remembering the inconceivable liberation of enlightening beings, remembering the inconceivable light of knowledge of enlightening beings, following the inconceivable entrance into the realm of reality, entering into the inconceivable principle of the communion of enlightening beings, observing the inconceivable transformation of those who realize Thusness, intent on the inconceivable communion of buddha-fields, clarifying the inconceivable manifestation of the magical power of buddhas, contemplating the magnificence of the inconceivable order of the concentrations and liberations of enlightening beings, following the steadfast determination to perform the inconceivable work of enlightening beings, conforming to the stream of undertaking of the inconceivable deeds of enlightening beings,
mthar gyis 'dzam bu gling gi mgo 'gebs pas rgyas par 'gengs pa zhes bya ba gang na ba der phyin nas/ dge slong rgya mtsho'i rgyal mtshan tshol tshol ba las/
Eventually he reached Milaspharaṇa at the tip of Jambudvīpa. He searched and searched for the bhikṣu Sāgaradhvaja.
gradually proceeded to Milaspharana on the tip of the continent, where he looked all over for the monk Saradhvaja.

'chag pa'i gnas shig gi 'chag sa'i mthar 'dug ste/ ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhag nas/ dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba med cing mi g.yo la/ byed pa med cing lus drang por bsrang ste/ dran pa mngon du byas nas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas rnam par 'phrul zhing / g.yas g.yon dang / steng logs su lus mtha' yas la/ tshad med cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ spyi gtsug bltar mi mthong ba/ kha dog du ma'i lus dang ldan pa sems kyi skad cig re re la kha dog rnam pa tha dad pa tshad med pa yongs su ston pa de/

Sudhana saw him sitting at the end of a meditation walkway. He was resting in samādhi with no inhalation or exhalation of breath, unmoving, inactive, sitting with his body upright, and manifesting mindfulness. With the inconceivable miraculous powers of samādhi, he miraculously manifested an inconceivable, immeasurable, infinite body to the right, left, and above, so that the crown of his head was beyond sight.[448] His body had many colors, manifesting countless different colors in each instant of the mind.

He saw Saradhvaja by the side of a place for walking at a retreat, sitting in concentration, following his breath, not stirring, not thinking, his body straight, his mindfulness on the immediate present, by the inconceivable power of concentration producing to the left, right, and above an inconceivable infinite body in each successive mental moment manifesting an infinite variety of bodies.

de de ltar mnyam par bzhag cing zab la zhi ba ste/ g.yo ba med cing dmigs pa med la/ dga' bas lus mtho bar gyur pa de'i ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pas rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rab tu 'gyed par byed cing 'dug pa mthong ngo/ /

Sudhana saw that as Sāgaradhvaja rested in that way in a profound, peaceful, motionless,[449] objectless meditation, from all the pores of his body,[450] which had become tall through joy,[451] countless miraculous manifestations of bodhisattva liberation appeared.

Sudhana saw an inconceivable miraculous display of the liberation of enlightening beings coming forth from every pore of the ecstatic body of Saradhvaja, who had attained such profound tranquility, silence, and objectlessness.

rnam par thar pas rnam par 'phrul pa de'i mthus/ sems kyi skad cig re re la sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchod pa sbyang ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad yongs su dag par bya ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyi phung po rnam par bzlog pa dang / ngan song gi lam thams cad yongs su bcad pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi bde ba'i lam gyi sgo dbye ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba rab tu zhi bar bya ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi mi shes pa'i sgrib pa rnam par gtor ba dang / sems can thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la dgod pa'i phyir/ rnam par 'phrul pa'i bye brag rnam pa sna tshogs mtha' yas pas chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par 'gengs shing /

In every single instant of mind, those miraculous manifestations from the gateway of liberation spread throughout the realm of phenomena, in order that those infinite miraculous manifestations would ripen all beings, make offerings to all the tathāgatas, purify all buddha realms, eliminate the mass of suffering of all beings, close all the paths to the lower existences, open the paths to happiness for all beings, end the affliction of the kleśas for all beings, disperse the obscuration of ignorance in all beings, and establish all beings in omniscience.

With this miraculous display of the medium of liberation, Saradhvaja filled the cosmos moment to moment with endless varieties of mystic projections, to perfect all beings, to honor all buddhas, to purify all buddha-fields, to do away with the mass of suffering of all sentient beings, to cut off the courses of all bad conditions, to open the door to good conditions for all beings, to extinguish the burning of afflictions of all beings, to dissolve all beings’ obstructions to knowledge, and to introduce all beings into omniscience.

de'i rkang pa'i mthil gnyis nas/ tshong dpon gyi tshogs bkur sti dang / rim gro sna tshogs byed pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du gtogs pa'i tshong dpon dang 'dra ba'i gzugs dang ldan pa/ lhag pa'i yul la spyod pa/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis lus shin tu klubs pa/ thor tshugs dang / gtsug gi rin po che dang / cod pan sna tshogs thogs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed/ byis pa bye ba 'phyes pa'i 'khor dang ldan par 'byung ba mthong ngo/ /

Sudhana saw assemblies of head merchants, as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, being emanated from the soles of Sāgaradhvaja’s feet. They attended and waited on him in various ways, and, appearing to be all the head merchants from all world realms, forming an exceptional field of activity, their bodies were adorned by a variety of ornaments with various kinds of topknots, crest jewels, and crowns, and they were accompanied by the images of entourages of their children.

Sudhana saw emanating from the soles of Saradhvaja’s feet masses of grandees as numerous as atoms in countless buddha-lands, their forms like those of the grandees in all worldly realms, wearing gorgeous clothing, variously adorned, wearing variously crested jewel crowns, surrounded by images of sons.

bram ze dang; khyim bdag mang po bza' btung rnam pa mang po dang / ro'i yan lag sna tshogs su sbyar ba thams cad dang / rgyan thams cad dang / gos thams cad dang / me tog thams cad dang / phreng ba thams cad dang / spos thams cad dang / byug pa thams cad dang / 'dod pa'i yo byad thams cad dang / rin po che thams cad dang / gnas thams cad dang; snod rnam pa sna tshogs thams cad dang / yo byad rnam pa sna tshogs thams cad kyis sems can dbul po rnams yongs su sdud cing / 'gro ba sdug bsngal ba rnams dbugs dbyung ba dang / sems can gyi sems tshim par bya ba dang / sems can gyi bsam pa rnam par dag par bya ba dang / sems can rnams byang chub tu yongs su smin par byed cing / phyogs bcu bkang ste 'dong ba mthong ngo/ /

Sudhana also saw attending brahmins and householders, each with different kinds of food and drink with combinations of various flavors,[452] all adornments, all clothes, all flowers, all garlands, all perfumes, all ointments, all desirable things, all jewels, all seats, all vessels of various kinds, and all kinds of utensils. They were emanated out into the ten directions, where they were gathering poor people and relieving beings of their suffering, purifying the thoughts of beings, satisfying the minds of beings, and ripening beings for enlightenment.

He also saw priests and householders going throughout the ten directions caring for the poor with all kinds of food and drink, services, supplies, clothing, flowers, garlands, fragrances, ointments, acts of love, jewels, dwellings, vessels, and implements, restoring life to the miserable world, satisfying sentient beings, purifying sentient beings’ minds, developing sentient beings for enlightenment.

pus mo'i lha nga gnyis nas rgyal rigs mkhas pa'i gzugs dang / bram ze mkhas pa'i gzugs dang / 'jig rten na mkhas pa'i gzugs dang / bzo sna tshogs la mkhas pa'i gzugs dang / mi'i 'gro ba'i rgyud na mkhas pa'i gzugs dang / 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i las kyi tshul dang / rgyus la gsal zhing mkhas pa'i gzugs dang / 'jig rten gyi slob dpon du bya bar mkhas pa'i gzugs cha byad rnam pa du ma dang ldan pa/ dbyibs dang rgyan rnam pa du ma dang ldan pa/ yid du 'ong ba'i tshig mang po brjod pas yi mi bde ba'i sems can rab tu dga' bar byed cing / chos kyi nor gyis dbul ba'i sems can rnams la phan gdags pa dang / sdug bsngal ba'i sems can rnams bde bar bya ba dang / log par lhung ba'i sems can rnams mngon par gdon pa dang / theg pa'i gru la nyam nyes su gyur pa'i sems can rnams dbugs dbyung ba dang / 'jigs pa'i sems can rnams yongs su bskyab pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba'i sgra kun tu grag par bya ba dang / sdig pa las bzlog pa'i sgra yongs su bsgrags pa dang / dge ba'i chos yang dag par blangs pa la sems can gzud pa dang / don spyad pa la sems can dgod pa dang / dga' ba'i shugs yongs su bskyed pa dang / snyan par smra ba'i bsdu ba'i dngos po yongs su brjod pa dang / 'jig rten la don mthun par bsgrub pa ston par byed cing / phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste 'dong ba mthong ngo/ /

Sudhana saw Sāgaradhvaja’s knees emanating and filling the ten direction with the forms of wise kṣatriyas, the forms of wise brahmins, the forms of those who were wise in worldly matters, the forms of those wise in various arts and crafts, the forms of those wise concerning human existence, the forms of those wise with the knowledge of carrying out both worldly and nonworldly practices, and the forms of those wise in honorable worldly conduct, taking on various forms, displaying the presence of many forms, speaking with pleasant words, making unhappy beings happy, caring for poor beings devoid of the wealth of the Dharma, making beings who are suffering happy, elevating beings who have fallen down, bringing relief to those who are shipwrecked, saving beings who are in fear, sounding out the words of all roots of merit, emitting the words of turning away from bad actions, bringing beings to the adoption of good qualities, establishing beings in beneficial conduct, engendering the power of joy, emitting pleasant words that are a method of gathering pupils, and showing consistency of words and actions[453] to the world.

Sudhana saw forms of warrior sages, priestly sages, worldly sages, scholars versed in various crafts, humanistic scholars, scholars expert in knowledge of the sciences of mundane and transmundane activities, sages considered teachers of the world, emanate from the circles on Saradhvaja’s knees and go throughout the ten directions in many forms and guises, speaking pleasant words, cheering up dejected sentient beings, taking care of spiritually and materially poor beings, comforting beings in distress, uplifting the fallen, reviving the shipwrecked, rescuing the imperiled, causing the voice of goodness to be heard, preaching rejection of evil, exhorting beings to virtuous practices, directing beings to beneficial actions, producing joy, uttering kind words, and showing the world the nature of cooperation.

lte ba'i dkyil 'khor nas drang srong mang po 'gro ba thams cad kyi lus dbyibs su 'khod pa/ pags pa dang / shun pa'i gos gyon pa/ ril ba thogs pa; gzugs dang / cha byad dang / dbyibs sna tshogs can/ spyod lam rab tu zhi ba dag byung nas/

Sudhana saw, issuing forth from Sāgaradhvaja’s navel, a multitude of ṛṣis manifesting as the bodies of all beings, wearing robes of antelope skins[454] and bark, holding staffs and burl bowls,[455] with various forms, features, and appearances,[456] and having a peaceful deportment.

Sudhana saw various forms of wizards, as many as there are living beings, emanating from Saradhvaja’s navel and going throughout the ten directions, wearing leather, rags, and bark, carrying staffs and pitchers, their deportment extremely calm,

steng gi bar snang las sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rjod par byed cing / chos kyi sgra yongs su bsgrag pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi sgra brjod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun yongs su bstan pa dang / tshangs pa'i spyod pa yongs su brjod pa dang / dbang po dben pa la sems can dgod pa dang / rang bzhin med pa'i don rab tu brtag pa dang / ye shes kyi don la 'jig rten rab tu dgod pa dang / 'jig rten gyi gtsug lag gi rnam pa yongs su brjod pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis 'byung ba'i lam gyi tshul rab tu bstan pa dang / mthar gyis bya ba'i las la sems can rab tu dgod pa byed cing /

From up in the sky they were proclaiming the qualities of a buddha, speaking the word Dharma, uttering the word Buddha, teaching the bodhisattva Saṅgha, describing the path of celibacy, establishing beings in restraining the senses, expounding[457] the meaning of the absence of intrinsic nature, establishing the world in the meaning of wisdom, guiding in the ways of worldly treatises, teaching the way of the path that gives rise to omniscience, and establishing beings in the succession of practices.[458]

up on the sky extolling the qualities of buddhas, causing the voice of the Teaching to be heard, speaking the voice of Buddhas, showing the community of enlightening beings, praising religious conduct, directing sentient beings to guard their senses, describing the meaning of the voidness of intrinsic essence, introducing sentient beings into the meaning of knowledge, teaching worldly science, showing the science of the Path to omniscience and emancipation, guiding beings in gradual practice.
phyogs bcu bkang ste 'dong ba mthong ngo/ /
[…Sudhana saw…]
[…Sudhana saw…]
rtsib logs gnyis nas klu'i bu mo 'jig rten rgyu ba thams cad kyi grangs dang mnyam pa/ lus kyi dbyibs bsam gyi mi khyab pa du ma dang ldan pa byung ste/

Sudhana, the head merchant’s son, saw, issuing forth from the sides of Sāgaradhvaja’s upper body, nāga maidens as numerous as all the worlds in existence, and in each instant of mind pervading the entire realm of phenomena. They were appearing as inconceivably numerous bodies,
Sudhana saw as many water spirit girls as all worldly events, in inconceivably many forms, emerging from Saradhvaja’s sides, pervading all universes moment to moment,

klu'i rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa yongs su bstan pa dang / spos kyi sprin gyi rgyan bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha'i dbyings la byin gyis brlab pa dang / me tog gi sprin gyi rgyan bsam gyis mi khyab pas nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad brgyan pa dang / phreng ba'i sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyan gyis nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad rnam par klubs pa dang / rin po che'i gdugs kyi sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyan gyis chos kyi dbyings thams cad yongs su khebs par bya ba dang /

manifesting an inconceivable number of nāga miracles, establishing in the sky an inconceivable adornment of clouds of scented water, adorning the sky with the inconceivable adornment of clouds of flowers, arraying the entire sky with the inconceivable adornment of clouds of garlands, and covering the entire realm of phenomena with the inconceivable adornment of clouds of precious parasols;

showing the miracle of water spirits, adorning the sky with inconceivable fragrant clouds, adorning the whole sky with inconceivable clouds of flowers, arraying the whole realm of space with inconceivable adornments of clouds of garlands, covering all universes with inconceivable adornment of bejeweled parasols,
rin po che'i rgyal mtshan gyi sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyan dang /
with the inconceivable adornment of clouds of precious banners;
adorning the sky with inconceivable clouds of jeweled banners,
rin po che'i lha'i ba dan gyi sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyan dang /
with the inconceivable adornment of clouds of precious streamers;
rin po che'i phyang phrul sna tshogs kyi sprin dang / char bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyan dang /
with the inconceivable adornment of the rain from clouds of various pendant ornaments;
inconceivable clouds of jeweled pennants,
nor bu rin po che dam pa'i sprin gyi char 'bab pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyan dang /

rain from inconceivable clouds of jewel necklaces and various flowers,

inconceivable raining clouds of jewel lotuses adorned with nets of pearls crowned with diamonds,

inconceivable clouds of jewel crowns and rain of clouds of endless lights adorned by all jewels,
lha'i lus kyi sprin gyi me tog dang / phreng ba dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang /
with the inconceivable adornment of the rain from clouds of the bodies of devas adorned by flowers, garlands, parasols, banners, and streamers;

lha'i ba dan bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyan dang / lha'i bu mo mang po'i lus kyi sprin thal mo sbyar te/ gser gyi me tog snyim pas 'thor ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa la yon tan dang legs pa thams cad du bstod pa'i sprin gyi 'brug sgra 'byin cing char 'bebs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyan/

inconceivable clouds of goddesses, adornments of rain produced by clouds of songs of praise of buddhas’ qualities sung by the goddesses on high standing with joined palms or scattering golden flowers,

nam mkha'i dbyings la byin gyis rlob cing / spos kyi phung po'i sprin rin po che thams cad kyi kha dog tu 'dug pa dang / bdug spos kyi na bun dang / sprin shin tu rgya che bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor mngon par khebs par bya ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams 'byams klas pa thams cad rab tu brgyan pa dang / sems can thams cad rab tu dga' bar bya ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pas

Vast clouds and mists of the best incense stationed[460] in the sky, together with the clouds of heaps of scented waters with the colors of all jewels, covered the assemblies of the followers of all tathāgatas, adorned the entire extent of world realms, brought happiness to all beings, and made offerings to all the buddhas.

also covering all buddhas’ assemblies with clouds of heaps of fragrances the colors of all jewels and clouds of smoke of the finest incense, adorning all worlds, delighting all beings, honoring all buddhas.
skad cig skad cig tu chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pa tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang gis mthong ngo/ /

Sudhana saw, issuing forth from the śrīvatsa on Sāgaradhvaja’s chest, asura lords as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, in each instant of mind pervading the realm of phenomena and manifesting networks of inconceivable, miraculous asura conjurations;

Sudhana saw as many titan kings as atoms in countless buddha-fields emerging from the auspicious mark on Saradhvaja’s chest and pervading the cosmos moment to moment, displaying the inconceivable magic transformations of titans,
chu 'dzin chen po yongs su bskyab pa dang /
agitating oceans;[461]
agitating the oceans,
'jig rten gyi khams brgya stong rab tu bskyod pa dang /
causing a hundred thousand world realms to tremble;
causing hundreds of thousands of worlds to quake,
ri'i rgyal po chen po thams cad 'thab par bya ba dang /
dashing together all the sovereign lords of mountains;
causing all the highest mountains to crash together,
lha'i gnas thams cad yongs su bskyod pa dang /

bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad zil gyis mnan pa dang /

crushing all armies of demons,

causing all people to destroy intoxication, conceit, and arrogance,

restraining and purifying corrupt minds,

frightening sentient beings by exercises of titanic magical powers and
sdig pa las gyen du bskyod pa dang /
causing them to shrink from bad actions;
scaring them away from evil,
'khor pas 'jigs par bya ba dang /
causing them to be terrified of saṃsāra;
making them wary of the mundane whirl,
srid pa'i lam gyi rgyud thams cad nas gyen du bskyod de/ gnas med pa la rab tu gnas par bya ba dang /

causing them to produce enlightening beings’ light of the way to buddhahood,
chos kyi tshul rnam par dgod pa sna tshogs kyis
and establishing beings in the various ways of the Dharma.
defining various principles and methods.
sems kyi skad cig re re zhing chos kyi dbyings rgyas par 'gengs par byed pa/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang gis mthong ngo/ /

rgyab kyi gzhung nas nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas mang po sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung nas/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyis 'dul ba'i sems can bdag tu mngon par zhen pa rnams la bdag med pa dang / sems can med pa yongs su rjod par byed cing / rtag par mngon par zhen pa rnams la 'du byed thams cad mi rtag par yongs su bstan pa dang / 'dod chags kyi spyod pa can rnams la mi sdug pa dang / zhe sdang gi spyod pa can rnams la byams pa dang / gti mug gi spyod pa can rnams la rkyen las 'byung ba'i rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba brjod pa dang / cha mnyam pa'i spyod pa can rnams la ye shes kyi yul dang ldan pa'i chos kyi tshul mngon par bstan pa dang / yul la mngon par dga' ba rnams la gnas med pa rab tu brjod pa dang / zhi ba la gnas su sems pa rnams la smon lam gyi khyad par gyis spro ba bskyed pa dang / phyogs kyi rgyud dang sgo thams cad du chos kyi tshul rgya mtsho'i rgyud dang sgo thams cad sems can thams cad kyi don du rjod par byed cing chos kyi dbyings rgyas par 'gengs pa/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang gis mthong ngo/ /

Sudhana saw, issuing forth from Sāgaradhvaja’s back, a multitude of śrāvakas and pratyekabuddhas as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms and pervading the realm of phenomena. The śrāvakas and pratyekabuddhas were teaching the absence of a self and the absence of a being to those beings who were to be guided by them and had attachment to a self; they were teaching the impermanence of the composite to those who were attached to permanence, ugliness to those who had the conduct of desire, love to those who had the conduct of anger, and dependent origination to those who had the conduct of ignorance; and they were teaching the way of the Dharma that has the range of wisdom to those who had equal amounts of those conducts, teaching the absence of a basis to those who delighted in the range of sensory perceptions, inspiring higher aspirations in those who intended to dwell in peace, and illuminating the gateways to all directions and all the gateways of the ocean of ways in the Dharma.

Sudhana saw as many bodies of Buddhist disciples and individual illuminates as atoms in countless buddha-fields emerge from Saradhvaja’s spine and pervade the cosmos, telling sentient beings attached to self and suited to guidance by disciples or individual illuminates about selflessness and the voidness of the being, clarifying the impermanence of all conditioned states to those attached to eternity, telling the lustful about the contemplation of impurity, telling the hostile about love, telling the deluded about causality and interdependent origination, illumining principles connected with the sphere of knowledge to those who are equally lustful, hostile, and deluded, telling those attached to objects about nondwelling, causing those inclined to stick to tranquillity to like the superiority of undertaking vows, showing actions beneficial to beings, in all places, in the beginning of all turnings of the ocean of ways to truth.

phrag pa'i lhun gnyis las gnod sbyin dang / srin po'i dbang po'i dbyibs sna tshogs dang ldan zhing / lus mi sdug pa dang / kha dog dang chu zheng sna tshogs can/ spyod lam gyi rnam pa sna tshogs dang ldan pa/ bzhon pa sna tshogs la zhon pa/ 'khor sna tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba sems can gyi khams yongs su bskyang ba la brtson pa/ 'od sna tshogs kyis snang bar bya ba la brtson pa/ dbyangs sna tshogs rab tu sgrog pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung nas thabs mngon par bsgrub pa sna tshogs ma 'dres pas/ phyogs dang phyogs mtshams kun gyi nam mkha' rgyas par 'gengs shing / dge ba'i spyod pa thams cad yongs su bsrung ba dang / 'phags pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad yongs su bsrung ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad yongs su gzung ba dang / lag na rdo rje'i las kyis yang dag par song ba dang / yang dag par zhugs pa thams cad yongs su bsrung ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod pa dang / rim gro bya ba dang / sems can log par lhung ba rnams kyi ngan song gi lam gyi rgyud thams cad rnam par bzlog pa dang / 'jig rten thams cad kyi nad dang / gnod pa dang / 'jigs pa thams cad zhi bar bya ba'i don du brtson pa/ sems can gyi don bya bas 'jig rten yongs su bskyang ba la brtson pa rnams bsod nams dang ye shes kyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang / chos kyi 'khor lo'i rjes su 'brang bar bya ba dang / phas kyi rgol ba'i 'khor tshar gcod par byed cing / chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par 'gengs par byed pa/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang gis mthong ngo/ /

Sudhana saw, issuing forth from Sāgaradhvaja’s shoulder blades, yakṣa and rākṣasa lords as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, having various forms, peculiar bodies of various colors and widths, various kinds of mendicancy, and various kinds of mounts. They were accompanied by various kinds of entourages, spreading throughout the realm of phenomena, and they were engaging in protecting the realm of beings, engaging in emitting different kinds of light, singing various songs, and filling the directions and intermediate directions of space with the accomplishment of various distinct methods as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms. They did this so as to guard all good conduct, so as to guard all the assemblies of the āryas, so as to care for all bodhisattvas, so as to protect through the activity of Vajrapāṇi all those who are perfectly practicing the perfect way, so as to render various services to and make various offerings to all the buddhas, and so as to bring fallen beings back from the pathway to the lower existences. They were engaged in bringing all illness, harm, and danger in all worlds to an end, were engaged in protecting in the world all activities beneficial to beings, were causing the wheel of gathering merit and wisdom to be completed, were causing the wheel of the Dharma to be turned,[465] and were destroying the wheel of the adversaries.

Sudhana saw as many demigods and supernatural beings as atoms in countless buddha-fields emerging from Saradhvaja’s shoulders and pervading the cosmos, with various physical forms, colors, and sizes, in various attitudes, riding various vehicles, surrounded by various retinues, striving to protect sentient beings, showing various powers, uttering various sounds, going everywhere employing various different means to guard the good actions of all sentient beings, to guard all circles of sages, to assist all enlightening beings, to protect those who are rightly oriented, to attend and honor all buddhas with the work of thunderbolt bearers, to remove all fallen sentient beings from evil ways, striving to annihilate all worldly calamities and perils such as disease, anxious to preserve the light of actions beneficial to beings, filling the stores of knowledge and virtue, causing the wheel of the teaching to roll along, restraining controversy.

mdun gyi lto nas mi'am ci'i dbang po/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed/ mi'am ci'i dbang po'i bu mo'i 'khor brgya stong grangs med pa can dang / dri za'i dbang po sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dri za'i dbang po'i bu mo'i 'khor brgya stong grangs med pa can dag byung nas lha'i rol mo brgya stong grangs med pa'i sgra snyan pa dang / glu'i dbyangs kyis chos kyi rang bzhin dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstod pa rjod pa byed cing / byang chub kyi sems yongs su bsngags pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yongs su brjod pa dang / mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i sgo thams cad la mngon par bstod pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo'i sgo thams cad du 'jug pa dang / rnam par 'phrul pa'i sgo thams cad la mngon par spro bar bya ba dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i sgo thams cad yongs su brjod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sgo thams cad yongs su gzung ba dang / sems can gyi sgo thams cad rab tu dga' bar bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi sgo thams cad yongs su dag par bya ba dang / chos kyi sgo thams cad mngon par bstan par bya ba dang / sgrib pa'i sgo thams cad rnam par bzlog par bya ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba'i sgo thams cad yongs su skyed pa byed cing chos kyi dbyings rgyas par 'gengs pa/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang gis mthong ngo/ /

Sudhana saw, issuing forth from Sāgaradhvaja’s stomach, kinnara lords as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, accompanied by entourages of countless hundreds of thousands of kinnara maidens and gandharva lords as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, accompanied by entourages of countless hundreds of thousands of gandharva maidens, spreading throughout the realm of phenomena, with the sounds of countless hundreds of thousands of musical instruments and the singing of songs that had the nature of the Dharma, eulogizing the aspiration to enlightenment, elucidating bodhisattva conduct, praising all the gateways to complete buddhahood, causing entry into all the gateways of the Dharma, causing aspiration for all the gateways to miracles, elucidating all the gateways to nirvāṇa, causing the acquisition of all the gateways to the Buddha’s teaching, causing joy for all the gateways to beings, causing the purification of all buddha realms, causing the elucidation of all the Dharma gateways, causing all the gateways to obscuration to be repelled, and causing all the gateways to the roots of merit to be developed.

Sudhana saw as many centaur chiefs as atoms in countless buddha-fields surrounded by countless hundreds of thousands of centaur princesses, and as many celestial musician kings as atoms in countless buddha-fields surrounded by countless hundreds of thousands of celestial musician princesses emerge from Saradhvaja’s abdomen and pervade the cosmos, performing music and songs in praise of Buddha dealing with the essence of things, illumining the thought of enlightenment, describing the conduct of enlightening beings, eulogizing all ways to attainment of enlightenment, fostering understanding of all ways of presenting the Teaching, causing attraction to all ways of spiritual transformation, illumining all ways into ultimate release, publicizing all buddhas’ teachings, gladdening all beings, purifying all buddha-fields, illuminating all ways to truth, removing all obstructions, begetting all roots of goodness.
kha'i sgo nas 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po/ rin po che bdun dang ldan zhing / stobs kyi yan lag bzhi'i tshogs kyi 'khor dang ldan pa byung nas/

Sudhana saw, issuing forth from Sāgaradhvaja’s mouth, cakravartins as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, possessing an entourage of the seven jewels and the four divisions of the army;[466] spreading throughout the ten directions of the realm of phenomena and
Sudhana saw as many emperors as atoms in countless buddha-fields, each surrounded by seven treasures and four armies, emerge from Saradhvaja’s face, pervading the cosmos,
sbyin pa chen po'i 'od zer gyi rgyan rab tu 'gyed cing
radiating a display of the light rays of great generosity;
radiating arrays of light beams of great relinquishment,
rin po che'i 'byung gnas thams cad yongs su gtang ba dang /
emitting a profusion[467] of all precious materials;
spewing forth masses of all kinds of jewels,
nor bu rin po che'i tshogs thams cad sbyin pa dang /
distributing a profusion of all precious jewels;
distributing multitudes of all kinds of jewels,
dbul po rnams nor dang ldan par bya ba dang /
making the poor wealthy;
enriching the poor,
srog gcod pa las 'jig rten rnam par bzlog pa dang /
turning the world away from killing;
causing people to desist from killing,
byams pa'i sems la sems can rab tu dgod pa dang /
establishing beings in a loving motivation;
fostering kindness in sentient beings,
ma byin par len pa dang rab tu dbral ba dang /
dissuading them from taking what has not been given;
causing them to give up stealing,
rgyan gyis shin tu brgyan pa'i bu mo bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong yongs su gtang ba dang /
bestowing on them a quintillion maidens adorned with jewelry;
giving them countless beautifully adorned maidens,
'dod pas log par g.yem pa las rnam par bzlog pa dang /
deterring them from sexual misconduct;
causing them to give up sexual misconduct,
tshangs pa'i spyod pa la rab tu dgod pa dang /
establishing them in celibacy;
establishing them in chastity,
brdzun du smra ba las rnam par bzlog pa dang /
turning them away from lying;
causing them to desist from lying,
bslu ba med pa la gzhol bar rab tu dgod pa dang /
exhorting them to avoid deception;[468]
enjoining on them supreme honesty,
phra ma'i tshig las rnam par bzlog pa dang /
turning them away from slanderous words;
causing them to desist from slander,
gzhan 'dum par brtson pa'i tshig rab tu brjod pa dang /
inspiring them toward creating harmony between others;
causing them to speak words of ultimate kindness and consideration,
zhe gcod pa'i tshig las 'jig rten rnam par bzlog pa dang /
turning the world away from harsh speech;
causing them to desist from harsh words and speak pleasantly,
'jam zhing yid du 'ong ba'i tshig rab tu brjod pa dang /
inspiring them to speak pleasantly and gently;
causing people to desist from all meaningless statements,
gnod pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i byung rgyal du smra ba las sems can rnam par bzlog pa dang /
turning beings away from worthless,[469] careless, meaningless speech and
statements connected with what is not beneficial and what is not right,
don zab mo'i tshig rab tu dbye ba gdon mi za ba las yang dag par dgod pa dang /
directing them to speech with definitive categories of profound words;
urging them to certainty of distinction of statements of profound meaning,
ngag gi nyes pa thams cad las 'jig rten rnam par bzlog pa dang / snying rje dang ldan pa'i tshig rab tu brjod par bya ba dang /
turning the world away from all bad speech and inspiring it to speak with words of compassion;
causing people to desist from all evils of speech and speak compassionately,
'jig rten gyi snying gi dri ma yongs su sel cing /
removing the heart’s stains within the world;
removing mental defilements from people,
'dod pa chung ba dang / chog shes pa la brtson par sems can rab tu dgod pa dang /

enjoining the excellent state of having few desires and being content,
chags sems las 'jig rten rnam par bzlog pa dang / gzhan gyi sems kyi rgyud dga' bar byed pa la rab tu dgod pa dang /

causing people to desist from malice and urging them to be peaceful in their relations with others,
lta ba'i dra ba thams cad las 'jig rten rab tu gdon pa dang /

extracting people from the web of all views,
yid gnyis kyi ra ba thams cad rnam par gtor ba dang /
demolishing the walls of all doubt;
causing them to break up all kinds of uncertainties,
the tshom gyi spo thams cad rab tu gzhom pa dang /
causing the mountain peak of all uncertainty to tumble down;
throwing off all masses of doubts,
nem nur dang som nyi'i rab rib yongs su bsal ba dang /
clearing away the darkness of indecisive thinking;
taking away the darkness of all confusion and hesitation,
chos rnam par dbye ba 'jig rten du rab tu dbye ba dang /
separating for the world the categories of phenomena;
definitively analyzing the truth for people,
rkyen las byung ba rab tu brjod pa dang /
describing dependent origination;
telling them about causality and interdependent origination,
rang bzhin gyis bden pa'i tshul la sems can rab tu dgod pa dang /
guiding beings into the way to the true nature;
directing them to the principle of the truth about inherent existence,
sgrib pa thams cad rnam par bzlog pa dang /
making them turn away from obscurations;
dispelling all obstacles,
sgrib pa med pa'i tshul la gzud pa dang /
causing them to enter the way free of obscuration;
leading into the way of nonobstruction,
sangs rgyas kyi don gyi tshul sna tshogs brjod pa byed cing /
and inspiring them on the way to the goal of buddhahood.
illuminating the meaning of enlightenment.
phyogs bcu'i chos kyi dbyings rgyas par 'gengs pa tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang gis mthong ngo/ /

mig gnyis nas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor brgya stong / sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung ste
Sudhana saw, issuing forth from Sāgaradhvaja’s eyes, hundreds of thousands of sun disks as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, filling the realm of phenomena of all beings[471] and
Sudhana saw as many hundreds of thousands of suns as atoms in countless buddha-fields emanate from Saradhvaja’s eyes,
sems can dmyal ba chen po thams cad yongs su snang bar byed cing / 'jig rten gyi mun pa chen po sel ba dang /
illuminating all the great hells, dispelling darkness in the world;
lighting up all the great hells, dispersing the great darkness in the world,
sems can rnams kyi gti mug gi rab rib sel ba dang /
eliminating the darkness of ignorance within beings;
removing the darkness of sentient beings’ delusions,
grang ba'i sems can dmyal ba na 'khod pa'i sems can rnams kyi grang ba'i sdug bsngal rab tu zhi bar byed pa dang /
bringing to an end the suffering of cold experienced by the beings in the cold hells;
relieving the beings in the frigid hells from the pains of cold,
sa'i rang bzhin gyi zhing rnams su 'od kha dog dkar bo can rab tu 'gyed pa dang /
shining white light rays over the realms that are made of earth;
shining clear light in lands made of lotus fibers,
gser gyi rang bzhin gyi zhing rnams su 'od bai DUr+ya'i kha dog can rab tu 'gyed pa dang /
shining light rays the color of beryl over the realms that are made of gold;
shining lapis-lazuli-colored light in gold lands,
bai DUr+ya'i rang bzhin gyi zhing rnams su 'od dngul gyi kha dog can rab tu 'gyed pa dang /
shining light rays the color of gold[472] over the realms that are made of beryl;
shining golden light in lands of lapis lazuli,
dngul gyi rang bzhin gyi zhing rnams su 'od gser gyi kha dog can rab tu 'gyed pa dang /
shining light rays the color of silver over the realms that are made of gold;[473]
gser gyi rang bzhin gyi zhing rnams su 'od shel gyi kha dog can rab tu 'gyed pa dang /
shining light rays the color of gold over the realms that are made of silver;
shining golden light in silver worlds,
shining light rays the color of crystal over the realms that are made of gold;
shining crystal light in gold lands,
shining light rays the color of gold over the realms that are made of crystal;[474]
shining golden light in crystal lands,
shining light rays the color of white coral over the realms that are made of gold;
shining coral light in gold lands,
shining light rays the color of gold over the realms that are made of white coral;
shining golden light in coral lands,
gser gyi rang bzhin gyi zhing rnams su 'od mu tig dmar po'i kha dog can rab tu 'gyed pa dang /
shining light rays the color of gold over the realms that are made of red pearls;
shining golden light in ruby lands,
shining light rays the color of red pearls over the realms that are made of gold;
shining ruby light in gold lands,
asma gar b+ha'i rang bzhin gyi zhing rnams su 'od gser gyi kha dog can rab tu 'gyed pa dang /
shining light rays the color of gold over the realms that are made of emerald;
shining golden light in emerald lands,
gser gyi rang bzhin gyi zhing rnams su 'od asma gar b+ha'i kha dog can rab tu 'gyed pa dang /
shining light rays the color of emerald over the realms that are made of gold;
shining emerald light in gold lands,
in+d+ra nI la'i rang bzhin gyi zhing rnams su 'od rin po che'i rgyal po nyi ma'i snying po'i kha dog can rab tu 'gyed pa dang /
shining light rays the color of sunstones, the kings of jewels, over the realms that are made of sapphire;
shining light the color of sun-filled jewels in sapphire lands,
rin po che'i rgyal po nyi ma'i snying po'i rang bzhin gyi zhing rnams su 'od rin po che'i in+d+ra nI la'i kha dog can rab tu 'gyed pa dang /
shining light rays the color of sapphires, the kings of jewels, over the realms that are made of sunstones, the kings of jewels;
shining sapphire light in lands made of sun-filled jewels,
mu tig dmar po'i rang bzhin gyi zhing rnams su 'od rin po che'i rgyal po zla ba'i 'od zer gyi dra ba dang / dkyil 'khor gyi snying po'i kha dog can rab tu 'gyed pa dang /
shining light rays the color of the kings of jewels, the essences of the disk of the aggregation of moonstones, over the realms that are made of red pearls;
shining light the color of jewels containing networks of moonbeams in red pearl lands,
rin po che'i rgyal po zla ba'i 'od zer gyi dra ba dang / dkyil 'khor gyi snying po'i rang bzhin gyi zhing rnams su 'od mu tig dmar po kha dog can rab tu 'gyed pa dang /
shining light rays the color of red pearls over the realms that are made of the kings of jewels, the essences of the disk of the aggregation of moonstones;
shining light the color of red pearls in lands made of jewels containing networks of moonbeams,
rin po che gcig gi rang bzhin gyi zhing rnams su 'od rin po che sna tshogs kyi kha dog can rab tu 'gyed pa dang /
shining light rays that have the colors of various kinds of jewels over the realms that are made of a single kind of jewel;
shining light the colors of various jewels in lands made of one jewel,
rin po che sna tshogs kyi rang bzhin gyi zhing rnams su 'od rin po che gcig gi kha dog can rab tu 'gyed pa dang /
and shining light rays that have the color of a single kind of jewel over the realms that are made of various kinds of jewels;
shining light the color of one jewel in lands made of various jewels,
de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad du sems can gyi don tshad med pa la brtson zhing
thus engaging in measureless activities for beings within all the assemblies of pupils of bodhisattvas.
thus involved in the infinite tasks of sentient beings, in the assemblies of all enlightening beings,
chos kyi dbyings rgyas par 'gengs pa tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang gis mthong ngo/ /
[…thus seen]
pervading the universes of all beings […thus seen].

smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu nas zla ba mang po sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung nas/ lha'i dbang po thams cad zil gyis gnon cing / 'jig rten thams cad kyi 'dod pa'i dga' ba rnam par bzlog pa dang / sangs rgyas blta bar dga' ba la rjes su bsngags par byed cing / sems can tshad med pa gdul ba la brtson par phyogs bcu'i chos kyi dbyings rgyas par 'gengs pa mthong ngo/ /

Sudhana saw, issuing forth from the ūrṇā hair between Sāgaradhvaja’s eyebrows, a multitude of moons as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, filling the ten directions of the realm of phenomena and overpowering all lords of devas, turning all the world away from delighting in desires, praising delight in seeing the buddhas, and dedicated to guiding measureless beings.

From the circle of hair between Saradhvaja’s eyebrows Sudhana saw as many moons as atoms in countless buddha-fields emerge, outshining all the celestial chiefs, turning all worldlings away from lust to enjoyment of the vision of Buddha, pervading the cosmos engaged in the guidance of infinite beings.

dpral ba nas tshangs pa chen po spyod lam rab tu zhi ba/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung nas tshangs pa'i dbyangs su brjod de sangs rgyas thams cad la gsol ba gdab pa dang; byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rab tu dga' bar bya ba byed cing sems can gyi don tshad med pa la brtson par phyogs bcu'i chos kyi dbyings rgyas par 'gengs pa tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang gis mthong ngo/ /

Sudhana saw, issuing forth from the Sāgaradhvaja’s forehead, Mahābrahmās as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, filling the ten directions of the realm of phenomena, who had a peaceful deportment, spoke with the voice of Brahmā, supplicated all the buddhas for instruction, eulogized all the buddhas,[475] gladdened all bodhisattvas, and were dedicated to measureless benefit for beings.

From Saradhvaja’s forehead Sudhana saw as many great Brahmas as atoms in countless buddha-fields emerge, their deportment extremely tranquil, murmuring prayers, asking all buddhas for instruction, praising all buddhas, gladdening all enlightening beings, pervading all universes in the ten directions, involved in the infinite tasks of sentient beings.

mgo nas byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung nas/ kha dog dang dbyings sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i lus yongs su ston cing / dpe byad bzang pos rnam par bris pa'i lus rab tu bstan pa dang / 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin mtha' dang dbus med pa rab tu dgye ba dang / ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa nas bzung ste/ gtong ba dang / len pa dang / dngos po yongs su gtong ba'i rnam pa'i sprin mang po rab tu dgye ba dang / pha rol tu phyin pa sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi spyor ba rgya mtsho yongs su bstan pa dang / sbyin pa'i spyod pa 'jig rten du yongs su brjod pa dang / ser sna'i dri ma rnam par bzlog pa dang / chags pa thams cad spang ba la sems can rab tu dgod pa dang / 'jig rten rin po che sna tshogs thams cad kyi rgyan gyis brgyan par byin gyis brlab pa dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sems can rab tu dgod pa dang / mtshan thams cad kyi yon tan yang dag par brjod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi mtshan 'byung ba'i rgyu ston pa byed pa mthong ngo/ /

Sudhana saw, issuing forth from Sāgaradhvaja’s head, bodhisattvas as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, filling in each instant of mind the ten directions of the realm of phenomena, manifesting bodies that had various colors, forms, and adornments,[476] revealing bodies beautified by the features of a great being, and emanating infinite clouds of halos. From all their pores there commenced the emanation of the past bodhisattva conduct of all buddhas, revealing clouds of the processes of acts of generosity with their givers, recipients, and gifts;[477] revealing an ocean of the previous practices of the various perfections; describing the conduct of generosity to the world; averting the stains of greed; bringing beings to the renunciation of all attachments; blessing worlds with an adorning array of every variety of jewel; establishing beings in the perfection of generosity and then establishing them in the power over necessities;[478] proclaiming the qualities of all characteristics of a supreme being; and teaching the causes for the arising of those features of a buddha.

From Saradhvaja’s head Sudhana saw emerge as many enlightening beings as atoms in countless buddha-fields, manifesting bodies of various appearances, forms, adornments, and embellishments, emanating infinite spheres of light, taking up the past enlightening practices of all buddhas and projecting from every pore multitudes of forms practicing charity without attachment to giver, receiver, or gift, showing oceans of past efforts involved in the various ways of transcendence, commending the act of giving to the world, getting rid of the filth of envy, directing beings to give up all grasping, causing the world to appear adorned with all kinds of jewels, establishing sentient beings in the practice of transcendent giving and in command over material things, praising all virtues, and teaching the cause of the characteristics of buddhas.

yang byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung nas/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su brjod cing / ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba rgya mtsho yongs su bstan pa dang / sems can thams cad lam gyi rgyud dang yul las phyir phyogs par byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul la mngon du phyogs par bya ba dang / 'jig rten gyi 'dod pa la rnam par smad pa dang / 'jig rten gyi phyin ci log gi ling tog rnam par bsal ba dang / log pa'i rnam par rtog pa rab tu zhi bar byas nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims la yang dag par dgod pa dang / snying rje chen po'i tshul khrims yongs su brjod cing / de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul khrims rab tu thob par bya ba'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi lam nan tan du bya ba'i tshul khrims la sems can rab tu dgod pa dang / srid pa'i lam gyi rgyud rmi lam lta bur sems can rnams la rab tu brjod cing; rmi lam gyi tshul dang mnyam par yongs su gzhol bar bya ba'i phyir/ yul yongs su 'dzin pa dang / nyon mongs pa la dbang bsgyur ba sems can rnams rab tu dgod pa byed pa mthong ngo/ /

Sudhana saw bodhisattvas issuing forth who were as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms and were describing the perfection of good conduct manifesting from all their pores, an ocean of the past practice by all the buddhas of the perfection of good conduct. They were causing all beings to turn away from the entire field of existences and worlds and directing them to the field of the tathāgatas; they were deploring the world of desire;[479] they were removing the cataracts of error in the world; they were bringing an end to erroneous thought and establishing beings in the correct conduct of the bodhisattvas; they were describing the correct conduct of great compassion and establishing beings in the correct conduct of practicing the path of the buddhas so that they might attain the correct conduct of the tathāgatas; they were describing to beings how the states of existence are like dreams; and they were establishing beings in a state of overpowering the kleśas and attachment to the field of the senses in order that they might attain the state of perceiving all to be the same as the way of dreams.

He also saw as many enlightening beings as atoms in countless buddha-fields emerge praising transcendent morality, manifesting from every pore oceans of past efforts of all buddhas involved in transcendent morality, turning all beings away from the spheres of all mundane states and turning them toward the sphere of the enlightened, disdaining the world of desire, dispersing the veil of error from the world, stopping untrue thoughts and enjoining the way of life of enlightening beings, commending the ethic of great compassion and leading beings into the conduct of the practice of the path of buddhas to attain the conduct of the enlightened, showing sentient beings that the state of existence is like a dream and guiding them into power over afflictions caused by grasping sense objects so that they may fully enter into the way of acting as in a dream.

yang byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung nas/ 'jig rten rnams la mdog gser gyi kha dog lta bur mngon par ston cing; khro ba med pa dang / 'khrug pa med pa dang / shar gnyer ba med pa dang / zhe sdang ba med pa dang / chud gson pa med pa dang / khong khro ba med pa'i sems la sems can rab tu dgod pa dang / byol song gi skye gnas kyi lam gyi rgyud thams cad yongs su gcad pa'i phyir/ ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba'i srid rab tu 'gyed cing / bzod pa'i stobs la sems can rab tu dgod pa dang / chos la dbang bsgyur ba la sems can rab tu snang bar byed pa mthong ngo/ /

Sudhana also saw bodhisattvas issuing forth who were as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms and were revealing worlds to be golden in color. They were establishing beings in having no anger and no vexation and in states of mind that are without harshness, without hatred,[480] nondestructive, and free of hostility.[481] In order to close the ways to animal wombs, they were manifesting from all their pores clouds of the past practice by the tathāgatas of dedication to the perfection of patience, and they were establishing beings in the power of patience and revealing to beings power over phenomena.

He also saw as many enlightening beings as atoms in countless buddha-fields emerge, lighting up the world with golden light, guiding beings to a state of mind without hatred or malice, free from all corruption and defect, emanating from every pore multitudes of past efforts of buddhas involved in transcendent tolerance in order to cut off all brutal tendencies, leading sentient beings into the power of tolerance, showing sentient beings mastery over phenomena.

yang byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i brtson 'grus kyi stobs mtha' yas pa shin tu ston cing / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du brtsams pa las phyir mi ldog pa'i stobs kyis thos pa rgya mtsho yongs su btsal bas mi skyo bar bya bar yongs su brjod pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod cing rim gro bya ba la sems can rab tu gzud pa/ sdug bsngal gyi phung po thams cad rnam par bzlog pa'i brtson 'grus chen po la sems can rab tu dgod pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba mang po'i sprin lus thams cad las rab tu 'gyed cing / byang chub sems dpa'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa yongs su bstan pa dang / sems can rnams kyi le lo'i ri rnam par gtor ba dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sems can rab tu dgod pa dang / las la dbang bsgyur ba la 'jig rten rab tu gzud pa dang / rgyun ma 'chad par brtson par byed pa mthong ngo/ /

Sudhana also saw bodhisattvas issuing forth who were as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, who were revealing the infinite power of the diligence of bodhisattvas, and who were describing how, through the power of never turning back from striving for omniscience, were never weary in seeking for an ocean of hearing the Dharma. They were causing beings to engage in serving and making offerings to all the tathāgatas; establishing beings in the great diligence that repels the entire mass of suffering; emanating all the clouds of the bodies of the past practice by the tathāgatas of dedication to the perfection of diligence; teaching the perfection of diligence of the bodhisattvas; disintegrating the mountains of the laziness of beings; establishing beings in the perfection of patience; and leading the world to power over karma, fixed in their resolve.[482]

He also saw as many enlightening beings as atoms in countless buddha-fields emerge, engaged in miraculous displays showing the endless power of energy of enlightening beings, commending tireless quest for the ocean of learning by the power of nonregression in progress toward omniscience, guiding beings to honor and attend all buddhas, leading beings to arouse great energy to get rid of the mass of all suffering, emanating from all their bodies multitudes of past efforts involved in enlightening beings’ perfection of transcendent energy, shattering sentient beings’ mountains of sloth, leading sentient beings into transcendent energy, guiding sentient beings to mastery over action.

yang byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung nas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rjes su dran pa'i lam la sems can thams cad rab tu dgod cing / sgrib pa dang / bar du gcod pa dang / rab rib thams cad rnam par bsal ba dang / rlom pa dang bag med pa thams cad las sems can rnam par bzlog pa dang / bag yod pa'i chos la rab tu dgod pa dang / khengs pa 'gying ba dang / nga rgyal gyi rgyal mtshan rab tu snyol ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi bsam gtan gyi yan lag rgya mtsho brjod pa dang / 'jig rten rnams la bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su bsngags pa dang / ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi tshul mang po'i sprin rab tu dgye ba dang / sems can la dbang bsgyur ba la sems can rab tu dgod pa byed cing / skad cig re re la chos kyi dbyings rgyas par 'gengs pa mthong ngo/ /

Sudhana also saw bodhisattvas issuing forth who were as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, were filling the realm of phenomena in each instant of mind, and were establishing beings on the path of mindfulness of the bodhisattvas.
