They were eliminating all obscurations, obstacles, and darkness; turning beings away from all conceit and carelessness; establishing them in the qualities of carefulness; casting down the banner of arrogance, haughtiness, and pride; describing an ocean of aspects of the meditation of the buddhas; praising the perfection of meditation to the world; emanating from all their pores clouds of the many past practices by the tathāgatas of the perfection of meditation; and establishing beings in power over mind.

He also saw as many enlightening beings as atoms in countless buddha-fields emerge guiding sentient beings into the path of mindfulness, dissolving the darkness of all obstructions, causing sentient beings to desist from all intoxication and leading them into sobriety, taking down the flags of pretentiousness, arrogance, and pride, telling of the ocean of branches of meditation of buddhas, describing transcendent meditation to people, emanating from every pore multitudes of past efforts involved in perfection of transcendent meditation, guiding sentient beings to mastery of mind, pervading the cosmos moment to moment.

yang byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung ste/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su tshol ba dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba mang po'i sprin rab tu dgye ba dang / dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i skad thams cad kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sprin gyi 'brug sgra sgrog pa dang / yang dag par lta ba'i glog rab tu 'gyed pa dang / chos kyi rang bzhin gyi sgra dbyangs rab tu bsgrag pa dang / sems can rnams kyi bdag tu lta ba'i ri'i lhun rab tu gzhig pa dang / lta ba thams cad kyi zug rngu dbyung ba dang / the tshom dang yid gnyis dang nem nur gyi rab rib rnam par bsal ba dang / ye shes kyi dbang yang dag par bsngags pa byed cing sems kyi skad cig re re la chos kyi dbyings rgyas par 'gengs pa mthong ngo/ /

Sudhana also saw bodhisattvas issuing forth who were as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, were filling the realm of phenomena in each instant of mind, and were emanating from all their pores clouds of the many past practices by the tathāgatas of seeking the Dharma. With all languages, which are an ocean of the aspects of speech, they emitted the thunder of the clouds of the perfection of wisdom; radiated the lightning of the correct view; resounded with the words on the nature of phenomena; destroyed the mountains of the view of a self held by beings; extracted the splinters of all wrong views; cleared away doubts, uncertainties, and equivocation; and praised power over motivation.[483]

He also saw as many enlightening beings as atoms in countless buddha-fields emerge and pervade the cosmos in every moment of thought emanating from every pore multitudes of past efforts involved in the search of buddhahood, uttering multitudes of perfections of transcendent wisdom by oceans of words, emanating the lightning of right insight, expressing the inherent nature of phenomena, shattering the mountainous masses of sentient beings’ notion of self, extracting all arrows of views, dispersing the darkness of desire, heedlessness, and doubt, commending control of inclination.

yang byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thabs mkhas pa'i tshul gyi dkyil 'khor rab tu rjod par byed cing / ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas thabs mkhas pa dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba mang po'i sprin rab tu dgye ba dang / 'jig rten rnams la thabs mkhas pa'i spyod pa rab tu brjod pa dang / theg pa chen po'i 'byung ba mngon par bstan pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor yang dag par bsngags pa dang / 'khor ba dang / mya ngan las 'das pa tha mi dad pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yongs su bstan pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thabs mkhas pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sems can rab tu dgod pa dang / 'jig rten rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i dbang gi dkyil 'khor rab tu bstan pa byed cing / sems bskyed pa re re la chos kyi dbyings rgyas par 'gengs pa mthong ngo/

Sudhana also saw bodhisattvas issuing forth who were as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, were filling the realm of phenomena in each instant of mind and describing the field of the way of skillful methods of all the buddhas. They were emanating from all their pores clouds of the many past practices by the tathāgatas of skillful methods for all beings, revealing the conduct of skillful methods to the world, explaining skill[484] in the Mahāyāna, praising the fields of all the buddhas, teaching the bodhisattva conduct in which there is no separation between saṃsāra and nirvāṇa, establishing beings in the perfection of skillful methods of the bodhisattvas, and teaching the bodhisattva field of power over rebirth to the world.

He also saw as many enlightening beings as atoms in countless buddha-fields emerge and pervade the cosmos in a mental impulse, showing the sphere of methods of all buddhas’ skill in liberative means, emanating from every pore multitudes of past efforts involved in skill in means, spreading the practice of skill in means in the world, illuminating the way of universal emancipation, describing the sphere of all buddhas, describing and showing the practice of enlightening beings which unites the mundane and the transcendental, guiding sentient beings to enlightening beings’ perfection of skill in means, demonstrating in the world all enlightening beings’ mastery of regeneration.

yang byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung ste/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mtshan rgya mtsho'i sprin gyi 'brug sgra sgrog cing / ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba mang po'i sprin rab tu dgye ba dang / smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang dag par bsngags pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dbang thams cad la sems can rab tu dgod pa dang / smon lam chen po'i shing rta'i 'khor lo phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug par 'dril ba/ chos thams cad kyi rjes su 'brang ba/ nyon mongs pa thams cad rnam par bzlog pa/ mi shes pa'i ri rnam par 'thor ba 'jig rten du rab tu rjod pa byed cing smon lam sna tshogs kyi rnam par 'phrul bas/ sems kyi skad cig re re la chos kyi dbyings rgyas par 'gengs pa mthong ngo/ /

Sudhana also saw bodhisattvas issuing forth who were as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, were filling the realm of phenomena in each instant of mind through the miraculous power of prayer, and were emanating from all their pores the thunder of the clouds of the ocean of the names of all tathāgatas. They were emanating from all their pores clouds of the many past practices of the pure perfection of prayer of all bodhisattvas;[485] they were praising the perfection of prayer, establishing beings in all the powers of the bodhisattvas; and they were teaching to the world the rolling of the wheels of the chariot of great prayer until the end of future time, the following of all Dharmas, the repelling of all kleśas, and the destruction of the mountains of ignorance.

He also saw as many enlightening beings as atoms in countless buddha-fields emerge and pervade the cosmos in each moment of thought by various projections of will, emanating from every pore multitudes of oceans of names of all buddhas, radiating from every pore multitudes of past efforts involved in purification of transcendent vows of all enlightening beings, commending transcendent commitment, guiding sentient beings into the masteries of all enlightening beings, powering through the world the eternally rolling chariot wheel of great vows which follows all truths and gets rid of all afflictions and shatters the mountains of nescience.

yang byang chub sems dpa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i stobs rab tu snang bar bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i stobs yongs su bsgrub pa'i sgra rab tu dbyung ba dang / ba spu bu ga thams cad nas stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgrub cing 'byin pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba mang po'i sprin rab tu dgye ba dang / bdud dang phas kyi rgol ba thams cad kyis mi thub pa'i stobs yongs stobs yongs su bstan pa dang / khor yug dang rdo rje'i ri thams cad lus kyi steng du rdib kyang mi nyams pa'i stobs rab tu brjod pa dang / bskal pas 'tshig pa thams cad kyi me rgya mtsho'i nang na gnas kyang lus la gnod pa med pa'i stobs yongs su bstan pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams 'byams klas pa thams cad lag pa'i mthil gyis nam mkha'i dbyings su ston pa'i stobs yongs su ston pa byed cing / sems kyi skad cig re re la chos kyi dbyings 'gengs pa rgyun mi gcod pa mthong ngo/ /

Sudhana also continuously[486] saw bodhisattvas issuing forth who were as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, filling the realm of phenomena in each instant of mind, and illuminating the strength of the bodhisattvas. They were emitting the sound of the words of the accomplishment of the strength of the bodhisattvas; emanating from all their pores the clouds of the many past practices by the tathāgatas of the accomplishment and creation of the perfection of strength; teaching the strength that cannot be defeated by all the māras and adversaries; describing the strength that is not weakened even if all Cakravāla vajra mountain ranges[487] were to drop down onto their bodies; teaching the strength with which their bodies will not be harmed even though they remain in an ocean of the fires that incinerate all kalpas; teaching the strength by which one can hold up in the sky, on the palm of the hand, all the vast extent of world realms; and establishing beings in the power over miracles.[488]

He also saw as many enlightening beings as atoms in countless buddha-fields emerge and ceaselessly fill the cosmos in each moment of thought, manifesting the power of enlightening beings’ consummation of power, emanating from every pore multitudes of past efforts producing the consummation of transcendental power, showing power which cannot be overcome by any demons or challengers, nurturing such power that all the adamantine mountains surrounding the earth would shatter upon contact with their bodies, showing power such that their bodies do not even blaze up in the ocean of fire that burns the universe at the end of each eon, showing the power to hold all worlds in their hands while hovering in space, guiding beings to control of magical powers.
yang byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung nas sems can rnams la ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor ston cing /

Sudhana also saw bodhisattvas issuing forth who were as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, were filling the realm of phenomena in each instant of mind, and were teaching the field of knowledge to beings.
He also saw as many enlightening beings as atoms in countless buddha-fields emerge and fill the cosmos in every thought illuminating the sphere of knowledge of sentient beings,
ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba mang po'i sprin rab tu 'gyed pa dang /
They were emanating from all their pores the clouds of the many past practices by the tathāgatas of the pure perfection of knowledge;
emanating from every pore multitudes of past efforts involved in purification of consummate knowledge,
'jig rten rnams la sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan dang ye shes mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyi sa rab tu brjod pa dang /
revealing to the world the level of knowledge[489] that is the clairvoyant knowledge of the qualities of all the buddhas;
manifesting in the world the stage of knowledge characterized by mystic knowledge of all buddhas’ virtues and knowledges,
sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mtshan mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyis mngon par bstan pa dang /
teaching the level of knowledge[490] that is the clairvoyant knowledge of the names of all the buddhas;
showing the stage of knowledge characterized by mystic knowledge of all buddhas’ perceptions,
smon lam thams cad mngon par bsgrub pa'i ye shes mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyis yongs su brjod pa dang /
elucidating the level of knowledge[491] that is the clairvoyant knowledge of the accomplishment of all prayers;
illuminating the stage of knowledge characterized by mystic knowledge of the undertaking of all vows,
sems can thams cad yongs su bsdu ba'i smon lam mngon par bsgrub pa'i ye shes mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyis shin tu yangs par bya ba dang /
proclaiming the level of knowledge[492] that is the clairvoyant knowledge of the accomplishment of the prayers for gathering all beings as pupils;
revealing the stage of knowledge characterized by mystic knowledge of the undertaking of the vow to save all sentient beings,
sems can thams cad bdag med pa'i rang bzhin la gzud pa mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyis rnam par bstan pa dang /
proclaiming the level of knowledge[493] that is the clairvoyant knowledge for bringing all beings to understand the nature of selflessness;
revealing the stage of knowledge characterized by mystic knowledge penetrating the lack of self or independent existence in all beings,
sems can thams cad kyi sems rgya mtsho rnam par blta ba mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyis rab tu brjod pa dang /
teaching the level of knowledge[494] that is the clairvoyant knowledge of seeing the ocean of the minds of all beings;
illumining the stage of knowledge characterized by mystic knowledge observing the ocean of minds of all sentient beings,
explaining the level of knowledge[495] that is the clairvoyant knowledge of the accomplishment of all prayers;
sems can thams cad kyi dbang po rnam par dbye ba'i ye shes mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyi sa rab tu dbye ba dang /
categorizing the level of knowledge[496] that is the clairvoyant knowledge that categorizes the faculties of all beings;
analyzing the stage of knowledge characterized by mystic knowledge discerning the faculties of all sentient beings,
sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa dang / mos pa rnam par blta ba'i ye shes mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyis yang dag par brjod pa dang;
describing the level of knowledge[497] that is the clairvoyant knowledge that views the thoughts and aspirations of all beings;
describing the stage of knowledge characterized by mystic knowledge observing the inclinations and interests of all sentient beings,
sems can thams cad kyi las rgya mtsho la 'jug pa'i ye shes mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyi sa rnam par dgrol ba dang /
explicating the level of knowledge[498] that is the clairvoyant knowledge that comprehends the ocean of the karma of all beings;
disclosing the stage of knowledge characterized by mystic knowledge comprehending the ocean of actions of all beings,
sems can thams cad kyi smon lam rgya mtsho la 'jug pa'i ye shes mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyis yongs su ston pa byed cing
teaching the level of knowledge[499] that is the clairvoyant knowledge that comprehends the ocean of the prayers of all beings;
showing the stage of knowledge characterized by mystic knowledge penetrating the ocean of commitments of all sentient beings,
and establishing beings in the perfection of knowledge.[500]
guiding sentient beings into the perfection of knowledge.
sems kyi skad cig re re la chos kyi dbyings rgyas par 'gengs pa tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang gis mthong ngo/ /
[…thus seen]
[…thus seen]
spyi bo'i gtsug tor gyi gseb nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed mtshan dam pa dang / dpe byad bzang po rnam par dag pas brgyan pa/
From Saradhvaja’s topknot of flesh Sudhana saw emerge as many embodiments of buddhas as atoms in countless buddha-fields, adorned with the finest characteristics and embellishments,
'dzam bu chu klung gi gser gyi ri bo shin tu 'bar ba ltar snang ba/
who shone like a mountain of Jambu River gold;
appearing like mountains of gold,
'od kyi dkyil 'khor phyogs bcur spa zhing tshad med par 'bar ba dang /
whose halos shone measurelessly, radiating into the ten directions;
with immeasurable auras of blazing light illumining everything in the ten directions and

chos kyi dbyings tshul gyis rgyas par 'gengs pa'i dbyangs mnga' ba/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa mtha' dang dbus med pa yongs su ston pa 'gro ba thams cad la tha mi dad par chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par 'bebs pa ste/
whose voices filled the ways of the realm of phenomena, demonstrating the limitless miraculous power of the buddhas. They were sending down the rain from the clouds of Dharma equally on all beings;
voices pervading the cosmos, suffusing all universes, showing endless miraculous transformations of Buddha, showering rain from clouds of teaching on all without discrimination—

'di ltar snying po byang chub mchog tu phyin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la chos kyi dbyings kyi gzhi'i bye brag mngon sum du shes pa'i sprin ces bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang /

sending down onto the bodhisattvas who had gone to the supreme bodhimaṇḍas the rain from the cloud of Dharma called the cloud of the direct knowledge of the separate bases for the complete realm of phenomena;
showering rain from a cloud of teaching called knowledge confronting the distinction of all planes of the cosmos on enlightening beings on the verge of enlightenment,
byang chub sems dpa' dbang bskur ba thob pa rnams la gzhi kun tu rten pa'i sprin ces bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang /
sending down onto the bodhisattvas who had received empowerment the rain from the cloud of Dharma called the complete cloud of bases;
showering rain from a cloud of teaching called the ground of universality on coronated enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa' chos chen po'i rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur ba rnams la sgo kun nas 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang /
sending down onto the bodhisattvas who had been empowered as regents of the great Dharma the rain from the cloud of Dharma called complete entry through the gateways;
showering rain from a cloud of teaching called entry into the ground of universality on enlightening beings ordained as princes of the great teaching,
byang chub sems dpa' gzhon nur gyur pa rnams la kun nas brgyan pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi char mngon par dbab pa dang /
sending down onto the bodhisattvas who were youths the rain from the cloud of Dharma called completely adorned;
showering rain from a cloud of teaching called universal arrangement on enlightening beings of youthful nature,
byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi ldog pa rnams la snying rje chen po'i tshogs shin tu brtan pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang /
sending down onto the irreversible bodhisattvas the rain from the cloud of Dharma called the summit[501] of steadfast compassion;
showering rain from a cloud of teaching called steadfast head of great compassion on nonregressing enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa' lhag pa'i bsam bdag pa rnams la chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin gyi bye brag shes pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang /
sending down onto the bodhisattvas with pure superior motivation the rain from the cloud of Dharma called the vajra of the knowledge of the separate natures of all phenomena;
showering rain from a cloud of teaching called diamond of knowledge distinguishing the intrinsic essence of all phenomena on enlightening beings of purified intent,
byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi sbyor ba dang ldan pa rnams la 'gro ba yongs su sdud pas kun nas brgyan pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang /
sending down onto the bodhisattvas who had accomplished practice in previous lifetimes the rain from the cloud of Dharma called the display of completely attracting beings;
showering rain from a cloud of teaching called arrangement taking in all beings on enlightening beings accomplished in preparatory practices,
byang chub sems dpa' cher skyes pa rnams la dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du dmigs pa'i sprin ces bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang /
sending down onto the bodhisattvas who had been reborn the rain from the cloud of Dharma called the cloud of the direct perception of the circles of followers of the tathāgatas in the three times;
showering rain from a cloud of teaching called cloud of communication with the assemblies of all buddhas of past, present, and future on regenerated enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa' rnal 'byor la spyod pa rnams la chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin dang / gzhi rab tu sgrog pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang /
sending down onto the bodhisattvas who were engaged in practice the rain from the cloud of Dharma called declaring the natures and bases of all phenomena;
showering rain from a cloud of teaching called voice of the ground of intrinsic essence of all phenomena on enlightening beings engaged in concerted practice,
byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa rnams la snying rje chen po'i tshul dang / thabs kyi snying po'i sprin kun tu 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang /
sending down onto beginner bodhisattvas the rain from the cloud of Dharma called the appearance of the cloud of the essence of method and the way great compassion;
showering rain from a cloud of teaching called source of clouds containing the ways and means of great compassion on enlightening beings engaged in primary practices,
byang chub sems dpa' sems dang po bskyed pa rnams la dga' bar bya ba'i mdzod shin tu bsags pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang /

sending down onto the bodhisattvas who had developed the aspiration for enlightenment for the first time the rain from the cloud of Dharma called the essence of the accumulated treasure that brings joy;
showering rain from a cloud of teaching called store of kindness on enlightening beings newly determined to see enlightenment,

byang chub sems dpa' yangs pa la mos pa rnams la rnam par thar pa la rnam par thar pa mi zad pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i smon lam gyis dga' bar byed pa'i mdzod ces bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang /
sending down onto the bodhisattvas who had vast aspiration the rain from the cloud of Dharma called the treasure that brings joy through unceasing liberations and the prayers of the tathāgatas;
showering rain from a cloud of teaching called inexhaustible treasury of kindness of the buddhas’ commitment to liberation on enlightening beings of great zeal,
gzugs la spyod pa'i sems can rnams la gzhi kun tu mi zad pa'i mdzod ces bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang /
sending down onto the beings in the form realm the rain from the cloud of Dharma called the treasure with an unceasing basis;
showering rain from a cloud of teaching called inexhaustible treasury of the universal ground on beings in the world of form,
tshangs pa'i ris kyi lha rnams la tshul rgya mtsho tshad med pa'i 'brug sgra'i dbyangs zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang /
sending down onto the Brahmakāyika devas the rain from the cloud of Dharma called the sound of the roar of an ocean of limitless ways;
showering rain from a cloud of teaching called sound produced by the measureless ocean of principles on Brahma body deities,
dbang sgyur gyi lha rnams la stobs 'byung ba'i chos kyi yo byad mi zad pa'i mdzod ces bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang /
sending down onto the Paranirmitavaśavartin devas the rain from the cloud of Dharma called the inexhaustible treasure of the prerequisite qualities for the arising of strength;
showering rain from a cloud of teaching called inexhaustible treasury of power producing spiritual methods on controlling deities,
bdud kyi ris kyi lha rnams la thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi tshogs rgyal mtshan sna tshogs can yang dag par bsgrub pa'i dbyangs zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang /
sending down onto the devas of Māra the rain from the cloud of Dharma called the voice that acquires[502] the various banners of the accumulation of omniscience;
showering rain from a cloud of teaching called sound cleaning variously represented provisions for omniscience on demon-body deities,
'phrul dga'i lha rnams la ye shes rin po che sna tshogs la brtson pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang /
sending down onto the Nirmāṇarati devas the rain from the cloud of Dharma called dedication to various precious knowledges;
showering rain from a cloud of teaching called varied cargo of jewels of knowledge on the deities who enjoy emanations,
dga' ldan gyi lha rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang /
sending down onto the Tuṣita devas the rain from the cloud of Dharma called the banner of the various precious prayers of the bodhisattvas;
showering rain from a cloud called varied representation of the vows of enlightening beings on deities in the heavens of happiness,
mtshe ma'i lha rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rjes su dran pa'i mdzod ces bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang /
sending down onto the Yāma devas the rain from the cloud of Dharma called the treasure of being mindful of all the tathāgatas;
showering rain from a cloud of teaching called treasury of recollection of all buddhas on deities in the heavens of timely portion,
lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyi gnas su de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bas dga' ba'i shugs 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang /
sending down onto the abode of Śakra,[503] the lord of the devas, the rain from the cloud of Dharma called the arising of the power of joy[504] through seeing the tathāgatas;
showering rain from a cloud of teaching called source of the rapture of the vision of Buddha on the abodes of the chief deities,
gnod sbyin gyi dbang po'i gnas su chos kyi dbyings kyi nam mkha' la de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas rnam par 'phrul pas rgyas par 'gengs pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang /
sending down onto the abode of the lord of the yakṣas the rain from the cloud of Dharma called the emanations of the abodes of the tathāgatas filling the space of the realm of phenomena;
showering rain from a cloud of teaching called multitude of transformations of Buddha pervading the space of the cosmos on the abodes of the chief demigods,
dri za'i dbang po'i gnas su de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos yang dag par bgro ba zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang /
sending down onto the abode of the lord of the gandharvas the rain from the cloud of Dharma called the sound of the songs[505] of the Dharma of all the tathāgatas;
showering rain from a cloud of teaching called sound of eulogies of the qualities of all enlightened ones on the abodes of the chief celestial musicians,
lha ma yin gyi gnas su ye shes kyi tshul rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ces bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang /
sending down onto the abode of the lord[506] of the asuras the rain from the cloud of Dharma called the vajra field of the way of wisdom;
showering rain from a cloud of teaching called indestructible sphere of ways to knowledge on the abodes of the chief titans,
nam mkha' lding gi dbang po'i gnas su de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'byung ba'i thabs kyi sprin ces bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang /
sending down onto the abode of the lord of the garuḍas the rain from the cloud of Dharma called the cloud of the method for the arising of all the tathāgatas;
showering rain from a cloud of teaching called multitude of means of development of all enlightened ones on the abodes of the chief birds,
mi'am ci'i dbang po'i gnas su chos kyi sprin yang dag par 'gro ba thams cad kyi dbyangs zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang /
sending down onto the abode of the lord of the kinnaras the rain from the cloud of Dharma called the singing of the songs[507] of all the clouds of Dharma;
klu'i dbang po'i gnas su byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par 'phrul ba sgrog cing srid pa'i lam gyi rgyud las skyo ba skyed pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang /
sending down onto the abode of the lord of the nāgas the rain from the cloud of Dharma called the miraculous resounding of the bodhisattvas that creates dismay with saṃsāra;
showering rain from a cloud of teaching called source of the magical utterances of enlightening beings traveling swiftly through the states of existence on the abodes of the chief dragons,
lto 'phye chen po'i dbang po'i gnas su dga' ba rgya mtsho rnam par 'phel bar byed pa'i shugs zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang /
sending down onto the abode of the lord of the mahoragas the rain from the cloud of Dharma called the power that increases an ocean of joy;
showering rain from a cloud of teaching called speed of increase of the ocean of joy on the abodes of the chief serpents,
mi'i gnas su 'gro ba thams cad las khyad par du 'phags pa'i ye shes rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang /
sending down onto the world of humans the rain from the cloud of Dharma called the range[508] of knowledge that is superior to that of all beings;
showering rain from a cloud of teaching called sphere of the highest knowledge of all beings on the realms of humans,

sems can dmyal ba'i 'jig rten du 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu zhi ba'i dbyangs dang / 'phags pa'i lam gyi tshig gi rgyud kyis brgyan pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang /
sending down onto the world of the hells the rain from the cloud of Dharma called the voice that ends all the suffering of saṃsāra;
showering rain from a cloud of teaching called ornament bearing the words of the holy path bespeaking the extinction of all the pains of mundane existence on the hells,

byol song gi skye gnas su las kyi lam kha na ma tho ba med pa la nan tan du bya ba'i dbyangs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rjes su dran pa'i sprin gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lhun ces bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang /

sending down onto those reborn as animals the rain from the cloud of Dharma called the form of the field of the clouds of mindfulness of the tathāgatas that describes the practice of the path of irreproachable activities;
showering rain from a cloud of teaching called round body of clouds of remembrance of buddhas bespeaking the practice of impeccable action on the realms of animals,

gshin rje'i 'jig rten du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgrags pas/ sems can thams cad kyi gtong ba'i sems 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang /

sending down onto those in the world of Yama[509] the rain from the cloud of Dharma called the proclamation of the perfections of all the tathāgatas that gives rise to generosity in the minds of all beings;
showering rain from a cloud of teaching called declaration of the transcendence of all buddhas producing a mind of nonattachment in all sentient beings on the ghost realms,
sems can log par lhung ba rnams la sdug bsngal thams cad zhi ba rab tu 'thob pas dbugs dbyung ba'i dbyangs kyi nga ro zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa mdzad cing /
and sending down onto the beings who had fallen down the rain from the cloud of Dharma called the roar of the voice that brings relief through the attainment of the cessation of all suffering.
showering rain from a cloud of teaching called comforting sound effecting the cessation of all pains on beings in distress.
chos kyi dbyings rgyas par 'gengs pa tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang gis mthong ngo/ /
[…thus seen]
[…thus seen]

ba spu'i bu ga thams cad las ba spu'i sgo re re nas kyang 'od zer gyi dra ba dang / dkyil 'khor gyi kha dog dang / gzugs kyi glong dang rgyan grangs med pa can/ dgos pa sna tshogs grangs med pa la sta gon du gnas pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung nas phyogs bcu'i chos kyi dbyings rgyas par 'gengs pa mthong ste/

Sudhana also saw issuing forth from all of Sāgaradhvaja’s pores, from each of his pores, fields of networks of light rays that were as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, were filling the ten directions of the realm of phenomena, and formed countless arrays of powers[510] and adopted forms prepared to carry out countless different activities.

He also saw as many orbs of webs of light beams as atoms in countless buddha-fields emerge from every pore, countless whirling arrays of phantom forms of power, manifestations of countless various works, pervading the entire cosmos.
'di ltar ba spu'i sgo'i 'od zer gyi dra ba dang / dkyil 'khor la la las ni/ sbyin pa'i spyod pa skyon med pas bdog pa thams cad yongs su gtong bar rnam par 'phrul ba mthong ngo/ /
Sudhana saw some of the fields of networks of light rays from the pores performing the miracle of giving away all possessions through a faultless conduct of generosity.
From some orbs of webs of light beams he saw scenes of the practice of pure giving, relinquishing everything;

ba spu'i sgo'i dra ba dang / dkyil 'khor la la las ni/ dus gsum gyi byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi tshul khrims dang / brtul zhugs dang / yid dam dang / tshul gyi dkyil 'khor du rnam par 'phrul pa mthong ngo; ;
Sudhana saw some of the fields of networks of light rays from the pores manifesting the field of the correct conduct, discipline, commitment, and precepts[511] of the bodhisattvas of the three times.
from some orbs of webs of light beams he saw scenes of the procedures of all past, present and future enlightening beings’ investiture with ethical precepts;

ba spu'i sgo'i 'od zer gyi dra ba dang / dkyil 'khor la la las ni/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bzod pa'i spyod pa'i rnam pa dus gsum du byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams rkang lag dang / yan lag gi dam pa gcad kyang / nyams su bzod pa byed pa'i rnam par 'phrul ba dang / khu tshur dang dbyig pas bsnun te/ mtshon gyis lus la btab kyang; nyams su bzod par byed pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang / lus thams cad gshegs sam snying dang mig phyung yang / nyams su bzod pa byed pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa mthong ngo; ;

Sudhana saw some of the fields of networks of light rays from the pores manifesting the forms of the conduct of patience of the bodhisattvas in the three times. They manifested them enduring their hands, feet, and heads[512] being cut off. They manifested them enduring their bodies being beaten with fists and sticks and struck by weapons. They manifested them enduring their bodies being cut apart[513] or their hearts and eyes being plucked out.

from some orbs of webs of light beams he saw scenes of all enlightening beings of past, present, and future practicing forbearance, enduring dismemberment, beatings, having their hearts and eyes gouged out,

byang chub sems dpa' dus gsum du byung ba/ rnam par brtags pa'i lus dang ldan pa gzhan dag gis thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos nyid yongs su btsal ba'i ched du lus dang sems la gnod pa thams cad dang / yan lag dang / nying lag gcad pa thams cad kyang snying rje chen pos dbang du byas pa'i phyir nyams su bzod par byas pa dang / bag la zha bar byas pa dang / gtang snyoms su bzhag pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i bzod pa'i spyod pa rnam par 'phrul ba'i gzugs brnyan gyi gzugs de lta bu dag kyang mthong ngo/ /

Sudhana saw the manifestation of forms of the images of the conduct of patience of all bodhisattvas: the formed appearances of other bodhisattvas appearing in the three times who, in seeking omniscience with great compassion, were enduring, forbearing, and indifferent to physical and mental torments and to their limbs and the smaller parts of their bodies being cut off.

and he saw magically produced images of the practices of forbearance of all enlightening beings by the oppressed enlightening beings of past, present, and future with bodies sundered in the search of omniscience, enduring, forgiving, and overlooking all physical and mental harassment, out of great compassion;

ba spu'i sgo'i 'od zer gyi dra ba dang / dkyil 'khor la la las ni/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi brtson 'grus kyi spyod pa rnam pa tha dad pa rnam par phye ba'i gzugs dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i brtson 'grus kyi rnam par 'phrul ba 'jig rten yongs su bskyod pa dang / rgya mtsho yongs su skem pa dang / sems can yongs su skyo bar bya ba dang / mu stegs can thams cad yongs su tshar gcad pa dang / bdud thams cad spa bkong ba dang / chos kyi phyogs snang bar bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i mthu chen po rnam par 'phrul ba mthong ngo/ /

Sudhana saw some of the fields of networks of light rays from the pores manifesting the different separate forms of the conduct of diligence of all bodhisattvas: the manifestations of the diligence of the bodhisattvas of the past, future, and present making worlds tremble, agitating[514] the oceans, causing beings to be dismayed with saṃsāra, terrifying[515] all tīrthikas, causing the hordes of māras to flee, and illuminating the aspects of the Dharma.

from some orbs of webs of light beams he saw scenes of different forms of the immensity of the practice of vigor of all enlightening beings, scenes of the great prowess of enlightening beings shaking the world, agitating the seas, startling sentient beings, scaring all heretics;

pa spu'i sgo'i 'od zer gyi dra ba dang / dkyil 'khor la la las ni/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyod pa rnam par rgyu ba'i rnam grangs ji snyed pa dang / lus nye bar len pa ji snyed pa dang / rigs su skye ba yongs su gzung ba ji snyed pa dang / gzugs kyi lus yongs su grub pa ji snyed pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis rjes su bstan pa yongs su gzung ba ji snyed pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi man ngag la nan tan du bya ba'i gnas ji snyed pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsam gtan gyi yan lag yongs su bsgrub pa dang mthun pa'i gtsug lag khang dang / gnas dang; gzhal med khang dang / yul dang / ri'i sul ji snyed pa dang / bsam gtan gyi yan lag de dag sus yongs su bsgrub pa'i drang srong gi lus ji snyed pa dang / rgyal po'i thabs ji snyed pa dang / 'byung ba la mngon par mos pa ji snyed pa dang / brtul zhugs dang / yi dam dang / tshul dang / spyod lam ji snyed pa de dag thams cad kyang tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang gis mthong ngo/ /

Sudhana also saw some of the fields of networks of light rays from the pores manifesting all the many kinds of bodhisattva conduct that are performed: all their choosing of an existence; their being born into a family; their formation of a body; their being taught by kalyāṇamitras; the locations for their practicing the instructions of the kalyāṇamitra; the temples, locations, aerial palaces, lands, or mountain caves that are favorable for the practice of the aspects of the meditation of the tathāgatas; their physical forms as ṛṣis in which they accomplish those aspects of meditation; their ruling as kings; their aspiration for renunciation; and the discipline, commitment, and precepts of their path of mendicancy.

from some orbs of webs of light beams he saw embodiments of all deeds of enlightening beings, the forms taken on, the perfections of physical bodies to be born in good families, the acceptance of instructions of spiritual benefactors, the states of practice of the teachings of spiritual benefactors, the abandonments of home, country, and city for suitable abodes to accomplish the branches of meditation of the enlightened, the seers, the meditation adepts, the kings, the recluses, the manners of disciplined conduct;

ba spu'i sgo'i 'od zer gyi dra ba dang / dkyil 'khor la la las ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa la rnam par spyod cing / chos thams cad yongs su tshol ba dang ldan pa'i lus yongs su bzung ba mthong ste/ lus gang gis chos kyi tshig gcig gi don du yang bdog pa thams cad yongs su btang ste/ sems can thams cad las yongs su btsal ba dang / rim gro dang / bkur sti thams cad kyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad las yongs su btsal ba dang; dad pa dang / sri zhus lus rab tu btud de/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams las yongs su btsal ba dang / chos kyi tshig gcig la ji lta ba de bzhin du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i chos kyi tshig thams cad la'ang de bzhin te/ 'gro ba thams cad du gzugs brnyan byung ba'i lus thams cad kyis yongs su btsal ba de dag thams cad kyang tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang gis/ ba spu'i sgo gcig gi 'od zer gyi dra ba dang / dkyil 'khor las mthong ngo/ /

Sudhana, the head merchant’s son, also saw some of the fields of networks of light rays from each of the pores manifesting the practice of the conduct of the perfection of wisdom. He saw the acquisitions of a body for seeking all the Dharma, in those bodies giving up all possessions for the sake of a single word of the Dharma, seeking that single word from all beings, seeking it from all kalyāṇamitras with service and respect, and seeking it from all the tathāgatas with faith, veneration, and bowing down the body. Just as they do for a single word of the Dharma, they do the same for all the words of the Dharma that have the perfection of wisdom of the tathāgatas, seeking them with the apparent image of a body appearing among all beings.

from some orbs of webs of light beams he saw embodiments involved in seeking all truths in the station of practice of transcendent wisdom; from the orbs of webs of light beams from each and every pore Sudhanasaw the bodies by which each statement of the Teaching was sought from the midst of all beings by relinquishing all that exists, sought from all spiritual benefactors through attendance and service, sought from buddhas with all the strength generated by faith and respect, and all the statements of the Teaching related to transcendent wisdom similarly sought by bodies manifested in the forms of all sentient beings;

ba spu'i sgo'i 'od zer gyi dra ba dang / dkyil 'khor la la las ni/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i thabs 'gro ba'i rgyud rgya mtsho thams cad du 'byams klas pa sems can thams cad yongs su bsdu ba'i sbyor ba mthong ngo/ / sems can re re la yang lus dang spyod pa'i tshul gyi sgo sngon gyi lus nye bar blangs pa/ thabs mkhas pa'i spyod pa la brtson pa/ sems can thams cad kyi lus dang 'dra bas yongs su sdud pa yang ba spu'i sgo'i 'od zer gyi dra ba'i dkyil 'khor gcig las mthong ngo/ /

Sudhana, the head merchant’s son, also saw some of the fields of networks of light rays from each of the pores manifesting the methods of all bodhisattvas for ripening beings, for gathering as pupils all beings, and he saw the entire vast extent of the ocean of beings. He saw the dedication to the conduct of skillful methods in their previous lifetimes, how they gathered pupils through having a body that was the same as that of each and every being.

from some orbs of webs of light beams he saw all enlightening beings entering the ocean of states of being with means of development, endeavoring to save all sentient beings; from orbs of webs of light beams from every pore he saw enlightening beings saving sentient beings, engaged in the practice of skill in means taken on by their original bodies, approaching each and every being in a form resembling those beings;

ba spu'i sgo'i 'od zer gyi dra ba'i dkyil 'khor la la las ni/ sngon gyi bcom ldan 'das kyis bskal pa thams cad du smon lam mngon par bsgrubs pa'i spyod pa dang / sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba'i smon lam mngon par bsgrubs pa'i spyod pa dang / zhing thams cad yongs su dag par bya ba'i smon lam mngon par bsgrub pa mdzad pa ji snyed pa dang / smon lam thams cad mngon par bsgrubs pa'i dkyil 'khor ji snyed cig de bzhin gshegs pa de dang de dag gi zhabs kyi drung du 'khor ba'i skyon thams cad las 'khor ba'i skyon so so re re'i gnyen por mngon par bsgrubs pa mdzad pa de dag thams cad kyang / tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang gis/ ba spu'i sgo'i 'od zer gyi dra ba'i dkyil 'khor gcig las mthong ngo/ /

Sudhana, the head merchant’s son, also saw some of the fields of networks of light rays from each of the pores manifesting the conduct that accomplishes the prayers of all the bhagavats in the past kalpas, the conduct that accomplishes the prayers for ripening all beings, and the conduct that accomplishes the prayers for purifying all realms. Within the field of the accomplishment of those prayers they accomplished the remedy for each fault of saṃsāra at the feet of this and that tathāgata. Sudhana, the head merchant’s son, saw all of these manifesting from each single field of networks of light rays from a pore.

from some orbs of webs of light beams he saw the conduct of the Buddha’s undertaking of vows in all past ages, the conduct of the undertaking of the vow to perfect all beings, the conduct of the undertaking of the vow to purify all lands, the spheres of accomplishment of all vows effected by each buddha by the specific cures for each of the ills of the mundane whirl. Sudhana saw all this from orbs of lights from each pore;
ba spu'i sgo'i 'od zer gyi dra ba'i dkyil 'khor la la las ni/ stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa thams cad dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba rgya mtsho mthong ngo/ /
Sudhana, the head merchant’s son, also saw some of the fields of networks of light rays from each of the pores manifesting an ocean of all the past conduct of the perfection of strength.
from some orbs of webs of light beams he saw oceans of past efforts involved in the practice of transcendent power;

ba spu'i sgo'i 'od zer gyi dra ba'i dkyil 'khor la la las ni/ ye shes kyi spyod pa rnam par rgyu ba thams cad dang ldan pa mi shes pa'i gnyid kyis log pa'i sems can sad par byed pa'i rang bzhin dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba rgya mtsho mthong bar gyur to/ /

Sudhana, the head merchant’s son, also saw some of the fields of networks of light rays from each of the pores manifesting an ocean of all the past practice of the conduct of wisdom that has the nature of awaking beings from the sleep of ignorance.

from some orbs of webs of light beams he saw oceans of past efforts involved in the contemplations of the practice of omniscience and the awakening of sentient beings asleep in the slumber of ignorance.

de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang dge slong rgya mtsho'i rgyal mtshan de ltar mnyam par bzhag pa la sems shing rtog pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor de rjes su dran par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi khyu mchog gi mthu phyung ba de la rjes su rnam par bsam pa dang / sems can gyi don gyi tshul rgya mtsho de la 'jug par bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba'i sgo rgyud kun la mngon du gnas pa'i rgyan de'i rjes su 'brang zhing khong du chud par bya ba dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi rgyan rnam par dag pa'i ye shes kyi sgo de la 'jug par bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs yang dag par mnod pa'i ye shes de la rab tu brtag pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dbang gi stobs de yongs su bskyed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam gyi stobs de brtan par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i stobs de shin tu rgyas par bya ba byed cing / dge slong rgya mtsho'i rgyal mtshan gyi mdun du nyin zhag gcig kyang lon no/ / nyin zhag gnyis dang / bdun yang lon no/ / zla ba phyed dang / zla ba gcig dang / zla ba gnyis dang / zla ba drug gi bar dang / nyin zhag kyang drug tu dge slong rgya mtsho'i rgyal mtshan gyi mdun du lon te/

Sudhana, the head merchant’s son, thus observed and examined the bhikṣu Sāgaradhvaja resting in meditation. He was mindful of the field of liberation of samādhi; he was contemplating the inconceivable,[516] supreme power of bodhisattva samādhi; he was comprehending that inconceivable[517] ocean of ways to benefit beings; he was following and was devoted[518] to that inconceivable,[519] complete display of the composite gateways for entry into those streams of conduct; he was entering through the gateway to the pure wisdom of the display of the realm of phenomena; he was examining the wisdom that is received through the blessing of the buddhas; he was developing the strength of those bodhisattva powers; he was making firm the strength of those bodhisattva prayers; and he was increasing the strength of that bodhisattva conduct. In that way, he sat before the bhikṣu Sāgaradhvaja for an entire day and night. He sat before the bhikṣu Sāgaradhvaja for two days, for seven days, for half a month, for a whole month, for two months, for six months, and for another six days and nights.

Then, observing the monk Saradhvaja thus concentrated in meditation, mindful of that sphere of concentration and liberation, contemplating the inconceivable power of concentration of enlightening beings, entering into that inconceivable ocean of ways of benefiting sentient beings, remembering that inconceivable medium of the performance of supernal manifestations confronting all the senses, strongly focusing his attention on it, entering that door of knowledge of purity of arrangement of the cosmos, aspiring to that enlightened power, expanding in knowledge, recognizing that controlling power of enlightening beings, stabilizing the power of vows of enlightening beings, extending the power of practice of enlightening beings, Sudhana stood before Saradhavja for a day and a night, for two days and nights, seven days and nights, a fortnight, a month, six months, and then six more days and nights.
de ltar zla ba drug dang / nyin zhag drug 'das nas/ dge slong rgya mtsho'i rgyal mtshan ting nge 'dzin de las langs so/ / de nas nor bzang gis smras pa/
When six months and six days had passed, the bhikṣu Sāgaradhvaja arose from his samādhi. Then Sudhana said to him,
After six months and six days and nights, the monk Saradhvaja rose from concentration. Sudhana said,
'phags pa/ ting nge 'dzin 'di de ltar zab la/
“Ārya, this wonderful samādhi that is so profound;
“It is marvelous, noble one, how profound this concentration is,
de ltar rgya che zhing /
that is so vast;
how vast,
de ltar tshad ma mchis pa'i yul dang ldan pa dang /
that has such an immeasurable scope;
how measureless its scope,
de ltar bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa dang /
that has such an inconceivable manifestation;
how inconceivable its arrays of projections,
de ltar snang ba mtshungs pa ma mchis pa dang /
that has such an unequaled radiance;
how incomparable its light,
de ltar grangs ma mchis pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa dang /
that has such innumerable displays;
how innumerable its manifestations,
de ltar mi 'phrog pa'i spyod yul dang ldan pa dang;
that has such an inviolable range;
how unsurpassable its range,
de ltar ma 'dres pa'i yul dang ldan pa dang /
that has such an unalloyed scope;
how pure its sphere,
de ltar phyogs kun tu rnam par snang ba dang /
that has such a universal illumination;
how it illumines everywhere equally,
ting nge 'dzin 'di de ltar sems can gyi don tshad ma mchis pa rab tu sgrub par gyur pa ni ngo mtshar te/
that has such an accomplishment of benefit for limitless beings;
how it works for the benefit of infinite beings,
de nas sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyi phung po tshad ma mchis pa rnam par zhi bar bgyi ba la sta gon du gnas pa ste/
that brings such a cessation of the measureless sufferings of all beings;
in that it is directed to the extinction of the measureless mass of suffering of all sentient beings,
'di ltar dbul ba'i sdug bsngal zhi bar bgyi ba la sta gon du gnas so/ /
that is present in order to end the sufferings of poverty;
to extinguish the sufferings of the destitute,
sems can dmyal ba'i lam gyi rgyud rgyun gcad pa dang /
to end hellish states,
byol song gi skye gnas kyi lam gyi rgyud las yongs su bskyab pa dang /
that is present in order to save beings from existences of rebirth as animals,
to rescue beings from brutish states,
mi khom pa'i lam gyi rgyud kyi sgo thams cad gcad pa dang /
in order to close all the gateways that lead to unfortunate existences,
to close the door on all conditions inopportune for enlightenment,
mtho ris kyi lam gyi rgyud du phyin par bgyi ba dang /
in order to lead onto the path to higher existences,
to lead the way to heavenly states,
lha dang mi'i dga' ba dang bde ba 'byung bar bgyi ba dang /
in order to bring the joy and happiness of devas and humans,
to produce human and celestial pleasure and happiness,
bsam gtan gyi yul gyi dga' ba nyams su myong bar bgyi ba dang /
in order to bring the experience of joy within the scope of meditation,
to foster experience of the pleasure of meditation,
'dus byas la spyod pa'i bde ba yongs su 'phel bar bgyi ba dang /
in order to increase joy in composite conduct,
to increase happiness in the conditioned world,
khams gsum pa las 'byung ba'i sgo yongs su bstan pa la sta gon du gnas pa'o/ /
and in order to show the gateway to escape from the three realms
to show the way out of the mundane.
byang chub kyi sems yang dag par skye ba'i rgyu yongs su brjod pa la sta gon du gnas pa'o/ /
that is present in order to illuminate the causes for the creation of the aspiration to enlightenment,
It is set forth to illumine the cause of production of the aspiration of enlightenment,
bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yang dag par skye ba'i rgyu rnam par 'phel bar bgyi ba dang /
to increase the causes for generating the accumulations of merit and wisdom,
to develop the cause of production of provisions of virtue and knowledge,
snying rje chen po'i shugs rgya chen po rnam par 'phel bar bgyi ba dang /
to increase the vast power of great compassion,
to increase the intensity of vast great compassion,
smon lam chen po'i stobs yongs su bskyed par bgyi ba dang /
to develop the strength of great prayers,
to generate the power of great vows,
byang chub sems dpa'i lam snang ba rab tu 'thob par bgyi ba dang /
to attain the illumination of the path of the bodhisattvas,
for the attainment of the light of the path of enlightening beings,
pha rol tu phyin pa chen po'i theg pa rnam par dgod pa dang /
to establish the yāna of the perfections,
for the arrangement of the great vehicle of the transcendent ways,
theg pa chen po'i khyad par la 'jug pa mngon par bsgrub pa dang /
to accomplish entry into the exceptional Mahāyāna,
for the accomplishment of the supreme attainment of the Great Vehicle,
kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa shes shing snang bar bgyi ba dang /
to know and illuminate the completely good conduct,
for the vision of the knowledge of universally good action,
byang chub sems dpa'i sa shes shing snang ba thob par bgyi ba dang /
to know and attain the illumination of the bodhisattva bhūmi,
for the attainment of the light of the knowledge of the stages of enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi smon lam dang / spyod pa dang / 'byung ba'i rgyan rnam par dag pa yongs su bsgrub pa dang /
to accomplish the prayers, conduct, and pure-emergence displays of all the bodhisattvas;
for accomplishment of the purification of the array of means of emancipation in the practice of the vows of all enlightening beings,
thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa gnan pa la thogs pa ma mchis par bgyi ba sta gon du gnas pa'o/ / 'phags pa/ ting 'dzin de'i ming ci zhes bgyi/
and that becomes present in order to ascend without impediment to the level of omniscience‍— Ārya, what is the name of this samādhi?”
for the empowerment of accession to the sphere of omniscience. Noble one, what is the name of this concentration?”

smras pa/ rigs kyi bu/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa kun nas lta ba'i btang snyoms yongs su thob pa zhes bya ba yod de/ ting 'dzin 'di ni de'i snang ba ste/ sgo kun nas rnam par dag pa'i rgyan ces bya ba'o/ /

The bhikṣu Sāgaradhvaja answered, “Noble one, it is the perfection of wisdom called the complete vision of the attainment of equanimity. The radiance of that samādhi is called the pure display of every gateway.
Saradhvaja said, “There is a perfection of wisdom called equanimity of the universal eye, and this concentration is its light, called manifestation of universal purification.

rigs kyi bu/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa kun nas lta ba'i btang snyoms rab tu thob pa'i snang ba las skyes pa'i ting nge 'dzin sgo kun nas rnam par dag pa'i rgyan ces bya ba 'di shin tu bsgoms na/ sgo kun nas rnam par dag pa'i rgyan la sogs pa ting nge 'dzin brgya stong grangs med pa phrag bcu tshang ba yongs su 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /

“Noble one, if you meditate on the pure display of every gateway samādhi that arises from attaining the radiance of the perfection of wisdom called the complete vision of the attainment of equanimity, then you will accomplish ten times countless hundreds of thousands of samādhis such as the pure display of every gateway.”

By the perfect accomplishment of the concentration of manifestation of universal purification, which springs from the light of the perfection of wisdom of equanimity of the universal eye, countless tens of hundreds of thousands of complete concentrations, beginning with the manifestation of universal purification, are born.”
smras pa/ 'phags pa/ ting nge 'dzin 'di'i yul der bas sam ma bas/
Sudhana asked, “Ārya, what is the range of this samādhi?”
Sudhana said, “Is this the greatest range of this concentration?”
smras pa/ rigs kyi bu/ ting nge 'dzin 'di la snyoms par zhugs pa la ni 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par dmigs pa la thogs pa med do/ /
Saradhvaja said, “One who has fully accomplished this concentration has the power to discern worlds,
'jig rten gyi khams su 'jug par bya ba la thogs pa med do/ /
you will have no impediment in entering those world realms;
to enter worlds,
'jig rten gyi khams rnam par gnon pa la thogs pa med do/ /
you will have no impediment in overpowering those world realms;
to travel freely in worlds,
'jig rten gyi khams yongs su brgyan pa la thogs pa med do/ /
you will have no impediment in adorning those world realms;
to adorn worlds,
'jig rten gyi khams yongs su sbyang ba la thogs pa med do/ /
you will have no impediment in cleansing those world realms;
to purify worlds,
'jig rten gyi khams yongs su dag par bya ba la thogs pa med do/ /
you will have no impediment in purifying those world realms;
to beautify worlds,
sangs rgyas blta zhing rnam par dmigs par bya ba la thogs pa med do/ /
you will have no impediment in perceiving and looking at the buddhas;
to see buddhas,
sangs rgyas kyi bdag nyid che ba brtag pa la thogs pa med do/ /
you will have no impediment in examining the greatness of the buddhas;
to observe the grandeur of buddhas,
sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa yongs su shes par bya ba la thogs pa med do/ /
you will have no impediment in knowing the miracles of the buddhas;
to know the emanations of buddhas,
sangs rgyas kyi stobs la 'jug cing khong du chud par bya ba la thogs pa med do/ /
you will have no impediment in comprehending and understanding the strengths of the buddhas;
to enter the powers of buddhas,
sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rgya mtshor 'jug pa la thogs pa med do/ /
you will have no impediment in comprehending the ocean of the qualities of the buddhas;
to plunge into the ocean of virtues of buddhas,
sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi sprin gyi char yongs su gzung ba la thogs pa med do/ /
you will have no impediment in obtaining the rain of the Dharma clouds of the buddhas;
to receive the teachings of buddhas,
sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi 'khor lo 'khor ma 'dres pa shes shing khong du chud par bya ba la thogs pa med do/ /
you will have no impediment in knowing and understanding distinctly the Dharma wheels of the buddhas;
to follow the knowledge of the unity of all buddhas’ teachings,
sangs rgyas kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi rgya mtsho la 'jug cing khong du chud par bya ba la thogs pa med do/ /
you will have no impediment in comprehending and understanding the ocean of the circles of followers of the buddhas;
to enter the ocean of congregations of buddhas,
phyogs bcur 'jug cing rjes su bgrang bar bya ba la thogs pa med do/ /
you will have no impediment in comprehending and following the ten directions;
to go anywhere in the ten directions,
sangs rgyas kyi chos bstan pa rjes su brtag par bya ba la thogs pa med do/ /
you will have no impediment in examining the Dharma taught by the buddhas;
to observe the teaching activity of the buddhas,
sangs rgyas kyi phyogs rjes su brtag par bya ba la thogs pa med do/ /
you will have no impediment in examining the directions of the buddhas;
to see the realms of the buddhas,
snying rje chen po'i phyogs rnam par mi spang pa la thogs pa med do/ /
you will have no impediment in never abandoning the direction of great compassion;
to embrace all with great compassion,
byams pas phyogs rgyas par dgang ba la thogs pa med do/ /
you will have no impediment in filling the directions with great love;
to pervade everywhere with love,
sangs rgyas blta ba'i phyogs la 'jug pas mi ngoms par bya ba la thogs pa med do/ /
you will have no impediment in never tiring of the direction of gazing at the buddhas;
to plunge tirelessly into the vision of buddhas everywhere,
(*) you will have no impediment in comprehending and understanding all of the ocean of the buddhas;
sems can rgya mtsho thams cad du 'jug cing khong du chud par bya ba la thogs pa med do; ;
you will have no impediment in knowing and understanding all of the ocean of beings;
to enter into the ocean of all beings,
sems can gyi dbang po rgya mtsho thams cad shes shing khong du chud par bya ba la thogs pa med do/ /

sems can gyi dbang po thams cad shes par bya ba la thogs pa med do/ /

rigs kyi bu /kho bos ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnam par spyod pa 'di shes su zad na/ byang chub sems dpa' shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnam par spyod pa rgya mtsho la zhugs pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyi yul la blo gros rnam par dag pa/ chos thams cad la rig pa rjes su 'brang ba'i ye shes can/ blo shin tu yangs pas tshad med pa'i yul rgyas par 'gengs pa/ gzungs chen po'i snang ba la dbang bsgyur ba/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor snang ba thams cad shin tu dag pa mngon par shes pas rnam par 'phrul pa dang / khyu mchog gi mthu 'byin pa la shin tu 'byung ba/ tha dad pa yang dag par shes pa mi zad pa'i rgya mtsho la zhugs pa/ ngag snyan pa sa'i snying po dang ldan pa brjod pa/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi rten du gyur pa rnams kyi spyod pa shes pa'am/ yon tan brjod pa'am/ spyod yul bstan pa'am/ yul rab tu brjod pa'am/ smon lam chen po'i stobs yang dag par bsngags pa'am/ 'byung ba'i sgo yongs su snang bar bya ba'am/ yang dag par bsgrub pa mngon par brjod pa'am/ lam yongs su bstan pa'am/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyun gyi rjes su 'brang bar bya ba'am/ sems kyi yul shes par bya ba'am/ ye shes mnyam pa nyid khong du chud par bya bar nus re skan;

“Noble one, I know only this conduct of the perfection of wisdom. How could I know or describe the qualities of, teach the conduct of, describe the scope of, praise the strength of the great prayers of, illuminate the gateway for the emergence of, describe the true accomplishment of, teach the path of, follow the continuum of samādhi of, know the scope of the mind of, or be able to comprehend the equanimity of the wisdom of the entry by the bodhisattvas in the ocean of the conduct of the perfection of wisdom? So too of the pure understanding of the scope of the realm of phenomena, of having the wisdom that follows knowing all phenomena, of pervading the immeasurable field of perception with a vast understanding, of having the power of the radiance of great mental retention, of the purity of the radiance of the field of samādhi, of the emergence of the mighty power of miraculous clairvoyance, of entering an ocean of unceasing discernment, of the sweet voice of the essence of the bodhisattva bhūmi, or of becoming a refuge for all beings.

“I know this state of perfection of wisdom; but how can I know the practice, tell of the virtues, show the realm, reveal the sphere, describe the power of great vows, illumine the way of emancipation, elucidate the attainment, shed light on the path, follow the stream of concentration, know the range of mind, or reach equality with the knowledge, of the enlightening beings who have entered the ocean of states of perfection of wisdom, who have clarified the cosmic perspective, who know where all teachings lead, who pervade an infinite sphere with vast awareness, who command the light of great mental control, who have purified the light of all spheres of concentration, who issue from the magical power of mystic knowledge, who have entered the inexhaustible ocean of intelligence, who speak pleasantly of the stages of enlightenment, who are refuges for all beings?

song / rigs kyi bu/ lho phyogs kyi rgyud 'di nyid na/ phyogs kyi gnas rgya mtsho rnam par rlob pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de na bza' shing gi ra ba kun nas rnam par brgyan pa zhes bya ba zhig /grong khyer 'od chen po zhes bya ba'i shar phyogs logs na yod de/ de na shes las skyes pa'i rgyal po 'od bzang gi chung ma/ dge bsnyen ma yid bzhin zhes bya ba yod kyi/ de'i gan du song la/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bya ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bya ba dris shig /

“Depart, noble one. In this southern region there is a land called Samudravetāḍī, in which there is a park named Samantavyūha to the east of the city Mahāprabhasa. There dwells an upāsikā by the name of Āśā, who is the wife of Suprabhasa, a lord over humans. Go to her and ask her, ‘How should a bodhisattva train in bodhisattva conduct? How should a bodhisattva practice it?’ ”

“Go south, to a place called Samudravetadin, where there is a park called Samantavyuha, in front of the city Mahaprabha, where a lay woman named Asha, wife of king Suprabha, dwells; go to her and ask her how an enlightening being is to learn and apply the practice of enlightening beings.”

de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang dga' rangs te/ mgu zhing nyams bde la/ tshim zhing yid bde ba skyes nas/ dge slong rgya mtsho'i rgyal mtshan las snying po yongs su blangs te/ chos kyis nye bar 'tsho bar byas pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi yul la zhugs pa/ snang ba thob pa ye shes snang bar gyur pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi snang ba rab tu thob pa/ mos pa rnam par dag pa khong du chud pa/ sems can chos kyi tshul gyi snang ba'i rjes su song ba/ rnam par dag pa'i sgos snang ba dang ldan par gyur pa/ phyogs su ye shes kyi snang ba rab tu 'dal ba

Then Sudhana, the head merchant’s son, was overjoyed, pleased, happy, and content, having received the essence from the bhikṣu Sāgaradhvaja, having been nourished by the Dharma, having been brought into the field of samādhi, having attained the illumination of the light of wisdom, having attained the illumination of the radiance of samādhi, having realized a pure aspiration, his mind[520] having followed the radiance of the way of the Dharma, possessing the radiance from the pure gateways, and having the wisdom that has arisen from the light of all directions.

Then Sudhana, pleased, uplifted, transported, overjoyed, joyful and happy, invigorated and sustained by Sarasdhvaja, having entered the realm of concentration, having attained illumined knowledge, having attained the light of concentration, his consciousness illumined by the light of the principles of teaching pursuant to purifications of interest, seeing the way to purity, with knowledge emanating light in all directions,

des/ dge slong rgya mtsho'i rgyal mtshan gyi rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas/ dge slong rgya mtsho'i rgyal mtshan la btud de phyag 'tshal nas/ yang dang yang lta zhing / yang dang yang mngon par blta ba dang / phyag bya ba dang / rab tu gdud pa dang / gus bar bya ba dang / rim gror bya ba dang / yid la bya ba dang / bsam pa dang / bsgom pa dang / yongs su bsgom pa dang / legs par brjod pa dang / ngo mtshar du bya ba dang / yon tan mngon du bya ba dang / rjes su bsngags pa dang / rjes su 'brang bar bya ba dang / rjes su dran par bya ba dang / brtan par bya ba dang / mi btang ba dang / yid la bsam pa dang / rjes su 'brang bar bya ba dang / smon lam gyi rjes su 'jug par bya ba dang / mthong bar dga' ba dang / dbyangs kyi mtshan ma gzung ba dang / gzungs kyi rjes su bsam pa dang / ming yongs su gzung ba'i rjes su song ba'i sems dang ldan par bya ba dang / kha dog dang dbyibs rjes su dran par bya ba dang / ye shes kyi yul rjes su bsam pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi yul la rjes su 'jug par bya ba dang / smon lam gyi yul la rjes su 'brang bar bya ba dang / spyod yul gyi yul rnam par dpyad par bya ba dang / ye shes kyi snang ba yongs su gzung ba byed cing dge slong rgya mtsho'i rgyal mtshan gyi drung nas song ngo// //

Then Sudhana, the head merchant’s son, bowed his head to the feet of the bhikṣu Sāgaradhvaja, circumambulated the bhikṣu Sāgaradhvaja a hundred thousand times, keeping him to his right, bowed down and paid homage to the bhikṣu Sāgaradhvaja, and, looking back again and again, paying homage to him, bowing down to him, venerating him,[521] respecting him,[522] keeping him in mind, thinking of him, meditating on him, meditating deeply on him, speaking highly of him, calling out in wonderment over him, focusing on his qualities, praising him,[523] being his follower, remembering him,[524] relying on him, never forsaking him, mentally approaching him and being connected[525] with him, being unified in prayer, longing to see him, remembering the qualities of his voice, preserving the memory of him, keeping his name in his mind, remembering his color and his form, contemplating the scope of his wisdom, comprehending the range of his samādhi, joining him in the scope of his prayers, practicing the range of his conduct, and receiving the radiance of his wisdom, he departed from the presence of the bhikṣu Sāgaradhvaja.

paid his respects to Saradhvaja and left, looking at him again and again, bowing to him, thinking and meditating on him, praising him, recalling his virtues and keeping them firmly in mind, joining in with his vow, seeking his vision, remembering his words, recalling his appearance, contemplating the excellence of his knowledge, plunging into his sphere of concentration, fixing his mind on his sphere of undertaking, reflecting on the scope of his experience, illumined by his knowledge.

Chapter 10. Āśā
Asha

de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang dge ba'i ba shes gnyen gyi yon tan gyis ni mgu/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis ni yang dag par bsngags te btang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen mthong ba'i byin gyis ni byin du brlabs/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams ngag la ni nan tan du byed/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen yid du 'ong ba ni rjes su sems/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la ni sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi 'byung gnas tsam du lta/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni sangs rgyas kyi chos ston pa yin par yang dag par lta/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi chos rjes su lta/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni sangs rgyas nam mkha' blta ba la mig tsam du lta zhing

Sudhana, the head merchant’s son, delighted by the qualities of the kalyāṇamitra, sent forth by the kalyāṇamitra, empowered by the sight of the kalyāṇamitra, practicing the instructions of the kalyāṇamitra, remembering the words of the kalyāṇamitra,[526] and contemplating the kalyāṇamitra with affection, saw kalyāṇamitras as the source of the Buddhadharma, saw kalyāṇamitras as the teachers of the Buddhadharma, saw kalyāṇamitras as masters[527] in the Dharma of omniscience, and saw the kalyāṇamitras as eyes that look into the sky of buddhahood.

Then Sudhana, uplifted by the virtues of the spiritual benefactor, sent forth by the spiritual benefactor, having gained access to the vision of the spiritual benefactor, putting the instructions of the spiritual benefactor into practice, remembering the words of the spiritual benefactor, kindly disposed toward spiritual benefactors, seeing spiritual benefactors as mines of the vision of buddhas, seeing spiritual benefactors as those who show the teachings of buddhas, seeing spiritual benefactors as teachers of the elements of omniscience, seeing spiritual benefactors as eyes to see the sky of buddhahood,

mthar gyis phyogs kyi gnas/ rgya mtsho rnam par rlob pa'i bza' shing gi rab kun nas rnam par brgyan pa gang na ba der phyin nas/ des mthong mthong ba/ bza' shing gi ra ba kun nas rnam par brgyan pa rin po che thams cad kyi ra bas kun nas bskor ba/ rin po che'i shing gi phreng ba spel legs pas yongs su brgyan pa/ rin po che thams cad kyi shing gi phreng ba'i me tog srad bu yid du 'ong ba'i sprin rab tu 'phrul bas gzhi rgyas pa/ rin po che thams cad kyi shing gis yang dag par brgyan pa/ shing thams cad kyi me tog shin tu rgyas pa sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba/ spos sna tshogs kyi shing gi phreng ba las phyogs kun tu spos kyi ngad zhim pa/ rin po che'i phreng ba'i shing sna tshogs kyi lhun las/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi phreng ba 'phyang ba rab tu 'byung zhing char ltar mngon par 'bab pa/ rin po che'i rgyal po thams cad kyi shing dang / nor bu rin po che sna tshogs kyis mdzes shing spa la rgya cher brgyan pa'i gzhi can/ yid bzhin gyi gos kyi shing thams cad las kha dog sna tshogs kyi gos 'byung bas gam yo khebs shing mdzes par brgyan pa/ sil snyan gyi shing thams cad las; lha rdzas las kyang 'phags pa'i sil snyan rlung gis bskyod cing sgra 'byin pa'i dbyangs snyan pa 'byung ba/ sa'i gzhi mthon dman med par gnas pa/ rgyan gyi shing sna tshogs kyi gseb nas rgyan sna tshogs rnam pa tha dad par rgyun du 'byung zhing 'phyang bas rab tu brgyan pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa mthong ste/

Eventually he came to the Samantavyūha Park in Samudravetāḍī. He saw the Samantavyūha Park, which was encircled by precious walls and rows[528] of precious trees that were perfectly adorned and by rows[529] of beautiful, delicate flowers, made of all precious materials, that released clouds of pollen that were spread across the ground.[530] It was adorned by trees made of all precious materials. It was filled with a variety of blossoming flowers of precious trees. The beautiful aroma from rows[531] of various incense trees spread in every direction. Strings of all kinds of jewels were hanging from the various trees like a rainfall of strings of jewels showering down. The trees made of all the kings of jewels were bestrewed, bedecked, and beautified by a variety of precious jewels. All the wish-fulfilling flower trees were beautified and covered by being draped with clothing of various colors. When all the musical trees were moved by the breeze there came the beautiful sound of music from instruments superior to those of the devas. The ground was perfectly level, and upon it was the display of all the various kinds of adorned trees that were hung and beautified with various kinds of ornaments.

gradually made his way to Samantavyuha Park in Samudravetadin. He saw the park surrounded by fences made of all kinds of jewels, in the midst of rows of all kinds of jewel trees, adorned throughout with beautiful delicate flowers like sets of all kinds of jewels releasing pollen, adorned by all kinds of jewel trees, strewn with the various blossoms of the flowers of all kinds of jewel trees, with rows of trees of all kinds of fragrances giving off their scents in all directions, trees of garlands of all jewels with their flower buds bursting forth streaming a rain of garlands of various jewels, the ground beautifully spread with various decorations made of jewels from trees of all kinds of diamonds, the area well distributed with cloths of various colors hanging down from trees of flowers of various forms, with trees of all kinds of musical instruments making beautiful sounds surpassing the heavens when stirred by the wind, the ground level throughout, neither high nor low, adorned with various trailing streamers of ornaments welling forth from the flower buds of trees of all ornaments.

bza' shing gi ra ba chen po kun nas rnam par brgyan pa de'i nang na khang pa bye ba brgya stong phrag bcu kun kyang / nor bu rin po che dam pa sna tshogs kyi ba gam gyis rnam par brgyan pa dang / khang pa brtsegs pa brgya stong phrag bcu 'dzam bu chu klung gi gser las brtsegs pa'i bde dang ldan pa dang / gzhal med khang brgya stong phrag bcug gdung rin po che rnam par snang pa las bres pa dang / rdzing bu brgya stong phrag bcu rin po che thams cad las gzhi blangs te/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi pha gus mu khyud byas pa/ rin po che thams cad kyi them skas btags pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi stegs bus bskor ba/ lha rdzas kyi tsan dan gyi dri dang ldan pa'i chus gang ba/ gser gyi bye mas kun tu gram pa; gzhi nor bu rin po che chu 'dang kun tu bkram pa/ phyogs bzhi nas them skas rnam par bres pa/ yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chus gang ba dang / ngang dur dang / rma bya dang / khu byug dang / khrung khrung dang / ka la ping+ka dang / ku na la'i sgra skad snyan pa'i dbyangs dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i ta la'i phreng bas kun nas brgyan pa/ gser gyi dril bu'i dra bas kun nas yog pa/ rlung gis bskyod pa'i sgra yid du 'ong ba 'byung ba/ steng nas rin po che'i bla re chen po bres pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi shing gi ra bas yongs su bskor ba; rin po che'i dra bas brgyan pa'i gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan legs par bsgreng ba/

Within the great park of Samantavyūha there were ten trillion mansions that had an array of spires[532] made of the best precious jewels; there were a hundred thousand kūṭāgāras with their towers covered with Jambu River gold; there were a hundred thousand aerial palaces with interiors[533] beautified by shining precious jewels; there were a million[534] ponds made of all precious materials, with walls made of bricks of various precious materials and with steps made of all precious materials,[535] encircled by a balcony of various precious materials, filled with water that had the aroma of divine sandalwood, strewn with gold dust, their bottoms spread with precious water-purifying jewels,[536] adorned on all four sides with stairways, filled with water that had the eight qualities, with geese, peacocks, cuckoos, cranes, and avadavats all emitting divine melodious songs, encircled by rows of precious palm trees hung with networks of little golden bells that emitted beautiful sounds when they were shaken by breezes, covered with a precious canopy, encircled by a wall of trees made of various precious materials, and with standing parasols and banners draped in nets of jewels.

In the park, furthermore, were ten hundred thousand arrays of turrets adorned with all kinds of precious jewels, extremely pure; ten hundred thousand towers covered with gold, ten hundred thousand mansions adorned with radiant jewels, ten hundred thousand lotus ponds made of all kinds of jewels, inlaid with jewel bricks, with varied stairways made of seven precious substances, surrounded by benches made of various gems, fragrant as pools of water scented with celestial sandalwood, the bottoms covered with golden sand, spread with ten layers of pure gold and jewels, stairways set on four sides, filled with water of eight qualities, vibrant with the beautiful sounds of the calls of various birds, surrounded by rows of jewel palms, covered by nets of gold bells chiming sweetly when stirred by the wind, with canopies of great jewels above, surrounded by enclosures of trees of various jewels, with banners and streamers flying from jewel nets.

lu ma brgya stong phrag bcu dus dang mthun pa'i tsan dan gyi 'dam gyis mtha' 'khor ba/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi kha dog tu 'dug pa'i pad+mos yongs su khyab pa/ rin po che'i pad+mo'i 'od chen pos snang bar gyur pa'i chu dri ma med pa dang ldan pa yod pa ste;
