'khor gyi stan la la la ni rgyal po chen po ngal bso po la sogs pa gnod sbyin gyi dbang po/ gnod sbyin gyi bu mo dang / gnod sbyin gyi byis pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng+ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ chos kyi sgo 'gro ba thams cad yongs su skyob pa'i mdzod ces bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo/ /

He saw the bhikṣuṇī Siṃhavijṛmbhitā teaching the Dharma gateway called the treasure that protects all beings to Mahārāja Vaiśravaṇa and other lords of yakṣas, yakṣa daughters, and yakṣa sons who were seated upon some of the assembly seats.
in another he saw her surrounded by demigods and demigoddesses and their children, expounding a doctrine called treasury of salvation of the world;

'khor gyi stan la la la ni dri za'i rgyal po gnas srung po la sogs pa dri za mang po dri za'i bu mo dang; dri za'i byis pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng+ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ chos kyi sgo dga' ba mi zad pa'i char rab tu 'bab pa zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo/ /

He saw the bhikṣuṇī Siṃhavijṛmbhitā teaching the Dharma gateway called rainfall[1189] of unceasing happiness to the gandharva king Dhṛtarāṣṭra and many other gandharvas, gandharva daughters, and gandharva sons who were seated upon some of the assembly seats.
in another he saw her surrounded by celestial musicians, expounding a doctrine called endless giving of delight;

'khor gyi stan la la la ni lha ma yin gyi dbang po sgra gcan na la sogs pa lha ma yin gyi bu mo dang / lha ma yin gyi byis pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng+ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ chos kyi sgo chos kyi dbyings shes pa'i tshul gyi shugs kyis brgyan pa zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo/ /

He saw the bhikṣuṇī Siṃhavijṛmbhitā teaching the Dharma gateway called the display of the power of knowing the nature of phenomena to the asura lord Rāhu and other asura lords, asura daughters, and asura sons who were seated upon some of the assembly seats.
in another he saw her surrounded by titans, with their wives and children, expounding a doctrine called manifestation of power of reason in the knowledge of the reality realm;

'khor gyi stan la la la ni nam mkha' lding gi dbang po shugs 'dzin chen po la sogs pa nam mkha' lding gi dbang po/ nam mkha' lding gi bu mo dang / nam mkha' lding gi byis pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng+ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ chos kyi sgo srid pa'i rgya mtshos 'jigs pa'i yul zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo/ /

He saw the bhikṣuṇī Siṃhavijṛmbhitā teaching the Dharma gateway called the range of the fear of the ocean of existence to the garuḍa lord Mahāvegadhārin and other garuḍa lords, garuḍa daughters, and garuḍa sons who were seated upon some of the assembly seats.
in another he saw her surrounded by fantastic birds, expounding a doctrine called the sphere of action concerned with alarming those in the ocean of existence;

'khor gyi stan la la la ni mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po la sogs pa mi 'am ci'i dbang po/ mi 'am ci'i bu mo dang / mi 'am ci'i byis pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng+ge rnam par bsgyings pas; chos kyi sgo sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa snang ba zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo/ /

He saw the bhikṣuṇī Siṃhavijṛmbhitā teaching the Dharma gateway called the light of the conduct of buddhas to the kinnara lord Druma and other kinnara lords, kinnara daughters, and kinnara sons who were seated upon some of the assembly seats.
in another he saw her surrounded by centaurs expounding a doctrine called the range of manifestation of the action of Buddha;

'khor gyi stan la la la ni lto 'phye chen po'i dbang po khro gnyer gdong la sogs pa lto 'phye chen po'i bu mo dang / lto 'phye chen po'i byis pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng+ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ chos kyi sgo sangs rgyas la dga' ba skye zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo/ /

He saw the bhikṣuṇī Siṃhavijṛmbhitā teaching the Dharma gateway called reaching a special wisdom[1190] to the mahoraga lord Bhṛkuṭīmukha and mahoraga daughters and mahoraga sons who were seated upon some of the assembly seats.
in another he saw her surrounded by great serpents, expounding a doctrine called production of the joy of the enlightened;

'khor gyi stan la la la ni skyes pa dang / bud med dang / khye'u dang / bu mo brgya stong mang po 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng+ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ chos kyi sgo khyad par du 'gro ba zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo/ /

He saw the bhikṣuṇī Siṃhavijṛmbhitā teaching the Dharma gateway called the arising of delight toward the buddhas to many hundreds of thousands of men, women, boys, and girls who were seated upon some of the assembly seats.
in another he saw her surrounded by hundreds of thousands of women, men, boys and girls, expounding a doctrine called higher reaches of knowledge;

'khor gyi stan la la la ni srin po'i dbang po rtag tu mdangs 'phrog sdong po'i rgyal po la sogs pa srin po'i dbang po/ srin po'i bu mo dang / sprin po'i byis pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng+ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ chos kyi sgo snying rje 'byung ba zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo/ /

He saw the bhikṣuṇī Siṃhavijṛmbhitā teaching the Dharma gateway called the arising of compassion to the rākṣasa lord Nityaujoharadrumarāja and to other rākṣasa lords, rākṣasa daughters, and rākṣasa sons who were seated upon some of the assembly seats.
in another he saw her surrounded by goblins, expounding a doctrine called production of compassion;

'khor gyi stan la la la ni sems can nyan thos kyi theg pa la mos pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng+ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ chos kyi sgo ye shes khyad par du 'phags pa'i mthu zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo/ /
He saw the bhikṣuṇī Siṃhavijṛmbhitā teaching the Dharma gateway called the power of exceptional wisdom to beings who aspired to the Śrāvakayāna and were seated upon some of the assembly seats.
in another he saw her surrounded by people devoted to the vehicle of listeners, expounding a doctrine called higher power of knowledge;

'khor gyi stan la la la ni sems can rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la mos pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng+ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ chos kyi sgo sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rgya chen po'i 'od ces bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo/ /

He saw the bhikṣuṇī Siṃhavijṛmbhitā teaching the Dharma gateway called the light of the vast[1191] qualities of buddhas to beings who aspired to the Pratyekabuddhayāna and were seated upon some of the assembly seats.
in another he saw her surrounded by people devoted to the vehicle of individual illumination, expounding a doctrine called splendor of the illustrious virtues of buddhas;

'khor gyi bstan la la la ni sems can theg pa chen po la mos pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng+ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi ye shes snang ba'i sgo kun du sgo zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo/ /

He saw the bhikṣuṇī Siṃhavijṛmbhitā teaching the gateway to the light of wisdom and samādhi called the universal gateway to beings who aspired to the Mahāyāna and were seated upon some of the assembly seats.
in another he saw her surrounded by people devoted to the Great Vehicle of universal enlightenment, expounding a medium of light of knowledge of concentration called door to totality;

'khor gyi stan la la la ni byang chub sems dpa' thog mar sems bskyed pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng+ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo sangs rgyas thams cad kyi smon lam gyi phung po zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo/ /

He saw the bhikṣuṇī Siṃhavijṛmbhitā teaching the gateway to samādhi called the aggregation of the prayers of all the buddhas to bodhisattvas who had first developed the aspiration to enlightenment and were seated upon some of the assembly seats.
in another he saw her surrounded by enlightening beings who had just been inspired to seek enlightenment, expounding a medium of concentration called multitude of vows of all buddhas;

'khor gyi stan la la la ni sbyang chub sems dpa' sa gnyis pa la gnas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng+ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo rdul dang bral ba'i dkyil 'khor ces bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo/ /
He saw the bhikṣuṇī Siṃhavijṛmbhitā teaching the gateway to samādhi called the unsullied disk to bodhisattvas who were on the second bhūmi and were seated upon some of the assembly seats.
in another he saw her surrounded by enlightening beings in the second stage, expounding a medium of concentration called sphere of dispassion;

'khor gyi bstan la la la ni byang chub sems dpa' sa gsum pa la gnas pa rnams 'khod cing; dge slong ma seng+ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo rab tu zhi ba'i rgyan ces bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo/ /
He saw the bhikṣuṇī Siṃhavijṛmbhitā teaching the gateway to samādhi called the display of complete peace to bodhisattvas who were on the third bhūmi and were seated upon some of the assembly seats.
in another he saw her surrounded by enlightening beings in the third stage, expounding a medium of concentration called sphere of tranquillity;

'khor gyi stan la la la ni byang chub sems dpa' sa bzhi pa la gnas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo thams cad mkhyen pa'i shugs kyi yul 'byung ba zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo/ /

He saw the bhikṣuṇī Siṃhavijṛmbhitā teaching the gateway to samādhi called the scope of the power of omniscience to bodhisattvas who were on the fourth bhūmi and were seated upon some of the assembly seats.
in another he saw her surrounded by enlightening beings in the fourth stage, expounding a medium of concentration called production of the field of action of the energy of omniscience;

'khor gyi stan la la la ni byang chub sems dpa' sa lnga pa la gnas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo sems kyi rgyud me tog gi snying po zhes bya bas yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo/ /

He saw the bhikṣuṇī Siṃhavijṛmbhitā teaching the gateway to samādhi called the essence[1192] of the flowers of the creepers[1193] of the mind to bodhisattvas who were on the fifth bhūmi and were seated upon some of the assembly seats.
in another he saw her surrounded by enlightening beings of the fifth stage, expounding a medium of concentration called treasury of flowers of the tendrils of the mind;

'khor gyi stan la la la ni byang chub sems dpa' sa drug pa la gnas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo rnam par snang ba'i snying po zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo/ /
He saw the bhikṣuṇī Siṃhavijṛmbhitā teaching the gateway to samādhi called the solar[1194] essence to bodhisattvas who were on the sixth bhūmi and were seated upon some of the assembly seats.
in another he saw her surrounded by enlightening beings in the sixth stage, expounding a medium of concentration called filled with light;

'khor gyi stan la la la ni byang chub sems dpa' sa bdun pa la gnas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng+ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sogs kun nas brgyan pa zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo/ /

He saw the bhikṣuṇī Siṃhavijṛmbhitā teaching the gateway to samādhi called the complete display of bhūmis to bodhisattvas who were on the seventh bhūmi and were seated upon some of the assembly seats.
in another he saw her surrounded by enlightening beings in the seventh stage, expounding a medium of concentration called adornment of the stage of totality;

'khor gyi stan la la la ni byang chub sems dpa' sa brgyad pa la gnas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo chos kyi dbyings su lus shin tu rnam par phye ba'i yul zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo/ /

He saw the bhikṣuṇī Siṃhavijṛmbhitā teaching the gateway to samādhi called the range of the complete distribution of the body through the realm of phenomena to bodhisattvas who were on the eighth bhūmi and were seated upon some of the assembly seats.
in another he saw her surrounded by enlightening beings in the eighth stage, expounding a medium of concentration called realm of the body distributed equally throughout the structure of the cosmos;

'khor gyi stan la la la ni byang chub sems dpa' sa dgu pa la gnas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas; chos kyi sgo mi dmigs pa'i stobs kyis gnas kyi sa bstan pa zhes bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo/ /

He saw the bhikṣuṇī Siṃhavijṛmbhitā teaching the gateway to the Dharma called the display of dwelling in the power of nondependence to bodhisattvas who were on the ninth bhūmi and were seated upon some of the assembly seats.
in another he saw her surrounded by enlightening beings in the ninth stage, expounding a medium of concentration called array of the abode of the power of nonacquisition;

'khor gyi stan la la la ni byang chub sems dpa' sa bcu pa la gnas pa rnams 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo sgrib pa med pa'i dkyil 'khor ces bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo/ /
He saw the bhikṣuṇī Siṃhavijṛmbhitā teaching the gateway to samādhi called the unobscured disk to bodhisattvas who were on the tenth bhūmi and were seated upon some of the assembly seats.
in another he saw her surrounded by enlightening beings in the tenth stage, expounding a medium of concentration called sphere of nonobstruction;

'khor gyi stan la la la ni lag na rdo rje'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor 'khod cing / dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ chos kyi sgo ye shes rdo rje mthu bo che'i rgyan ces bya ba yang dag par bstan pa mthong ngo/ /

He saw the bhikṣuṇī Siṃhavijṛmbhitā teaching the gateway to the Dharma called the display of the great might of the vajra wisdom to the assembled retinue of vajrapāṇis who were seated upon some of the assembly seats.
in another he saw her teaching an audience of thunderbolt bearers a doctrine called mighty array of thunderbolts of knowledge.

de ltar skye ba'i skye mched rnam pa tha dad pa thams cad kyi sems can du gdags pa dang / sems can gyi lam gyi rgyud ji snyed pa de dag gi sems can yongs su smin pa rnam par 'dul ba/ snod du gyur pa ji snyed cig bza' shing gi ra ba der 'ongs shing / 'khor gyi stan la so sor 'khod pa/ bsam pa tha dad pa/ mos pa mi mtshungs pa/ bsam pa shin tu gzhol bar gyur pa/ dad pa'i ro rdam [*rngam?] chen po dang ldan pa rnams la/ dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ ci nas kyang thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par 'gyur ba de lta de ltar chos bstan pa mthong ngo/ /

Similarly, he saw the bhikṣuṇī Siṃhavijṛmbhitā teaching the Dharma to classes of beings‍—those categorized as beings, who had different kinds of births and states, beings who had been ripened, had correct behavior, and were worthy recipients and who had various motivations, various aspirations, constant motivations,[1195] and the strong elixir[1196] of faith‍—who had come into this great park and were seated upon separate assembly seats, teaching them the Dharma that would make them firmly established in wishing to attain the highest, complete enlightenment.

Thus he saw the mature, the teachable, the capable among those in all states of being gathered in this park, each type in a separate assembly, with various inclinations and interests, firmly intent and deeply faithful, with the nun Sinhavijurmbhita teaching them each in such a way that all became certain of supreme perfect enlightenment.

de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa des/ kun du lta ba'i btang snyoms dang ldan pa la sogs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad shin tu bstan pa la sogs pa dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi gzhi tha dad pa la sogs pa dang / sgrib pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad rnam par 'thor ba la sogs pa dang / 'gro ba thams cad kyi dge ba'i sems yang dag par 'byung ba la sogs pa dang / khyad par yod pa'i rgyan la sogs pa dang / chags pa med pa'i tshul gyi snying po la sogs pa dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor la sogs pa dang / sems kyi mdzod la sogs pa dang / kun du mos pa mngon par sgrub pa'i snying po la sogs pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo brgya stong grangs med pa non pa'i phyir te/

What was the cause of this? The bhikṣuṇī Siṃhavijṛmbhitā had practiced countless hundreds of thousands of gateways to the perfection of wisdom such as the complete sight of equanimity, the teaching of all the Dharmas of the buddhas, the different bases of the realm of phenomena, the destruction of all the domains of obscuration, the arising of the virtuous mind in all beings, the exceptional display, the essence of the way of nonattachment, the domain of the nature of phenomena, the treasure of the mind, and the essence of the complete attainment of one’s aspirations.

How was that so? Because the nun Sinhavijurmbhita had gone into countless tens of hundreds of thousands of doors of transcendent wisdom, beginning with the equanimity of the universal eye, exposition of all buddhas’ teachings, differentiation of the planes of the reality realm, dispersing all obstructions, production of good thoughts in all sentient beings, supreme adornment, matrix of the principle of nonattachment, sphere of the realm of reality, treasury of mind, and source of miracles pleasing to all.

bza' shing gi ra ba nyi ma'i mdog der/ byang chub sems dpa' ma/ sems can gzhan ji snyed cig /dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa la blta ba dang / chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'ong ba de dag thams cad kyang / sngon dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ dge ba'i chos yang dag par blangs pa la shin tu bkod pa nas; bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa'i bar du byas pa sha stag go/

All those bodhisattvas and other beings who came to the great Sūryaprabha Park in order to see the bhikṣuṇī Siṃhavijṛmbhitā and listen to the Dharma had in the past been established by the bhikṣuṇī Siṃhavijṛmbhitā in the accomplishment of the roots of merit and set on irreversible progress toward the highest, complete enlightenment.

And all the enlightening beings and others who came to this park to see the nun Sinhavijurmbhita and hear her teach were guided by her, from the beginning accumulation of virtues, until she had made them irreversible on the way to supreme perfect enlightenment.

de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang gis/ dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings ba'i bza' shing gi ra ba phun sum tshogs pa dang / nags tshal phun sum tshogs pa dang / gtsug lag khang phun sum tshogs pa dang / 'chag sa phun sum tshogs pa dang / longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang / mal cha phun sum tshogs pa dang / 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor phun sum tshogs pa dang / dbang chen po phun sum tshogs pa dang / rdzu 'phrul dang / rnam par 'phrul pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / dbyangs kyi rgyan phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa de lta bu mthong ste/ chos kyi tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'ang thos nas/ chos kyi sprin gyi char chen pos sems mngon par brlan pa de'i yid la/ dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ bsam pa rnam par dag pa phun sum tshogs par byas kyi/ da ni g.yas phyogs su bskor ba lan brgya stong du ma zhig tu bya'o snyam pa dang / de'i mod la dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pas/ bza' shing gi ra ba dang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du bcas pa de dag thams cad kyang snang ba chen pos khyab par byas so; ; de ltar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba bya'o snyam du bsams nas/ skor ba byed pa'i tshe/ 'khor thams cad na'ang dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa 'dug pa mthong nas/

In that way, Sudhana, the head merchant’s son, saw the bhikṣuṇī Siṃhavijṛmbhitā’s perfect park, perfect forest,[1197] perfect vihāra, perfect walkway, perfect enjoyments, perfect seat, perfect assembly, perfect supremacy, perfect miraculous manifestations, and perfect display of eloquence. He heard her inconceivable way of the Dharma. His mind was saturated by a vast cloud of Dharma, and with perfect motivation toward[1198] the bhikṣuṇī Siṃhavijṛmbhitā he thought, “I shall circumambulate her to my right many hundreds of thousands of times.” In that instant, the bhikṣuṇī Siṃhavijṛmbhitā filled the entire park and the assembly with light. He circumambulated her many hundreds of thousands of times[1199] and thought, “As I circumambulated, the bhikṣuṇī Siṃhavijṛmbhitā was always seated before me.”

Then Sudhana, having seen the nun Sinhavijurmbhita with such an abode, such furnishings, such an audience, such mastery, such mystic power, and such eloquence, and having heard her teaching, his mind drenched by the immense cloud of the Teaching, his thoughts toward Sinhavijurmbhita pure, he prostrated himself and then circled her in respect hundreds of thousands of times. At that time the whole park and the congregations were suffused with a glorious light from the nun. Having made hundreds of thousands of circumambulations, he noticed that as he circumambulated he saw the nun whichever way he faced.

mdun du 'dug ste thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad ces smras so/ / 'phags ma/ bdag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed na/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba ma 'tshal te/ 'phags ma ni/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gdams ngag dang / rjes su bstan pa mdzad do zhes bdag gis thos na 'phags ma/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba bdag la bshad du gsol/

With his hands together in homage he stood before her and said, “Āryā, I have developed the aspiration for the highest, complete enlightenment, but I do not know how bodhisattvas should train in bodhisattva conduct and in what way they should practice it. Āryā, I have heard that you give instruction and teachings to bodhisattvas! I pray that you explain to me how bodhisattvas should train in bodhisattva conduct and how they should practice it!”

He stood before her and said, “Noble one, I have set my mind on supreme perfect enlightenment, but I do not know how to learn and carry out the practice of enlightening beings. I hear you give enlightening beings instructions, so please tell me how to learn and carry out the practice of enlightening beings.”
des smras pa/ rigs kyi bu/ kho mo ni byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa rlom sems thams cad yongs su bcom pa zhes bya ba thob pa'o/ /
She said, “Noble one, I have attained the bodhisattva liberation called the eradication of all conceit.”
She said, “I have attained the enlightening liberation of removal of all vain imaginings.”

smras pa/ 'phags ma/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa rlom sems thams cad yongs su bcom pa de'i yul ji lta bu zhig mchis/ smras pa/ rigs kyi bu/ de ni ye shes snang ba ste/ dus gsum du byung ba'i rgyan sems skad cig gi cha shas la rnam par dmigs pa'i rang bzhin no/ /

Sudhana asked, “Āryā, what is the scope of that bodhisattva liberation called the eradication of all conceit?” She replied, “Noble one, it is the light of wisdom; it has the nature of perceiving in a fraction of an instant of mind the displays that occur in the three times.”
Sudhana asked her about the sphere of this liberation, and she said, “It is the light of knowledge whose nature is instantaneous awareness of the phenomena of past, present, and future.”
smras pa/ 'phags ma/ ye shes snang ba de'i yul yang ji lta bu zhig mchis/
Sudhana asked, “Āryā, what is the scope of that light of wisdom?”
Sudhana asked about the compass of this light of knowledge,
smras pa/ rigs kyi bu/ kho mo ye shes snang ba 'di la sgrub pa dang yongs su sgrub pa'i tshe/ chos thams cad rab tu 'thad pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin skyes te/
She replied, “Noble one, when I had striven for and accomplished[1200] this light of wisdom,[1201] there arose the samādhi called accordance with all Dharmas.[1202]
and she replied, “As I go in and out the door of this light of knowledge, there is born in me a concentration called ‘possessed of all phenomena,’

ting nge 'dzin de thob ma thag tu yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus kyis phyogs bcu thams cad kyi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du/ byang chub sems dpa' sku tshe gcig gis thogs pa/ dga' ldan gyi pho brang na bzhugs pa thams cad re re la yang lus sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis mchod pa rnam pa tha dad pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis mchod pa sbyar ba'i phyir 'gro ste/

With the attainment of that samādhi, I go in bodies that are made of mind to the bodhisattvas with one life remaining who reside in Tuṣita palaces in all the world realms in all ten directions, so that with bodies as numerous as the atoms in an inexpressible number of buddha realms I can engage in making offerings to each bodhisattva with offerings that are as numerous as the atoms in an inexpressible number of buddha realms.

by the attainment of which concentration I go to all worlds in the ten directions with mentally produced bodies to present offerings as numerous as atoms in untold buddha-lands with bodies as numerous as atoms in untold buddha-lands to each of the enlightening beings in the heavens of satisfaction who are bound to attain buddhahood in one lifetime.
'di ltar lha'i lus dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lho 'phye chen po dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa'i dbang po lus
This means I go as the bodies of lords of devas and as the bodies of nāgas, yakṣas, gandharvas, asuras, garuḍas, kinnaras, mahoragas, humans, and nonhumans,
In the forms of all sorts of beings,

me tog gi sprin yongs su 'dzin pa dang / sbos kyi sprin yongs su 'dzin pa dang / bdug spos kyi sprin yongs su 'dzin pa dang / phreng ba'i sprin yongs su 'dzin pa dang / byug pa'i sprin yongs su 'dzin pa dang / phye ma'i sprin yongs su 'dzin pa dang / na bza'i sprin yongs su 'dzin pa dang / gdugs kyi sprin yongs su 'dzin pa dang / rgyal mtshan gyi sprin yongs su 'dzin pa dang / ba dan gyi sprin yongs su 'dzin pa dang / rin po che'i lhab lhub kyi sprin yongs su 'dzin pa dang / rin po che'i dra ba'i rgyan gyi sprin yongs su 'dzin pa dang / rin po che'i gnam yol gyi rgyan gyi sprin yongs su 'dzin pa dang / rin po che'i rgyan rnam par phye ba'i sprin yongs su 'dzin pa dang / rin po che'i sgron ma'i rgyan gyi sprin yongs su 'dzin pa dang / rin po che'i gdan gyi sprin yongs su 'dzin pa mang pos mchod pa sbyar ba'i phyir 'gro'o/ /

holding clouds of flowers, holding clouds of perfumes, holding clouds of incense, holding clouds of garlands, holding clouds of ointments, holding clouds of powders, holding clouds of clothing, holding clouds of parasols, holding clouds of banners, holding clouds of flags, holding clouds of jewel ornamentations, holding clouds of arrays of nets of jewels, holding clouds of arrays of bejeweled canopies, holding clouds of arrays of spread-out jewels,[1203] holding clouds of arrays of bejeweled lamps, and holding clouds of arrays of bejeweled seats so as to engage in making offerings.
bringing all sorts of gifts,
dga' ldan gyi gnas na bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sku tshe gcig gis thogs pa rnams la/ mchod pa bya ba'i phyir ji ltar 'gro ba
“In the same way that I go to the bodhisattvas with one life remaining who reside in Tuṣita so as to engage in making offerings,
I go to make offerings to the enlightening beings in the heavens of satisfaction who are going to become buddhas in the next life,

de bzhin du yum gyi skur gshegs pa dang / bltam pa dang / btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang na bzhugs pa dang / mngon par 'byung ba dang / snying po byang chub tu gshegs pa dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas shing / snying po byang chub la bzhugs pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu skor ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang /

I go in bodies that are made of mind and in such forms engage in offerings to all the tathāgatas who have entered the bodies of their mothers, who are born, who reside within harems, who have gone forth into homelessness, who are going to the bodhimaṇḍa, who are present at the bodhimaṇḍa, who have attained the highest, complete enlightenment of buddhahood, who turn the wheel of the Dharma,

and I go to all the buddhas, be they in the womb, being born, at home, leaving home, going to the heights of enlightenment, at the pinnacle of enlightenment, having become supremely perfectly enlightened, gone to various realms of existence,

de bzhin du lha'i gnas na bzhugs pa dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa'i gnas na bzhugs pa dang / 'gro ba thams cad kyi sems dang / bsam pa yongs su tshim par mdzad nas/ yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i bar de dag thams cad la'ang / yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus rnam pa de lta bu dag gis rnam pa de lta bu'i mchod pa byed cing / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi drung du 'gro'o/ /

and who are entering nirvāṇa having satisfied the minds and wishes of those who reside in the dwellings of the devas and those who reside in the dwellings of the nāgas, yakṣas, gandharvas, asuras, garuḍas, kinnaras, mahoragas, humans, and nonhumans and in the dwellings of all beings.
or entering final extinction after having satisfied the minds of all beings, making such offerings with such mentally produced bodies.
sems can gang gis kho mo sangs rgyas mchod pa dang / rim gro byed pa'i las 'di shes par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par 'gyur ro/ /
“Those beings who know my offerings and service to the buddhas will all definitely attain the highest, complete enlightenment.
Those sentient beings who know my work of making offerings to buddhas all become certain of supreme perfect enlightenment.
sems can gang kho mo'i drung du 'ong ba de dag thams cad la yang / kho mo ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gdams ngag dang / rjes su bstan pa 'di nyid ston te/
“I give the instructions on the teachings of the perfection of wisdom to all those beings who come to me.
And to all those sentient beings who come to me I give instruction in this same transcendent wisdom.

rigs kyi bu/ kho mo ye shes kyi mig gis sems can thams cad la blta'ang sems can gyi 'du shes kyang mi skyed la; rlom sems kyang mi byed do/ / 'gro ba thams cad kyi skad rgya mtsho yang nyan te/ tshig gi lam thams cad la mngon par zhen pa med pas rlom sems su byed pa med do/ / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang mthong ste/ chos kyi lus yongs su shes pas rlom sems su byed pa'ang med de/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor lo yongs su 'dzin kyang / chos kyi rang bzhin khong du chud pas rlom sems su byed pa med do/ / sems kyi skad cig re re la chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par 'gengs kyang chos nyid sgyu ma'i rang bzhin khong du chud pas rlom sems su byed pa med do/ /

“Noble one, I look upon all beings with wisdom eyes, but I do not give rise to the concept of ‘beings,’ and I do not become conceited. I listen to the ocean of the languages of all beings but do not become attached to any way of speaking, and I do not become conceited. I also see all the tathāgatas, but through knowing the body of the Dharma, I do not become conceited. I possess the Dharma wheels of all the tathāgatas, but because I have realized the nature of phenomena, I do not become conceited. In each instant of mind I permeate the entire realm of phenomena, but because I have realized the illusory nature of phenomena, I do not become conceited.

“I see all beings with the eye of knowledge, yet I do not conceive any notion of ‘sentient being,’ and do not imagine so. I hear all beings’ verbal signals, yet I do not imagine so, because I do not enter into the spheres of any discourses. I see all buddhas, yet I do not imagine so, because I know their body is reality. I remember the cycles of teachings of all buddhas, but I do not imagine so, because I am aware of the true nature of things. I pervade the cosmos in every moment of awareness, but I do not imagine so, because I know the nature of things as existing in illusion.

rigs kyi bu/ kho mos ni byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa rlom sems thams cad yongs su bcom pa 'di shes par zad na/ kho mos byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi dbyings mtha' dang dbus med pa la zhugs pa/ chos thams cad la rlom sems med par gnas kyang skyil mo krung gcig gis chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad rang gi lus su 'dus par ston kyang / skad cig gcig gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi drung du 'dong ba/ lus la sangs rgyas kyi rdzu 'phrul thams cad 'byung zhing rgyu ba/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa ba spu'i nyag ma gcig gis spams shing mngon par 'phen pa/ rang gi ba spu'i bu gar 'jig rten gyi khams brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i 'du ba dang / 'jig pa'i bskal pa yongs su ston pa/ skad cig gcig la bskal pa brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med par gnas pa mnyan pa nyid kyis yang dag par 'dzud pa/ skad cig gcig gis brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i bskal par 'khod pa de dag gi spyod pa shes pa'am/ yon tan brjod par nus re skan/

“Noble one, I know this bodhisattva liberation called the eradication of all conceit, but how could I know the conduct or describe the qualities of the bodhisattvas who have comprehended the endless and centerless realm of phenomena, who remain without conceit within all phenomena, who sitting cross-legged alone pervade the entire realm of phenomena, who reveal all buddha realms contained within their bodies, who in a single instant come into the presence of all the tathāgatas, within whose bodies all the miracles of the buddhas take place, who manifest and introduce within a single pore-hair an anabhilāpyānabhilāpya of buddha realms, who manifest in their pores the kalpas of the creation and destruction of an anabhilāpyānabhilāpya of countless world realms, who in one instant enter into the equality of dwelling in an anabhilāpyānabhilāpya of kalpas, and who in one instant move through an anabhilāpyānabhilāpya of kalpas?

“Thus, I know the enlightening liberation of removal of all vain imaginings; but how can I know the practice or tell of the virtues of the enlightening beings who penetrate the infinite cosmos of realities, who are free from vain imaginings about all things, who pervade all realms of reality while sitting cross-legged in one body, who see all buddha-lands in their own bodies, who go to all buddhas in a single instant, in whose own beings the miracles of all buddhas are taking place, who lift up untold buddha-lands with a single hair, who show the eons of becoming and dissolution of untold worlds in their own pores, who in a single instant enter into the commonality of coexistence in untold eons, who enter untold eons in a single instant?

song / rigs kyi bu/ lho phyogs kyi rgyud 'di nyid kyi yul bgrod dka' ba na/ grong khyer rin po che'i rgyan zhes bya ba yod de/ de na bcom pa ma lha'i bshes gnyen ma zhes bya ba 'dug gi /de'i gan du song la/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bya ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bya ba dris shig /

“Depart, noble one. In this southern region, in the land called Durga, in the city called Ratnavyūha, dwells a courtesan by the name of Vasumitrā. Go to her and ask her, ‘How should a bodhisattva train in bodhisattva conduct? How should a bodhisattva practice it?’ ”

“South of here, in the land of Durga, is a city called Ratnavyuha, where Vasumitra, a worshiper of the god of light, is living. Go ask her how to learn and carry out the practice of enlightening beings.”

de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang gis/ dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas/ yang dang yang du bltas te/ dge slong ma seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa'i drung nas song ngo/ /

Then Sudhana, the head merchant’s son, bowed his head to the feet of the bhikṣuṇī Siṃhavijṛmbhitā, circumambulated the bhikṣuṇī Siṃhavijṛmbhitā many hundreds of thousands of times, keeping her to his right, and, looking back again and again, departed from the bhikṣuṇī Siṃhavijṛmbhitā.
So, paying his respects to the nun Sinhavijurmbhita, Sudhana left her and went on his way.
