ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas sems can thams cad dang mnyam pa'i lus kha dog sna tshogs su sprul pa'i sprin 'thon te/ yan lag dang nying lag thams cad kyang nyams su bzod pa sems can thams cad la yongs su ston pa/ sems can thams cad kyis lus la gnod par mtho ba tsams [?] kyang nyams su bzod par byed pa dang / sems can thams cad kyis tshul dang mi 'dra ba'i tshig gis spyo ba dang / brgyad pa dang / smad pa dang / bskyung ba dang / brdeg pa dang / bsdigs pa nyams su bzod par byed pa yongs su ston pa dang; sems can thams cad kyis mi sgul ba yongs su ston pa dang / rim gror byas pa dang / rim gror ma byas pa thams cad kyis mtho ba dang / dma' bar mi 'gyur ba yongs su ston pa dang / sems can thams cad la nga rgyal med pa yongs su ston pa dang / chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin la bzod pa mi zad pas/ ye shes mi zad pa yongs su ston pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa thams cad yongs su spang ba'i phyir/ bzod pa'i spyod pa yongs su ston pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi lus dbyibs mi sdug cing kha dog mi mdzes pa'i gzugs rnam par zlog par byed pa dang / sems can thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mdog rnam par dag pa bla na med pa yongs su ston cing / sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo/ /

He saw, issuing forth from all her pores, clouds of emanated bodies of various colors, which were as numerous as all beings, teaching the endurance by all beings of the major and minor parts of their bodies being cut off; teaching the endurance by all beings of harm to their bodies; teaching the endurance by all beings of being falsely reviled, censured, reproached, disgraced, and threatened; teaching the imperturbability of all beings; teaching all beings[1337] to be neither uplifted by honors nor made downcast by disrespect;[1338] teaching humility in all beings; teaching the unceasing wisdom of the unceasing patience toward the nature of all phenomena; teaching the practice of patience that eliminates the kleśas in all beings; turning all beings away from misshapen bodies with ugly color; teaching[1339] the supreme pure color of the tathāgatas; and ripening beings.

He also saw emerging from all the goddess’s pores multitudes of projected bodies with various appearances showing sentient beings’ patient endurance of mutilation and dismemberment, patient endurance of beatings, patient endurance of unjust abuse, reproof, contempt, degradation, beatings, and threats, showing unshakability, showing kindness to all beings without hauteur or servility, showing freedom from conceit, showing inexhaustible knowledge of the inexhaustibility of tolerance of the true nature of all things, showing the practice of forbearance to destroy all afflictions of all sentient beings, turning sentient beings away from all warped conditions, praising the supreme purity of the enlightened, developing sentient beings to maturity.

ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas sems can thams cad dang mnyam pa'i skye ba sna tshogs kya [*kyi?] lus kha dog dang / dbyibs dang / chu zheng sna tshogs su sprul pa'i sprin 'thon te; sems can rnams kyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du rgyas par khyab par byas nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi tshogs chen po la/ brtson 'grus kyis sngon du 'dor ba yang dag par ston pa dang / bdud kyi dkrugs ma thams cad rnam par 'thor ba'i brtson 'grus dang / byang chub tu brtsams pa mi 'khrugs mi zlog pa'i brtson 'grus dang / sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las rab tu bsgral ba'i brtson 'grus dang / mi khom pa dang / ngan song dang / ngan 'gro dang / log par ltung ba'i lam thams cad rnam pa bzlog pa'i brtson 'grus dang / mi shes pa'i ri rnam par gtor ba'i brtson 'grus dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod cing bsnyen bkur bya bas yongs su mi skyo ba'i brtson 'grus dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo yang dag par blang ba dang / yongs su gzung ba'i brtson 'grus dang / sgrib pa thams cad kyi ri rab tu gzhom zhing rnam par gtor ba'i brtson 'grus dang / sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang / gdul bas mi skyo ba'i brtson 'grus dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing / thams cad yongs su dag par bya ba'i brtson 'grus dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i brtson 'grus rnam par dag pa bla na med pa yongs su ston cing / sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo/ /

He saw, issuing forth from all her pores, clouds of emanated bodies of various colors, shapes, and sizes, equal in number to that of all beings, which spread everywhere in accordance with the aspirations of beings, teaching exertion in diligence for the great accumulation of omniscience; the diligence that puts to flight all discord from the māras; the diligence that is constant and unwavering in undertaking the attainment of enlightenment; the diligence for rescuing all beings from the ocean of saṃsāra; the diligence that turns beings away from all the paths that lead to unfortunate existences, calamitous existences, terrible existences, and downfalls; the diligence for shattering to pieces the mountain of ignorance; the diligence that never wearies in serving and making offerings to all the tathāgatas; the diligence for receiving and holding the Dharma wheel of all the buddhas; the diligence for shattering and scattering the mountain of all obscurations; the diligence that never wearies of ripening and guiding all beings; and the diligence for purifying all buddha realms and teaching the pure, unsurpassable diligence of the tathāgatas, and he saw them ripening beings.

He also saw emerge from all the pores of the goddess multitudes of projections of the forms of various kinds of beings, the same as all beings in appearance and size, showing all sentient beings, according to their mentalities, the exertion of energy to store the great knowledge and virtue needed for omniscience, showing the energy to destroy all demons, the energy to work for enlightenment without being disturbed or deflected, the energy to lift all sentient beings out of the sea of the mundane whirl, the energy to get rid of all paths leading to falls into miserable conditions, evils, and states inopportune for enlightenment, the energy to pulverize the mountain of nescience, the energy to serve all buddhas tirelessly, the energy to receive and hold all buddha-teachings, the energy to cut through and shatter the mountains of all obstacles to enlightenment, the energy to develop and guide all sentient beings tirelessly, the energy to purify all buddha-lands, and the supreme purity of the energy of the enlightened, thus developing sentient beings to maturity.

ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas/ lus sna tshogs kha dog dang / dbyibs rnam pa tha dad par sprul pa'i sprin 'thon te/ thabs sna tshogs kyis sems can rnams kyi dga' ba yongs su skyed pa dang / yid mi bde ba rnam par zlog pa dang / 'dod pa'i dga' ba thams cad rnam par smod pa dang / ngo tsha shes pa'i chos nyid 'jig rten du sgrog pa dang / dbang po bsdams pa la sems can rnams rab tu dgod pa dang / tshangs pa'i spyod pa bla na med pa yang dag par bsngags pa byed pa dang / 'dod pa'i 'jig rten bdud kyi yul 'jigs pa dang bcas par yongs su ston pa dang / 'dod pa'i dga' ba dang bral ba rnams la 'jig rten gyi 'dod pa dang dga' ba'i yul thams cad yongs su ston pa dang / chos la mos shing dga' ba la sems can rab tu dgod pa dang / mthar gyis bsam gtan dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa'i sgo mngon par sgrub pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa thams cad rnam par bsal ba la nges par rtogs pa'i sems yongs su brjod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho'i rnam par 'phrul pa thams cad yongs su sten [*ston?] pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i mngon par shes pa dang / rnam par 'phrul pa dang / khyu mchog gi mthu phyung ba yongs su ston par byed cing / sems can thams cad kyi dga' ba yongs su bskyed pa dang / spro ba 'phel bar bya ba dang / nyams bde ba yongs su bskyed pa dang / yid mi bde ba bzlog pa dang / sems skyon med pa yongs su bsgrub pa dang / sems las su rung bar bya ba dang / bsam pa rnam par sbyang ba dang / dbang po gsal bar bya ba dang / lus kyi bde ba yongs su skyed pa dang / chos la dga' ba'i shugs rnam par 'phel bar bya ba byed cing sems can rnams yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo/ /

He saw, issuing forth from all her pores, clouds of emanated bodies of various colors and shapes that through various methods brought joy to beings; prevented unhappiness; condemned all delights in desire; proclaimed in the world the quality of a sense of shame; brought beings to control of their senses; praised the unsurpassable conduct of celibacy; taught the fearfulness of the world of desire and the realm of Māra; taught all the worlds that are the range of desire, even to those who were free from delighting in desires; caused beings to delight in the pleasures of the Dharma; enabled the successive attainment of the gateways[1340] to dhyāna, samādhi, and samāpatti; described the mind that comprehends the elimination of all kleśas in all beings; taught all the miraculous manifestations of the ocean of bodhisattva samādhis; taught the miracles and supremacy of the higher cognitions of the bodhisattvas; brought joy to all beings; increased enthusiasm;[1341] created happiness; dispelled unhappiness; caused the attainment of faultless minds; made minds skillful; purified thoughts; clarified the senses; brought physical bliss; magnified the power of delight in the Dharma; and thus ripened beings.

He also saw multitudes of projected bodies emanate from the goddess’s pores producing joy in sentient beings by various means, removing depression, wary of all sensuality, promoting modesty in the world, directing sentient beings to guard their senses, praising unexcelled religious practice, portraying the realm of desire as a perilous realm of demons, showing the realm of enjoyment of all worldly desires even to those free from sensuality, establishing sentient beings in enjoyment of truth, step by step producing the bliss of the attainments of meditation and concentration, praising conscious contemplation of all the afflictions of all sentient beings, showing the magical creativity of the ocean of concentrations of all enlightening beings, showing the majesty of the miracles of the mystic knowledges of enlightening beings, making sentient beings joyful and happy, removing melancholy, bringing goodness of mind, producing cleverness and activity of mind, purifying the mind, clarifying the senses, producing physical bliss, promoting the growth of the energy of the joy of truth, thus developing sentient beings to maturity.

ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas skye ba thams cad dang 'dra ba'i lus kyi sprin sna tshogs 'thon te/ zhing thams cad kyi khongs su chud pa'i sems can thams cad kyi yid bzhin du bstan pa'i phyir/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gan du 'gro bas skyo ba med pa yongs su ston pa dang / slob dpon dang / bla ma dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rim gro bya ba dang / bsnyen bkur bas skyo ba med pa yongs su ston pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo 'khor ba yang dag par blang zhing yongs su bzung bas skyo ba med pa'i brtson 'grus yongs su ston pa dang / sangs rgyas mtsho thams cad khong du chud par bya ba'i tshul yang dag par brjod pa dang / chos kyi sgo rgya mtsho thams cad rnam par 'byed pa dang / chos thams cad kyi mtshan nyid dang / rang bzhin dang / tshul mngon par brjod pa dang / chos thams cad ting nge 'dzin gyi sgor yongs su ston pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi dri ba dang / the tshom rgya mtsho rnam par sel bas shes rab kyi yul yongs su ston pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi lta ba'i ri shin tu 'joms pa'i shes rab rdo rje yongs su ston pa dang / sems kyi skad cig gcig dang ldan pas sems can thams cad kyi ma rig pa'i mun pa rnam par sel ba'i shes rab kyi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'char ba yongs su ston pa byed cing / sems can thams cad kyi dga' ba yongs su skye bar bya bas sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo/ /

He saw, issuing forth from all her pores, clouds of various bodies resembling all bodies that appear, in order to appear in accordance with the wishes of all beings within all realms, demonstrating unwearyingly going into the presence of kalyāṇamitras;[1342] demonstrating unwearying service and attendance to ācāryas, gurus, and kalyāṇamitras;[1343] demonstrating the diligence that never wearies of receiving and holding the turning of the Dharma wheel of all the tathāgatas; describing the way of comprehending the ocean of all the buddhas; contemplating the ocean of all Dharma entrances; explaining the characteristics, natures, and ways of all Dharmas; teaching the entrances into the samādhis of all Dharmas;[1344] teaching the range of wisdom that dispels the ocean of questions and doubts of all beings;[1345] teaching the vajra of wisdom that destroys the mountains of wrong views of all beings; teaching, with every instant of mind, the rising of the disk of the sun of wisdom that dispels the darkness of the ignorance of all beings; and ripening beings[1346] by bringing happiness to all beings.

He also saw multitudes of bodies in the forms of all sentient beings emanate from all the goddess’s pores, appearing agreeably to all sentient beings in all lands, showing them tirelessness in going to all spiritual benefactors, showing tirelessness in attendance on all mentors and spiritual benefactors, showing tireless energy in taking in and holding in mind the operations of the cycles of teachings of all buddhas, investigating the oceans of all approaches to the truth, describing the way to enter the ocean of all buddhas, elucidating the teaching of the characteristics and nature of all phenomena, showing the door of concentration, showing the thunderbolt of wisdom which breaks through the mountain of views of sentient beings, by continuous mental application showing the rise of the sun of wisdom dispelling the darkness of ignorance of all sentient beings, developing sentient beings in omniscience while engendering joy in all sentient beings.

ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas kha dog dang dbyibs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i lus mang po 'gro ba thams cad dang mnyam pa'i sprul pa'i sprin 'thon te/ bsam pa dang mos pa ji lta ba bzhin du sems can thams cad la mngon du gnas shing sgra skad sna tshogs kyis yongs su sbyang ba bstan pas/ 'jig rten pa'i bsod nams dang / bsod nams ma yin pa mngon par ston pa dang / 'jig rten pa'i bya ba thams cad rab tu rgyu ba dang / khams gsum pa 'byung ba thams cad yongs su bstan pa dang / khams gsum pa thams cad las 'byung ba'i phyogs yang dag par brjod pa dang / lta ba'i mya ngan mi bzad pa thams cad las 'byung ba'i phyogs yang dag par bstan pas/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi lam gyi khyad par yongs su brjod pa dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa'i lam las yongs su bzla ba yang dag par ston pa dang / rim gror byas pa dang / rim gror ma byas pa la byams sdang gis gos pa med pa yongs su ston pa dang / 'khor ba dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i sgol [?] mi gnas pa yang dag par ston pa dang / dga' ldan gyi gnas la sogs pa gcig nas gcig tu rgyu ba rgyun mi 'chad pa yongs su ston pa dang / snying po byang chub tu song zhing mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar rgyun mi 'chad pa yongs su ston pa byed cing / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du sems can yongs su smin pa byed pa mthong ngo; ;

He saw, issuing forth from all her pores, clouds of emanations of many bodies of inconceivable colors and shapes, equal to those of all beings, becoming present before all beings in accordance with their motivations and aspirations, and teaching, giving instructions by having mastered various languages, the knowledge of what is meritorious in the world and what is not meritorious.[1347] He saw the worldly deeds that should be accomplished, the description of the origin of all three realms, the explanation of the direction that leads to leaving all three realms, the teaching of the direction that leads to leaving the unendurable misery[1348] of wrong views, and thereby the teaching of the unique path to omniscience, the teaching of the transcending of the path of the śrāvaka and pratyekabuddha levels, the teaching of being unstained by anger or love toward those who show respect and those who disrespect, the teaching of nonengagement with the gateways[1349] to either saṃsāra or nirvāṇa, the teaching of the unceasing successive passage from one place to another such as the Tuṣita paradise, the teaching of the unceasing succession of going to the bodhimaṇḍa and attaining complete buddhahood, and the ripening of beings for omniscience.

He also saw multitudes of projected bodies, equal to all sentient beings, with splendid, inconceivably various appearances, emanate from the goddess’s pores and appear before all sentient beings in accord with their inclinations and interests, using various languages to reveal higher knowledge of all worldly good, explaining the excellence of the path of omniscience by doing all that should be done in the world, by showing the issue of all states of existence, by describing the way out of conditioned existences, and by showing the way out of the wilderness of all views, showing transcendence of the paths of individual salvation, showing absence of attraction or aversion toward the created or the uncreated, showing nonattachment to the pleasures of mundane life or nirvana, showing unceasing progression from the heaven of satisfaction, showing unceasing attainment of enlightenment at the pinnacle of enlightenment, showing the realm of wisdom to guide all beings out of the sea of doubt, illumining omniscience for sentient beings.

ba spu'i sgo thams cad kyi ba spu'i sgo re re nas kyang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi lus sprul pa'i sprin 'thon te/ sems can gyi 'jig rten thams cad la mngon sum du gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa dang smon lam yongs su brjod pa dang / chos kyi dbyings thams cad rnam par dag pa'i mthar thug pa'i smon lam gyi khyad par yongs su brjod pa dang / sems kyi skad cig re re la 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho thams cad yongs su dag par bya ba yongs su brjod pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod cing rim gror bya ba rgyun mi 'chad pa yongs su brjod pa dang / sems kyi skad cig re re la chos kyi tshul rgya mtsho thams cad la 'jug pa rgyun mi 'chad pa yongs su ston pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho thams cad du rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul rgya mtsho la 'jug pa rgyun mi 'chad pa yongs su ston pa dang / zhing thams cad du phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal pa'i mur thug par gnas shing / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi lam rnam par dag par bya bar yongs su brjod pa rgyun mi 'chad pa yang dag par ston pa dang / sems kyi skad cig re re la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs la 'jug pa rgyun mi 'chad pa yang dag par brjod pa dang / dus gsum gyi tshul rgya mtsho thams cad la 'jug pa rgyun mi 'chad pa yongs su ston pa dang / zhing thams cad du rdzu 'phrul gyis rnam par 'phrul pa yongs su bstan pa rgyun mi 'chad pa yang dag par ston pa byed cing / byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang spyod pa yongs su bstan pas sems can thams cad thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rab tu 'god pa mthong ngo/ /

He saw, issuing forth from all her pores, clouds of emanated bodies as numerous as the atoms in all buddha realms and visibly present in all worlds of beings. They were describing the completely good bodhisattva conduct and prayer; describing the special prayer for the perfect purification of the entire realm of phenomena; describing the purification of the entire ocean of world realms in each instant of mind; describing continuous service and offering to all the tathāgatas; teaching the continuous entry into the ocean of all the ways of the Dharma in each instant of mind; describing the continuous entry into the ocean of the ways of the realm of phenomena, which are as numerous as the atoms in the entire ocean of world realms, in each instant of mind; describing the continuous teaching of the purification of the path to omniscience while remaining resolutely throughout all future kalpas in all realms; describing continuous entry into the strengths of the tathāgatas in each instant of mind; teaching continuous entry into the ocean of all the ways of the three times; teaching the continuous manifestation of miraculous powers in all realms; and establishing all beings in omniscience through the teaching of bodhisattva prayer and conduct.

He also saw as many multitudes of projected bodies as atoms in all lands emanate from each pore of the goddess and stand before all sentient beings praising the vow of practice of universally good enlightening beings, praising the excellence of the vow to ultimately purify all universes, praising purification of all worlds in each moment of thought, praising persistence in entering the powers of buddhas in each moment of thought, showing ceaseless entry into the ocean of principles of the cosmos—equal to the number of atomic particles in all oceans of worlds—in every single moment of thought, praising ceaseless elucidation of purification of the path of omniscience in all lands throughout all time, showing ceaseless entry into the ocean of past, present, and future means of guidance, showing ceaseless manifestations of all magical powers of enlightening beings, leading all sentient beings to omniscience by showing the practice of the vows of enlightening beings.

ba spu'i sgo thams cad kyi ba spu'i sgo re re nas kyis 'gro ba thams cad kyi sems dang mnyam pa'i lus kyi sprul pa'i sprin mang po 'thon te/ sems can thams cad la mngon par gnas shing; thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi tshogs kyi stobs mu med pa yongs su ston pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems kyi stobs mi zad pa dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / chud mi za ba'i chos can yongs su ston pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad yongs su bsgrub pa'i stobs phyir mi ldog cing phyir mi ldog la/ thug pa med pa dang / rgyun med pa dang / bla na med pa yongs su ston pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi stobs 'khor ba'i nyes pa thams cad kyis mi gos pa yongs su ston pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi stobs bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad rnam par 'thor ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi stobs nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi dri mas nye bar nyon mongs pa med pa yongs su ston pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi stobs las kyi sgrib pa thams cad kyi ri rnam par 'thor ba yongs su ston pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snying rje chen po'i stobs bskal ba thams cad du gnas kyang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pas skyo ba med pa yongs su ston pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi stobs sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad yongs su bskyod cing bskul bas/ sems can thams cad rab tu dga' bar byed pa yongs su ston pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi stobs bdud dang / phas kyi rgol ba'i tshogs thams cad rab tu 'joms pa yongs su ston pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i ye shes kyi stobs chen po 'jig rten du rab tu brjod pa byed cing / sems can thams cad thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo/ /

He saw, issuing forth from all her pores, clouds of emanated bodies as numerous as the minds of all beings, and in the presence of all beings teaching the limitless strength of the accumulation of omniscience; teaching the inexhaustible, indestructible,[1350] and everlasting strength of the mind that knows all phenomena; teaching the irreversible, nonregressive, invincible, ever-continuing,[1351] unsurpassable strength of the attainment of all bodhisattva conduct; teaching the bodhisattva strength that is unstained by any of the faults of saṃsāra; teaching the bodhisattva strength that disperses the entire army of Māra; teaching the bodhisattva strength that is unafflicted by the stains of any of the kleśas; teaching the bodhisattva strength that disperses the mountain of all karmic obscurations; teaching the bodhisattva strength of great compassion that continues throughout all kalpas with unwearying bodhisattva conduct; teaching the bodhisattva strength that brings happiness to all beings by shuddering and shaking all buddha realms; teaching the bodhisattva strength that defeats all the hosts of māras and adversaries; and elucidating in the world the great strength of the wisdom of turning the Dharma wheel and thus ripening all beings for omniscience.

He also saw multitudes of projected bodies as numerous as the minds of all beings emanate from each of the goddess’s pores and stand before all sentient beings, showing them the endless power of the provisions for omniscience, showing the unbreakable, invincible, indestructible power of the will for omniscience, showing the nonregressing, irreversible, sustained, ceaseless power of accomplishment of the supreme practice of all enlightening beings, praising enlightening beings’ power to remain unaffected by the ills of mundane life, showing enlightening being’s power to destroy all demons, showing enlightening beings’ power of great compassion tirelessly carrying out enlightening actions throughout all ages, showing enlightening beings’ power to shake all buddha-lands and please all beings, showing enlightening beings’ power to crush all demons and false teachers, to nurture the power of knowledge to turn the wheel of the great teaching in the world, elucidating omniscience for all sentient beings.

ba spu'i sgo thams cad kyi ba spu'i sgo re re nas kyang lus kyi sprul pa rgya mtsho kha dog mtha' yas pa/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi sems dang mnyam pa'i sprin/ phyogs bcu mtha' yas pa'i sems can gyi khams su rgyas par 'gengs pa 'thon te/
He saw, issuing forth from all her pores, clouds of emanated bodies, as numerous as the minds of all beings, which spread throughout the infinite realms of beings in the ten directions,

He also saw multitudes of projected bodies in endless forms, presented to the minds of all sentient beings, emanate from each pore of the goddess, filling the endless realms of sentient beings in the ten directions,
sems can rnams kyi bsam pa dang / mos pa ji lta ba bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang / ye shes kyi rnam par gnon pa yongs su ston pa dang /
teaching in accordance with the motivations and aspirations of beings the prowess of bodhisattva conduct and wisdom;
showing beings, according to their mentalities, the energetic activity of the knowledge of the practice of enlightening beings,
sems can gyi khams rgya mtsho thams cad la 'jug pa'i ye shes yongs su ston pa dang /
teaching the wisdom that comprehends the ocean of all the realms of beings;
showing knowledge comprehending all realms of sentient beings,
sems can thams cad kyi sems rgya mtsho la 'jug pa'i ye shes yongs su ston pa dang /
teaching the wisdom that comprehends the ocean of the minds of all beings;
showing knowledge comprehending all sentient beings’ minds,
sems can thams cad kyi dbang po rgya mtsho yongs su shes pa'i ye shes yongs su ston pa dang /
teaching the wisdom that knows the ocean of the faculties of all beings;
showing knowledge thoroughly aware of the faculties of all sentient beings,
sems can thams cad kyi spyod pa rgya mtsho la 'jug pa'i ye shes yongs su ston pa dang;
teaching the wisdom that comprehends the ocean of the conducts of all beings;
showing knowledge comprehending all sentient beings’ actions,
sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang / gdul ba'i dus las mi 'da' ba'i ye shes yongs su ston pa dang /
teaching the wisdom that always knows the time for ripening and guiding all beings;
showing knowledge of proper timing in developing and guiding all sentient beings,
chos kyi dbyings thams cad du grags par sgrog pa'i ye shes yongs su ston pa dang /
teaching the wisdom that resounds throughout the entire realm of phenomena;
showing the knowledge to echo the languages of all realms of existence,
sems kyi skad cig re re la chos kyi dbyings thams cad du ye shes kyi tshul rgya mtshos rgyas par 'gengs pa'i ye shes yongs su ston pa dang /
teaching the wisdom that pervades everywhere, in each instant of mind, the ocean of all the ways of knowing the entire realm of phenomena;
showing knowledge pervading the ocean of ways to knowledge of all phenomena in each moment of thought,
'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho thams cad 'du ba dang / 'jig pa'i ye shes yongs su ston pa dang /
teaching the knowledge of the formation and destruction of the ocean of all world realms;
showing knowledge of the formation and disintegration of all worlds,
'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi gzhi dang / dbyibs dang / rgyan rnam par dgod pa'i ye shes yongs su ston pa dang /
teaching the knowledge of the basis, shape, and arrayed displays of all world realms;
showing knowledge of the differences in basis, form, and arrangement of all worlds,

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchod pa rnam par sprul te/ spyan sngar phyin nas mchod cing rim gro byed pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo'i sprin yang dag par 'dzin pa'i ye shes yongs su ston pa byed cing / de ltar ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa yongs su ston pas sems can rnams kyi dga' ba skyed pa dang / sems rab tu dang bar byed pa dang / rab tu dga' ba skyed pa dang / mos pa 'phel bar byed pa dang / yid mi bde ba rnam par zlog pa dang / sems rnam par sbyong ba dang / sems skyon med pa skye bar byed pa dang / dbang po gsal bar byed pa dang / mos pa'i stobs yongs su skyed pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid las phyir mi ldog par byed pa mthong ngo/ /

and teaching the knowledge of emanating offerings to all the tathāgatas, going into their presence, making offerings, rendering service, and possessing clouds of Dharma wheels. And by teaching in that way the practice of the perfection of knowledge, they were bringing happiness to beings, making their minds clear, creating joy, increasing aspiration, dispelling unhappiness, purifying[1352] the mind, creating a faultless mind, clarifying the senses, creating the power of aspiration, and causing irreversible progress toward omniscience.

showing the knowledge to go to buddhas with magical offerings, serve the buddhas, and receive their teachings, thus producing joy in sentient beings by showing the practice of the transcendent way of knowledge, soothing their minds, producing joy and happiness, getting rid of melancholy, purifying the mind, leading to goodwill, clarifying the senses, producing the power of resolution, making sentient beings irreversible on the way to omniscience.
pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa yongs su bstan pas 'jig rten du ji ltar sems can yongs su smin par gyur pa mthong ba de bzhin du/
In the same way that he saw beings being ripened in worlds through the teaching of the practice of the perfections,
Just as he saw her proceeding to develop sentient beings in the world by demonstrations of the practices of the transcendent ways,
byang chub sems dpa'i chos thams cad rab tu sgrog pa'i tshul gyis mtshan mo'i lha mo rab tu dga' ba'i mig 'gro bar rnam par snang ba'i thog ma sems bskyed pa'i tshogs dang /
he saw the night goddess Pramuditanayanajagadvirocanā proclaiming all the bodhisattva Dharmas: the initial accumulation of developed motivation;

he saw multitudes of bodies of beings of various forms emanate from each of the goddess’s pores with the thunder of the laws of all enlightening beings, the preparations of the goddess’s first inspiration,
dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsnyen bkur ba'i thabs dang /
the methods for serving and venerating kalyāṇamitras;
propitiation of spiritual benefactors,
de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs kyi drung du phyin cing mchod pa dang rim gro byas pa'i tshul dang /
approaching the feet of tathāgatas and making offerings to them and attending them;
going to buddhas and attending them,
dge ba'i chos spyad pa'i thabs ji snyed pa dang /
every method for practicing good qualities;
the practice of virtuous conduct,
sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pas gtang bar dka' ba yongs su btang ba dang /
making the most difficult of gifts through the practice of the perfection of generosity;
the relinquishment of what is hard to give up in the course of practicing transcendent giving,
tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su sbyangs pa'i thabs dang /
the methods for training in the perfection of correct conduct;
the purification of transcendent discipline,
rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug chen po dang / 'khor mang po dang longs spyod kyi dbang chen po yongs su btang ste/ mngon par byung ba'i thabs ji snyed pa dang /
all the methods for giving up the great power of kingship, retinues, and great power over enjoyments and becoming a renunciate;
the abandonment of rulership and retinue and going forth from society,
'jig rten gyi dka' ba'i spyod pa brtul zhugs dang / dka' thub chen po'i dkyil 'khor la bzod pa mngon par bsgrubs pa ji snyed cig yod pa dang /
all the accomplishments of patience in the domain of vows of discipline and great asceticism that are difficult to undertake in this world;
the exercise of forbearance in austerities difficult to practice in the world,
byang chub sems dpa'i brtul zhugs yang dag par blangs pa'i sbyor ba la mi g.yo bar bya ba ji snyed cig yod pa dang /
all resolute engagement in the bodhisattva vows of discipline;
unshakability in the application of the vows undertaken by enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i yi dam brtan pa'i chos rgya mtsho
the ocean of the qualities of firm bodhisattva commitments;
the oceans of practices of steadfast resolutions of enlightening beings,
sems can gyi khams thams cad kyi nyes byas dang / ngan du smra ba dang / nyes par spyod pa thams cad bag la zha bar byed pa'i sbyor ba dang /
the endurance[1353] of the bad actions, bad speech,[1354] and bad thoughts[1355] of all realms of beings;
the endurance of suffering which is impossible, unspeakable, unthinkable to all worldly beings,
lus dang sems kyi gnod pa nyams su bzod par byed pa'i sbyor ba ji snyed cig yod pa dang /
the endurance of harm to the body and the mind;
the endurance of physical and mental harassment,
chos thams cad 'jig pa med pa'i chos nyid la bzod pa dang /
the patience of the nonperishing[1356] nature of the Dharma;[1357]
acceptance of the nonperishing nature of deeds,
chos thams cad la yid ches pa'i bzod pa dang /
the patience of belief in all Dharmas;
earnest acceptance of all truths,
chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin nges par rtogs pa'i bzod pa ji snyed cig yod pa dang /
the patience of realizing the nature of the Dharma;
contemplative acceptance of the nature of all things,
thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du rtsom zhing sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus ji snyed cig yod pa dang /
the diligence for engaging in undertaking omniscience;
energy in undertaking to become omniscient,
sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yongs su sgrub pa'i brtson 'grus ji snyed cig yod pa dang /
the diligence for accomplishing all the qualities of buddhahood;
energy in accomplishing all aspects of buddhahood,
brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa ji snyed pa thams cad dang /
the practice of the perfection of diligence;
all practices of transcendent energy,
bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshogs dang /
the accumulation of the perfection of meditation;
the preparations for transcendent meditation,
bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brtson par bya ba dang /
dedication to the perfection of meditation;
energetic efforts in transcendent meditation,
bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgrub pa rnam par dag pa'i spyod pa ji snyed cig yod pa dang /
the pure practices that accomplish the perfection of meditation;
practices purifying the attainments of transcendent meditation,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin rab tu thob pas rnam par 'phrul pa ji snyed cig yod pa dang /
the miraculous powers from the attainment of bodhisattva samādhis;
mystical powers attained by enlightening beings through concentration,
ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo rgya mtsho la 'jug pa ji snyed cig yod pa dang /
the entry through an ocean of samādhi gateways;
entries into the ocean of mediums of concentration,
bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa ji snyed pa thams cad dang /
the practices of the perfection of meditation;
practices of transcendent meditation,
shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshogs ji snyed cig yod pa dang /
the accumulation of the perfection of wisdom;
the preparations for transcendent wisdom,
byang chub sems dpa'i shes rab chen po'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rnam par spyad pa'i tshul ji snyed cig yod pa dang /
the ways of purifying the sun disk of great bodhisattva wisdom;
the clarification of the sun of great wisdom of enlightening beings,
shes rab chen po'i sprin yongs su 'du ba'i tshul ji snyed cig yod pa dang /
the ways of accumulating[1358] the clouds of great wisdom;
the issue of great masses of wisdom,
shes rab kyi gter chen po'i tshogs ji snyed cig yod pa dang /
the accumulations of the great treasure of wisdom;
the treasures of wisdom,
shes rab kyi rgya mtsho chen po la rnam par dpyad pa'i tshul dang / sbyor ba ji snyed pa thams cad dang /
the ways of analyzing the great ocean of wisdom;
applications of the ways of contemplation of the ocean of great wisdom,
thabs chen po la mkhas pa'i tshul gyi sbyor ba ji snyed cig yod pa dang /
dedication to purification[1359] and skill in great methods;
applications of the principles of great skill in means,
thabs chen po la mkhas pa yongs su dag par bya ba dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba ji snyed pa thams cad dang /
byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i lus ji snyed cig yod pa dang /
the bodies from the perfection of great bodhisattva prayers;
embodiments of the transcendent vows of enlightening beings,
smon lam chen po'i pha rol phyin pa yongs su grub pa ji snyed cig yod pa dang /
the accomplishment of the perfection of great prayers;
achievements of great transcendent vows,
smon lam chen po'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa ji snyed cig yod pa dang /
the practice of the perfection of great prayers;
practices of transcendent commitment,
smon lam chen po'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba ji snyed pa thams cad dang /
the dedication in the past to the perfection of great prayers;
past efforts involved in great transcendent vows,
stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thob par bya ba'i tshogs chen po ji snyed cig yod pa dang /
the great accumulations for attaining the perfection of strength;
great resources for the attainment of transcendent power,
stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rkyen du gyur pa ji snyed cig yod pa dang;
the conditions for the perfection of strength;
cooperating circumstances of transcendent power,
stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul rgya mtsho chen po ji snyed cig yod pa dang /
the great ocean of the ways of the perfection of strength;
oceans of principles of transcendent power,
stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa shin tu bstan pa ji snyed cig yod pa dang /
the teaching of the perfection of strength;
indications of transcendent power,
stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba ji snyed pa thams cad dang /
the dedication in the past to the perfection of strength;
past efforts involved in transcendent power,
ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sbyor ba ji snyed cig yod pa dang /
the practice of the perfection of knowledge;
applications of transcendent knowledge,
the ways of the perfection of knowledge;
principles of transcendent knowledge,
ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rnam par dag pa'i tshul ji snyed cig yod pa dang /
the ways of the purification of the perfection of knowledge;
methods of purification of knowledge,
ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i phyogs ji snyed cig yod pa dang /
the direction of the perfection of knowledge;
realms of knowledge,
ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rjes su 'brang bar bya ba ji snyed cig yod pa dang /
following the perfection of knowledge;
attainments of knowledge,
ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'byams klas pa ji snyed cig yod pa dang /
the vastness of the perfection of knowledge;
ranges of knowledge,
ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul la yang dag par gzhol bar bya ba ji snyed cig yod pa dang /
absorption in the ways of the perfection of knowledge;
integration of principles of knowledge,
ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul rnam par dmigs par bya ba ji snyed cig yod pa dang /
focusing on the ways of the perfection of knowledge;[1360]
methods of communicating knowledge,
ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'byams klas pa'i rjes su 'brang bar bya ba ji snyed cig yod pa dang /
following the vastness of the perfection of knowledge;
consequences of the courses of knowledge,
ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pas rgyas par 'gengs pa ji snyed cig yod pa dang /
the pervasion of the perfection of knowledge;
suffusions of knowledge,
ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgya chen po ji snyed cig yod pa dang /
the extent of the perfection of knowledge;
expansions of knowledge,
ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i lhun ji snyed cig yod pa dang /
the assemblage of the perfection of knowledge;[1361]
embodiments of knowledge,
principles of the ocean of knowledge,
ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su grub par bya ba dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba ji snyed pa thams cad dang /
dedication in the past to the accomplishment of the perfection of knowledge;
past efforts involved in the accomplishment of knowledge,
ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa'i rnam par rab tu phye ba la 'jug pa 'byung bar yongs su bsgrub pa ji snyed cig yod pa dang /
the arrangement of the arising of entry into the classification of the kinds of practice of the perfection of knowledge;
attainments made possible by ascertainment and entry into the modes of practice of knowledge,
ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par gzhol bar bya ba'i tshul dang ldan pa'i chos rnams dang /
possessing the ways of absorption in the perfection of knowledge;[1362]
attainments of knowledge involved in the method of total integration of perfect knowledge,
chos yongs su bsdu ba dang / chos kyi ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang /
seeking the knowledge of Dharma that encompasses what is Dharma and what is not Dharma;[1363]
attainments of knowledge of truth comprehending right and wrong,
las kyi ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang /
seeking the knowledge of karma;
attainments of knowledge of actions,
zhing gi ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang /
seeking the knowledge of realms;
of lands,
bskal pa'i ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang /
seeking the knowledge of kalpas;
of ages,
dus kyi ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang /
seeking the knowledge of times;[1364]
of past, present, and future,
sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang /
seeking the knowledge of the occurrence of buddhas;
attainments of knowledge of the emergence of buddhas,
sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang /
seeking the knowledge of buddhas;
attainments of knowledge of buddhas,
byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang /
seeking the knowledge of the bodhisattvas;
attainments of knowledge of enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i sems yongs su 'byung ba'i ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang /
seeking the knowledge of the arising of bodhisattva motivation;
attainments of knowledge originating in the mind of enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par dgod pa'i ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang /
seeking the knowledge of the presence of bodhisattvas;
attainments of knowledge of the particular states of enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i 'byung ba'i ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang /
seeking the knowledge of the arising of bodhisattvas;
attainments of knowledge of the origins of enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i rab tu 'jug pa'i ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang /
seeking the knowledge of the setting-forth[1365] of bodhisattvas;
attainments of knowledge of the orientation of enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam gyi ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang /
seeking the knowledge of prayers;
attainments of knowledge of the vows of enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i chos kyi 'khor lo'i ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang /
seeking the knowledge of the Dharma wheels of bodhisattvas;
attainments of knowledge of the cycles of teaching of enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i chos rnam par 'byed pa'i ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang /
seeking the knowledge of the analysis of the Dharma by bodhisattvas;
attainments of knowledge of enlightening beings’ ascertainment of what is right,
byang chub sems dpa'i chos rgya mtsho'i tshul gyi ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang /
seeking the knowledge of the ways of the sea of Dharma of the bodhisattvas;
attainments of knowledge of principles of the ocean of practice of enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i chos gangs chen mtsho'i ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang /
seeking the knowledge of the ocean[1366] of Dharma of the bodhisattvas;
attainments of knowledge of the multitude of enlightening beings’ doctrines,
byang chub sems dpa'i chos kyi rgyud kyi ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang /
seeking the knowledge of the turning[1367] of the Dharma wheel of the bodhisattvas;
their spheres,
byang chub sems dpa'i chos kyi gter gyi ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang /
seeking the knowledge of the treasure of the Dharma of the bodhisattvas;
their hidden resources,
byang chub sems dpa'i chos kyi lugs kyi ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba ji snyed cig yod pa dang /
and seeking the knowledge of the state of the Dharma of the bodhisattvas.
and their courses of action—all the principles of enlightening beings connected with consummate knowledge of infinite objects,

mtshan mo'i lha mo rab tu dga' ba'i mig 'gro bar rnam par snang ba'i ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mtha' dang dbus med pa'i dmigs pa can de dag thams cad de'i ba spu'i sgo thams cad kyi ba spu'i sgo re re nas mngon par 'thon te/ sems can gyi lus kyi sprin kha dog sna tshogs can du mngon par mched cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo/ /

Clouds of bodies of beings of various colors emitted from each of the night goddess Pramuditanayanajagadvirocanā’s pores ripened beings through all the limitless and centerless bodhisattva practices[1368] endowed with the perfection of knowledge.
Sudhana saw being embodied by emanations from the goddess to develop sentient beings to maturity.

'di lta ste/ 'og min dang / shin tu mthong ba dang / gya nom snang ba dang / ma dros pa dang / mi che ba'i gtsang ma'i gnas kyi lha lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo/ /
They were like this: he saw clouds of bodies that were like those of the Śuddhāvāsa devas of the Akaniṣṭha, Sudarśana, Sudṛśa, Atapa, and Avṛha paradises issuing forth and ripening beings.
He saw multitudes of embodiments of the forms of all kinds of beings emanating from the goddess, filling the cosmos, appearing before all sentient beings, and developing them to maturity.
de bzhin du 'bras bu che ba dang / bsod nams 'phel ba dang / sprin dang bral ba'i lha lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo/ /
In the same way, he saw clouds of bodies that were like those of the devas in the Bṛhatphala, Puṇyaprasava, and Anabhraka paradises issuing forth and ripening beings.
dge rgyas dang / tshad med dge ba dang / dge ba chung ba'i lha lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo/ /
He saw clouds of bodies that were like those of the devas in the Śubhakṛtsna, Apramāṇaśubha, and Parīttaśubha paradises issuing forth and ripening beings.
kun snang dang ba dang / tshad med snang ba dang / snang ba chung ngu'i lha lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo/ /
He saw clouds of bodies that were like those of the devas in the Ābhāsvara, Apramāṇābha, and Parīttābha paradises issuing forth and ripening beings.[1369]
tshangs chen dang / tshangs lha nye phan dang / tshangs pa kun ris kyi lha lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing / sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo/ /
He saw clouds of bodies that were like those of the devas in the Mahābrahma, Brahmapurohita, and Brahmapārṣada paradises issuing forth and ripening beings.
dbang sgyur gyi lha'i rgyal po/ lha mo'i tshogs dang / lha'i bu dang bcas pa lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo/ /
He saw clouds of bodies that were like those of the deva king Vaśavartin and his devas and apsarases issuing forth and ripening beings.
lha'i rgyal po rab 'phrul dga'/ lha mo'i tshogs dang / lha'i bu dang bcas pa lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo/ /
He saw clouds of bodies that were like those of the deva king Sunirmita and his devas and apsarases issuing forth and ripening beings.
rab dga' ldan gyi lha'i rgyal po/ lha mo'i tshogs dang / lha'i bu dang bcas pa lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo/ /
He saw clouds of bodies that were like those of the deva king Saṃtuṣita and his devas and apsarases issuing forth and ripening beings.
rab mtshe ma'i lha'i rgyal po/ lha mo'i tshogs dang / lha'i bu dang bcas pa lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo/ /
He saw clouds of bodies that were like those of the deva king Suyāma and his devas and apsarases issuing forth and ripening beings.
lha'i rgyal po brgya byin/ lha mo'i tshogs dang / lha'i bu dang bcas pa lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing / sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo/ /
He saw clouds of bodies that were like those of the deva king Śakra and his devas and apsarases issuing forth and ripening beings.
dri za'i rgyal po gnas srung po dang / dri za'i bu dang / dri za'i bu mo lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo/ /
He saw clouds of bodies that were like those of the gandharva king Dhṛtarāṣṭra and his male gandharvas and female gandharvas issuing forth and ripening beings.
grul bum gyi rgyal po 'phags skyes po dang / grul bum gyi bu dang / grul bum gyi bu mo lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo/ /
He saw clouds of bodies that were like those of the kumbhāṇḍa king Virūḍhaka and his male kumbhāṇḍas and female kumbhāṇḍas issuing forth and ripening beings.
klu'i rgyal po mig mi bzang dang / klu'i bu dang / klu'i bu mo lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo/ /
He saw clouds of bodies that were like those of the nāga king Virūpākṣa and his male nāgas and female nāgas issuing forth and ripening beings.
gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po chen po ngal bso po dang / gnod sbyin gyi bu dang / gnod sbyin gyi bu mo lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo/ /
He saw clouds of bodies that were like those of the great yakṣa king Vaiśravaṇa and his male yakṣas and female yakṣas issuing forth and ripening beings.
mi'am ci'i rgyal po sdong po dang / mi 'am ci'i bu dang / mi'am ci'i bu mo lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo/ /
He saw clouds of bodies that were like those of the kinnara king Druma and his male kinnaras and female kinnaras issuing forth and ripening beings.

lto 'phye chen po'i dbang po blo gros bzang po dang / lto 'phye chen po'i bu dang / lto 'phye chen po'i bu mo lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo/ /
He saw clouds of bodies that were like those of the mahoraga lord Sumati and his male mahoragas and female mahoragas issuing forth and ripening beings.

nam mkha' lding gi dbang po shugs drag stobs chen dang / nam mkha' lding gi bu dang / nam mkha' lding gi bu mo lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo/ /
He saw clouds of bodies that were like those of the garuḍa lord Mahābalavegasthāma and his male garuḍas and female garuḍas issuing forth and ripening beings.
lha ma yin gyi dbang po sgra gcan dang / lha ma yin gyi bu dang / lha ma yin gyi bu mo lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo/ /
He saw clouds of bodies that were like those of the asura lord Rāhu and his male asuras and female asuras issuing forth and ripening beings.
chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje dang / gshin rje'i bu dang / gshin rje'i bu mo lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo/ /
He saw clouds of bodies that were like those of the Dharma king Yama and his male yamas and female yamas issuing forth and ripening beings.
mi'i dbang po dang / skyes pa dang / bud med dang / khye'u dang / bu mo thams cad lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo/ /
He saw clouds of bodies that were like those of the lord of humans and his male humans and female humans issuing forth and ripening beings.
de bzhin du 'gro ba'i rgyud thams cad du gtogs pa'i sems can thams cad lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo/ /
Thus he saw clouds of bodies that were like those of all the beings that appear in all existences issuing forth and ripening beings.
nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / drang srong thams cad lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo/ /
He saw clouds of bodies that were like those of śrāvakas, pratyekabuddhas, and ṛṣis issuing forth and ripening beings.
rlung dang / chu dang / me'i phung po'i lha lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo/ /
He saw clouds of bodies that were like the devas of the realms of wind, water, and fire issuing forth and ripening beings.

rgya mtsho dang / chu klung dang / ri dang / nags tshal dang / lo tog dang / sman dang / shing dang / sa'i lha lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ngo/ /
He saw clouds of bodies that were like those of the devas of oceans, rivers, mountains, forests, harvests,[1370] herbs, trees, and earth issuing forth and ripening beings.

bza' shing gi ra ba dang / grong khyer dang / snying po byang chub dang / nyin bar dang / mtshan mo dang / nam mkha' dang / phyogs dang / rkang gis 'gro dang / lus kyi ris su gtogs pa'i lha lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa mthong ba nas/

He saw clouds of bodies that were like those of the devas of parks, cities, the bodhimaṇḍa, the day, the night, space, directions, those who walk on legs, and all those who have bodies issuing forth and ripening beings.

de bzhin du lag na rdo rje lta bu'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon cing phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul 'byams klas pa thams cad du sems can thams cad la mngon par gnas shing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa'i bar du mthong ste/

In the same way, he saw clouds of bodies that were like Vajrapāṇi issuing forth, spreading throughout the ten directions, being present before beings throughout the extent of the ways of the realm of phenomena, and ripening beings.

mtshan mo'i lha mo rab tu dga' ba'i mig 'gro bar rnam par snang ba'i sems thog ma bskyed pa'i tshogs la sogs pa/ sngon gyi tshe rabs la yongs su bsgrubs pa'i dge ba'i sems gcig nas gcig tu brgyud de rgyun ma chad pa'i tshul ji snyed pa dang /

He saw, beginning with the night goddess Pramuditanayanajagadvirocanā’s first accumulation of the development of the aspiration to enlightenment, the unbroken succession of the accomplishment of a virtuous mind in her past lifetimes;
He also saw projections of the streams of good thoughts rising in the goddess’s past lives, beginning with the preparations of her initial aspiration,
byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i bsngags pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang /
the constant succession of praising the aspiration to enlightenment;
the continuing successions of commendations of aspiration to enlightenment,
shi 'pho dang / skye ba yongs su bzung ba gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang /
the constant succession of passing away and obtaining a rebirth;
the continuous successions of death and rebirth,
lus yongs su bzung ba gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang /
the constant succession of the possession of a body;
the continuous successions of incarnation,
ming gi 'khor lo gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang /
the constant succession of the wheel of names;
the continuous successions of names,
dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gan du 'gro ba gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang /
the constant succession of going to a kalyāṇamitra;
the continuous successions of visits to spiritual benefactors,
sangs rgyas byung ste bsnyen bkur ba gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang /
the constant succession of honoring the appearance of a buddha;
the continuous successions of harmonizations with buddhas,
chos kyi tshig dang; yi ge blangs pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang /
the constant succession of acquiring the sentences and syllables of the Dharma;
the continuous successions of absorption of every sentence and syllable of the teachings of buddhas,
byang chub sems dpa'i lam gyi nan tan gyi sems gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang;
the constant succession of the motivation to practice the bodhisattva path;
the continuous successions of states of mind in carrying out the path of enlightening beings,
ting nge 'dzin rab tu thob pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang /
the constant succession of attaining samādhi;
the continuous successions of attainment of concentrations,
ting 'dzin thob pas sangs rgyas mthong ba gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang /
the constant succession of seeing buddhas through having attained samādhi;
zhing mthong ba'i mig gis rgyas par bkang ba gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang /
the constant succession of the expanding vision that sees the realms;
the continuous successions of pervasion of vision of all lands,
bskal pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo 'dab chags pa dang /
the constant wheel of the knowledge of the succession of the kalpas;
the continuities of the circles of knowledge of the succession of ages,
chos kyi dbyings khong du chud pa'i ye shes gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang /
the constant succession of the knowledge that comprehends the realm of phenomena;
the continuous succession of penetrating knowledge of the cosmos,
sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta ba gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang /
the constant succession of seeing the natures of beings;
the continuous succession of knowledge observing the realms of sentient beings,
chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul rgya mtshor gtogs pa'i sems can pha rol gyi shi 'pho dang skye ba shes pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang /
the constant succession of knowing the successive passing and rebirth of beings who are within the ocean of the ways of the realm of phenomena;
the continuous succession of knowledge of individual deaths and rebirths, penetrating the ocean of principles of the cosmos,
lha'i rna ba yongs su dag pa rtogs par byed pa'i shes pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang /
the constant succession of understanding pure divine hearing;
the continuous successions of contemplative knowledge purifying the celestial ear,
sems can gyi khams thams cad kyi sems la rnam par lta zhing dbyings la 'jugs pa'i sgo gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang /
the constant succession of the gateways for entering into the continuum[1371] of looking into the minds of the entire realm of beings;
the continuous successions of media of access of wisdom observing the minds of all sentient beings,
thog ma lha'i mig la zhugs pa'i sgo gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang /
the constant succession of gateways for first entering divine sight;
the continuous successions of media of initial access of the celestial eye,
thog ma lha'i rna ba rnam par dmigs pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang /
the constant succession of the first perception through divine hearing;
the continuous successions of initial perceptions of the celestial ear,
thog ma sems can pha rol gyi sems shes pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang /
the constant succession of the first knowledge of the minds of other beings;
the continuous successions of initial knowledge of others’ thoughts,
thog ma bdag dang sems can pha rol gyi sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa shes pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang /
the constant succession of the first knowledge of the memory of the previous lifetimes of herself and others;
the continuous successions of initial recollections of the past states of self and others,
thog ma dngos po med pa la rab tu gnas te/ mngon par 'du bya ba med pa'i rdzu 'phrul thob pa'i rkyen gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang /
the constant succession of the first conditions for attaining miraculous activity through being established in the absence of existence;
the continuous succession of the initial circumstances of attainment of uncontrived mystic powers based on nonbeing,
rdzu 'phrul chen po'i rnam par gnon pas phyogs rgyas par 'gengs pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang /
the constant succession of spreading the prowess of miraculous powers throughout the directions;
the continuous succession of pervading everywhere by exercise of great mystic powers,
byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa thob pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang /
the constant succession of attaining bodhisattva liberations;
the continuous succession of attainments of liberations of enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa rgya mtsho tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa la 'jug pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang /
the constant succession of realizing the inconceivable ways of an ocean of bodhisattva liberations;
the continuous successions of comprehension of the inconceivable principles of the ocean of liberations of enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam par 'phrul pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang /
the constant succession of the miraculous manifestations of bodhisattva samādhi;
the continuous successions of mystic transformations of enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par gnon pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang /
the constant succession of bodhisattva prowess;
the continuous successions of procedures of enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i yongs su gnon pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang /
the constant succession of bodhisattva domination;
the continuous successions of attainments of enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i ming du bya ba gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa dang /
the constant succession of gaining the title of bodhisattva;
the continuous successions of impressions of enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i lam la 'jug pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa nas/
the constant succession of entering the bodhisattva path;
the continuous succession of entries into the path of enlightening beings, and so on,

mtshan mo'i lha mo rab tu dga' ba'i mig 'gro bar rnam par snang ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes shin tu phra ba gcig nas gcig tu brgyud cing 'dab chags pa ji snyed pa de dag thams cad de'i ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas sprul pa'i lus kyi sprin du mngon par 'thon te/ sems can rnams la chos 'chad pa dang /

and the night goddess Pramuditanayanajagadvirocanā’s constant succession of bodhisattva knowledge all issued from all her pores as clouds of emanated bodies that he then saw teaching the Dharma to beings.

including the night goddess’s continuous successions of entries into the most subtle knowledge of enlightening beings. He saw projected bodies emanate from each pore of the goddess, expounding the Teaching to sentient beings,

yang dag par ston pa dang / gsal bar byed pa dang / yongs su ston pa dang / rjes su brjod pa dang / rab tu 'byed pa dang / shin tu rgya cher byed pa dang / 'grang ba dang / nges par ston pa dang / rnam par rig par byed pa dang / nye bar bsgrub pa mthong ste/
He saw them declaring it, elucidating it, revealing it, communicating it, categorizing it, expanding upon it, enumerating it, giving instruction on it, making it known, and accomplishing it.
elucidating, clarifying, demonstrating, discussing, analyzing, extending, categorizing, explaining, communicating, and conveying it to them.
la la la ni rlung gi dkyil 'khor shin tu 'khrugs pa'i sgra skad kyis chos ston pa mthong ngo/ /
He saw some teaching the Dharma through speech from the sound of shaking in a domain of wind,
He saw some teaching with the sound of wind,
la la la ni chu'i phung po rab tu rlob pa'i sgra skad kyis/
some through speech from the sound of crashing waves on a mass of water,
some with the sound of water,
la la la ni me'i me lce shin tu rlob pa'i sgra skad kyis/
some through speech from the sound of the roaring flames of a fire,
some with the sound of fire,
la la la ni rgya mtsho'i 'brug gi sgra skad kyis/
some through speech from the sound of a roaring ocean,
some with the sound of the ocean,
la la la ni sa yongs su g.yos pa'i sgra skad kyis/
some through speech from the sound of the rumbling of an earthquake,
some with the sound of earth quaking,
la la la ni ri chen po phan tshun thug cing 'thab pa'i sgra skad kyis/
some through speech from the sound and noise of great mountains striking against and buffeting one another,
some with the thrilling sound of mountains crashing together,
la la la ni lha'i grong khyer g.yos pa'i nga ro snyan pa'i sgra skad kyis/
some through speech from the melodious sound of the shaking of the cities of the devas,
some with the sweet sound of celestial cities trembling,
la la la ni lha'i gzhal med khang thug cing 'khrol ba'i sgra skad kyis chos ston pa mthong ngo/ /
some through speech from the sound of divine aerial palaces buffeting one another,
some with the sound of celestial palaces crashing together,
la la la ni lha'i dbang po'i skad kyis/
some through the speech of the lords of the devas;
some with the voices of celestial beings,
la la la ni klu'i dbang po'i skad kyis/
some through the speech of the lords of the nāgas,
some with the voices of various fantastic beings and entities,
la la la ni gnod sbyin gyi dbang po'i skad kyis/
some through the speech of the lords of the yakṣas,
la la la ni dri za'i dbang po'i skad kyis/
some through the speech of the lords of the gandharvas,
la la la ni lha ma yin gyi dbang po'i skad kyis/
some through the speech of the lords of the asuras,
la la la ni nam mkha' lding gi dbang po'i skad kyis/
some through the speech of the lords of the garuḍas,
la la la ni mi'am ci'i dbang po'i skad kyis/
some through the speech of the lords of the kinnaras,
la la la ni lto 'phye chen po'i dbang po'i skad kyis/
some through the speech of the lords of the mahoragas,
la la la ni mi'i dbang po'i skad kyis/
some through the speech of the lords of the humans,
some with the voices of human chiefs,
la la la ni tshangs pa'i dbang po'i skad kyis/
some through the speech of the lords of the Brahmā devas,
some with the voices of Brahma chiefs,
la la la ni lha mo'i glu dbyangs kyis/
some through the speech of the songs of the apsarases,
some with the songs of nymphs,
la la la ni lha rdzas kyi rol mo legs par blangs pa'i dbyangs kyis;
some through speech from the playing of divine music,
some with celestial music,
la la la ni nor bu rin po che'i sgra dbyangs kyis/
some through speech sounding from precious jewels,[1372]
some with the sound of jewels,
la la la ni sems can gyi ris thams cad kyi skad sna tshogs kyis/
and some through the speech of all the various classes of beings,
some with the voices of all living beings,
mtshan mo'i lha mo rab tu dga' ba'i mig 'gro bar rnam par snang ba'i rnam par thar pa'i yul/ sems can rnams la rab tu brjod pa mthong ngo/ /
describing to beings the scope of the liberation of the night goddess Pramuditanayanajagadvirocanā.
explaining the sphere of the night goddess’s liberation to sentient beings.

de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i lus kyi sprin gyis byang chub sems dpa'i sgra skad sna tshogs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa'i sku'i sprin gyis de bzhin gshegs pa gsung rnam pa tha dad pa'i dbyangs kyi yan lag gi tshul gyis/ mtshan mo'i lha mo rab tu dga' ba'i mig 'gro bar rnam par snang ba'i rnam par thar pa'i yul/ thog ma sems bskyed pa dang bcas pa yongs su byung ste/ grub cing yang dag par 'dus pa dang bcas/ rnam par thar ba'i rnam par rtse ba dang bcas pa/ sems can thams cad la rnam par dmigs par byed pa mthong ngo/ /

In the same way, he saw clouds of bodhisattva bodies with various kinds of bodhisattva speech and clouds of emanated[1373] tathāgatas, with the ways of the aspects of voice of the different kinds of speech of each tathāgata and describing to all beings the range of the liberation of the night goddess Pramuditanayanajagadvirocanā, including the first occurrence of developing the aspiration to enlightenment and the accumulation of accomplishments.

Thus he saw the range of the night goddess’s liberation, with the attainment of perfection proceeding from her first aspiration, including her sport in liberation, being communicated to all sentient beings by means of multitudes of embodiments of enlightening beings, various utterances of enlightening beings, multitudes of emanation bodies of buddhas, and various utterances of buddhas.

de'i sprul pa'i gzugs kyi sprin re res kyang / sems kyi skad cig re re la phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa rnam par sbyong ba mthong ngo/ /
He saw that each of those clouds of emanated forms purified, in each instant of mind, an anabhilāpyānabhilāpya of buddha realms in the world realms in the ten directions.
He saw untold buddha-lands in the ten directions being purified in each instant of thought by each of her hosts of projected bodies;
sems can rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa dag kyang ngan song gi sdug bsngal thams cad las rnam par 'grel ba mthong ngo/ /
He saw them liberating[1374] an infinite ocean of beings from all the sufferings of the lower realms.
he saw infinitely varied oceans of sentient beings being liberated from all ills and miseries;
sems can gyi khams mtha' dang dbus med pa dag kyang mi'i phun sum tshogs pa la rab tu 'god pa mthong ngo/ /
He saw them establishing realms of beings, without limit or center, in the good fortune of devas[1375] and humans.
he saw infinitely varied sentient beings being led to celestial and human states;
sems can rgya mtsho mtha' dang dbus med pa dag kyang 'khor ba rgya mtsho las gyen du bskyod pa mthong ngo/ /
He saw them freeing an ocean of beings, without limit or center, from the ocean of saṃsāra.
sems can rgya mtsho mtha' dang dbus med pa dag kyang nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa la rab tu 'god pa mthong ngo/ /
He saw them establishing an ocean of beings without limit or center on the śrāvaka and pratyekabuddha levels.
he saw infinitely varied multitudes of sentient beings being led to the stages of individual liberations.
sems kyi skad cig re re la sems can rgya mtsho mtha' dang dbus med pa dag kyang stobs bcu'i ye shes kyi sar 'dzud pa tshong dpon gyi bu nor bu bzang gis mthong ngo/ /
Sudhana, the head merchant’s son, saw them bringing, in each instant of mind, an ocean of beings, without limit or center, to the level of the ten strengths.
In each moment of thought Sudhana saw infinite masses of sentient beings going through the ten stages;
thos so/ / rnam par dpyad do/ / zhugs so/ / khong du chud do/ / nges par rtogs so/ / rjes su shes so/ / rjes su 'brangs so; ; rjes su zhugs so/ / mnyam pa nyid du byin gyis brlabs te/
He heard them, contemplated them, scrutinized them, comprehended them, understood them, knew them, followed them, fathomed them, and was resolved as to their equality.
he listened, reflected, investigated, discerned, contemplated, approached, followed, entered, and made himself equal thereto,

de ni mtshan mo'i lha mo rab tu dga' ba'i mig 'gro bar rnam par snang ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa kun tu bzang po'i dga' ba shin tu yangs pa'i rgyal mtshan bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang / khyu mchog gi mthu phyung ba'i byin dang / sngon bskal pa mnyam par spyad pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis byin du brlabs pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par smin pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa kun tu bzang po'i snod du gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /

This was because of the night goddess Pramuditanayanajagadvirocanā’s having become an appropriate vessel for the completely good bodhisattva conduct, her supremacy through the miracles of the bodhisattva liberation called the vast banner[1376] of inconceivable, completely good joy, her corresponding practice in the past, her being blessed by the blessings of the tathāgatas, and the ripening of her countless roots of merit.

by the mystical power of the night goddess’s enlightening liberation characterized by the immensity of the inconceivable joy of universal good, by the development of inconceivable roots of goodness through having performed the same practices in the past and having been empowered by the support of the enlightened, and by having become a vessel of universally good enlightening practice.

de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang byang chub sems dpa'i dga' ba'i shugs drag po gangs chen mtsho snang ba chen po rab tu thob pa/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa des/ mtshan mo'i lha mo rab tu dga' ba'i mig 'gro bar rnam par snang ba'i mdun du 'dug ste thal mo sbyar nas/ mtshan mo'i lha mo rab tu dga' ba'i mig 'gro bar rnam par snang ba la tshul dang 'dra ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do; ;

Then Sudhana, the head merchant’s son, who had attained the illumination of an ocean of the power of great bodhisattva joy, who had been blessed by all the tathāgatas in the ten directions, placed his hands together in homage and praised the night goddess Pramuditanayanajagadvirocanā with these appropriate verses:

Then Sudhana, imbued with the light of the ocean of ecstasy of enlightening beings, empowered by the buddhas of the ten directions, stood reverently before the night goddess Pramuditanayanajagadvirocana and sang her praises in such terms:
rgyal ba'i chos rnams shin tu zab/ / de la khyod kyis bskal pa tshad med bslabs/ / bsam pa ji bzhin gzugs rnams kyis/ / 'gro ba kun kyang 'jig rten rim pas bstan/ /
“The Dharma[1377] of the jinas is profound. You trained in it for countless kalpas. In successive forms that accord with dispositions, You pervade all beings and appear in worlds. {1}
For measureless eons you have studied The profound nature of the buddhas, Progressively extending throughout the worlds of the ten directions, Appearing according to the minds of the beings therein.
bdag med mgon med log pa yi/ / 'du shes rtag tu 'khrul pa mkhyen gyur nas/ / rdzu 'phrul rnam pa du ma yis/ / lus dang dbang phyug ston mdzad 'gro ba 'dul/ /
“Knowing that they have no self and no protector, Have incorrect conceptions, and are continually deluded, You guide beings by manifesting bodies and powers Through various kinds of miracles. {2}
Knowing them to have no self, no master, To be always confused by untruth and false ideas, By occult powers you manifest many kinds of bodies And guide sentient beings.
shin tu rims bral rab tu zhi/ / chos sku gnyis med rnam par dag pa mnga'/ / 'gro ba ma lus gnyis gnas pa/ / sprul pa'i sprin sgra 'brug gis rnam par 'dul/ /

“Completely free from fevers, in perfect peace, You have a pure, nondual Dharma body. You guide through the thunder of clouds of emanations All beings, without exception, who are dependent on duality. {3}
Infinite, tranquil, the reality-body Is nondual and pure: Sentient beings clinging to duality You guide by myriad emanations.
phung po khams dang skye mched la/ / khyod ni nam yang mi gnas mi rten te/ / yan lag kun rgyas gzugs mchog dang / / dbang phyug yongs su bsgrags pas 'gro ba 'dul/ /
“You are never dependent, never reliant On the skandhas, āyatanas, and dhātus. You have a perfect form with all limbs complete, And you guide with your roar of supremacy. {4}
While you have no attachment To mind or matter, You guide the world By emanation of perfect forms.
phyi dang nang las rnam par grol/ / gnyis las byung ba'i mtsho las 'phags gyur kyang / 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa'i/ / gzugs brnyan 'gro ba'i rgyud du rab tu ston/ /
“You are liberated internally and externally. You have risen above the ocean of duality, Yet you manifest illusory forms for beings In the infinite ocean of saṃsāra. {5}
Detached from the internal and the external, Having left the ocean of mortality, You manifest infinite reflections In the states of mundane existence.
khyod la g.yo ba mi mnga' ste/ / nam yang rlom sems g.yo ba'i spros mi mnga'/ / 'jig rten spros mos byis pa rnams/ / chos kyi rang bzhin bstan cing 'dul ba mdzad/ /
“You do not vacillate. You are not complicated by pride or hurry. You teach the nature of phenomena And guide the fools in the world who delight in complication. {6}
You have no vacillation, No vain imaginations or false ideas; To the ignorant attached to falsehood you show The inherent nature of things to guide them.
ting 'dzin rgya mtsho kun spyod pas/ / bskal pa mang por rtse gcig thub bzhugs kyang / / phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs mchod don du/ / spu rnams rtse las sprul pa'i sprin kyang 'gyed/ /

“Through remaining in an ocean of samādhis, Your mind is one-pointed for many kalpas, Yet you emit clouds of emanations from your pores So as to make offerings to the sugatas in the ten directions. {7}
Single-minded for many eons On the states of the ocean of all concentrations, To make offerings to buddhas everywhere, you send forth Multitudes of emanations from your pores.
sangs rgyas stobs la 'jug pa'i tshul/ / skad cig re rer mtha' yas thugs su chud/ / sems can bsdu ba'i sbyor ba rnams/ / so so'i rkyen bzhin go bar bgyi bas bstan/ /

“In every single instant of mind, you comprehend The ways of entering into the strengths of the buddhas. According to individual circumstances, you manifest The undertakings that will gather beings[1378] around you. {8}
You enter the way to the powers of buddhas In every moment of thought: Striving to save all beings, You show them incarnations like themselves.
khyod kyis srid pa'i rgya mtsho dag / las kyi rnam bris sna tshogs gzugs gzigs shing / / chos kyi sgrib pa med pa'i lam bstan te/ / sems can kun kyang rnam par sbyong ba mdzad/ /
“You see the oceans of existence And the various forms painted by karma. You purify all beings by showing them The unobscured path of the Dharma. {9}
Observing the ocean of being, Its variety of actions and various forms, Showing the path of nonobstruction by things, You purify sentient beings.
khyod sku mtshan bris rnam dag kyang / / kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa dam pa yis; ; sems can bsam pa'i dbang tshul du/ / khyod ni lha mo'i sku gzugs ston/ /

“Your body is beautified by the signs of a great being, But through the pure, perfectly good conduct, You manifest in the world the form of a goddess In accordance with the dispositions of beings.” {10}
Your body, of splendid appearance, Is purified by the practice of universal good: In command of the minds of beings, You manifest the form of a goddess in the world.

de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang gis/ mtshan mo'i lha mo rab tu dga' ba'i mig 'gro bar rnam par snang ba la tshul dang 'dra ba'i tshigs su bcad pa de dag gis mngon par bstod de 'di skad ces smras so/ /
Having praised the night goddess Pramuditanayanajagadvirocanā with those verses, Sudhana asked,
Having praised the goddess with these verses, Sudhana said to her,
