grong na gnas pa'i sems can rnams la khams gsum pa thams cad las 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir chos ston to/ /
I teach the Dharma so that beings who are in villages will depart from the three realms altogether.
Those in villages I teach in such a way that they may be emancipated from everything in the realms of desire, form, and formlessness.
yul gyi 'dabs na gnas pa'i sems can rnams la nyan thos dang rnag byang chub kyi lam las yang dag par 'da' bar bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa la rab tu dgod par bya ba'i phyir chos ston to/ /
I teach the Dharma so that beings who are in the countryside will surpass the paths of the śrāvakas and pratyekabuddhas and be established on the level of the tathāgatas.
Those in communities I teach in such a way as to lead them beyond the paths of those who strive for individual salvation and set them on the way to buddhahood.
grong rdal na 'khod pa'i sems can rnams la chos kyi rgyal po'i pho brang du gnas par 'gyur ba'i phyir chos ston to/ /
I teach the Dharma so that beings who live in towns will dwell in the palace of the king of the Dharma.
Those in cities I teach in such a way as to reveal the city of the supreme truth.
phyogs mtshams na 'khod pa'i sems can rnams la dus gsum mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes rab tu thob par bya ba'i phyir chos ston to/ /
I teach the Dharma so that beings who live in the intermediate directions will attain the knowledge of the equality of the three times.
Those in the intermediate directions I teach in such a way that they may attain knowledge of the equality of past, present, and future.
phyogs na gnas pa'i sems can rnams la chos thams cad kyi ye shes mngon par shes par bya ba'i phyir chos ston to/ /
I teach the Dharma so that beings who live in the principal directions will know the higher cognition of all phenomena.
Those in the four quarters I teach in such a way that they may realize higher knowledge of all things.
'dod chags la gcig tu dga' ba'i sems can rnams la mi sdug pa'i sgos 'khor ba'i sred pa rnam par bzlog pa'i phyir chos ston to/ /
I teach the Dharma so that beings who delight only in desires will turn away from craving for saṃsāra because of passing through the gateway of its ugliness.
Those whose behavior is governed solely by lust I teach to stop their craving for all mundane pleasures by means of contemplation of impurity.
zhe sdang la spyod pa'i sems can rnams la byams pa chen po'i tshul rgya mtsho la 'jug par bya ba'i phyir chos ston to/ /
I teach the Dharma so that beings who act out of anger will enter an ocean of the ways of great love.
Those who act on hatred I teach in such a way that they many enter the ocean of universal love.
gti mug la spyod pa'i sems can rnams la chos thams cad kyi sgo rgya mtsho rab tu 'byed pa'i ye shes mngon par shes par bya ba'i phyir chos ston to/ /
I teach the Dharma so that beings who act out of ignorance will have the higher cognition of the knowledge that analyzes an ocean of the gateways into all the Dharma.
Those who act on delusion I teach in such a way that they may realize higher knowledge with analytic comprehension of all things.
cha mnyam pa la spyod pa'i sems can rnams la theg pa thams cad kyi smon lam gyi tshul rgya mtshos khyad par du 'gro bar bya ba'i phyir chos ston to/ /
I teach the Dharma so that beings whose conduct is equally that of desire, anger, and ignorance will have the preeminence of an ocean of the ways of aspiration for all the yānas.
Those who act equally on lust, hatred, and delusion I teach in such a way that they may rise above them through the ocean of means of the undertakings of all vehicles of emancipation.
'khor ba'i yul gyi dga' ba'i bsam pa can gyi sems can rnams la 'khor ba'i yul dga' ba rnam par bzlog pa'i phyir chos ston to/ /
I teach the Dharma so that beings whose aspirations are to the sensory field of saṃsāra will turn away from the sensory field of saṃsāra.
Those who are inclined to enjoyment of evanescent mundane objects I teach in such a way as to lead them away from attachment to transient mundane objects.
'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad kyis gtses pa'i sems can rnams la 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad kyis nye bar nyon mongs pa med par bya ba'i phyir chos ston to/ /
I teach the Dharma so that beings who are experiencing all the sufferings of saṃsāra will not be afflicted by any of the sufferings of saṃsāra.
Those who are touched by all the miseries of the mundane whirl I teach in such a way that they may be unaffected by the woes of life and death.
de bzhin gshegs pas 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la mi skye ba'i gnas yang dag par bstan pa'i phyir chos ston to/ /
I teach the Dharma so that beings who are guided by the tathāgatas will be taught the state of birthlessness.
Those who are susceptible to guidance by the enlightened I teach in such a way as to elucidate unborn birth.
phung po la gnas pa'i bsam pa can gyi sems can rnams la gzhi med pa'i chos kyi spyod yul la rnam par spyod par bya ba'i phyir chos ston to/ /
I teach the Dharma so that beings who aspire to remain in the skandhas will dwell in the domain of the Dharma that has no location.
Those who are attached to physical and mental elements I teach in such a way that they may abide in nonreliance.
bsam pa zhum pa'i sems can rnams la lam gyi rgyan gyi khyad par yang dag par bstan par bya ba'i phyir chos ston to/ /
I teach the Dharma so that beings who are discouraged will be taught the preeminent display[1502] of the path.
Those who are cowardly I teach in such a way as to reveal the excellence of the adornments of the path of enlightenment.
mtho ba'i nga rgyal can gyi sems can rnams la chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi bzod pa yang dag par bstan pa'i phyir chos ston to/ /
I teach the Dharma so that beings who have the pride of superiority will be taught the patience of the equality of all phenomena.
To those who are conceited I elucidate acceptance of the equality of all things.
g.yo sgyu'i yul gyi bsam pa dang ldan pa'i sems can rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i bsam pa yongs su dag par bya ba'i phyir chos ston to/ /
I teach the Dharma so that beings who are attracted to the field of deception and deceit will have the pure aspiration of the bodhisattvas.
To those who are prone to deceit and guile I explain the purity of intention of enlightening beings.

de ltar rigs kyi bu/ kho mo ni/ sems can thams cad chos kyi sbyin pas yongs su bsdus shing ngan song gi lam gyi rgyud sdug bsngal ba thams cad nas rnam par bzlog pa dang / lha dang mi'i phun sum tshogs pa dang / bde ba yongs su bstan pa dang / khams gsum pa las gyen du bskyed pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rab tu dgod pa dang / thabs sna tshogs kyis yongs su smin par byed byed pas dga' ba chen po'i shugs rgya mtsho snang ba rab tu thob pas dga' zhing spro la yid bde bar gyur pa'o/ /

“In that way, noble one, I gather all beings through the gift of the Dharma, turn them away from all the sufferings of the paths to the lower realms, teach them the good fortune and happiness of devas and humans, make them ascend from the three realms, establish them in omniscience, and ripen them through various methods so that they will attain the light of a powerful ocean of great happiness and thereby be joyful, delighted, and happy.

“In this way I take care of all sentient beings by giving teaching. Leading them away from all miseries and paths leading to unhappiness, showing them the happiness of human and celestial states, freeing them from the dominion of the realms of desire, form, and formlessness, leading them to omniscience, developing them to maturity by various means, I rejoice, exult, become glad at heart, having achieved manifestation of the ocean of energy of great joy.

gzhan yang rigs kyi bu/ kho mo ni/ phyogs dang phyogs mtshams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho la rnam par lta zhing smon lam rgya mtsho la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' lus sna tshogs rnam par dag pa
“Moreover, noble one, I see the ocean of the assemblies of bodhisattvas in the principal and intermediate directions, bodhisattvas who have various pure bodies and engage in an ocean of prayers;

“Furthermore, as I observe the oceans of assemblies of enlightening beings in all directions, I generate oceans of energy of various joys in the enlightening beings carrying out various vows, enlightening beings with variously purified bodies,
'od kyi dkyil 'khor sna tshogs kyi rgyan dang ldan pa/
who are adorned by various auras;
with various auras of light,
'od zer dang 'od kyi dkyil 'khor kha dog mtha' yas pa rab tu 'gyed pa/
who radiate light rays and auras of infinite colors;
radiating auras of light beams of infinite colors,
thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi tshul rgya mtsho sna tshogs la zhugs pa'i ye shes snang ba can/
who have the light of wisdom that enters an ocean of the various ways of omniscience;
illumined by knowledge penetrating oceans of various ways to omniscience,
ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho sna tshogs la zhugs pa;
who have entered into an ocean of various samādhis;
plunged into oceans of various concentrations,
rnam par 'phrul pa sna tshogs kyi yul dang ldan pa/
who possess a range of various miraculous manifestations;
manifesting various occult powers,
dbyangs kyi yan lag dang / skad rgya mtsho sna tshogs kyi dbyangs dang ldan pa/
who speak in an ocean of various voices and languages;
speaking in various languages,
rgyan sna tshogs kyis rnam par klubs pa'i lus can/
who have bodies beautified by various adornments;
variously adorned,
de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul sna tshogs la zhugs pa/
who have entered the various ways of the tathāgatas;
plunged into various principles of buddhahood,
zhing rgya mtsho 'byams klas pa sna tshogs su zhugs pa'i lus dang ldan pa/
who have bodies that enter the vast extent of the ocean of various realms;
gone to various lands,
sangs rgyas rgya mtsho sna tshogs la zhugs pa/
who have entered an ocean of various buddhas;
seeing various multitudes of buddhas,
tha dad pa yang dag par shes pa rgya mtsho sna tshogs la zhugs pa/
who have realized an ocean of various discernments;
imbued with oceans of various intellectual capacities,
de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par thar pa dang / ye shes kyi yul sna tshogs kyis snang bar gyur pa/
who have illuminated the range of the various liberations and wisdoms of the tathāgatas;
aware of the sphere of knowledge of various liberations of buddhas,
ye shes rgya mtsho sna tshogs kyi snang ba rab tu thob pa/
who have attained the illumination of an ocean of the various wisdoms;
encompassing oceans of various knowledges,
ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho sna tshogs kyi tshul la rnam par spyod pa/
who engage in the ways of an ocean of various samādhis;
dwelling in various methods of concentration,
chos sna tshogs kyi rnam par thar pa'i gzhal med khang rnam par rtse ba'i yul dang ldan pa/
who possess the field of play in the divine palaces[1503] of the various liberations of the Dharma;
freely employing various doctrines, liberations, and disciplines,
thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sgo sna tshogs le mngon du gnas pa/
who face the various gateways into omniscience;
entering various doors to omniscience,
chos kyi dbyings sna tshogs kyi nam mkha'i rgyan dang ldan pa/
who have the various displays of the space of the realm of the Dharma;
variously adorning the sky of the cosmos,
rgyan sna tshogs kyi sprin gyis nam mkha' rgyas par 'gengs pa/
who pervade all space with clouds of various displays;
filling the sky with clouds of various supernal manifestations,
'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho sna tshogs la rnam par lta ba/
who look upon the oceans of the various assemblies of followers;
observing various communities,
'jig rten gyi khams sna tshogs nas 'dus pa/
who gather together[1504] from different worlds;
gathered joyfully in various worlds,
sangs rgyas kyi zhing sna tshogs 'byams klas par rjes su 'dong ngo/ /
who go to the entire extent of the various buddha realms;
gone to various buddha-lands,
phyogs rgya mtsho sna tshogs nas yongs su 'dus pa/
who gather from the ocean of various directions;
assembled in various places,
de bzhin gshegs pa tha dad pas bkye ba/
sent forth by buddhas,
de bzhin gshegs pa tha dad pa'i zhabs kyi drung nas lhags pa/
who come to be at the feet of various tathāgatas;
leaving the presence of various buddhas
byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs sna tshogs kyi 'khor dang ldan pa/
who have retinues of various assemblies of bodhisattvas;
in company with groups of enlightening beings,
rgyan sna tshogs kyi sprin gyi char rab tu 'bebs pa/
who send down a rain from clouds of various displays;
showering rain from clouds of various adornments,
de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul sna tshogs la zhugs pa/
who have entered the various ways of the tathāgatas;
entering into the systems of various buddhas,
de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos rgya mtsho sna tshogs la rnam pa spyod pa/
who practice the ocean of the various Dharmas of the tathāgatas;
contemplating the oceans of teachings of various buddhas,
ye shes sna tshogs rgya mtsho la zhugs pa/
who have entered an ocean of various wisdoms;
plunged into various oceans of knowledge,
rgyan gyi snying po sna tshogs can gyi stan la 'khod pa rnams kyi dga' ba sna tshogs kyi shugs rgya mtsho yongs su bskyed de/
and who are seated upon thrones that have a variety of adornments.
sitting in the midst of various magnificent arrays.
de dag dga' ba sna tshogs kyi shugs rgya mtsho yongs su skyes nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtshor 'dong ste/
Those enlightening beings, filled with various joys, enter the oceans of assemblies of buddhas,
de dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs tshad med pa rjes su sems pas kyang dga' ba'i shugs chen po rgya mtsho yongs su 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /
Seeing them, I feel an ocean of various powerful joys.
see them, and contemplate them; as they meditate on the infinity of the powers of buddhas, floods of great joy arise in them.

rigs kyi bu/ gzhan yang kho mo ni/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi gzugs kyi sku yongs su dag pa mtshan gyis rab tu brgyan pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mthong nas dga' ba chen po dang / mos shing nyams bde ba rab tu 'thob ste/

“Moreover, noble one, I see the inconceivable, completely pure form body of the Bhagavat Vairocana, which is adorned by the physical signs of a great being, and attain a great joy, delight, and happiness.
“Furthermore, perceiving the inconceivable purity of the form body of Vairocana Buddha, adorned by the marks of greatness, I experience exalted joy and serenity.

sems kyi skad cig re re la'ang 'od kyi dkyil 'khor chos kyi dbyings ltar yangs pa/ kha dog rgya mtsho mtha' dang dbus med par snang ba la lta zhing / sems kyi skad cig re re la dga' ba chen po'i shugs rgya mtsho rab tu 'thob bo/ /

“I see, in each instant of mind, his aura of light, which is as vast as the realm of phenomena and is an ocean of colors without limit or center, and in each instant I attain an ocean of the power of great joy.
Observing his array of lights, vast as the cosmos, moment to moment manifesting an infinitely varied ocean of colors, in each moment of consciousness I experience floods of great joy.

rigs kyi bu/ gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku'i ba spu'i sgo re re nas kyang 'od zer chen po sangs rgya kyi zhing mtha' dang dbus med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung ste/ 'od zer re re zhing yang 'od zer rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'khor dang ldan pas chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal rab tu zhi bar mdzad pa mthong zhing sems kyi skad cig re re la dga' ba chen po'i shugs rgya mtsho rab tu 'thob bo/ /

“Moreover, noble one, I see that from each pore on the body of the Bhagavat Vairocana shine great rays of light as numerous as the atoms in an extent of buddha realms that has no limit and no center. Each of those light rays is accompanied by an ocean of light rays that are as numerous as the atoms in endless buddha realms, and they fill the entire realm of phenomena and cause the sufferings of all beings to cease. Seeing that, in each instant I experience an ocean of the power of great joy.

“Also, seeing as many oceans of great beams of light as atoms in infinite buddha-lands emanate from each pore of Vairocana Buddha’s body, each beam of light accompanied by as many oceans of light beams as atoms in infinite buddha-lands, pervading all buddha-universes and extinguishing the suffering of all beings, in each moment of consciousness I experience floods of great joy.

rigs kyi bu/ gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbu dang / sku phrag pa gnyis kyi lhun las sems kyi skad cig re re la rin po che thams cad kyi 'od 'phro ba'i ri'i sprin/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 'byung zhing chos kyi dbyings rgya mtsho thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pa mthong nas dga' ba chen po'i shugs rgya mtsho shin tu yangs pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /

“Moreover, noble one, I see that in each instant of mind, from the head and shoulders of the Bhagavat Vairocana there come clouds, as numerous as the atoms in all buddha realms, of mountains of light rays from all jewels, and they fill the entire realm of phenomena. Seeing that, in each instant I attain an ocean of the power of great joy.

“Also, seeing massive clouds of lights the color of all jewels, as many as atoms in all buddha-lands, emerging from Vairocana’s head moment to moment, pervading all universes, I experience great floods of joy.

rigs kyi bu/ gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku'i ba spu'i sgo re re nas sems kyis skad cig re re la kha dog dri zhim po dang / 'od zer sna tshogs can gyi sprin/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 'byung zhing sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pa mthong nas dga' ba chen po'i shugs rgya mtsho shin tu yangs pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /

“Moreover, noble one, I see that from each pore on the body of the Bhagavat Vairocana, in each instant of mind, come clouds, as numerous as the atoms in all buddha realms, of various colors,[1505] scents, and light rays, and they fill all the buddha realms. Seeing that, in each instant I attain an ocean of the power of great joy.

“Also, seeing multitudes of various fragrant lights, as numerous as atoms in all buddha-lands, emanating from each pore of Vairocana’s body in each moment of thought, I experience great floods of joy.

rigs kyi bu/ gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku la rnam par bltas na/ sems kyi skad cig re re la mtshan re re nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs mtshan gyis rab tu brgyan pa'i sprin/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung ste 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pa mthong nas dga' ba chen po'i shugs rgya mtsho shin tu yangs pa rab tu thob bo/ /

“Moreover, noble one, when I gaze upon the body of the Bhagavat Vairocana, in each instant of mind, from each of his physical signs of a great being come clouds, as numerous as the atoms in all buddha realms, of the form bodies of tathāgatas adorned by the signs, and they fill the entire ocean of world realms. Seeing that, in each instant I attain an ocean of the power of great joy.

“Also, as I observe Vairocana’s body, seeing multitudes of images of Buddha, adorned with the marks of greatness, as numerous as atoms in all buddha-lands, emanating from each of the Buddha’s marks of greatness in each moment of thought, I experience great floods of joy.

rigs kyi bu/ gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das rnam pa snang mdzad kyi sku'i dpe byad bzang po re re las sems kyi skad cig re re la de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa'i sku dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus shin tu 'bar ba'i sprin/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung ste sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad rgyas par 'gengs shing / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbyangs su sgrog pa'i 'brug sgra 'byin pa mthong nas dga' ba chen po'i shugs rgya mtsho shin tu yangs pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /

“Moreover, noble one, from the features of a great being on the body of the Bhagavat Vairocana, in each instant of mind, from each of his physical signs of a great being come clouds, as numerous as the atoms in all buddha realms, of the emanation bodies[1506] of tathāgatas brightly adorned by the eighty features, and they fill all the buddha realms and roar out the thunder of the sound of the wheel of the Dharma. Seeing that, in each instant I attain an ocean of the power of great joy.

“Also, seeing multitudes of mystically projected bodies of Buddha, shining with the eighty embellishments of greatness, as numerous as atoms in all buddha-lands, emanating from each of the Buddha’s physical embellishments in each moment of thought, I experience great floods of joy.

rigs kyi bu/ gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku la rnam par bltas nas/ sems kyi skad cig re re la ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas sangs rgyas rnam par 'phrul pa'i sku dang po byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa dang bcas/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam rnam par dag pa'i rgyan dang bcas/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa yongs su gnon pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang bcas pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 'byung ba mthong nas dga' ba chen po'i shugs rgya mtsho shin tu yangs pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /

“Moreover, noble one, when I gaze upon the body of the Bhagavat Vairocana, in each instant of mind, from all the pores on his body come manifested bodies that make the first aspiration to enlightenment, that have the display of the pure path of the perfections and ascend the bodhisattva bhūmis, and that are as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms. Seeing that, in each instant I attain an ocean of the power of great joy.

“Also, as I observe Vairocana’s body, seeing multitudes of Buddha’s spiritual manifestations, as numerous as atoms in untold buddha-lands, emanate from each pore in each moment of thought, including manifestations of the Buddha’s first inspiration, purification of the six transcendent ways, and progress through the stages of enlightenment, I experience great floods of joy.

rigs kyi bu/ gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku las sems kyi skad cig re re la lha'i dbang po'i lus kyi sprin/ lha'i dbang po'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang bcas pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung zhing

“Moreover, noble one, from the body of the Bhagavat Vairocana, in each instant of mind, come clouds of bodies of a lord of the devas, together with the miraculous manifestations of a lord of the devas, and they are as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms,
“Also, as I watch Vairocana’s body, seeing multitudes of all kinds of beings, celestial, preternatural, and human, as numerous as atoms in untold buddha-lands,…

'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rgyas par bkang ste lha'i dbang po'i lus yongs su bstan pas 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la mngon du gnas shing chos ston pa mthong nas dga' ba chen po'i shugs rgya mtsho shin tu yangs pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /
fill all world realms, manifest the body of a lord of the devas in front of beings, and teach them the Dharma. Seeing that, in each instant I attain an ocean of the power of great joy.

rigs kyi bu/ gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku las sems kyi skad cig re re la klu'i dbang po'i lus kyi sprin/ klu'i dbang po'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang bcas pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung zhing 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rgyas par bkang ste klu'i dbang po'i lus yongs su bstan pas 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la mngon du gnas shing chos ston pa mthong nas dga' ba chen po'i shugs rgya mtsho shin tu yangs pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /

“Moreover, noble one, from the body of the Bhagavat Vairocana, in each instant of mind, come clouds of bodies of a lord of the nāgas, together with the miraculous manifestations of a lord of the nāgas, and they are as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, fill all world realms, manifest the body of a lord of the nāgas in front of beings, and teach them the Dharma. Seeing that, in each instant I attain an ocean of the power of great joy.

rigs kyi bu/ gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku la rnam par bltas na/ sems kyi skad cig re re la ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas gnod sbyin gyi dbang po'i lus kyi sprin/ gnod sbyin gyi dbang po'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang bcas pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung zhing chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par bkang ste gnod sbyin gyi lus yongs su bstan pas 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la mngon du gnas shing chos ston pa mthong nas dga' ba chen po'i shugs rgya mtsho shin tu yangs pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /

“Moreover, noble one, from the body of the Bhagavat Vairocana, in each instant of mind, come clouds of bodies of a lord of the yakṣas, together with the miraculous manifestations of a lord of the yakṣas, and they are as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, fill all world realms, manifest the body of a lord of the yakṣas in front of beings, and teach them the Dharma. Seeing that, in each instant I attain an ocean of the power of great joy.

rigs kyi bu/ gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku la rnam par bltas na/ sems kyi skad cig re re la ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas dri za'i dbang po'i lus kyi sprin/ dri za'i dbang po'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang bcas pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung zhing chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par bkang ste dri za'i dbang po'i lus yongs su bstan pas 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la mngon du gnas shing chos ston pa mthong nas dga' ba chen po'i shugs rgya mtsho shin tu yangs pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /

“Moreover, noble one, from the body of the Bhagavat Vairocana, in each instant of mind, come clouds of bodies of a lord of the gandharvas, together with the miraculous manifestations of a lord of the gandharvas, and they are as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, fill all world realms, manifest the body of a lord of the gandharvas in front of beings, and teach them the Dharma. Seeing that, in each instant I attain an ocean of the power of great joy.

rigs kyi bu/ gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku la rnam par bltas na/ sems kyi skad cig re re la ba spu'i sgo re re nas lha ma yin gyi dbang po'i lus kyi sprin; lha ma yin gyi dbang po'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang bcas pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung zhing 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rgyas par bkang ste lha ma yin gyi dbang po'i lus yongs su bstan pas 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la mngon par gnas shing chos ston pa mthong nas dga' ba chen po'i shugs rgya mtsho shin tu yangs pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /

“Moreover, noble one, from the body of the Bhagavat Vairocana, in each instant of mind, come clouds of bodies of a lord of the asuras, together with the miraculous manifestations of a lord of the asuras, and they are as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, fill all world realms, manifest the body of a lord of the asuras in front of beings, and teach them the Dharma. Seeing that, in each instant I attain an ocean of the power of great joy.

rigs kyi bu/ gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku la rnam par bltas na/ sems kyi skad cig re re la ba spu'i sgo re re nas nam mkha' lding gi dbang po'i lus kyi sprin/ nam mkha' lding gi dbang po'i rnam pa 'phrul ba dang bcas pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung zhing 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rgyas par bkang ste nam mkha' lding gi dbang po'i lus yongs su bstan pas 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la mngon du gnas shing chos ston pa mthong nas dga' ba chen po'i shugs rgya mtsho shin tu yangs pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /

“Moreover, noble one, from the body of the Bhagavat Vairocana, in each instant of mind, come clouds of bodies of a lord of the garuḍas, together with the miraculous manifestations of a lord of the garuḍas, and they are as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, fill all world realms, manifest the body of a lord of the garuḍas in front of beings, and teach them the Dharma. Seeing that, in each instant I attain an ocean of the power of great joy.

gzhan yang rigs kyi bu/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku la rnam par bltas na/ sems kyi skad cig re re la ba spu'i sgo re re nas mi 'am ci'i dbang po'i lus kyi sprin/ mi 'am ci'i dbang po'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang bcas pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung zhing chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par bkang ste mi 'am ci'i dbang po'i lus yongs su bstan pas 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la mngon du gnas shing chos ston pa mthong nas dga' ba chen po'i shugs rgya mtsho shin tu yangs pa rab tu 'thob bo; ;

“Moreover, noble one, from the body of the Bhagavat Vairocana, in each instant of mind, come clouds of bodies of a lord of the kinnaras, together with the miraculous manifestations of a lord of the kinnaras, and they are as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, fill all world realms, manifest the body of a lord of the kinnaras in front of beings, and teach them the Dharma. Seeing that, in each instant I attain an ocean of the power of great joy.

rigs kyi bu/ gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku la rnam par bltas na/ sems kyi skad cig re re la ba spu'i sgo re re nas lto 'phye chen po'i lus kyi sprin/ lto 'phye chen po'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang bcas pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung zhing chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par bkang ste lto 'phye chen po'i dbang po'i lus yongs su bstan pas 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la mngon du gnas shing chos ston pa mthong nas dga' ba chen po'i shugs rgya mtsho shin tu yangs pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /

“Moreover, noble one, from the body of the Bhagavat Vairocana, in each instant of mind, come clouds of bodies of a lord of the mahoragas, together with the miraculous manifestations of a lord of the mahoragas, and they are as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, fill all world realms, manifest the body of a lord of the mahoragas in front of beings, and teach them the Dharma. Seeing that, in each instant I experience an ocean of the power of great joy.

rigs kyi bu/ gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku la rnam pa bltas na/ sems kyi skad cig re re la ba spu'i sgo re re nas mi'i dbang po'i lus kyi sprin/ mi'i dbang po'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang bcas pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung zhing chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par bkang ste mi'i dbang po'i lus yongs su bstan pas 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la mngon du gnas shing chos ston pa mthong nas dga' ba chen po'i shugs rgya mtsho shin tu yangs pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /

“Moreover, noble one, from the body of the Bhagavat Vairocana, in each instant of mind, come clouds of bodies of a lord of humans, together with the miraculous manifestations of a lord of humans, and they are as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, fill all world realms, manifest the body of a lord of humans in front of beings, and teach them the Dharma. Seeing that, in each instant I attain an ocean of the power of great joy.

… emanating from each of Vairocana’s pores in each moment of thought, along with their characteristic atmospheres of projected auras, going throughout all worlds, appearing to those sentient beings who are suited to being guided by manifestations of such and such particular forms of being, and expounding the Teaching to them, I experience great floods of joy.

rigs kyi bu/ gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das rnam pa snang mdzad kyi sku la rnam par bltas na/ sems kyi skad cig re re la ba spu'i sgo re re nas tshangs pa'i dbang po'i lus kyi sprin/ tshangs pa'i dbang po'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i yul dang bcas pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung zhing chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par bkang ste tshangs pa'i dbang po'i lus yongs su bstan pas 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la mngon du gnas shing tshangs pa'i sgra skad dang / dbyangs kyis chos ston pa mthong nas sems kyi skad cig re re la thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i dga' ba chen po'i shugs rgya mtsho chos kyi dbyings ltar rgya che zhing shin tu yangs pa rab tu 'thob ste/

“Moreover, noble one, from the body of the Bhagavat Vairocana, in each instant of mind, come clouds of bodies of a lord of the Brahmās, together with the miraculous manifestations of a lord of the Brahmās, and they are as numerous as the atoms in countless buddha realms, fill all world realms, manifest the body of a lord of the Brahmās in front of beings, and with the voice of a Brahmā teach them the Dharma. Seeing that, in each instant I attain an ocean of the power of the great joy of omniscience that is as extremely vast and extensive as the realm of phenomena.

“And as I watch Vairocana’s body, seeing multitudes of Brahma gods, as numerous as atoms in untold buddha-lands, emanating from each pore in each moment of thought, along with the miraculous projections of Brahma gods, appearing to sentient beings in all universes who are suited to being guided by manifestations in the form of Brahma gods and expounding the Teaching to them with the voice of Brahma, in each moment of awareness I experience great floods of joy of cosmic dimensions concomitant with all-knowledge.

sngon thob par gyur pa 'thob par 'gyur ba ma yin no/ / sngon khong du chud pa khong du chud par 'gyur ba ma yin no/ / sngon zhugs pa la 'jug par 'gyur ba ma yin no/ / sngon khyab par gyur pa khyab par 'gyur ba ma yin no/ / sngon mthong ba mthong bar 'gyur ba ma yin no/ / sngon thos pa thos par 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /

“I attain what I have not previously attained. I realize what I have not previously realized. I comprehend what I have not previously comprehended. I permeate what I have not previously permeated. I see what I have not previously seen. I hear what I have not previously heard.

“And so I attain what I have never attained before, understand what I have never understood before, penetrate what I have never penetrated before, pervade what I have never pervaded before, see what I have never seen before, and hear what I have never heard before.

de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos kyi rang bzhin gyi mtshan nyid yongs su shes pa ltar na/ chos thams cad mtshan nyid gcig pa'ang ci rob ma yin te/ dus gsum gyi tshul 'jug pa'i sgor zhugs na/ chos thams cad kyang mtha' dang dbus med par bstan du yod pa ste/

“Why is that? The characteristic of the nature of phenomena being known, all phenomena have a single characteristic, and, also, as all phenomena appear in the three times, they are taught to be without limit or center.
Why? All things are to be completely known by the nature of things as being of one characteristic at all times, while yet manifest in an endless variety as all things.
'di ni/ rigs kyi bu; byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa'i tshul dga' ba yangs pa'i shugs 'byung bas sems kyi skad cig rnam par brgyan pa'i tshul rgya mtsho'i snang ba ste/
“This is the range of the ocean of means of the enlightening liberation of supernal manifestations of a moment of thought producing immense floods of joy.
rigs kyi bu; rnam par thar pa 'di ni/ chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul rgya mtsho la 'jug pa'i phyir mtha' dang dbus med pa'o/ /
“Noble one, this bodhisattva liberation has no limit or center because it comprehends the ocean of the ways of the realm of the Dharma.
This liberation is infinite because it goes into the ocean of principles of the cosmos.
rnam par thar pa 'di ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du sems bskyed pa dang tha mi dad pas zad mi shes pa'o/ /
“This liberation is imperishable because it is no different from the aspiration to omniscience.
This liberation is inexhaustible because it is inseparable from the determination for omniscience.
rnam par thar pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes kyi mig gis rnam par shes par bya ba yin pas mu med pa'o/ /
“This liberation is unlimited because it is known by the wisdom eyes of the bodhisattvas.
This liberation is endless because it is perceived by the eye of enlightening beings.
rnam par thar pa 'di ni/ chos kyi dbyings tha mi dad pa'i tshul gyis gtan du rgyas par 'gengs pas gting med ba'o/ /
“This liberation is unfathomable[1507] because it completely and fully pervades the undifferentiated way of the realm of Dharma.
This liberation is peerless, because it pervades the total cosmos.
rnam par thar pa 'di ni/ dmigs pa gcig tu rnam par 'phrul pa thams cad yongs su 'du bar byed pas sgo thams cad dang ldan pa'i/ /
“This liberation has all Dharma gateways because it includes all miraculous manifestations within a single object.
This liberation is all-sided, because it encompasses all miracles in a single object.
rnam par thar pa 'di ni/ chos thams cad kyi lus dang mi gnyis par spyod pas don yod pa'o; ;
“This liberation is beneficial because it is united with the body of the entire Dharma.
This liberation is unfailing, because of practicing the nonduality of all bodies of reality.
rnam par thar pa 'di ni/ sgyu ma lta bur yongs su spyod pas ma skyes pa'o/ /
“This liberation is unborn because its practice is like an illusion.
This liberation is unborn, because its practice is like magic.
rnam par thar pa 'di ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi smon lam gyi gzugs brnyan du byung bas gzugs brnyan lta bu'o/ /
“This liberation is like a reflection because it arises as a reflection of the prayer for omniscience.
This liberation is like a reflection, because it arises as a reflection of the vow for omniscience.
rnam par thar pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pas shin tu sprul pa'i phyir sprul pa lta bu'o/ /
“This liberation is like an emanation because it is an emanation of bodhisattva conduct.
This liberation is like an emanation, because it emanates the practices of enlightening beings.
rnam par thar pa 'di ni/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi rten du gyur pas sa chen po lta bu'o/ /
“This liberation is like the great earth because it is a support for all beings.
This liberation is like earth, because it is the refuge of all sentient beings.
rnam par thar pa 'di ni/ 'gro ba thams cad snying rje chen pos mngon par rlan par byed pas chu'i phung po lta bu'o/ /
“This liberation is like a mass of water because it saturates all beings with compassion.
This liberation is like water, because it rains great compassion on all sentient beings.
rnam par thar pa 'di ni; sems can thams cad kyi sred pa'i rlan yongs su skem pas me'i phung po lta bu'o/ /
“This liberation is like a mass of fire because it dries up the liquid of craving in all beings.
This liberation is like fire, because it ends the cravings of all sentient beings.
rnam pa thar pa 'di ni/ sems can thams cad thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du rab tu ston pa'i phyir rlung gi phung po lta bu'o/ /
“This liberation is like a mass of air because it reveals[1508] omniscience to all beings.
This liberation is like wind, because it directs all sentient beings to omniscience.
rnam par thar pa 'di ni/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi yon tan gyi rgyan gyi gzhi yin pas rgya mtsho lta bu'o/ /
“This liberation is like an ocean because it is the basis for the adornment of good qualities for all beings.
This liberation is like the ocean, because it is a repository of ornaments of virtues for all sentient beings.
rnam par thar pa 'di ni/ chos thams cad kyi ye shes rin po che rgya mtsho las mngon par 'phags pas ri rab ri'i rgyal po lta bu'o/ /
“This liberation is like Meru, the king of mountains, because it rises up from the ocean of the precious knowledge of the entire Dharma.
This liberation is like the polar mountain, because it rises out of the ocean of jewels of knowledge of all things.
rnam par thar pa 'di ni/ chos thams cad kyi rnam par thar pa'i gzhal med khang rnam par skyod pa'i phyir rnam par skyod pa'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor lta bu'o/ /
“This liberation is like the circle of the wind because it is the practice of the aerial palace of liberation of all the Dharma.[1509]
rnam par thar pa 'di ni/ dus gsum du byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa thams cad kyi go 'byed pas nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /
“This liberation is like space because it provides room for all the miraculous manifestations of the tathāgatas who appear in the three times.
This liberation is like the sky, being the space in which the miracles of the buddhas of past, present, and future take place.
rnam par thar pa 'di ni/ sems can thams cad la chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon du 'bebs pas sprin chen po lta bu'o/ /
“This liberation is like a great cloud because it sends down a rain of Dharma on all beings.
This liberation is like a great cloud, showering the rain of the cloud of the Teaching on all sentient beings.
rnam par thar pa 'di ni/ sems can thams cad kyi mi shes pa'i mun nag rnam par sel pas nyi ma lta bu'o; ;
“This liberation is like the sun because it dispels the darkness of ignorance in all beings.
This liberation is like the sun, dispelling the darkness of nescience of all sentient beings.
rnam par thar pa 'di ni/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi rgya mtsho chen pos shin tu sgrub pa'i phyir zla ba lta bu'o/ /
“This liberation is like the moon because it is produced by a great ocean of merit and wisdom.
This liberation is like the moon, imbued with an ocean of goodness and knowledge.
rnam par thar pa 'di ni/ thams cad du song ba'i phyir de bzhin nyid lta bu'o/ /
“This liberation is like the true nature because it is omnipresent.
This liberation is like arrival at Thusness, reaching everywhere.
rnam par thar pa 'di ni/ las kyi chos kyis shin tu sprul pa'i phyir rang gi grib ma lta bu'o/ /
“This liberation is like one’s shadow because it is emanated through the Dharma of karma.
This liberation is like one’s own reflection, being produced by rightness of action.
rnam par thar pa 'di ni/ sems can gyi mos pa ji lta ba bzhin du chos kyi sgra rab tu sgrog pas brag ca lta bu'o/ /
“This liberation is like an echo because it resounds the words of the Dharma in accordance with the dispositions of beings.
This liberation is like an echo, thundering the voice of all truths in accord with inclinations.
rnam par thar pa 'di ni/ bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du sems can thams cad kyis rnam par dmigs par byed pa'i phyir gzugs brnyan lta bu'o/ /
“This liberation is like a reflection because it is perceived by all beings in accordance with their dispositions.
This liberation is like a reflection, communicating to all sentient beings according to their mentalities.
rnam par thar pa 'di ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul pa'i me tog shin tu rgyas pa'i phyir shing gi rgyal po lta bu'o/ /
“This liberation is like the king of trees because it blossoms with the miraculous manifestations of all the buddhas.
This liberation is like a great tree, flowering with the miracles of all buddhas.
rnam par thar pa 'di ni/ mi shigs pa'i chos can yin pas rdo rje lta bu'o/ /
“This liberation is like a vajra because it has the quality of indestructibility.
This liberation is like diamond, its nature unbreakable.
rnam par thar pa 'di ni/ rnam par 'phrul pa mtha' dang dbus med pa rgya mtsho mngon par sgrub pas nor bu yid bzhin rin po che'i rgyal po lta bu'o/ /
“This liberation is like the king of wish-fulfilling jewels because it creates a limitless, centerless ocean of miraculous manifestations.
This liberation is like a wish-fulfilling jewel, accomplishing an endless variety of miracles.
rnam par thar pa 'di ni/ dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul pa rnam par dmigs par bya ba la sgrib pa med pas rin po che'i rgyal po dri ma med pa'i snying po lta bu'o/ /
“This liberation is like the essence of a stainless king of jewels because of its unobscured perception of the miraculous manifestations of the tathāgatas in the three times.
This liberation is like a flawless jewel, showing the miracles of the buddhas of past, present, and future without interference.
rnam par thar pa 'di ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo mnyam pa nyid du sgrog pas nor bu rin po che dga' ba'i rgyal mtshan lta bu ste/
“This liberation is like the precious jewel of a banner of happiness because it emits the sound of the Dharma wheels of all buddhas equally.
This liberation is like a jewel of happiness, equally producing the voice of the teachings of all buddhas.

rigs kyi bu/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa dga' ba yangs pa'i shugs shin tu yangs pa 'byung bas sems kyi skad cig rnam par brgyan pa 'di ni/ dpe tshad med pa rnam par dgod pa'i rjes su 'brang bas bstan par bya'o/ /
“Thus, noble one, the bodhisattva liberation the display in each instant of mind of the arising of the power of vast delight is taught by following an array of limitless examples.”
This liberation is illustrated by countless such similes.”

de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang gis mtshan mo'i lha mo sgra rgya mtsho rab tu zhi pa dang ldan pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ / 'phags ma lha mo/ ji ltar nan tan du bgyis na/ byang chub sems dpas de lta bu'i rnam par thar pa de yongs su 'grub par 'gyur/
Then Sudhana, the head merchant’s son, said to the night goddess Praśantarutasāgaravatī, “Āryā, goddess, how does a bodhisattva practice in order to accomplish such a liberation?”
Then Sudhana asked the night goddess, “How did you manage to attain such a liberation?”

smras pa/ rigs kyi bu/ bcu po 'di dag ni/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshogs chen po chos yangs pa dang ldan pa/ rnam par rgya chen po/ gsal ba chen po/ snang ba chen po/ 'od chen po/ byin chen po/ rnam par dbye ba chen po/ 'byung ba chen po/ phun sum tshogs pa chen po ste/ de dag la nan tan du byed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rnam par thar pa 'di lta bu phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba dag go/

She answered, “Noble one, there are these ten: a great accumulation, a great abundance of qualities, a great vastness, a great brightness, a great illumination, a great brilliance, a great portion,[1510] a great share, a great becoming, and the great fortune of the bodhisattvas. “If bodhisattvas practice them, they will attain a perfect result such as this liberation.

She replied, “There are ten great provisions of enlightening beings, great accomplishments, great encompassing practices, great illuminations, great manifestations of power, great good fortunes, great heritages, great capacities, great powers, by the practice of which enlightening beings attain this liberation.
bcu gang zhe na/
“What are these ten?
What are the ten?
'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pa sems can rgya mtsho thams cad kyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su tshim par byed pa la zhugs pa ni/ rgya chen po'i chos so/ /
(1) Engaging in the generosity of a bodhisattva, which satisfies all beings in accordance with their aspirations, is a vast quality.
Enlightening beings’ great encompassing practice of giving, devoted to satisfying all sentient beings according to their wishes;
byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho la 'jug pa'i nan tan la zhugs pa ni/ rgya chen po'i chos so/ /
(2) Engaging in the practice of the correct conduct of a bodhisattva, which enters an ocean of the qualities of the tathāgatas, is a vast quality.
enlightening beings’ great encompassing practice of appropriate conduct, devoted to embodying the virtues of all buddhas;
byang chub sems dpa'i bzod pa chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin nges par rtogs par bya ba la zhugs pa ni/ rgya chen po'i chos so/ /
(3) Engaging in the patience of a bodhisattva, which realizes the nature of all phenomena, is a vast quality.
enlightening beings’ great encompassing practice of forbearance, devoted to contemplating the nature of all things;
byang chub sems dpa'i brtson 'grus thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yang dag par brtsams pa las phyir mi ldog pa la zhugs pa ni/ rgya chen po'i chos so/ /
(4) Engaging in the diligence of a bodhisattva, which undertakes attaining omniscience, is an extensive quality.
enlightening beings’ great encompassing practice of vigor, devoted to undertaking the attainment of omniscience without turning back;
byang chub sems dpa'i bsam gtan sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba rab tu zhi bar bya ba la zhugs pa ni/ rgya chen po'i chos so/ /
(5) Engaging in the meditation of a bodhisattva, which pacifies the torment of the kleśas in all beings, is an extensive quality.
enlightening beings’ great encompassing practice of meditation, devoted to extinguishing the fire of afflictions of all sentient beings;
byang chub sems dpa'i shes rab chos rgya mtsho thams cad yongs su shes par bya ba la zhugs pa ni/ rgya chen po'i chos so/ /
(6) Engaging in the wisdom of a bodhisattva, which is knowing the entire ocean of the Dharma, is an extensive quality.
enlightening beings’ great encompassing practice of wisdom, devoted to higher knowledge of all things;
byang chub sems dpa'i thabs sems can rgya mtsho thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang gdul ba la zhugs pa ni/ rgya chen po'i chos so/ /
(7) Engaging in the methods of a bodhisattva, which guides and ripens the entire ocean of beings, is an extensive quality.
enlightening beings’ great encompassing practice of skill in means, devoted to guiding all sentient beings to perfection;

byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa'i bskal par sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyad pa'i phyir zhing rgya mtsho thams cad la zhugs pa ni/ rgya chen po'i chos so/ /

(8) Engaging in the prayer of a bodhisattva, which is entering the entire ocean of realms in order to perform bodhisattva conduct in all buddha realms throughout the endless future kalpas, is an extensive quality.
enlightening beings’ great encompassing practice of vows, going to all lands to go into the practice of enlightening beings for all time in all lands;

byang chub sems dpa'i stobs sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du skad cig re re la mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar yongs su bstan pa rgyun mi gcad pa'i phyir chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul rgya mtsho thams cad la zhugs pa ni/ rgya chen po'i chos so/ /

(9) Engaging in the strength of a bodhisattva, which is to enter an ocean of the ways of the realm of the Dharma so as to continuously manifest the attainment of buddhahood in each instant in all buddha realms, is an extensive quality.
enlightening beings’ great encompassing practice of power, going to all universes to ceaselessly manifest realization of enlightenment in each instant in all lands;
byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes dus gsum gyi chos thams cad la sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes thob par bya ba'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs la zhugs pa ni/ rgya chen po'i chos so/ /

(10) Engaging in the knowledge of a bodhisattva, which is to gain the strengths of the tathāgatas so as to attain the unobscured knowledge of all phenomena in the three times, is an extensive quality.
enlightening beings’ great encompassing practice of knowledge, intent upon the powers of all buddha-lands in those oceans of structures of all realms of reality.

rigs kyi bu/ bcu po de dag ni/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rgya chen po'i chos tshogs chen po dang ldan pa rnams te/ de dag la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rnam par thar pa de lta bu phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro/ / rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ / yongs su 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / yang dag par 'phel bar 'gyur ro; ; kun nas 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / rab tu skye bar 'gyur ro/ / yongs su 'grub par 'gyur ro/ / shin tu brtan par 'gyur ro/ / rnam par yangs par 'gyur ro/ / yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ / yongs su gnas par 'gyur ro/ /

“Noble one, those ten are the great accumulations, the vast qualities of the bodhisattvas. The bodhisattvas who remain within them will obtain this kind of bodhisattva liberation. They will make it pure, cause it to arise, increase it, elevate it, manifest it, accomplish it, make it enduring, make it vast, perfect it, and establish it.”
nor bzang gis smras pa/ 'phags ma lha mo/ khyod yun ring po ji srid cig nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu zhugs/
Sudhana asked, “Āryā, goddess, how long has it been since you set out for the highest, complete enlightenment?”

des smras pa/ rigs kyi bu/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gzhi me tog gi snying po'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'di'i shar phyogs logs su 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho stong phrag bcu 'das pa'i pha rol na 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho rin po che thams cad kyis dri ma med pa'i 'od du rnam par brgyan pa zhes bya ba yod do/ /

She replied, “Noble one, to the east of this ocean of world realms called Kusumatalagarbhavyūhālaṃkāra, beyond a hundred thousand oceans of world realms, there is an ocean of world realms called Sarvaratnavimalaprabhāvyūha.
de'i dbus na 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'od dang / smon lam gyi dbyangs zhes bya ba yod do; ;
In its center there is a group of world realms called Sarvatathāgataprabhāpraṇidhinirghoṣa.

de'i dbus na 'jig rten gyi khams rin po che thams cad kyi sprin sna tshogs dang ldan pa/ 'jig rten gyi 'og gi mtshams nas rin po che thams cad kyi phreng ba'i dra ba rgya mtshos brtan pa/ rin po che'i rgyal po spos kyi rdo rje thams cad kyi rgyan gyi lhun dang ldan pa/ khang pa brtsegs pa rgya'i dbyibs su 'dug pa/ rnam par dag cing kun nas nyon mongs pa; lha rdzas kyi gzhal med khang dang gnas kyi sprin gyis kun tu gang ba/
gser ltar dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi rgyan ces bya ba yod pa
[Sarvaratnavimalaprabhāvyūha…see above]

der bskal pa kun tu snang ba'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba byung ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams de na snying po byang chub rin po che thams cad kyi snying po 'od sna tshogs can zhes bya ba yod de/ der bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa phyir mi ldog pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi dbyangs zhes bya ba/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas te/

“There, during a kalpa called Samantāvabhāsadhvaja, in that world, there was a bodhimaṇḍa called Sarvaratnagarbhavicitrābha. There a tathāgata, who was called the Bhagavat Avivartyadharmadhātunirghoṣa, attained the highest, complete enlightenment of buddhahood.

de'i tshe de'i dus na kho mo yang snying po byang chub kyi lha mo bsod nams sgron ma phun sum tshogs pa kun nas dpal gyi 'od ces bya ba zhig tu gyur te/ byang chub kyi shing de la 'dug 'dug nas der kho mos de bzhin gshegs pa de mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'i rnam par 'phrul pa mthong nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /

“At that time, in that time, I was a goddess of the bodhimaṇḍa, named Puṇyapradīpasaṃpatketuprabhā, who dwelled at the Bodhi tree. When I saw that tathāgata’s miraculous manifestation of buddhahood, I developed the aspiration to attain the highest, complete enlightenment,
de bzhin gshegs pa de mthong nas kyang kho mos de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho'i 'od ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob bo/ /
and on seeing that tathāgata I attained a samādhi called the light of an ocean of qualities.

de'i 'og tu 'jig rten gyi khams de nyid kyi rgyal po'i gnas kun nas yongs su rgyas pa'i dpal gyi snying po zhes bya bar snying po byang chub de nyid du de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi sdong po ri bo gzi brjid ces bya ba mngon par sangs rgyas so/ /
“Subsequently, the Tathāgata Dharmadrumaparvatatejas attained buddhahood at that bodhimaṇḍa, by that world’s royal capital called Samantasaṃpūrṇaśrīgarbhā.
kho mos ni/ de nas shi 'phos te snying po byang chub de nyid du ye shes phun sum tshogs pa'i bsod nams 'od ces bya ba'i mtshan mo'i lha mo zhig tu gyur cing 'dug 'dug ste/
I had passed away and become a night goddess, by the name of Jñānaśrīpuṇyaprabhā, who dwelled at the bodhimaṇḍa.

kho mos der bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi sdong po ri bo gzi brjid des chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rnam par 'phrul pa mthong nas 'gro ba thams cad du yongs su ston pa'i mnyam pa nyid kyi 'od kyi yul zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob bo/ /
“There I saw the Tathāgata Dharmadrumaparvatatejas’ miraculous manifestation of turning the wheel of the Dharma, and I attained a samādhi called the range of the light of an ocean of qualities.

de'i 'og tu kho mos snying po byang chub de nyid du de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi rgya mtsho thams cad kyi gsung gi rgyal po zhes bya ba bsnyen bkur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa de mthong ma thag tu chos thams cad kyi yang dag par 'phel bar byed pa'i gnas zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob bo/ /

“Subsequently, I venerated the Tathāgata Sarvadharmasāgaranirghoṣarāja at that bodhimaṇḍa. As soon as I saw that tathāgata, I attained a samādhi called the state of enhancing the levels[1512] of all dharmas.
“Subsequently, I venerated the Tathāgata Ratnaraśmipradīpadhvajarāja at that bodhimaṇḍa. As soon as I saw that tathāgata, I attained a samādhi called clouds of the complete light of the tree.

de'i 'og tu kho mos snying po byang chub de nyid du de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i 'od zer sgron ma'i rgyal mtshan rgyal po zhes bya ba bsnyen bkur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa de mthong ma thag tu kho mos sangs rgyas rgya mtsho rab tu snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob bo/ /
“Subsequently, I venerated the Tathāgata Guṇasumeruprabhatejas[1513] at that bodhimaṇḍa. As soon as I saw that tathāgata, I attained a samādhi called the radiance of the ocean of buddhas.

de'i 'og tu kho mos snying po byang chub de nyid du de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi sprin sgra'i rgyal po zhes bya ba bsnyen bkur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa de mthong ma thag tu kho mos chos rgya mtsho thams cad kyi sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob bo/ /
“Subsequently, I venerated the Tathāgata Dharmameghanirghoṣarāja at that bodhimaṇḍa. As soon as I saw that tathāgata, I attained a samādhi called the lamp of the ocean of all dharmas.

de'i 'og tu kho mo lha'i bu mo zhig tu gyur te snying po byang chub de nyid du de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes skar mda' snang ba'i rgyal po zhes bya ba bsnyen bkur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa de mthong ma thag tu kho mos sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal rab tu zhi par byed pa'i sgron ma snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob bo/ /

“Subsequently, I venerated the Tathāgata Jñānolkāvabhāsarāja at that bodhimaṇḍa. As soon as I saw that tathāgata, I attained a samādhi called the light of the lamp that ends the suffering of all beings.

de'i 'og tu kho mos snying po byang chub de nyid du de bzhin gshegs pa chos rnam par 'phrul pa'i shugs kyi rgyal mtshan dpal zhes bya ba bsnyen bkur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa de mthong ma thag tu kho mos dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yang dag par 'jug pa'i snying po'i snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob bo/ /

“Subsequently, I venerated the Tathāgata Dharmavikurvitavegadhvajaśrī at that bodhimaṇḍa. As soon as I saw that tathāgata, I attained a samādhi called the light of the essence of comprehending all the tathāgatas in the three times.

de'i 'og tu kho mos snying po byang chub de nyid du de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi sgron ma ye shes kyi rnam par gnon pa zhes bya ba bsnyen bkur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa de mthong ma thag tu 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du ye shes thogs pa med pa'i 'khor lo snang ba'i gzi brjid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob bo/ /

“Subsequently, I venerated the Tathāgata Dharmapradīpavikramajñānasiṃha[1514] at that bodhimaṇḍa. As soon as I saw that tathāgata, I attained a samādhi called the brilliance of the light of the wheel of unimpeded knowledge of all world realms.

de'i 'og tu kho mos snying po byang chub de nyid du de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes kyi stobs kyi ri bo gzi brjid ces bya ba bsnyen bkur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa de mthong ma thag tu kho mos dus gsum gyi sems can gyi spyod pa dang / dbang po rab tu snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob bo; ;

“Subsequently, I venerated the Tathāgata Jñānabalaparvatatejas at that bodhimaṇḍa. As soon as I saw that tathāgata, I attained a samādhi called the illumination of the conduct and faculties of beings in the three times.

rigs kyi bu/ de ltar kho mos 'jig rten gyi khams gser ltar dri ma med pa'i 'od der bskal pa kun tu snang ba'i rgyal mtshan la de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed cig bsnyen bkur te/ la la ni/ lha'i dbang por gyur te bsnyen bkur to/ / la la ni/ klu'i dbang por gyur te bsnyen bkur to; ; la la ni/ gnod sbyin gyi dbang por gyur pas/ la la ni/ dri za'i dbang por gyur pas/ la la ni/ lha ma yin gyi dbang por gyur pas/ la la ni/ nam mkha' lding gi dbang por gyur pas/ la la ni/ mi 'am ci'i dbang por gyur pas/ la la ni/ lto 'phye chen po'i dbang por gyur pas/ la la ni/ mi'i dbang por gyur pas/ la la ni/ tshangs pa'i dbang por gyur pas/ la la ni/ lhar gyur pas/ la la ni/ mir gyur pas/ la la ni/ bud med du gyur pas/ la la ni/ skyes par gyur pas/ la la ni/ khye'ur gyur pas/ la la ni/ bu mor gyur pas bsnyen bkur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyang kho mos mched pa'i yo byad ci bdog pas mchod do/ / de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyang rim gror byas so/ / de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyi chos bstan pa yang thos so/ /

“In that way, noble one, in the world realm called Kanakavimalaprabhāvyūha, during the kalpa called Samantāvabhāsadhvaja, I venerated as many tathāgatas as there are atoms in ten buddha realms. Sometimes I venerated them when I was a lord of devas; sometimes, when I was a lord of nāgas; sometimes, when I was a lord of yakṣas; sometimes, when I was a lord of gandharvas; sometimes, when I was a lord of asuras; sometimes, when I was a lord of kinnaras; sometimes, when I was a lord of mahoragas; sometimes, when I was a lord of humans; sometimes, when I was a lord of Brahmās; sometimes, when I was a deva; sometimes, when I was a human; sometimes, when I was a woman; sometimes, when I was a man; sometimes, when I was a boy; and sometimes, when I was a girl. To all those tathāgatas I made offerings and offered whatever I possessed. I attended to all those tathāgatas. I heard the Dharma that all those tathāgatas taught.
de nas kho mo shi 'phos nas 'jig rten gyi khams de nyid du bskal pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed cig tu byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyad do/ /
“After I passed away, I practiced bodhisattva conduct in that world realm for as many kalpas as there are atoms in a buddha realm.

de nas shi 'phos nas 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gzhi dang snying po me tog gi rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'di'i 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed du skyes te/ kho mos bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa log par dad sel bsnyen bkur to/ /
“Then, when I passed away, I was reborn in this Sahā world realm in the ocean of world realms called Kusumatalagarbhavyūhālaṃkāra.
de bzhin gshegs pa de mthong ma thag tu kho mos mun pa'i rdul thams cad dang bral bas rab tu snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob bo/ /
“I venerated the Tathāgata Krakucchanda. As soon as I saw that tathāgata, I attained a samādhi called the radiance that is free of all darkening dust.

de'i 'og tu kho mos de bzhin gshegs pa gser thub bsnyen bkur to/ / de bzhin gshegs pa de mthong ma thag tu kho mos zhing rgya mtsho thams cad snang ba rjes su 'phro bar bya bas rgyas par 'gengs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob bo/ /
“Subsequently, I venerated the Tathāgata Kanakamuni. As soon as I saw that tathāgata, I attained a samādhi called the radiance that spreads throughout all the ocean of realms.

de'i 'og tu kho mos de bzhin gshegs pa bsod skyabs bsnyen bkur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa de mthong ma thag tu kho mos sems can thams cad kyi skad rgya mtsho 'brug sgra sgrog pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob bo/ /
“Subsequently, I venerated the Tathāgata Kāśyapa. As soon as I saw that tathāgata, I attained a samādhi called the thunder of the sounds of the ocean of the languages of all beings.

de'i 'og tu kho mos bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad 'di bsnyen bkur te/ de snying po byang chub la de bzhin gshegs pa mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i sgo rgya mtsho sems kyi skad cig re re la yongs su ston pa mdzad pa mthong nas kho mos byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa dga' ba yangs pa'i shugs 'byung bas sems kyi skad cig rnam par brgyan pa 'di thob bo/ /

“Subsequently, I venerated the Tathāgata Vairocana. At the bodhimaṇḍa, he manifested in each instant of mind an ocean of the gateways to the miraculous manifestations of a tathāgata’s buddhahood. As soon as I saw that, I attained this bodhisattva liberation called the display in each instant of mind of the arising of the power of vast delight.
de thob ma thag tu chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la zhugs par gyur to/ /
As soon as I had attained it, I entered an ocean of the ways of the realm of phenomena that were as numerous as the atoms in an anabhilāpyānabhilāpya of buddha realms.

chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul rgya mtsho de dag thams cad du gtogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing ji snyed pa de dag la rdul shin tu phra ba ji snyed yod pa de dag thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba re re la yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing la zhugs te mthong bar gyur to/ /

I saw that in each of the atoms that were all the atoms within all buddha realms in that ocean of all the ways of the realm of phenomena, there were buddha realms as numerous as the atoms in an anabhilāpyānabhilāpya of buddha realms.

sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag thams cad las sangs rgyas kyi zhing re re na yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad snying po byang chub tu gshegs te sems kyi skad cig re re la mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa yongs su ston par mdzad cing / mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i rnam par 'phrul pa re res kyang chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul rgya mtsho rgyas par 'gengs pa mdzad pa mthong ngo/ /

“I saw that among all those buddha realms, in each buddha realm there was the Bhagavat Vairocana going to the bodhimaṇḍa and in each instant of mind manifesting the miraculous manifestation of the attainment of buddhahood. Each miraculous manifestation of the attainment of buddhahood completely pervaded the ocean of ways of the realm of phenomena.

And in each of those buddha-lands I see Vairocana Buddha at the pinnacle of enlightenment manifesting the miracle of perfect enlightenment in each moment of consciousness, pervading the oceans of structures of all reality realms with each miraculous display of enlightenment.
de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad las de bzhin gshegs pa re re'i zhabs kyi drung na yang bdag mngon du 'dug par shes par gyur to/ /
“I perceived that among all those tathāgatas, I was seated at the feet of every one of those tathāgatas.
I also perceive myself in the presence of each of those buddhas
'jig rten gyi khams de dag tu de bzhin gshegs pa snying po byang chub la bzhugs pa de dag gis chos bstan pa de dag thams cad kyang thos par gyur to/ /
I heard all the Dharma that was taught by all those tathāgatas seated at the bodhimaṇḍa in those world realms.
and listen to what the buddhas in those worlds teach.

de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyi ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas sprul pa rgya mtsho byung ste chos kyi sprin rgya mtsho rab tu sgrog pa dang / rnam par 'phrul pa sna tshogs yongs su ston pa mdzad cing / chos kyi dbyings kyi phyogs rgya mtsho thams cad du gtogs pa'i zhing rgya mtsho thams cad dang / 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud thams cad dang / 'jig rten gyi khams 'byams klas pa thams cad kyi sems can 'byams klas pa thams cad 'gro ba'i rgyud sna tshogs su skyes pa dag gi nang na sems can gyi bsam pa'i dbang du 'du shes kyi rnam pa sna tshogs kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba

“An ocean of emanations came from each pore of all those tathāgatas, roaring out an ocean of clouds of Dharma, manifesting various miraculous manifestations, and turning the wheel of the Dharma according to the various dispositions of beings born into various kinds of existences, the entire extent of all beings in all the ocean of realms, in all successions of world realms, in the entire extent of world realms within the ocean of every direction in the realm of phenomena.

And as multitudes of emanations of all those buddhas come forth from all their pores, proclaiming myriad teachings and showing various miracles, and turn the wheel of teaching in all realms by mastery of sentient beings’ minds, using various ideas,

de dag thams cad kyang yongs su 'dzin to/ / khong du chud par byed do/ / nges par rtogs par byed do/ / don dang / tshig dang / yi ge 'dzin pa'i shugs kyis rnam par gnon pa'i gzungs kyi mthus yongs su 'dzin to/ / chos kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad rnam par dag pa'i snying po khong du chud pa'i shes rab kyis yongs su sbyong ngo/ /

“I possess all those turnings of the Dharma wheel, comprehend them, understand them, and keep them through the power of mental retention that has the prowess of maintaining all their meaning, words, and letters. I purify them with wisdom that understands the essence of the pure domain of all the Dharmas.

I remember, apply, and contemplate it all. I pick it up by mental command, able to swiftly grasp all meanings and expressions, clarify it by wisdom penetrating the inner sanctum of purity of all realities,
chos rgya mtsho thams cad rnam par 'byed pa la mkhas pa'i rigs pas khong du chud par byed do/ / dus gsum ltar rnam par yangs pa'i blos rgyas par 'gengs so/ /
I understand their categories through skill in the analysis of the ocean of all Dharmas. I permeate them with an understanding that is as vast as the three times.
follow its course by higher knowledge investigating the ocean of all realities, encompass it by awareness as vast as past, present, and future,
de bzhin gshegs pa dang mnyam pa nyid kyi rjes su 'gro ba'i shes rab kyis mnyam par byed cing chos kyi tshul thams cad mngon par sgrub bo/ /
I perceive them as equal through the wisdom that comprehends the equality of the tathāgatas. I accomplish all the ways of the Dharma.
balance it by wisdom conforming to the equality of those who arrive at Thusness. I carry out all the principles of the Teaching,
tshul thams cad la mdo sde'i sprin mngon par sgrub bo/ /
I attain clouds of sūtras within all the Dharmas.[1515]
I bring forth multitudes of scriptures from all the clouds of teaching,
mdo sde'i sprin thams cad las chos rgya mtsho yongs su gzhog par byed do/ /
I am established in an ocean of Dharma within the clouds of all sūtras.
I arrange oceans of doctrines in all the multitudes of scriptures,
chos rgya mtsho thams cad la chos kyi rgyud thams cad yang dag par gzhol bar byed do/ /
I am established in the categories of Dharma in the ocean of all Dharmas.
I gather cycles of doctrine in all the oceans of doctrines,
chos kyi rgyud thams cad la chos kyi sprin yongs su shes par byed do/ /
I know clouds of Dharma within the categories of all Dharmas.
chos kyi sprin thams cad la chos kyi rlabs yongs su skyed do/ /
I give rise to waves of Dharma within the clouds of all Dharmas.
chos kyi rlabs thams cad la chos kyi dga' ba'i shugs rgya mtsho rab tu thob par byed do/ /
I attain an ocean of the power of delight in the Dharma within the waves of all Dharmas.
I find oceanic floods of spiritual joy in all the waves of doctrine,
chos kyi dga' ba'i shugs rgya mtsho thams cad las rab tu thob par bya ba'i shugs mngon par sgrub bo; ;
I accomplish the power of attaining the bhūmis[1516] within the power of delight in all Dharmas.
I produce momentum in attainment of the stages of enlightenment in all the oceans of spiritual joy,
sa'i shugs thams cad la ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho'i shugs mngon par sgrub bo/ /
I accomplish the power of an ocean of samādhis within the power of all the bhūmis.
I produce momentum in attainment of oceans of concentration in the momentum through all the stages,
ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho'i sprin thams cad la sangs rgyas mthong ba rgya mtsho rab tu thob par byed do/ /
I attain an ocean of visions of the buddhas within the clouds of oceans of all samādhis.
I attain oceans of visions of buddhas in all the multitudes of oceans of concentration,
sangs rgyas mthong ba rgya mtsho thams cad la snang ba rgya mtsho rab tu thob par byed do/ /
I attain an ocean of light within the ocean of all visions of the buddhas.
I attain oceans of awareness in all the oceans of visions of buddhas,
snang ba rgya mtsho thams cad la dus gsum gyi ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gyis yongs su gzhog par byed do/ /
I am established on the level[1517] of the domain of the knowledge of the three times within the ocean of all lights.
I order the stages of knowledges of past, present, and future in all the oceans of awareness;
[…see below…]
“I comprehend and know the first development of aspiration by those tathāgatas and so on until the cessation of their Dharma.
[…see below…]
phyogs rgya mtsho mtha' dang dbus med pa rgyas par dgang ba'i tshul dang /
I do so by pervading[1518] the ocean of directions without limit or center;
by concentration on pervading the endlessly variegated ocean of realms,
de bzhin gshegs pa'i sngon gyi mtha'i spyod pa rgya mtsho tshad med pa la 'jug pa'i tshul dang /
by comprehending the immeasurable ocean of the past conduct of the tathāgatas;
by concentration on comprehending the ocean of past practices of infinite buddhas,
de bzhin gshegs pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba rgya mtsho tshad med pa'i ye shes snang ba'i tshul dang /
through the illuminating knowledge of the immeasurable ocean of the past practices of the tathāgatas;
by concentration on the range of knowledge of the ocean of past efforts of infinite buddhas,
de bzhin gshegs pa'i dka' ba tshad med pa yongs su btang ba'i ye shes snang ba rab tu thob par bya ba'i tshul dang /
through attaining the immeasurable light of knowledge of the tathāgatas;
by concentration on attainment of the light of knowledge of infinite buddhas,
de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul khrims kyi dkyil 'khor tshad med pa yongs su dag pa snang bar bya ba'i tshul dang /
through illuminating the immeasurable domain of the purified correct conduct of the tathāgatas;
by concentration on perception of the purity of conduct of infinite buddhas,
de bzhin gshegs pa'i bzod pa'i sa tshad med pa yongs su sbyang ba'i tshul dang /
through the immeasurable level of the purified patience of the tathāgatas;
by concentration on perfection of the stage of forbearance of infinite buddhas,
de bzhin gshegs pa'i brtson 'grus chen po'i shugs tshad med pa rnam par 'phel bar bya ba'i mthu'i ye shes snang ba rab tu thob par bya ba'i tshul dang /
through having attained the illuminating knowledge of the prowess of the tathāgatas to increase the immeasurable power of their great diligence;
by concentration on attainment of the scope of knowledge of the mighty effort increasing the great force of energy of infinite buddhas,
de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsam gtan gyi dkyil 'khor dang / bsam gtan gyi yan lag rgya mtsho tshad med pa yongs su dag par bya ba'i sbyor bas snang ba rab tu thob par bya ba'i tshul dang /
through having attained the illumination of the ways the tathāgatas purify the immeasurable ocean of the domain of meditation and the branches of meditation;
by concentration on attainment of perception of the efforts to purify the ocean of contemplative attainments of the meditations of infinite buddhas,
de bzhin gshegs pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul rgya mtsho tshad med pa yongs su dag par bya ba dang / rnam par dmigs pa snang bar bya ba'i tshul dang /
through the illuminating perception of the purification by the tathāgatas of the immeasurable ocean of the perfection of wisdom;
by concentration on the perception of the purity of the ocean of means of consummation of transcendent wisdom of infinite buddhas,
de bzhin gshegs pa'i thabs mkhas pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul rgya mtsho tshad med pa la 'jug par bya ba'i tshul dang /
through comprehending the immeasurable ocean of the ways of the tathāgatas in the perfection of skillful methods;
by concentrating on penetrating the ocean of ways of consummation of transcendent skill in means of infinite buddhas,
de bzhin gshegs pa'i smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul rgya mtsho tshad med pa la 'jug par bya ba'i tshul dang /
through comprehending the immeasurable ocean of the ways of the tathāgatas in the perfection of prayers;
by concentration on comprehending the ocean of ways of consummation of transcendental vows of infinite buddhas,
de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsod nams dang / ye shes kyi stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad med pa la gnas par bya ba dang / yongs su 'phel bar bya ba'i ye shes rab tu thob par bya ba'i tshul dang /
through having attained the knowledge of the tathāgatas remaining in and increasing the immeasurable perfection of the power of merit and wisdom;
by concentration on attainment of knowledge of increasing and perpetuating the good and wise transcendent power of infinite buddhas,
de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul rgya mtsho tshad med pa la rnam par spyad pa rab tu thob par bya ba'i ye shes yongs su sgrub pa'i tshul dang /
through having attained the knowledge of the ways of practice by the tathāgatas in the immeasurable ocean of the perfection of knowledge;
by concentration on attainment of contemplation of the ocean of principles of the perfect knowledge of infinite Buddhas,
de bzhin gshegs pa'i sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa'i sa yongs su gnon pa mdzad pa'i ye shes snang ba rab tu thob par bya ba'i tshul dang /
through having attained the illuminating knowledge of the tathāgatas in the past ascending immeasurable[1519] bodhisattva bhūmis;
by concentration on attainment of the scope of knowledge of infinite buddhas’s past progress through the stages of enlightening beings,
de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa yongs su gnon pa'i mtshams kyi rnam par 'phrul ba tshad med pas bskal pa rgya mtshor gnas par bya ba'i tshul dang /
through being present in an ocean of kalpas of immeasurable miraculous manifestations by the tathāgatas on ascending the bhūmis;
by concentration on infinite buddhas’ past entry into the spheres of the stages of enlightening beings,
de bzhin gshegs pa'i sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa'i sa'i dkyil 'khor tshad med pa yongs su gnon pa'i tshul dang /
through the past ascent by the tathāgatas through the immeasurable domain of the bodhisattva bhūmis;
by concentration on infinite buddhas’ abiding in the stages of enlightening beings,
de bzhin gshegs pa'i sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa'i sa tshad med pa la gnas par bya ba'i tshul dang /
through the past dwelling by the tathāgatas in immeasurable bodhisattva bhūmis;
by concentration on infinite buddhas’ perfection of the stages of enlightening,
de bzhin gshegs pa'i sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa'i sa tshad med pa yongs su dag par bya ba'i tshul dang /
through the past purification by the tathāgatas of immeasurable bodhisattva bhūmis;
de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa tshad med pa ye shes rgya mtshos rnam par dpyad pa'i tshul dang /
through contemplating the ocean of knowledge of the immeasurable bhūmis of the tathāgatas;[1520]
by concentration on contemplation of the ocean of knowledge of infinite buddhas,
de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa'i ye shes snang ba tshad med pa rab tu thob par bya ba'i tshul dang /
through having attained the illuminating knowledge of immeasurable tathāgatas;
by concentration on attaining manifestation of the knowledge of infinite buddhas,
de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub sems dpar gyur pas sngon gyi sangs rgyas ma lus par gzigs pa dang / rjes su 'brang ba mdzad pa tshad med pa rnam par dmigs par bya ba'i tshul dang /
through perceiving the immeasurable seeing and following of every past buddha by the tathāgatas when they were bodhisattvas;
by concentration on communication of all meetings and association with past buddhas on the part of infinite buddhas when they were enlightening beings,
de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub sems dpar gyur pas sngon gyi sangs rgyas rgya mtsho ma lus par gzigs shing bskal pa rgya mtshor bzhugs bzhugs pa tshad med pa'i tshul dang /
