Ārya, I have heard that you give instruction and teachings to bodhisattvas! Ārya, I pray that you explain to me how bodhisattvas should train in bodhisattva conduct and how they should practice it!”

“Noble one, I have set my mind on supreme perfect enlightenment, but I do not know how to learn and carry out the practice of enlightening beings. I hear you give enlightening beings instruction, so please tell me how an enlightening being is to learn and carry out enlightening practice.”
des smras pa
When he had said that, Śilpābhijña, the head merchant’s son, said,
Shilpabhijna said,
rigs kyi bu/ kho bo ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa bzo mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa thob pa ste/
“Noble one, I have attained the bodhisattva liberation called higher knowledge of the arts.
“I have attained an enlightening liberation with higher knowledge of arts.
rigs kyi bu/ de ltar kho bo yi ge'i ma mo slob pa'i tshe yi ge a brjod pa dang byang chub sems dpa'i mthus shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo yul tha mi dad pa zhes bya ba khong du chud do/ /

“Noble one, in that way, while studying the alphabet, through reciting the letter A and through the power of a bodhisattva, I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called the undifferentiated range.
In uttering the phonemes, as I pronounce A, by the associative power of an enlightening being I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called sphere of totality;
ra zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo gzhi'i bye brag mtha' yas pa zhes bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Ra I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called the infinite particulars of the bases.
pronouncing Ra, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called differentiation of infinite levels;
pa zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo chos kyi gzhi yang dag par 'dres pa zhes bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Pa I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called blending[1908] the basis of the realm of phenomena.
pronouncing Pa, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called differentiation of levels of the cosmos of realities;
tsa zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo 'khor lo rnam par phye ba kun nas gcod pa zhes bya ba khong du chud do; ;
“Through reciting the letter Ca I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called dividing the wheel.
pronouncing Cha, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called analysis of the universal sphere;
na zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo gnas med pas gzhi thug pa med pa zhes bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Na I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called without location and without basis.[1909]
pronouncing Na, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called independence;
la zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo ming dang bral te gnas med pas dri ma med pa zhes bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter La I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called stainless through having no name and no location.[1910]
pronouncing La, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called unattached;
da zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo sbyor ba phyir ldog pa zhes bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Da I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called irreversible union.
pronouncing Da, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called unregressing effort;
ba zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ces bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Ba I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called the vajra field.
pronouncing Ba, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called adamantine sphere;
Da zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo kun tu 'khor lo zhes bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Ḍa[1911] I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called the complete wheel.
pronouncing Da, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called universal sphere;
Sha zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo rgya mtsho'i snying po zhes bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Ṣa[1912] I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called the essence of the ocean.
pronouncing Sa, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called ocean womb;
ba zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo kun nas rnam par 'phel bar rnam par sgrub pa zhes bya ba khong du chud do/ /
Through reciting the letter Va I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called the accomplishment of complete increase.
pronouncing Va, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called branching out everywhere;
ta zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo skar ma'i dkyil 'khor ces bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Ta I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called the field of stars.
pronouncing Ta, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called sphere of light;
ya zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyis rol tu phyin pa'i sgo phung po tha mi dad pa zhes bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Ya I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called the undifferentiated[1913] heap.
pronouncing Ya, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called multitude of mixtures;
Sh+Ta zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo gdung ba kun nas zhi bar byed pa'i 'od ces bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Ṣṭa[1914] I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called the cessation of all torment.
pronouncing Shta, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called light extinguishing all burning;
ka zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo sprin tha mi dad pa zhes bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Ka I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called undifferentiated clouds.
pronouncing Ka, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called unified multitude;
sa zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo char mngon par 'bab pas khyab pa zhes bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Sa[1915] I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called the pervading rainfall.
pronouncing Sha, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called directed rain;
ma zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo shugs chen pos brgyan pa'i rtse mo zhes bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Ma I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called the pinnacle adorned by great power.
pronouncing Ma, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called crest of various currents of great force;
ga zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo kun nas rnam par bsgrubs pa zhes bya ba khong du chud do; ;
“Through reciting the letter Ga I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called complete accomplishment.
pronouncing Ga, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called extending to all levels;
tha zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo de bzhin nyid tha mi dad pa'i snying po zhes bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Tha[1916] I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called the undifferentiated essence of the true nature.
pronouncing Tha, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called unified womb of Thusness;
dza zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo 'gro ba'i 'khor ba rnam par dag pa la 'jug pa zhes bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Ja I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called entering the purification of the saṃsāra of beings.
pronouncing Ja, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called plunging into purification of the mundane whirl;
zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo sangs rgyas thams cad dran pas brgyan pa zhes bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Sva[1917] I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called the display of the memory of all the buddhas.
pronouncing Swa, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called supernal manifestation of recollection of all buddhas;
d+ha zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo chos kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par dpyod pa rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Dha I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called the analysis through examination of the field of phenomena.
pronouncing Dha, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called contemplative investigation of truths;
sha zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gdams ngag gi 'khor lo snang ba zhes bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Śa I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called the light of the wheel of instruction of all the buddhas.
pronouncing Sha, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called light of the wheel of teaching of all buddhas;
kha zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo mngon par 'du bya ba'i rgyu dang / sa'i ye shes kyi snying po zhes bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Kha I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called the essence of the knowledge of the causes and levels of the composite.
pronouncing Kha, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called womb of knowledge of the causal ground of accomplishment;
k+Sha zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo las zhi ba rgya mtsho'i mdzod rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Kṣa[1918] I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called examining the treasure of the ocean of the pacification of karma.
pronouncing Ksha, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called investigation of the treasury of the ocean in which all actions are stilled;
sta zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo nyon mongs pa thams cad rnam par 'thor bas rnam par dag pa'i snying po zhes bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Sta I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called the essence[1919] of purity through dispelling all kleśas.
pronouncing Sta, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called light of purity dispelling all afflictions;
nya zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo 'jig rten 'byung ba rnam par dmigs pa zhes bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Ña[1920] I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called perceiving the origin of the world.[1921]
pronouncing Ña, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called access to worldly knowledge;
pha zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo 'khor ba dang mi mthun pa'i 'khor lo'i ye shes dkyil 'khor ces bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Pha[1922] I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called the field of the knowledge of the wheel that counters saṃsāra.
pronouncing Tha, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called sphere of knowledge of the cycles of the mundane whirl;
b+ha zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo gnas kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad rnam par dmigs par brgyan pa zhes bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Bha I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called the display of the perception of the entire field of dwellings.
pronouncing Bha, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called array of manifestations of spheres of existence;
tsha zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo bsags pa dam pa'i thabs kyi spyod pa'i gdugs kyi dkyil 'khor tha dad pa zhes bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Cha I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called the different fields of the parasols that engage in the methods[1923] for supreme accumulation.
pronouncing Chha, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called division of the encompassing sphere of practice applied to development;
sma zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo sangs rgyas thams cad blta ba'i phyogs la mngon du gyur pa zhes bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Sma I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called turning in the direction of the vision of all buddhas.
pronouncing Sma, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called turning to face all directions to see all buddhas;
zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo sems can thams cad kyi mdog la rnam par lta ba'i stobs shin tu skyes ba rgya mtsho'i snying po zhes bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Hva[1924] I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called the essence of the ocean[1925] that gives rise to the power to see the appearances of all beings.
pronouncing Hwa, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called matrix of power to observe what all sentient beings cannot;
yas zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo yon tan rgya mtsho thams cad nan tan rtogs par 'jug pa zhes bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Tsa[1926] I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called entering the realization of the practice of the ocean of all qualities.
pronouncing Tsa, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called plunging into practice of the ocean of all virtues;
g+ha zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo chos thams cad kyi sprin yongs su 'dzin pa'i rgya mtsho brtan pa zhes bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Gha I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called the unwavering ocean of holding the clouds of all the Dharma.
pronouncing Gha, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called strong oceanic vessel holding the multitude of all teachings;
Ta zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo sangs rgyas thams cad smon lam gyi phyogs su mngon par 'gro ba zhes bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Ṭa[1927] I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called going in the direction of the prayers of all the buddhas.
pronouncing Tha, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called going in the direction of the vows of all buddhas;
Na zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo yi ge 'khor lo mi zad pa'i mtha' rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Ṇa[1928] I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called analyzing the end of the inexhaustible wheel of letters.
pronouncing Na, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called voicing the millions of configurations of the wheel of phonemes;
spa zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba'i mthar phyin pa'i dkyil 'khor ces bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Spha[1929] I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called the field of fully accomplishing the ripening of all beings.
pronouncing Pha, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called sphere of the ultimate development of all sentient beings;

ska zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo sa'i snying po tha dad pa yang dag par shes pa thogs pa med pa'i snang bas 'khor lo rgyas par 'gengs pa zhes bya ba khong du chud do; ;
“Through reciting the letter Ska I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called the pervasion of the wheel through the light of the unimpeded discernment of the essences of the bhūmis.
pronouncing Ska, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called suffusion of the sphere of light of unimpeded intellectual powers contained in the stages of enlightenment;
yam zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos shin tu bstan pa'i yul zhes bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Ysa[1930] I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called the range of the perception of the Dharma teaching of all the buddhas.
pronouncing Sya, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called sphere of exposition of all buddha-teachings;
sh+tsa zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo sems can gyi nam mkha' las chos kyi sprin gyi 'brug sgra byung bas rgyas par 'gengs pa zhes bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Śca I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called the pervasion of the thunder that comes from the clouds of Dharma in the sky of beings.
pronouncing Shcha, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called thunder of truth filling the sky of beings;
Tha zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo sems can gyi don bdag med pa'i dgos pa mthar phyin par zin pa'i sgron ma zhes bya ba khong du chud do/ /

“Through reciting the letter Ṭha[1931] I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called the lamp that possesses the complete accomplishment of the necessity of the absence of a self for the sake of beings.
pronouncing Ta, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called lamp of the ultimate consummation of selfless work for the benefit of sentient beings;
d+ha zhes bya ba brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo chos kyi 'khor lo tha mi dad pa'i snying po zhes bya ba khong du chud do/ /
“Through reciting the letter Ḍha[1932] I realized the gateway to the perfection of wisdom called the undifferentiated essence of the wheel of the Dharma.
pronouncing Dha, I enter a door of transcendent wisdom called matrix of the distinction of cycles of the Teaching.

rigs kyi bu/ kho bo de ltar yi ge'i ma mo slob pa'i tshe shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo de dag la sogs pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo tshad med grangs med pa zhig khong du chud do/ /
“Noble one, I have realized those entrances to the perfection of wisdom and so on, countless innumerable entrances to the perfection of wisdom.
“As I pronounce the phonemes, I enter immeasurable, innumerable doors of transcendent wisdom, beginning with these forty-two.
rigs kyi bu/ de ltar kho bo ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa bzo mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa 'di thob pa ste/
“Noble one, in that way, I have attained the bodhisattva liberation called higher knowledge of the arts.
I have attained this enlightening liberation with higher knowledge of arts,
rigs kyi bu/ kho bos de shes par zad na; kho bos byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bzo gnas thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mchog thob pa/
“Noble one, I know only that, and therefore how could I know or describe the qualities of the bodhisattvas who have attained perfection in all mundane and supramundane arts;
and it is this I know. How can I know the practice or tell the virtues of enlightening beings who have attained perfection of all mundane and transcendental arts,
bzo'i gnas thams cad la 'jug pa dang / yi ge dang / grangs dang / rtsis dang / shod thabs thams cad khong du chud par bya ba dang /
who engage in all arts; who comprehend all writing, numbers, counting, and calculations;
—all writing and mathematics,
sngags dang / sman thams cad kyi tshul la mkhas pa rab tu thob par bya ba dang /
who have attained skill in the ways of all mantras and medicines;
all applied sciences of spells and herbs,
'byung po dang / gza' dang / skar ma dang / brjed byed dang / byang stems dang / ro langs kyi gnod pa thams cad gso ba dang /
who heal demonic afflictions from bhūtas, planets and stars, apasmāras, kākhordas, and vetālas;
all the bases of obsession, psychotherapy, epilepsy, lameness, and insanity,
sems can gyi khams gso bar bya ba'i sman dang thabs kyi rgyus dang /
who know the medicines and methods that heal the elements of beings;
the science of compounding medicines,
khams kyi thabs yongs su bsdu ba'i cho ga dang /
who know the practices of the collected methods for the elements;
chemistry,

gser dang / nor bu dang / mu tig dang / bai DUr+ya dang / dung dang / man shel dang / byi ru dang / mu tig dmar po dang / mu sa ra gar+b+ha dang / ke sa ra dang / dpal gyi snying po dang / rin po che thams cad 'byung zhing skye ba dang / rigs dang / 'byung khungs dang / rin thang gi rgyus shes par bya ba dang /

who know the origin, creation, classes, sources, and values of gold, jewels, pearls, beryl, conch, crystal, coral, red pearls, white coral, saffron, rubies, emeralds,[1933] and all precious materials;
mineralogy,
bza' shing gi ra ba dang / dka' thub kyi nags tshal dang / grong dang / grong khyer dang / ljongs dang / khams dang / rgyal ba'i gnas mngon par sgrub pa dang /
who establish parks, forests for mendicants, towns, villages, regions, lands,[1934] and royal residences;
the making of parks, groves, villages, towns, and cities,

ri dang / 'khor lo dang / mtshan ma blta ba dang / sems can gyi mtshan gyi ltas dang / sa g.yo ba dang / phyogs tshig pa dang / skar mda' ltung ba dang / dge mi dge dang / mu ge dang / lo legs pa la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi thabs lag thams cad kyi rgyus khong du chud par bya ba dang /
who comprehend the zodiac,[1935] omens, signs on beings, earth tremors, red skies, shooting stars, good and bad signs, signs of famine and harvest, and all other mundane knowledge;
knowledge of the vicissitudes of the world through astronomy, physiognomy, geomancy, meteorology, agronomy, and prediction of trends of events, and the analysis, communication, understanding,

'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos rnam par phye ba thams cad brjod cing bstan pa dang / khong du chud par bya ba dang / yang dag pa nyid rjes su rig par bya ba'i rgyus la sgrib pa'am/ the tshom mam/ yid gnyis sam/ nem nur ram/ tsham tshom mam/ mgo rmongs pa'am/ 'khor ba'am/ mi bde ba'am/ sgyid lug pa'am/ mi shes pa'am/ khong du mi chud pa med pa de dag gi spyod pa shes pa'am/ yon tan brjod par nus re skan/

and who can explain and teach and comprehend all the categories of supramundane qualities, knowing them correctly without obscuration, doubt, uncertainty, perplexity, indecision, bewilderment, stupidity,[1936] unhappiness, lack of confidence, lack of knowledge, or misunderstanding?

and actualization of all transmundane phenomena—inasmuch as they have no barrier, no doubt, no confusion, no uncertainty, no hesitation, no ignorance, no difficulty, no impairment, no frustration, no lack of knowledge, and no misunderstanding in regard to the subject matters of all arts.

song rigs kyi bu/ yul ma ga d+ha 'di nyid kyi ljongs dag pa zhes bya ba'i grong khyer 'tsho ba zhes bya ba na dge bsnyen ma bzang mo'i mchog ces bya ba 'dug gi /de'i gan du song la ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bya ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bya ba dris shig /

“Depart, noble one. In the town called Vartanaka in the region called Kevalaka in this land of Magadha resides a kalyāṇamitra by the name of Bhadrottamā. Go to her and ask her, ‘How should a bodhisattva train in and practice bodhisattva conduct?’ ”

“In the city of Vartanaka, in the region of Kevalaka, in this same country of Magadha, there lives a laywoman named Bhadrottama. Go ask her how an enlightening being is to learn and carry out the practice of enlightening beings.”

de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang gis tshong dpon gyi bu bzo mngon par shes pa'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ tshong dpon gyi bu bzo mngon par shes pa la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas yang dang yang bltas te tshong dpon gyi bu bzo mngon par shes pa'i drung nas song ngo/ /

Sudhana, the head merchant’s son, bowed his head to the feet of Śilpābhijña, the head merchant’s son. He circumambulated Śilpābhijña, the head merchant’s son, many hundreds of thousands of times, keeping him to his right, and, looking back at him again and again, he departed from Śilpābhijña, the head merchant’s son.
So Sudhana paid his respects and left the noble youth Shilpabhijna.
[dge bsnyen ma bzang mo'i mchog]
Chapter 48. Bhadrottamā
Bhadrottama

de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang ljongs dag pa'i grong khyer 'tsho ba gang na ba dang / dge bsnyen ma bzang mo'i mchog gang na ba der song ste phyin nas dge bsnyen ma bzang mo'i mchog gi rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal nas dge bsnyen ma bzang mo'i mchog la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas te dge bsnyen ma bzang mo'i mchog gi mdun du 'dug nas thal mo sbyar te 'di skad ces smras so/ /

Sudhana, the head merchant’s son, went to the town called Vartanaka in the region of Kevalaka and approached the kalyāṇamitra Bhadrottamā. When he approached the kalyāṇamitra Bhadrottamā, he bowed his head to her feet, and then he stood before the kalyāṇamitra Bhadrottamā with his palms together in homage and said,
Then Sudhana went to Vartanaka city in the region of Kevalaka, where he called on the laywoman Bhadrottama. Paying his respects to her, he said,

'phags ma/ bdag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed na/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba ma 'tshal te/ 'phags ma ni; byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gdams ngag dang / rjes su bstan pa mdzad do/ /zhes bdag gis thos na/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba 'phags mas bdag la bstan du gsol/

“Āryā, I have developed the aspiration for the highest, complete enlightenment, but I do not know how bodhisattvas should train in bodhisattva conduct and in what way they should practice it. Āryā, I have heard that you give instruction and teachings to bodhisattvas! I pray that you explain to me how bodhisattvas should train in bodhisattva conduct and how they should practice it!”

“Noble one, I have set my mind on supreme perfect enlightenment, but I do not know how an enlightening being is to learn and carry out the practice of enlightening beings. I hear you give enlightening beings instruction, so please tell me how to learn and practice.”
des smras pa/
When he had said that, the kalyāṇamitra Bhadrottamā said,
She said,

rigs kyi bu/ kho mo ni/ chos kyi rnam grangs gnas med pa'i dkyil 'khor ces bya ba shes shing ston pa ste/ kho mos thogs pa med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin kyang thob bo/ / ting nge 'dzin de ni/ chos gang la yang thogs pa med de/ de la gnas na/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du mig thogs pa med pa 'jug go/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du rna ba thogs pa med pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du sna tshogs pa med pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du lce thogs pa med pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du lus thogs pa med pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yid thogs pa med pa yang rab tu 'jug go/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi rlabs thogs pa med pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du snang ba thogs pa med pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du shugs thogs pa med pa 'gro ba rab tu snang ba'i dkyil 'khor dag kyang rab tu 'jug go /

“Noble one, I know and teach the Dharma teaching called The Field without Location, and I have attained the samādhi called unimpeded.[1937] That samādhi is unimpeded toward any phenomenon, and when I rest within it, I have the unimpeded eyes of omniscience, I have the unimpeded ears of omniscience, I have the unimpeded nose of omniscience, I have the unimpeded tongue of omniscience, I have the unimpeded body of omniscience, I have the unimpeded mind of omniscience, I have the unimpeded waves of omniscience, I have the unimpeded lightning[1938] of omniscience, and I have the unimpeded power of omniscience and the field of the illumination of beings.

“I know and teach a doctrine called ‘baseless sphere’ and have attained a concentration of mystic empowerment. In that concentration there is no foundation of any phenomenon whatsoever. Therein is produced the mystical empowerment of the eye of omniscience, the mystical empowerment of the ear of omniscience, the mystical empowerment of the nose of omniscience, the mystical empowerment of the tongue of omniscience, the mystical empowerment of the body of omniscience, the mystical empowerment of the mind of omniscience, the mystical power of the waves of omniscience, the mystical power of the lightning of omniscience, the mystical power of the flood of omniscience, spheres illumining the world.
rigs kyi bu/ kho mo ni/ chos kyi rnam grangs gnas med pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di shes shing khong du chud par zad na/ kho mos byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa chags pa med pa ril gyis shes par nus re skan/
“Noble one, I know only this Dharma teaching called The Field without Location. How could I know completely unimpeded bodhisattva conduct?
“It is this doctrine of the baseless sphere that I know. How can I know all the unobstructed, unattached practices of enlightening beings?

song rigs kyi bu; lho phyogs kyi rgyud na khrong khyer rgyas pa'i 'gram zhes bya ba yod do/ de na gser tshong gces pa gtong ba zhes bya ba 'dug gi /de'i gan du song la ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bya ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bya ba dris shig/

“Depart, noble one. In the southern region there is town called Bharukaccha. There resides a goldsmith by the name of Muktāsāra. Go to him and ask him, ‘How should a bodhisattva train in and practice bodhisattva conduct?’ ”
Go south—there is a city called Bharukaccha, where there lives a goldsmith named Muktasara. Go ask him how an enlightening being is to learn and carry out the practice of enlightening beings.”

de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang gis dge bsnyen ma bzang mo'i mchog gi rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ dge bsnyen ma bzang mo'i mchog la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas yang dang yang bltas te dge bsnyen ma bzang mo'i mchog gi drung nas song ngo/ /

Sudhana, the head merchant’s son, bowed his head to the feet of the kalyāṇamitra Bhadrottamā. He circumambulated the kalyāṇamitra Bhadrottamā many hundreds of thousands of times, keeping her to his right, and, looking back at her again and again, he departed from the kalyāṇamitra Bhadrottamā.
So then Sudhana paid his respects, took his leave, and departed.
[gser tshong gces pa gtong ba]
Chapter 49. Muktāsāra
Muktasara

de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang mthar gyis lho phyogs kyi rgyud du song ste/ grong khyer rgyas pa'i 'gram du gser tshong gces pa gtong ba gang na ba der phyin te/ gser tshong gces pa gtong ba'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te mdun du 'dug nas thal mo spyar te 'di skad ces smras so/ /

Sudhana, the head merchant’s son, eventually arrived in the southern region, and in the town of Bharukaccha he approached the goldsmith Muktāsāra. He bowed his head to the feet of the goldsmith Muktāsāra and then, standing before him with his palms together in homage, said,
Then Sudhana made his way south, to the goldsmith Muktasara in the city of Bharukaccha. Paying his respects to Muktasara, Sudhana said,

'phags pa/ bdag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed na/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba ma 'tshal te/

When he had said that, the brahmin Śivarāgra said, “Noble one, I have the conduct empowered by truth. There is the speech of truth by which the bodhisattvas in the three times have not turned back, do not turn back,[1941] and will never turn back from the highest, complete enlightenment. Through the empowerment of that speech of truth, if I say ‘May this and that necessity be accomplished!’ then all my wishes become fulfilled.

Shivaragra said, “I act on a vow of truth, that as by truth, by speaking truth, there has never been, is not now, and never will be, a single enlightening being who has turned away from supreme perfect enlightenment, who is turning away, or who will turn away, by that vow of truthful speech this work of mine may succeed. So whatever I wish comes to fruition. By this vow of truth, I accomplish all my tasks.

“Noble one, I know only this empowerment of the truth. How could I know the conduct or describe the qualities of the bodhisattvas who have attained the speech devoted to truth?
It is this vow of truth that I know. How can I know the practice or tell the virtues of the enlightening beings whose words and deeds mutually accord in truth?

“Depart, noble one. In this southern region there is a town called Sumanāmukha. There resides a boy by the name of Śrīsaṃbhava and a girl by the name of Śrīmati. Go to them and ask them, ‘How should a bodhisattva train in and practice bodhisattva conduct?’ ”

“South of here is a city called Sumanamukha, where there live a boy named Shrisambhava and a girl named Shrimati. Go ask them how an enlightening being is to learn and carry out the practice of enlightening beings.”

rigs kyi bu/ bdag cag gnyis kyis ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa sgyu ma'i rnam pa zhes bya ba thob ste/ mngon du byas so/ /
“Noble one, we have both attained and manifested the bodhisattva liberation called the appearance of illusion.
“We have attained and experienced an enlightening liberation called ‘illusory.’
rigs kyi bu/ de ltar kho bo cag rnam par thar pa 'di dang ldan pas 'jig rten thams cad sgyu ma'i rnam par rgyu rkyen sgyu ma las byung bar mthong ngo/ /
“Noble one, through possessing this liberation, we see all worlds as the appearance of illusions arising from illusory causes and conditions.
Having realized this liberation, we see all worlds as illusory, being produced by the illusion of causes and conditions.
las dang nyon mongs pa sgyu mar shes pas sems can thams cad kyang sgyu ma'i rnam par shes so/ /
“We know karma and kleśas to be illusions, and so we know all beings to be the appearance of illusions.
We know all beings are illusory, by knowledge of the illusion of afflictions in action.
ma rig pa dang / srid pa dang / sred pa'i rgyu las byung bas 'gro ba thams cad kyang sgyu ma'i rnam par mthong ngo/ /
“We see that all beings[1942] are the appearance of illusions because they arise from illusory[1943] ignorance, becoming, and craving.
We see all worldlings as illusory, born of the illusion of ignorant craving for existence.
phan tshun gyi rkyen gyi rgyu las byung bas chos thams cad kyang sgyu ma'i rnam par mthong ngo/ /
“We see that all phenomena[1944] are the appearance of illusions because they arise from illusory[1945] interdependent conditions.
We see all phenomena as illusory, arisen from the illusion of mutual conditioning.
phyin ci log gi rgyu las byung bas khams gsum thams cad kyang sgyu ma'i rnam par mthong ngo/ /
“We see that all three realms also are the appearance of illusions because they arise from erroneous illusions.[1946]
We see the whole triple world as illusory, produced by the illusion of misunderstanding.

“We see the passing away and transference, conception, birth, old age and death, misery, wailing, suffering, unhappiness, and agitation of all beings as the appearance of illusions because they arise from the illusion[1947] of incorrect thoughts.
We see all sentient beings, afflicted by birth, old age, death, grief, lament, suffering, and sorrow, as illusory, born of the illusion of untrue ideas.

“We see all realms also as illusions because they arise from being bewildered by conceptions of nonexistence because of the illusions[1948] of erroneous conceptions, motivations, and views.
We see all lands as born of illusion, produced by the delusion of ideas of substance of existence in the illusions wrongly seen by the conceiving mind.
ye shes kyi spong ba'i rgyu la brtags te bskyed pas nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyang sgyu ma'i rnam par mthong ngo/ /
“We see all śrāvakas and pratyekabuddhas as the appearance of illusion because they arise from illusory[1949] analysis that has discarded wisdom.
We see all hearers and individual illuminates as illusory, born of illusory thoughts of knowledge and effort.

sgyu mar mngon par bsgrubs pa las grub ste/ sprul pa'i spyod pa dang / 'dul ba sgyu ma'i rang bzhin pas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang / smon lam gyis yongs su smin par bya ba dang / gdul ba gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa yang sgyu ma'i rnam pa lta bur shes so/ /

“We also know the successive ripening and guiding of beings through bodhisattva conduct and prayers to be like the appearance of illusions because they are accomplished as illusions having emanated conduct and guidance that have the nature of being illusions.

We know the succession of all enlightening beings’ practices, vows, and developmental guidance of sentient beings as illusory, being essentially illusions of action and teaching created from illusion.

smon lam dang / ye shes sgyu mas mngon par bsgrubs te; yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgyu ma'i rang bzhin yin pas sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor kyang sgyu mar mthong ngo/ /

“We see the field of buddhas and bodhisattvas as the appearance of illusions, because it is accomplished through the illusion of prayers and wisdom and has the nature of being an illusory inconceivable range of perception.
We see the circle of all buddhas and enlightening beings as illusory, being essentially illusions of the inconceivable realm, produced by the illusions of vows and knowledge.

rigs kyi bu; bdag cag gnyis kyis ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa sgyu ma'i rang bzhin 'di shes par zad na/ kho bo cag gis byang chub sems dpa' las sgyu ma mtha' yas pas rnam par sgrub pa'i dra ba khong du chud pa rnams kyi spyod pa shes pa'am/ yon tan brjod par nus re skan/

“Noble one, the two of us know only this bodhisattva liberation called the appearance of illusion. How could we know the conduct or describe the qualities of the bodhisattvas who have realized the net of the accomplishment of infinite illusory activities?”

“We know this enlightening liberation of illusoriness. How can we know the practice or tell of the virtues of the enlightening beings who follow the extensive network of the endless illusion of action?”

Then the boy and girl, having showered Sudhana with an inconceivable stream of virtue and told him of their own range of liberation, said to him,

song rigs kyi bu/ lho phyogs kyi rgyud 'di nyid kyi phyogs kyi sgo'i gnas rgya mtsho'i 'gram zhes bya ba de na bza' shing gi ra ba rgya chen po zhes bya ba yod de de'i nang na khang pa brtsegs pa chen po rnam par snang mdzad kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i snying po zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par smin pa las mngon par grub pa/

“Depart, noble one. In this southern region there is a great park called Mahāvyūha in a province called Samudrakaccha. Within it there is a great kūṭāgāra called Vairocanavyūhālaṃkāragarbha, which has been created by the ripening of a bodhisattva’s roots of merit.

“Go south, to a place called Samudrakaccha. There is a park called Great Array there, wherein there is a great tower called Chamber of Adornments of Vairocana, which has been produced by the maturation of roots of goodness of enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i sems dang yid la bya ba las byung ba/
It has appeared from the mind and mentation of a bodhisattva.
originating from the thoughts of enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam las mngon par skyes pa/
It has arisen from the prayers of a bodhisattva.
arisen from the vows of enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i dbang las byung ba;
It has appeared from the power of a bodhisattva.
based on the masteries of enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i mngon par shes pa'i ye shes kyi stobs kyis sprul pa/
It has been emanated by the power of the higher knowledge of a bodhisattva.
created by the power of mystic knowledge of enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i thabs mkhas pa las byung ba/
It has appeared from the skillful methods of a bodhisattva.
made of the skill in means of enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i bsod nams dang ye shes kyi stobs kyis rdzogs pa/
It has been perfected by the strength of the merit and knowledge of a bodhisattva.
completed by the power of virtue and knowledge of enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje chen pos sems can rnam par gdul ba'i don du bstan pa/
It has manifested for the guiding of beings by the great compassion of a bodhisattva.
showing enlightening beings’ great compassionate guidance of sentient beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i byin gyi rlabs rnam par phye bas bsgru bas pa/
It has been accomplished by the display of the blessing of a bodhisattva.
built of arrays of spiritual powers of enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas la 'jug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa yod de/
It is adorned by dwelling in the inconceivable state of bodhisattva liberation.
adorned by the states of inconceivable liberation of enlightening beings. There an enlightening being,
de na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa zhes bya ba/ skye ba'i sa la gnas pa'i mi rnams rjes su gzung ba dang /
Within it resides the bodhisattva mahāsattva Maitreya, in order to take into his care the humans who dwell on the level of birth;
a great being named Maitreya, lives for the purpose of benefiting the people of his native land,
pha dang / ma dang / gnyen du gyur pa rnams yongs su smin par bya ba dang /
in order to ripen fathers, mothers, and families;
developing his parents and relatives to maturity,
der skyes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' skal pa mnyam pa rnams kyi theg pa chen po rab tu bstan par bya ba dang /
in order to make firm[1950] the Mahāyāna for bodhisattvas born there who have the corresponding conduct;[1951]
making those there who carry out the same practices firm in the Great Vehicle,
de ma yin pa'i sems can gzhan rnams kyang gar 'os pa'i sar dge ba'i rtsa bas yongs su smin par bya ba dang /
in order to also ripen other beings with roots of merit according to their levels;
to develop the roots of goodness of other beings according to their states,
rang gi rnam par thar pa'i tshul la 'jug par bya ba yongs su bstan pa dang /
in order to teach how to enter his own liberation;
to show how to enter this liberation,

byang chub sems dpa'i skye ba la dbang sgyur ba thams cad kyi rjes su song ba rab tu brjod pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi skye ba yongs su bstan pa la mngon par gzhol bar bya bas sems can yongs su smin par bya ba mi gtang ba dang /
in order to describe how bodhisattvas with power over birth go everywhere intent on manifesting in the births of all beings in order not to forsake ripening beings;
to cultivate the power of an enlightening being to be born anywhere and travel about, appearing in all states of being, to perfect those beings,
'gro ba thams cad yongs su gzung ba mi smad pas byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje chen po'i stobs bstan par bya ba dang /
in order to generate the strength of the great compassion of a bodhisattva through not being inferior in caring for all beings;
to develop the power of universal compassion of enlightening beings in the desire to benefit all beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i gnas gzhi rten thams cad las gyen du 'phags pa khong du chud par bya ba dang /
in order for bodhisattvas to realize rising up above all locations;
to become aware of the state of enlightening beings, which is detached from all abodes and locations,
gnas med pa la gzhol bar srid par skye ba thams cad na gnas pa yongs su bstan pa'i don du 'dug gi/
and in order for them to manifest, without location, being located in all births in existences.
and to appear to live in all states of existence while being ultimately unattached.

de'i gan du song la ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yongs su dri ba dang / ji ltar byang chub sems dpa'i lam yongs su dag par bya ba dang / ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la nan tan du bya ba dang / ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub kyi sems yongs su sbyang bar bya ba dang / ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam mngon par bsgrub par bya ba dang / ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs yongs su gsog par bya ba dang / ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i sa yongs su gnon par bya ba dang / ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang / ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i bzod pa la 'jug par bya ba dang / ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i nan tan gyi yon tan la gnas par bya ba dang / ji ltar byang chub sems dpas dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsnyen bkur bar bya ba dris shig/

“Go to him and ask him, ‘How should a bodhisattva inquire about bodhisattva conduct? How should a bodhisattva purify the bodhisattva path? [1952] How should a bodhisattva practice the bodhisattva training? How should a bodhisattva purify the aspiration to enlightenment? How should a bodhisattva accomplish bodhisattva prayers? How should a bodhisattva gather the bodhisattva accumulations? How should a bodhisattva ascend the bodhisattva bhūmis? How should a bodhisattva complete the bodhisattva perfections? How should a bodhisattva enter the patience of a bodhisattva? How should a bodhisattva dwell in the qualities of bodhisattva practice? How should a bodhisattva serve the kalyāṇamitras?’

“Go to Maitreya and ask how an enlightening being is to seek the practices of enlightening beings, clarify the path of enlightening beings, carry out the studies of enlightening beings, purify the aspiration for enlightenment, accomplish the vows of enlightening beings, establish the provisions of enlightening beings, enter the stages of enlightening beings, fulfill the transcendent ways of enlightening beings, persist in the tolerances of enlightening beings, stabilize the qualities of achievement of enlightening beings, and attend spiritual benefactors.

de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pa zhes bya ba de ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad la zhugs pa'o/ / de ni/ sems can thams cad kyi sems dang / bsam pa rtogs par khong du chud pa'o/ / de ni/ sems can thams cad kyi spyod pa'i rjes su zhugs pa'o/ / de ni/ sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang / gdul ba la mngon du gyur pa'o/ / des ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byas pa'o/ / de ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa thams cad la rab tu gnas pa'o/ / des ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i bzod pa thams cad rab tu thob pa'o/ / de ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i skyon med par zhugs pa'o/ / des ni/ lung bstan pa thams cad yang dag par blangs pa'o/ / de ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa thams cad la rnam par rtse ba'o/ / des ni/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs thams cad yongs su blangs pa'o/ / de ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi yul la dbang bskur bas mngon par dbang bskur ba'o/ /

“Why should you do that? Noble one, the bodhisattva Maitreya has understood all bodhisattva conduct, he has comprehended the minds and thoughts of all beings, he has followed the conduct of all beings, he is focused on ripening and guiding all beings, he has completed all the perfections, he dwells on all the bodhisattva bhūmis, he has attained all the patience of a bodhisattva, he is free of the defects of a bodhisattva, he possesses all the prophecies of a bodhisattva, he delights in all the liberations of a bodhisattva, he has acquired all the blessings of the buddhas, and he has been empowered by the empowerment of the range of omniscience of all the tathāgatas.

“Why? Because the enlightening being Maitreya has entered into all practices of enlightening beings; he has reached the goal of aspirations of all enlightening beings; he has comprehended the actions of all beings; he has confronted the developmental guidance of all beings; he has fulfilled all the transcendent ways; he has been through all the stages of enlightening beings; he has attained all the tolerances of enlightening beings; he has attained the certainty of enlightening beings; he has received all the predictions of buddhahood; he has roamed in all the liberations of enlightening beings; he has held the empowerments of all buddhas; he has been anointed by all buddhas with the consecration of the realm of omniscience.

rigs kyi bu; dge ba'i bshes gnyen de khyod la dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyis ni/ mngon par brlan par byed do/ / byang chub tu sems bskyed pa ni/ rnam par 'phel bar byed do/ / lhag pa'i bsam pa'i dbyings ni/ rab tu ston par byed do/ / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad ni/ shin tu byang bar byed do/ / byang chub sems dpa'i dbang po'i shugs ni; yang dag par 'phel bar byed do/ / chos kyi phyogs bsgribs pa med pa ni/ yongs su ston par byed do/ / gzhi kun tu zug pa'i sa khong du chud par bya ba ni/ rtogs par byed de; ; byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi smon lam gyi sar 'byung ba'i sgo la ni/ gzhog par byed do/ / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyod pa dang / smon lam gyi yon tan yongs su 'grub pa ni/ yang dag par brjod par 'gyur ro/ / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa thos par bya ba skye ba'i sgo ni/ yongs su ston par 'gyur gyi;

“Noble one, that kalyāṇamitra will saturate you with roots of merit, he will increase your aspiration for enlightenment, he will make the element of your superior aspiration stable, he will purify all your roots of merit, he will increase the force of your bodhisattva powers, he will reveal the unobscured direction of the Dharma, he will make you realize the understanding of all the bhūmis that are entered, he will make you enter the gateways to the arising of the prayers of all bodhisattvas, and he will show you the gateway to the arising of the attainment of the completely good bodhisattva conduct.

As a spiritual benefactor, he will nourish your roots of goodness, increase your determination for enlightenment, make your will firm, purify all your roots of goodness, increase the powers of your enlightening faculties, show you the realm of nonobstruction, bring you into conformity with the stage of universal goodness, introduce you to the means of carrying out all the vows of enlightening beings, describe to you the perfection of the virtues of the practical undertakings of all enlightening beings, and tell you about the practice of universal good.

rigs kyi bu/ khyod dag ba'i rtsa ba gcig la chags par ma byed cig/ chos kyi sgo'i 'od snang ba gcig la gzhol bar ma byed cig/ spyod pa gcig yongs su rdzogs pas chog par ma sems shig/ smon lam gcig pu mngon par sgrub pa lhur ma len cig/ lung bstan pa gcig gi mthar thug pas rgyun gcad par ma byed cig /bzod pa gsum la 'jug pas chog par bya ba'i 'du shes su ma byed cig/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par bya ba rgyun ma gcod cig/ sa bcu thob pas mthar thug par ma byed cig /sangs rgyas kyi zhing tshad yod pa yongs su gzung ba dang / yongs su dag par bya ba ma smon cig /dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshad yod pa dga' bar bya ba dang / bsnyen bkur bas ngoms par ma byed cig /

“Noble one, do not be attached to one root of merit! Do not be devoted to one illumination from the light of a Dharma gateway! Do not be dedicated to accomplishing one prayer! Do not continuously follow through one prophecy! Do not have the perception that three kinds of patience are enough! Do not continually bring to completion six perfections! Do not make attaining ten bhūmis the ultimate goal! Do not aspire to possess and purify a measurable number of buddha realms! Do not be satisfied by rejoicing in and serving a measurable extent of kalyāṇamitras!

“You should not develop just one virtue, nor concentrate on clarifying just one doctrine, nor be satisfied with just one practice, nor concentrate on carrying out just one vow, nor take up just one instruction, nor rest in completion, nor think of attaining the three tolerances as ultimate, nor rest upon fulfillment of the six transcendent ways, nor stop on attainment of the ten stages, nor vow to encompass and purify a finite buddha-land, nor be content with attendance on a limited number of spiritual benefactors.
de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu/ byang chub sems dpas ni/ dge ba'i rtsa ba tshad med pa yongs su bsdu bar bya dgos so/ /
“Why is that? Noble one, a bodhisattva must gather countless roots of merit;
“Why? Because an enlightening being should gather infinite roots of goodness,

appear in infinite different forms,
skad rnam par phye ba tshad med pa yongs su shes par bya dgos so/ /
must know countless categories of languages;
know infinite different languages,
sems can gyi sems rnam pa tha dad pa tshad med pa khong du chud par bya dgos so/ /
must comprehend countless different kinds of minds of beings;
comprehend infinite differences in the minds of beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul rgya chen po'i rjes su 'jug par bya dgos so/ /
must enter into the vast bodhisattva range of activity;
enter the vast realm of action of enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i gnas shin tu yangs par rjes su spyad dgos so/ /
must perform conduct in the extensive bodhisattva locations;
live in the vast palace of enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par spyod pa zab mo la rnam par blta dgos so/ /
must look at profound bodhisattva conduct;
observe the profound state of enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i yul rtogs par dka' ba khong du chud par bya dgos so/ /
must comprehend the bodhisattva scope of perception that is difficult to understand;
awaken to the mysterious realm of enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i lam bgrod par dka' ba bgrod par bya dgos so/ /
must follow on the bodhisattva path that is difficult to follow;
reach the difficult goal of enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i shugs sgrub par dka' ba yongs su gzung dgos so/ /
must gain the bodhisattva power that is difficult to accomplish;
sustain the hard-to-attain energy of enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i skyon med par 'jug par dka' ba la 'jug par bya dgos so/ /
must gain bodhisattva faultlessness that is difficult to gain;
enter the difficult-of-access certainty of enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rnam pa sna tshogs khong du chud par bya dgos so/ /
must comprehend the variety of bodhisattva conducts;
be aware of the varied practice of enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par 'phrul pa thams cad du khyab pa kun tu bstan dgos so/ /
and must manifest all-pervading bodhisattva miraculous manifestations.
show the ubiquitous miracle of enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i chos kyi sprin yongs su gzung dgos so/ /
A bodhisattva[1955] must obtain the clouds of the Dharma
receive the united multitudes of teachings,
byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i dra ba mtha' dang dbus med pa rab tu rgyas par bya dgos so/ /
and must expand the vast extent, without end or middle, of bodhisattva conduct.
spread the infinitely varied network of practices of enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpas pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bya dgos so/ /
A bodhisattva[1956] must complete all the perfections;
fulfill the endless ways of transcendence,
byang chub sems dpas lung bstan pa tshad med pa yang dag par mnod dgos so/ /
a bodhisattva[1957] must acquire countless prophecies;
receive infinite directions for the future,
byang chub sems dpas bzod pa'i sgo dpag tu med pa la 'jug par bya dgos so/ /
a bodhisattva must enter an incalculable number of gateways into patience;
enter countless doors of tolerance,
byang chub sems dpas sa grangs med pa yongs su sbyang dgos so/ /
a bodhisattva must purify innumerable bhūmis;
purify countless stages of enlightenment,
byang chub sems dpas chos kyi sgo dpag tu med pa yongs su dag par bya dgos so/ /
a bodhisattva must make pure a countless number of gateways to the Dharma;
purify innumerable ways of access to truth,
byang chub sems dpas sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa yongs su sbyang dgos so/ /
a bodhisattva must purify an indescribable number of buddha realms;
purify untold buddha-lands,
byang chub sems dpas bskal pa mtha' yas par go cha bgo dgos so/ /
a bodhisattva must put on the armor for remaining throughout endless kalpas;
put on spiritual armor for endless eons,
byang chub sems dpas de bzhin gshegs pa dpag tu med pa mchod par bya dgos so/ /
a bodhisattva must make offerings to countless tathāgatas;
serve infinite buddhas,
byang chub sems dpas smon lam mngon par sgrub pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mngon par bsgrub dgos so; ;
and a bodhisattva must accomplish an inconceivable number of accomplished prayers.
accomplish the undertakings of inconceivable vows.

rigs kyi bu/ mdor na/ sems can thams cad yongs su smin par byed pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa ni/ sems can thams cad dang mnyam par bstan to/ / bskal pa thams cad du gnas pas bskal pa thams cad mnyam par bstan to/ / thams cad du skye ba yongs su bstan pas skye ba thams cad dang mnyam par bstan to/ / dus gsum gyi ye shes khong du chud par bya ba'i phyir dus thams cad dang mnyam par bstan to/ / chos thams cad la nan tan du byed pas chos thams cad dang mnyam par bstan to/ / zhing thams cad yongs su dag par byed pas zhing thams cad dang mnyam par bstan to/ / smon lam thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pas smon lam thams cad dang mnyam par bstan to/ / sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pa mngon par sgrub pas sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par bstan to/ / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi smon lam dang gcig tu 'gyur ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang mnyam par bstan to/ / dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad la bsnyen bkur byed pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad dang mnyam par bstan to/ /

“Noble one, in brief, bodhisattva conduct manifests equally to all beings because it ripens all beings; [1958] it manifests equally in all kalpas because it remains throughout all kalpas; it manifests equally in all births because it manifests births everywhere; it manifests equally in all times because of the realization of the knowledge of the three times; it manifests equally in all Dharmas because it is the practice of all Dharmas; it manifests equally in all realms because it purifies all realms; it manifests equally in all prayers because it fulfills all prayers; it manifests equally to all buddhas because it is the accomplishment of making offerings to all buddhas; it manifests equally in all bodhisattvas because it is the one prayer of all bodhisattvas; and it manifests equally to all kalyāṇamitras because it serves all kalyāṇamitras.

“In short, the practice of enlightening beings is to perfect all sentient beings, to live in all ages, to manifest birth everywhere in all conditions, to awaken to knowledge of all times past, present, and future, to practice all truths, to purify all lands, to fulfill all vows, to provide for all buddhas, to be one with all enlightening beings in aim, to attain rapport with all spiritual friends.
rigs kyi bu/ de bas na/ khyod kyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen yongs su btsal pa la skyo bar mi bya'o/ /
“Therefore, noble one, never weary of seeking for kalyāṇamitras!
“Therefore you should not tire of seeking spiritual friends and benefactors,
dge ba'i bshes gnyen mthong bas ngoms pa bskyed par mi bya'o/ /
Never feel you have had enough of seeing kalyāṇamitras!
should not weary of meeting spiritual friends and benefactors,
dge ba'i bshes gnyen la yongs su dri bas chog shes par mi bya'o/ /
Never feel you no longer need to ask questions of kalyāṇamitras!
should not become complacent about questioning spiritual friends and benefactors,
dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'grogs pa las bsam pa phyir ldog par mi bya'o/ /
Never turn your thoughts away from being with kalyāṇamitras!
should not give up the determination to contact spiritual friends and benefactors,
dge ba'i bshes gnyen la phu dud dang / rim gro sbyor ba rgyun gcad par mi bya'o/ /
Never cease from revering and venerating kalyāṇamitras!
should not cease striving to respectfully attend spiritual friends and benefactors,
dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams ngag dang / rjes su bstan pa log par gzung bar mi bya'o/ /
Never maintain the instructions and teachings of the kalyāṇamitras incorrectly!
should not misconstrue or resist the advice or instruction of spiritual friends and benefactors,
dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi yon tan thob par 'gyur ba la the tshom mi bskyed do/ /
Never have doubts concerning the attainment of the qualities of the kalyāṇamitras!
should not be irresolute in acquiring the qualities of spiritual friends and benefactors,
dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis 'byung ba'i sgo bstan pa la yid gnyis su mi bya'o/ /
Never have uncertainty concerning the teaching of gateways that have been brought forth by the kalyāṇamitras!
should not doubt the ways of emancipation shown by spiritual friends and benefactors,
dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi thabs kyi bsam pa dang / 'jig rten gyi rjes su 'brang bar bya ba'i rgyud la zhe sdang bskyed par mi bya'o/ /
Never have anger toward the following of worldly ways through the use of methods by kalyāṇamitras!
should not malign the acts of spiritual friends and benefactors adapting to the world to expedite their work,
dge ba'i bshes gnyen la mos pa rnam par bskyed pas lus dang / sems rnam par ldog par mi bya'o/ /
Never let your mind and body deviate from the development of adoration for the kalyāṇamitras!
should not give up increasing pure faith in spiritual friends and benefactors.
de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad thos pa ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rag las pa'o/ /
“Why is that? Noble one, hearing of all the bodhisattva conducts of bodhisattvas is dependent on the kalyāṇamitras.
“What is the reason for this? It is from spiritual benefactors that enlightening beings learn the practice of enlightening beings;
byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan yongs su rdzogs par bya ba thams cad ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen las byung ba'o; ;
All the completion of the qualities of a bodhisattva comes from the kalyāṇamitras.
it is through spiritual benefactors that all enlightening beings’ virtues are perfected;
byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam gyi rgyun thams cad ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen las byung ba'o/ /
All the continuation of bodhisattva prayers comes from the kalyāṇamitras.
spiritual benefactors are the source of the streams of all enlightening beings’ vows;
byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis bskyed pa'o/ /
All the roots of merit of a bodhisattva are created by the kalyāṇamitras.
the roots of goodness of all enlightening beings are produced by spiritual benefactors;
byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis bsgrubs pa'o/ /
All the accumulations of a bodhisattva are accomplished by the kalyāṇamitras.
the provisions for enlightenment are produced by spiritual benefactors;
byang chub sems dpa'i chos kyi sgo snang ba thams cad ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen las byung ba'o/ /
All the lights from the Dharma doors of the bodhisattvas come from the kalyāṇamitras.
all enlightening beings’ perceptions of truth derive from spiritual benefactors;
byang chub sems dpa'i 'byung ba'i sgo rnam par dag pa thams cad ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen las byung ba'o/ /
All the pure doors of the setting-forth of bodhisattvas[1959] come from the kalyāṇamitras.
the purification of all ways to enlightenment derives from spiritual benefactors;
byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la nan tan du bya ba thams cad ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rag las pa'o/ /
All the practices of bodhisattva training are dependent on the kalyāṇamitras.
the accomplishment of all studies of enlightening beings depends on spiritual benefactors;
byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan gyi chos thams cad ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la gnas pa'o/ /
All the phenomena of the qualities of bodhisattvas rely on the kalyāṇamitras.
the virtuous qualities of all enlightening beings are based on spiritual benefactors;
byang chub sems dpa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa yongs su dag pa thams cad ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rtsa bar gyur pa'o/ /
All the pure higher motivations of bodhisattvas have the kalyāṇamitras as their roots.
the purification of all enlightening beings’ wills is rooted in spiritual benefactors;
byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed pa brtan pa thams cad ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen las skyes pa'o/ /
All the firm developments of the aspiration to enlightenment of the bodhisattvas arise from the kalyāṇamitras.
the steadfastness of determination of all enlightening beings is born of spiritual benefactors;
byang chub sems dpa' gzungs dang / spobs pa'i sgo snang ba thams cad du khrid pa ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen no/ /
The kalyāṇamitras are the guides to all the light from the doors to[1960] the mental retention and eloquence of bodhisattvas.
the light of the oceanic mental command and intelligence of all enlightening beings derives from the guidance of spiritual benefactors;
byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par dag pa'i sgo'i mdzod thams cad ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bzung ba'o/ /
The kalyāṇamitras possess all the treasures of the doors to the purity of the bodhisattvas.
the treasuries of ways of purification of enlightening beings are sustained by spiritual benefactors;
byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes snang ba thams cad ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yang dag par bskyed pa'o/ /
The kalyāṇamitras give rise to all the light of the knowledge of the bodhisattvas.
the lights of knowledge of all enlightening beings are generated by spiritual benefactors;
byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam khyad par can thams cad ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi lag na 'dug pa'o/ /
The kalyāṇamitras hold in their hands all the special prayers of the bodhisattvas.
the excellence of vows of all enlightening beings is in the hands of spiritual benefactors;
byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam gyi tshul rgyud gcig tu gyur pa thams cad ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten pa'o/ /
The single family of the way of the prayers of bodhisattvas is dependent on the kalyāṇamitras.
single-mindedness is led by spiritual benefactors;
byang chub sems dpa'i yang dag par sgrub pa khyad par can mnyam pa thams cad ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rgyud las byung ba'o/ /
The equality of all the special accomplishments[1961] of the bodhisattvas comes from the family of the kalyāṇamitras.
the faith characteristic of the attainment of all enlightening beings has its source in spiritual benefactors;
byang chub sems dpa'i gsang ba'i gnas thams cad ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mdzod na 'dug pa'o/ /
All the secret states of the bodhisattvas are in the treasury of the kalyāṇamitras.
the secrets of all enlightening beings are in the treasury of spiritual benefactors;
byang chub sems dpa'i chos thams cad ni; dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi 'byung gnas nas byung ba'o/ /
All the qualities[1962] of the bodhisattvas originate in the kalyāṇamitras.
spiritual benefactors are mines of principles of enlightening beings;
byang chub sems dpa'i dbang po'i shugs kyi myu gu thams cad ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis rnam par spel pa'o/ /
All the seedlings of the force of the power of bodhisattvas are increased by the kalyāṇamitras.
the sprouts of power of the faculties of all enlightening beings are fostered by spiritual benefactors;
byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes rgya mtsho thams cad ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yang dag par spel ba'o/ /
All the oceans of wisdom of the bodhisattvas are increased by the kalyāṇamitras.
the oceans of knowledge of all enlightening beings are expounded by spiritual benefactors;
byang chub sems dpa'i gter gyi mdzod thams cad ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bskyangs pa'o/ /
All the treasuries of the wealth of the bodhisattvas are protected by the kalyāṇamitras.
the treasuries of all enlightening beings are guarded by spiritual benefactors;
byang chub sems dpa'i bsod nams bsags pa thams cad ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis bsrungs pa'o/ /
All the accumulations of merit of the bodhisattvas are guarded by the kalyāṇamitras.
the accumulations of virtues of all enlightening beings are protected by spiritual benefactors;
byang chub sems dpa'i tshe rnam par dag pa thams cad ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis bskyed pa'o/ /
All the pure lifetimes of the bodhisattvas are created by the kalyāṇamitras.
the purities of life of all enlightening beings are generated by spiritual benefactors;
byang chub sems dpa'i chos mnyan pa'i sprin thams cad ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi kha nas byung ba'o/ /
All the clouds of Dharma heard by the bodhisattvas come from the mouths of the kalyāṇamitras.
the multitude of teachings for all enlightening beings come from spiritual benefactors;
byang chub sems dpa'i 'byung ba'i lam la 'jug pa thams cad ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi khong na yod pa'o/ /
All the paths of setting forth entered by the bodhisattvas are within the kalyāṇamitras.
the entries into the paths of emancipation of all enlightening beings are in the keeping of spiritual benefactors;
sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rim gror byas pas thob pa'o/ /
All the enlightenments of the buddhas are attained through venerating the kalyāṇamitras.
the enlightenment of all buddhas is attained by association with spiritual benefactors;
byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bzung ba'o/ /
All the conducts of the bodhisattvas are possessed by the kalyāṇamitras.
the practice of all enlightening beings is governed by spiritual benefactors;
byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan brjod pa thams cad ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis bstan pa'o; ;
All the descriptions of the qualities of bodhisattvas are taught by the kalyāṇamitras.
the developments of virtues of all enlightening beings are illumined by spiritual benefactors;
byang chub sems dpa'i chos kyi phyogs kyi rjes su 'brang ba thams cad ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bstan pa'o/ /
All following the direction of the Dharma by bodhisattvas is taught by the kalyāṇamitras.
the directions followed by all enlightening beings are shown by spiritual benefactors;
byang chub sems dpa'i sems dang lhag pa'i bsam pa'i bdag nyid che ba ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yang dag par brjod pa'o/ /
All the greatness of the aspirations and superior motivations of bodhisattvas is described by the kalyāṇamitras.
the greatness of will of all enlightening beings is described by spiritual benefactors;
byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byams pa chen po'i stobs ni; dge ba'i bshes gnyen las byung ba'o/ /
All the strength of the great love of the bodhisattvas comes from the kalyāṇamitras.
the power of universal love of enlightening beings derives from spiritual benefactors;
byang chub sems dpa'i rnams kyi snying rje chen po'i stobs ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis bskyed pa'o/ /
All the strength of the great compassion of the bodhisattvas is created by the kalyāṇamitras.
the power of universal compassion of enlightening beings is generated by spiritual friends;
byang chub sems dpa'i dbang thams cad ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bzung ba'o/ /
All the powers of the bodhisattvas are possessed by the kalyāṇamitras.
the masteries of all enlightening beings are governed by spiritual benefactors;
byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yan lag thams cad ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis bskyed pa'o/ /
All the aspects[1963] of the bodhisattvas are created by the kalyāṇamitras.
all elements of enlightenment are produced by spiritual benefactors;
byang chub sems dpa'i phan pa nye bar sgrub pa thams cad ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen las byung ba'o/ /
All the benefits accomplished by the bodhisattvas come from the kalyāṇamitras.
the charitable works of all enlightening beings originate from spiritual friends.
rigs kyi bu/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yang dag par zin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni/ ngan song du mi ltung ngo/ /
“Noble one, the bodhisattvas cared for by the kalyāṇamitras do not fall into the lower existences.
“Sustained by spiritual benefactors, enlightening beings do not fall into bad ways;
dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bzung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni/ theg pa chen po las mi ldog go /
The bodhisattvas in the care of the kalyāṇamitras do not turn away from the Mahāyāna.
supported by spiritual benefactors, enlightening beings do not fall away from the Great Vehicle;
dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bsam pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang 'gal bar mi byed do/ /
The bodhisattvas who are in the thoughts of the kalyāṇamitras do not transgress the trainings.
minded by spiritual benefactors, enlightening beings do not overstep the precepts of enlightening beings;
dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis shin tu bsrungs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni/ sdig pa'i grogs pa'i lag tu mi 'dong ngo/ /
The bodhisattvas guarded by kalyāṇamitras do not fall into the hands of bad companions.
guarded by spiritual benefactors, enlightening beings do not come under the sway of bad influences;
dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bskyangs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i chos las nyams par mi 'gyur ro/ /
The bodhisattvas protected by kalyāṇamitras do not lapse from the Dharma of the bodhisattvas.
protected by spiritual benefactors, enlightening beings do not deviate from the laws of enlightening beings;
dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yang dag par zin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni/ so so skye bo'i sa las yongs su 'da'o/ /
The bodhisattvas being cared for by kalyāṇamitras transcend the level of ordinary beings.
aided by spiritual benefactors, enlightening beings go beyond the stage of sentient beings;
dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bsrungs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi skyon med par mi 'jug go /
The bodhisattvas guarded by kalyāṇamitras do not engage in the faults of the śrāvakas and pratyekabuddhas.[1964]
taught by spiritual benefactors, enlightening beings do not drop into the fall of those who seek individual liberation alone;
dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis bskyangs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni/ 'jig rten las mngon par 'phags pa yin no/ /
The bodhisattvas protected by kalyāṇamitras rise above the world.
hidden by spiritual benefactors, enlightening beings rise above the world;
dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yang dag par bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni/ 'jig rten gyi chos kyis mi gos pa yin no/ /
The bodhisattvas created by kalyāṇamitras are unstained by worldly qualities.
developed by spiritual benefactors, enlightening beings are unstained by mundane things;
dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsnyen bkur ba'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni/ spyod pa thams cad la mi 'khrul bar spyod pa yin no; ;
The bodhisattvas who serve the kalyāṇamitras practice a conduct free of confusion.
attended by spiritual benefactors, enlightening beings become heedful and alert in all their practices;
dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis bsgrubs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni/ brtsams pa thams cad las phyir mi ldog go /
The bodhisattvas accomplished by kalyāṇamitras do not turn away from all undertakings.
roused by spiritual benefactors, enlightening beings do not give up their undertakings;
dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bzung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni/ las dang / nyon mongs pas thub par dka' ba yin no/ /
The bodhisattvas in the care of kalyāṇamitras are invincible to karma and kleśas.
assisted by spiritual benefactors, enlightening being become invulnerable to active afflictions;
dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi stobs kyis bstan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni/ bdud thams cad kyis mi thub pa yin no/ /
The bodhisattvas who are reliant on the strength of the kalyāṇamitras are invulnerable to all māras.
based on the power of spiritual benefactors, enlightening beings cannot be crushed by any demons;
dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rten la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni/ byang chub kyi yan lag thams cad kyis rnam par 'phel lo/ /
The bodhisattvas who remain dependent on kalyāṇamitras increase all the aspects of enlightenment.
in association with spiritual benefactors, enlightening beings develop all the elements of enlightenment.
de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni/ sgrib par gyur pa'i chos thams cad las rnam par sbyang ba'o/ /
“Why is that? Noble one, the kalyāṇamitras have purified all obscured qualities.
“What is the reason for this? Spiritual benefactors are those who clear away obstructions,
dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni/ sdig to las rnam par bzlog pa'o/ /
The kalyāṇamitras have turned away from bad actions.
restrain us from evil,
dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni/ mi bya ba rnams khong du chud par byed pa'o/ /
The kalyāṇamitras have understood what is not to be done.
teach us what is not to be done,
bag med pa'i gnas las yang dag par zlog pa'o/ /
They have eliminated all states of carelessness.
extricate us from folly,
ma rig pa'i mun pa rnam par sel ba'o/ /
They have dispelled the darkness of ignorance.
dispel ignorance,
lta ba'i 'ching ba thub pa'o/ /
They have cut through the bondage of wrong views.
break the bonds of views,
'khor ba'i grong khyer nas 'don pa'o/ /
They have left the city of saṃsāra.
emancipate us from the mundane whirl,
'jig rten gyi gnas 'dor bar byed pa'o/ /
They have discarded worldly states.
cut off attachments to the world,
bdud kyi zhags pa las thar par byed pa'o/ /
They have become free from the noose of Māra.
free us from the nets of demons,
sdug bsngal gyi zug rngu 'byin pa'o/ /
They have pulled out the splinter of suffering.
extract the barbs of suffering,
mi shes pa thibs po las thar par byed pa'o/ /
They have been liberated from the wasteland of unknowing.
liberate us from the thicket of nescience,
lta ba'i mya ngan las yongs su zlog pa'o/ /
They have eliminated the misery of wrong views.
convey us across the desert of views,
srid pa'i chu bo las sgrol ba'o/ /
They are freed from the river of existence.
ferry us over the torrents of existence,
'dod pa'i 'dam nas 'byin pa'o/ /
They are extracted from the swamp of desire.
pull us out of the mud of desire,
lam mi bde ba nas rnam par zlog pa'o/ /
They have turned away from paths to unhappiness.
extricate us from false paths,
byang chub sems dpa'i lam yang dag par ston pa'o/ /
They teach the path of the bodhisattvas.
show the path of enlightening beings,
byang chub sems dpa'i yi dam la gzhog pa'o/ /
They maintain the resolve of the bodhisattva.
enjoin on us the undertaking of enlightening beings,
nan tan la rab tu 'god pa'o/ /
They establish others in practice.
establish us in spiritual practices,
thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'gro ba'i phyogs rab tu ston pa'o; ;
They teach the direction for going to omniscience.
lead the way to omniscience,
shes rab kyi mig rnam par sbyong ba'o/ /
They purify the eyes of wisdom.
clarify the eye of wisdom,
byang chub sems dpa' rnam par 'phel bar byed pa'o/ /
They increase the aspiration to enlightenment.
strengthen the determination for enlightenment,
snying rje chen po yang dag par skyed pa'o/ /
They give rise to great compassion.
foster universal compassion,
spyod pa yongs su ston pa'o/ /
They teach the conduct.
tell about enlightening practices,
pha rol tu phyin pa'i gdams ngag rab tu ston pa'o/ /
They teach the instructions for the perfections.
give instruction in the ways of transcendence,
sa la rab tu 'god pa'o/ /
They establish others on the bhūmis.
direct us into the stages of enlightenment,
bzod pa rnam par 'byed pa'o/ /
They elucidate[1965] patience.
impart tolerance,
dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yongs su 'grub par byed pa'o/ /
They cause the accomplishment of all roots of merit.
engender all roots of goodness,
tshogs thams cad skyed par byed pa'o/ /
They cause the development of all accumulations.
produce all preparations for enlightenment,
byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan thams cad stob pa'o/ /
They bestow all the bodhisattva qualities.
bestow all virtues of enlightening beings,
sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhabs kyi drung du phyin par byed pa'o/ /
They enable going to the feet of all buddhas.
deliver us to the presence of all buddhas,
yon tan thams cad yongs su ston pa'o/ /
They teach all qualities.
show all virtuous qualities,
