ngan song lam rnams thams cad rnam par zlog / mi khom ngan 'gro thams cad rnam par sbyangs/ / sdug bsngal chos rnams khyod kyis thams cad bor/ / mi dga' thams cad yongs su spang bar gyis/ /

“You have turned away from all paths to the lower existences. You have been purified of all inopportune, unfortunate existences. You have cast away all the qualities of suffering, So cast aside all unhappiness. {139}
You have left all states of woe, cleared away the misfortune of situations Inopportune for attaining enlightenment, transcended all evil things— Do not be weary or distressed.
byis pa'i sa ni khyod kyis rnam par bzlog / byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan sa la gnas/ / ye shes sa yi dam pa yongs bskang zhing / / sangs rgyas sa rab ring por mi thogs 'thob/ /

“You have turned away from the level of foolish beings. You are established on the level of bodhisattva qualities. You have filled the supreme level of wisdom, And you will soon attain the level of a buddha. {137}
You have left the stage of the ignorant and are firmly grounded In the virtues of enlightening beings; having fulfilled The greatest knowledge, soon you will attain buddhahood.
byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgya mtsho snyed/ / sangs rgyas ye shes nam mkha'i mdzod dang mtshungs/ / de yi tshad kyi smon lam gang chen mtsho/ / khyod kyis btsal zin shin tu dga' bar gyis/ /

“You should be happy, for you have attained All the oceans of bodhisattva conduct, The wisdom of the buddhas, which is like the treasure of space, And the corresponding extent of the ocean of prayers. {138}
Enlightening practice is like an ocean, enlightened knowledge is like space, The ocean of vows is equally vast—you should be happy with these.
de ltar dbang po yongs su mi skyo la/ / bsam pa brtan zhing sbyor ba nges pa rnams; ; gang dag 'di 'dra'i bshes gnyen sten byed pa/ / de dag ring por mi thogs mgon por 'gyur/ /
“Those who thus have unwearying powers, Strong aspiration, and definite practice And rely on these kinds of kalyāṇamitras Will become leaders before long. {139}
The Friends are indefatigable, firm in will, and sure in application; Those who follow such Friends as these will soon become guides themselves.
khyod kyi byang chub spyod pa sna tshogs kyis/ / sems can mang po dul bar 'gyur mthong zhing / / chos kun sgo yi byang chub spyod pa la/ / nam yang yid gnyis byed par ma gyur cig /
“You[2035] have seen many beings being guided By a variety of bodhisattva conducts. You should not develop any doubts concerning Bodhisattva activity that is the gateway to all Dharmas. {140}
Seeing how various are the many practices of enlightening beings To educate sentient beings, do not become perplexed About enlightenment practice that confronts all realities.
de ltar phun sum tshogs pa 'di 'dra 'di/ / sangs rgyas sras pos de ring 'dir mthong ba/ / don chos yon tan dad pa phun sum tshogs/ / khyod kyi bsod nams phun ldan bsam mi khyab/ /
“Your perfection of merit is inconceivable. You have perfect benefit, Dharma qualities, and faith. Because of that, today, here, son of the buddhas, You are seeing this kind of perfection. {141}
de ltar rgyal sras rnams kyis rgyun 'brel bar/ / rang rang so so'i smon lam bstan byas te/ / khyod kyis de dag ma lus mthun rtogs pa/ / khyod kyis thob pa chen po ci 'dra ltos/ /
“Look at the great attainment of yours In seeing this continuous succession of jinaputras, Each one revealing to you their individual prayers, And you comprehend them all accordingly. {142}
See how great is your gain in seeing enlightening beings continuously; They each show you your vows, and you follow them all.
byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i snod gyur pa/ / de 'dra srid pa brgyar yang dkon pas na/ / de phyir rgyal sras de dag rgyun 'brel ba/ / khyod la rnam thar tshul rnams yongs su ston/ /
“Even in a hundred existences it is difficult To find such a vessel for bodhisattva conduct as you. Therefore, the jinaputras in continuous succession Teach you the ways of the liberations. {143}
Hard to find even in hundreds of lifetimes Is such a participant in the practices of enlightening beings; Therefore the enlightening beings, one after another, Show you their ways of liberation.
bskal pa khrag khrig bye bar 'gro ba gang / / bde gshegs sras dang lhan cig 'grogs gyur ba/ / de dag de rnams spyod yul mi shes te/ / de dag yon tan snod du bdag ma byas; ;
“Those beings who during a quintillion kalpas Have been in the company of sons of the sugatas Without knowing their field of activity Cannot themselves be vessels for the good qualities. {144}
People live with enlightening beings for millions and billions of ages Yet do not know of their state, nor make themselves vessels of virtue.
khyod kyis 'di 'dra'i tshul 'di thos par gyur/ / byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i rnam 'phrul pa/ / 'gro ba kun na dkon pa khyod kyis mthong / / de ltar nor bzang dga' ba'i yid du gyis/ /
You hear this teaching, and see what is hard to find in the world, The spiritual manifestation of greatness of enlightening beings— You should be uplifted in mind.
khyod la sangs rgyas thams cad dgongs pa mdzad/ / byang chub sems dpa' khyod gzung phyir yang gnas/ / khyod kyang de dag rjes su bstan la gnas/ / legs so nor bzang khyod kyi 'tsho ba dge /
“All of the buddhas pay heed to you. All the bodhisattvas remain caring for you, And you are established in their teaching. Well done, Sudhana, you have a good life! {146}
All the buddhas are minding you, the enlightening beings are caring for you, And you are grounded in their teaching—bravo, Sudhana, you live a good life.
byang chub sems dpa'i rigs kyi chos la gnas/ / khyod ni rgyal sras yon tan rnams la slob/ / bde bar gshegs rigs rnam par 'phel byed 'gyur/ / nor bzang dga' ba rgya chen nyams su longs/ /
“You dwell within the family of the bodhisattvas. You train in the qualities of the jinaputras. You will increase the lineage of the sugatas. Sudhana, you should experience the highest joy! {147}
sangs rgyas mnyam med thams cad khyod kyi pha/ / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad khyod dang spun/ / byang chub yan lag thams cad khyod gyi gnyen/ / khyod ni bde gshegs thugs las skyes pa'i sras/ /
“All the unequaled buddhas are your fathers. All the bodhisattvas are your brothers. All the aspects of enlightenment are your relatives. You are a son born from the heart of the sugatas. {148}
chos kyi rgyal po'i rigs kyi rgyud 'dzin pa/ / byang chub sems dpa'i rigs rgyud 'phel bar byed/ / ring por mi thogs chos rgyal 'thob 'gyur gyi/ / nor bzang dbang po tshim zhing dga' bar gyis/ /

“You are a holder of the family lineage of the king of Dharma. You increase the family lineage of the bodhisattvas. Before long you will become a king of the Dharma. Sudhana, be happy, with satisfied senses. {149}
Sustainer of the lineage of spiritual sovereigns, Prolonger of the lineage of enlightening beings, You will attain buddhahood soon, so be happy, Sudhana, full of joy.
sangs rgyas kun gyi dbang bskur dam pa yang / / ring por mi thogs rmad byung thob par 'gyur/ / rgyal ba'i sras dang mtshungs shing mnyam par 'gyur/ / khyod kyi spyod pa'i tshul mthun de 'dra'o/ /

“Before long you will attain the wonderful, Supreme consecration from all the buddhas. You will become the same as and equal to the bodhisattvas,[2036] And your conduct will also be the same in that way. {150}
Soon you will receive the supreme marvelous coronation of all buddhas And become equal to the peerless heirs of the Victors.
mi gang ci 'dra'i sa bon 'debs byed pa/ / de ni de 'dra'i 'bras bu 'thob par 'gyur/ / dga' ba rgya chen bsam yas nyams su longs/ / ngas ni de ring khyod kyi dbugs kyang dbyung / /
“Whatever kinds of seeds are planted by humans, They will gain the corresponding results. You should experience an inconceivable, vast joy, For today I am giving you my reassurance. {151}
As a man sows a seed, so shall he reap the fruit; Today I bring you glad tidings, that you may find inconceivable joy.
tshe gcig khyod kyis gang rnams thog gyur pa/ / byang chub sems dpa' khrag khrig bsam yas pa/ / bskal pa khrag khrig byang chub spyod spyod pa/ / de dag gis kyang phun sum 'di ma rnyed/ /
“That which you have attained in one lifetime Is a perfection that has not been obtained By countless billions of bodhisattvas Practicing bodhisattva conduct in billions of kalpas. {152}
Even unthinkable millions of enlightening beings Who have carried out this practice for millions of eons Have not attained such accomplishment As you have realized in one lifetime.
'di rnams thams cad mos pa'i 'bras bu ste/ / brtson 'grus bsam pa dag ni de bzhin no/ / gang zhig spyod pa 'di 'drar dga' ba yang / / nor bzang spyod pa gang yin de la spyod/ /
“Whoever delights[2037] in this conduct In all these results that are aspired to, And similarly in its diligence and motivation, Should practice Sudhana’s conduct. {153}
This is all the fruit of devotion and firmness and vigor of will; Those who admire this practice should take up what Sudhana has done.
spyod pa thams cad smon lam byung ba yin/ / chos rnams thams cad mos las yongs su gyur/ / nor bzang de ltar khyod kyis yongs su bsgrubs/ / rtag tu khyad par spyod pa btsal bar gyis/ /
“All conduct originates from prayer. All Dharma originates from aspiration. Sudhana, this has been accomplished by you. Always pursue this supreme conduct! {154}
All practice derives from vows, all qualities derive from application; Sudhana, you have accomplished this, forever the best course of conduct.
klu yi bsam pa ji snyed byung gyur pa/ / de snyed char pa yongs su 'bab par 'gyur/ / smon lam ye shes spyod yul ji snyed pa/ / de snyed byang chub spyod pa rgyas par 'gyur/ /

“To the extent that the nāgas have the intention, To that extent there will come rainfall. To the extent that there is the field of activity of the wisdom of prayers, To that extent spreads the conduct of a bodhisattva. {155}
nor bzang bzang po'i spyod ces bya ba 'di/ / tshul 'di khyod la bstan pa 'di yin gyi/ / de shes gyis la dge bshes rang bzhin gyis/ / bsnyen bkur byed tshe 'jigs par ma byed cig /
“Sudhana, this conduct that is called good, This is the way that has been taught to you. Knowing it, you will naturally be serving The kalyāṇamitras; at that time, have no fear.[2038] {156}
This should be shown to you, Sudhana, by the practice of the good; Once one realizes this, one will be serving the Friends thereby.
lus rnams bye ba sngon chad khyod kyis kyang / / 'dod pa'i don du don med zad byas soms/ / da ni byang chub yongs su tshol gyur na/ / brtul zhugs bzang po brtul bas zhig ko 'dod/ /
“Contemplate how in the past you have wasted Millions of lives meaninglessly for the sake of desires. Now, in seeking for enlightenment, Proceed perfectly disciplined by disciplined conduct. {157}
khyod kyis bskal pa bye ba 'das byas te/ / 'du byas sdug bsngal thams cad nyams su myong / / gang+gA'i bye snyed sangs rgyas mnyes ma byas/ / 'di 'dra'i tshul yang thos par ma gyur to/ /
“While ten million kalpas passed by, You experienced all composite suffering. You did not honor buddhas as numerous as the Ganges sands Or hear from them the teaching on this way. {158}
Over millions of eons past you experienced all miseries in conditioned states; Having turned away from myriad buddhas, you did not hear such a doctrine as this.
de las da ni khom par mir yang skyes; ; sangs rgyas byung mthong dge bshes 'di 'dra ste/ / byang chub mchog gi spyod pa'ang thos par gyur/ / rnam dag sems su de ko cir mi 'gyur/ /

“Now this time you have been born into an opportune human existence, Have seen the appearance of a buddha, and have heard This supreme bodhisattva conduct from these kinds of kalyāṇamitras, So why should your mind not be pure? {159}
Now you have got your chance as a human, in the presence of Buddha, With such spiritual friends; how could one not be purified when one has heard of the practice of supreme enlightenment?
bde bar gshegs pa yang du 'byung bar 'gyur/ / dge bshes de bzhin chos mnyan thos par 'gyur/ / gal te bsam pa yongs su ma sbyangs na/ / tshul 'di phyin chad thos par dka' ba yin/ /
“The sugatas can appear repeatedly And the Dharma heard from the kalyāṇamitras, But if your aspiration has not been purified, It will be difficult to hear this way. {160}
Even if there are buddhas existing and the Teaching is heard From spiritual friends and benefactors, If one does not listen to this doctrine one’s mind will not be purified.
de bas dad dang mos dang bsam pa rnams/ / yongs su skyed la bla ma phu dud kyis/ / the tshom lta ba yongs su skyo spongs la/ / yang dang yang du 'di 'dra'i tshul nyon cig /
“Therefore, develop faith, aspiration, and motivation, And with veneration for the gurus Be weary of and reject views of doubt, And listen again and again to this way. {161}
By it an attitude of faith and devotion is produced, supreme respect; Getting rid of desire, views, and lassitude, listen to this Teaching more and more.
gang gis spyod la 'jug pa 'di 'dra 'di/ / thos nas de 'dra'i smon lam mngon bsgrubs pa/ / de dag thob pa dam pa bsam mi khyab/ / de dag mi yi sa srid par legs par 'ongs / /
“Those who have heard this kind of entry into conduct And have accomplished that kind of prayer Will have an inconceivable, perfect attainment And will have an excellent human existence. {162}
Hearing of such an entry into practice, whoever accomplishes this undertaking Makes a supreme gain, inconceivable—this human life is worthwhile.
gang gis de 'dra'i mos pa sbyangs pa ni/ / de la dge bshes thams cad mi dkon no/ / de ni rgyal ba rnams kyi sras dang spun/ / de la phyin chad byang chub the tshom med/ /
“For the ones who purify that kind of aspiration, The sight of all the sugatas will not be rare. All jinaputras will be their kin, and henceforward He will have no doubts about enlightenment. {163}
For one whose mind is thus purified, the buddhas are not hard to find, The enlightening beings are all friends, and there is no more doubt of enlightenment.
gang zhig 'di 'dra'i tshul 'dir zhugs gyur ba/ / des ni log par ltung ba thams cad spangs/ / des ni sdug bsngal chos rnams thams cad bsal/ / des ni yon tan thams cad bsdu bar byas/ /
“Those who enter this kind of way Will forsake all downfalls through error, Will eliminate all the phenomena of suffering, And will accumulate all good qualities. {164}
One who has entered such a teaching keeps all the precepts, Abandons all causes of misery, and embraces all virtues.
lus ni bor nas ring por mi thogs su/ / yongs su dag pa'i sangs rgyas zhing du 'gro / byang chub sems dpa'i gnas su 'jug par 'gyur/ / phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bar 'gyur/ /
Soon, relinquishing this body, you will go to a buddha-land, purified; You will see the abode of enlightening beings and behold the buddhas everywhere.
nor bzang khyod kyi sngon gyi rgyu sdug pas/ / da ltar byung la mos pa nges pa yis; ; khyad par don gnyer dge bshes bsten byas pas/ / chu las ut+pa la bzhin de phyir 'phel/ /

“Sudhana, through your multitude of causes in the past, Through your definite aspiration in the present, And through your relying on kalyāṇamitras for a special purpose, You will grow like a blue lotus on the water. {166}
You have completed a set of past causes, Sudhana, based on your devotion; You serve the Friends with the highest aim, thereby growing like a lotus in water.
dge bshes thams cad phu dud bsam pa dang / / sangs rgyas thams cad dgyes bya'i bsam pa dang / / chos kun yongs su dri ba'i bsam pa can/ / brtul zhugs bzang po ldan pa dal gyis longs/ /

“You who have the aspiration to revere all kalyāṇamitras, You who have the aspiration to please all buddhas, You who have the aspiration to inquire about all Dharmas, You who have excellent discipline, stand up easefully. {167}
Intent on rapport with all spiritual friends and with all buddhas, Intent on seeking out all truths, arise, well disciplined, and do not weary.
chos kyi nan tan kun la rab gnas pa/ / lam rnams rjes su kun tshol rab gnas pa/ / sangs rgyas sras kyi smon lam rab gnas pa/ / yon tan chos rnams kun gyi snod khyod longs/ /

“Stand, you who are established in all practices of the Dharma, You who are established in following all paths, You who are established in the prayers of the sons of buddhas, You who are a vessel for all good qualities and the Dharma. {168}
Set out to apply all truths and follow all the paths; offspring of Buddha, Grounded on vows, arise, vessel of all virtues.
mos pa phun sum tshogs pa ci 'dra bas; ; khyod kyis nga la phyag 'di byas pa ni/ / sangs rgyas thams cad 'khor du mngon sum du/ / ring por mi thogs yongs su 'byung bar 'gyur/ /
“Just as you have developed a perfect aspiration And you have paid homage to me, Before long you will come to be Directly before the assemblies of all buddhas. {169}
Through such perfect devotion you have paid this honor to me; Soon you will come into the presence of the assemblies of all buddhas.
skyo ba'i yid med nor bzang legs pa yin/ / sangs rgyas kun gyi smon lam sems ldan pa/ / brtul zhugs brtan khyod ring por mi thogs par/ / sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan mthar phyin 'gyur/ /
Bravo, Sudhana, buoyant in mind, conscious of the vows of all buddhas; Firm in resolve, you soon will reach the perfection of virtue of buddhas.
ye shes spyod yul rnam thar mthar phyin pa'i/ / 'jam dpal gan du nor bzang khyod song ste/ / bzang po'i spyod pa dam pa mchog dris shig / de tshul khyod 'jug de ni byed par 'gyur/ /

“Sudhana, go into the presence of Mañjuśrī, Who has fully attained the field of activity of wisdom, And ask him about the supreme, excellent good conduct, And then you will enter that way and practice it.” {171}
Ask Manjushri about ultimate liberation in the realm of knowledge; He will initiate you into the highest practice of good in your final existence.
de ltar byams pa chags med spyod yul gyis/ / nor bzang yang dag legs pas 'phags mthong nas/ / 'khor rnams kun la mngon par bstan byas te/ / de yi yon tan legs mdzod 'di brjod do/ /

In that way, Maitreya, who has an unimpeded field of activity, Saw Sudhana, who was superior through his excellent qualities. He then showed him to his entire assembly of followers And described this excellent treasury of his qualities. {172}[2039]
Thus Maitreya, seeing Sudhana arrive, imbued with virtues, in the realm of nonobstruction, revealed him to the assembly, speaking of his treasury of qualities.
'di 'dra'i rjes su bstan pa dam pa dang / / gdams ngag de 'dra nor bzang thos gyur nas/ / dga' ba'i shugs kyis dbang po mngon brlan pas/ / mchi ma'i rgyud mang rab tu des kyang blags/ /
When Sudhana had heard such instructions And such a sublime teaching as this, His senses were saturated by the power of joy, And he streamed with a flow of many tears. {173}
Sudhana, hearing such supreme direction and instruction, was flooded with joy and burst into tears.
dga' ba'i nyams chen nyams su myong bar 'gyur/ / dbang po tshim nas shugs kyis dbugs kyang phyung / / nor bzang langs te thal mo rab sbyar nas/ / byams pa de la bskor ba rab tu byas/ /

There arose a great experience of joy, His senses were satisfied, and he was spontaneously relieved. Sudhana stood up with his palms pressed together, And he performed circumambulations around Maitreya. {174}
His hair stood on end and he sighed with delight. He rose and paid his respects to Maitreya.
de yi lag tu 'jam dpal sems dbang gis/ / me tog phreng ba rin chen mdzes pa dag / byang chub sems dpa'i smon pas mngon thon pa/ / yid du 'ong ba mang po byung bar gyur/ /
Through the power of Mañjuśrī there appeared A precious garland of flowers in Sudhana’s hands, And there appeared many kinds of delights, Which were arising from bodhisattva prayers. {175}
Then, by the mental power of Manjushri, there appeared in his hands beautiful flower garlands and jewels, produced by the vows of enlightening beings;
nor bzang de tshe rab tu dga' gyur nas/ / dga' bar de dag khyams pa de la gtor/ / de tshe de yi mgo la kun nas byugs/ / byams pas tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras/ /
At that time, Sudhana was filled with joy, And he joyfully scattered them toward Maitreya. At that time, Maitreya stroked his head, And then he recited this verse: {176}
blissfully, Sudhana showered these on Maitreya. Then Maitreya patted him on the head and said,
rgyal ba'i sras po nor bzang legs so legs/ / de ltar khyod ni yongs su mi skyo bas/ / nga dang 'jam dpal ci 'dra ci bzhin du; ; yon tan snod du khyod ni myur te 'gyur/ /
“Well done, well done, Jinaputra Sudhana. In that manner you remain unwearied. You will quickly become a vessel for qualities So that you will be just like me and Mañjuśrī.” {177}
“It is good that you are so indefatigable, Sudhana; you will be a vessel of virtues, like Manjushri and me.”
thos nas nor bzang dga' ba'i tshig brjod pa/ / 'di 'dra'i dge bshes bdag dang phrad pa ni/ / srid pa brgya phrag bgrangs par shin tu dkon/ / bdag gis de ring 'dir phyin shin tu legs/ /
When he heard that, Sudhana, filled with joy, recited, “My meeting this kind of kalyāṇamitra Would be a rare event even in hundreds of lives! It is excellent that I have come here today! {178}
Hearing this, Sudhana disclosed the joy of his heart: “It is hard to find, even in hundreds of lifetimes, such Friends as these whom I have now met. It is good for me to have come here today.
yon tan kun gyi pha rol phyin gyur pa/ / 'jam dpal khyod kyi byin rlabs bzang po yis/ / bdag gis bshes gnyen 'di dag dkon pa rnyed/ / khyod dang bdag tu myur du 'grogs par 'gyur// //
“Through your excellent blessing, Mañjuśrī,[2040] You who have attained the perfection of all qualities, I have found these rare kalyāṇamitras. May I soon be together with you!” {179}
By the direction of the honorable Manjushri, perfect in true virtue, I have found this rare Friend. I should quickly meet Manjushri himself.”
shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/ sangs rgyas phal po che zhes bya ba las/ sdong pos brgyan pa'i le'u ste/ bam po brgya bcu gnyis pa/

de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa'i mdud du 'dug ste thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad ces smras so/ / 'phags pa/ bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par zhugs na/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba ma 'tshal te/

Then Sudhana, the head merchant’s son, stood before the bodhisattva mahāsattva Maitreya with his palms together in homage and said, “Ārya, I have set out upon the highest, complete enlightenment, but I do not know how bodhisattvas should train in bodhisattva conduct and in what way they should practice it.

Then Sudhana stood respectfully before Maitreya and said, “Noble one, I have set out for supreme perfect enlightenment, but I do not know how an enlightening being is to learn and carry out the practice of enlightening beings.
'phags pa byams pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku tshe gcig gis thogs par bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan pa ste/
“Ārya Maitreya, you have been prophesied by all the tathāgatas to be only one lifetime from the highest, complete enlightenment.
It has been predicted by all the buddhas that noble Maitreya will become supremely perfectly enlightened in one lifetime;
gang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sku tshe gcig gis thogs pa de ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par dgod pa thams cad las yang dag par 'das pa lags/
“Those who are only one lifetime from the highest, complete enlightenment have transcended all the established states of bodhisattvas.
and one who is sure of supreme perfect enlightenment in one lifetime has gone beyond all the stations of enlightening beings,
des ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa thams cad rab tu brnyes pa lags/
de ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i skyon med pa rab tu zhugs pa lags/
They have entered the faultlessness of bodhisattvas.
entered the certainty of enlightening beings,
des ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa lags/
They have completed all the perfections.
fulfilled all the transcendent ways,
de ni/ bzod pa'i sgo thams cad du zhugs pa lags/
They have entered all the gateways to patience.
entered all doors of tolerance,
des ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa thams cad rab tu brnyes pa lags/
They have attained all the bodhisattva bhūmis.
attained all states of enlightening beings,
de ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo thams cad la rnam par rol pa lags/
They delight in all the entrances to the bodhisattva liberations.
mastered all ways of liberation,
des ni/ ting nge 'dzin thams cad yongs su sgrub pa lags/
They have accomplished all samādhis.
perfected all concentrations,
de ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud thams cad rtogs par thugs su chud pa lags;
They have realized all the states of existence of bodhisattvas.
reached the goal of all courses of action of enlightening beings,
de ni/ gzungs dang spobs pa snang ba'i tshul thams cad rab tu brnyes pa lags/
They have attained all the ways of the light of retention and eloquence.
attained all powers of memory, intellect, and methods of elucidation,
de ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i dbang thams cad la mnga' thob pa lags/
They have gained all the powers of bodhisattvas.
mastered all powers of enlightening beings,
des ni; byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad shin tu bsags pa lags/
They have gathered all the accumulations of bodhisattvas.
gathered all provisions of enlightening beings,
de ni/ shes rab dang thabs mkhas pa'i tshul la rnam par rol pa lags/
They delight in the ways of skill in wisdom and methods.
mastered the methods of wisdom and skill in means,
des ni/ mngon par shes pa chen po dang / rig pa dang / ye shes snang ba'i tshul bskyed pa lags/
They have developed the ways of the light of great higher cognition, knowledge, and wisdom.
developed the illumination of higher knowledge,
de ni/ bslab pa thams cad la byung ba lags/
They have come forth from all trainings.
mastered all learning,
des ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yongs su sbyangs pa lags/
They have purified all bodhisattva conduct.
purified all practices of enlightening beings,
des ni/ smon lam gyis 'byung ba'i sgo thams cad mngon par bsgrubs pa lags/
They have accomplished all the gateways that arise from prayer.
accomplished all methods of carrying out vows,
des ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi lung bstan pa rab tu blangs pa lags/
They have obtained the prophecies of all tathāgatas.
received the directions of all buddhas,
de ni/ theg pa thams cad kyis 'byung ba'i sgo la mkhas pa lags/
They are skilled in the gateways that arise from all yānas.
comprehended all vehicles of liberation,
des ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs yang dag par blangs pa lags/
They have obtained the blessing of all the tathāgatas.
taken on the empowerment of all buddhas,
des ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub yongs su bzung ba lags/
They have grasped the enlightenment of all the buddhas.
embraced the enlightenment of all buddhas,
des ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi mdzod bzung ba lags;
They have gained the Dharma treasure of all the tathāgatas.
preserved the treasuries of all buddhas,
des ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin pa lags/
They possess the treasure of the secrets of all the tathāgatas.
stored the secrets of all buddhas,
de ni/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor phyin pa lags/
They are the heads of all the secret fields of all bodhisattvas.
gained leadership of the esoteric circle of all enlightening beings.
de ni/ nyon mongs pa'i dpung thams cad rnam par dkrug pa la shin tu dpa' ba lags/
They are heroes who alarm all the hosts of the kleśas.
Such a one is a hero in all assaults against afflictions,
de ni/ 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon par lus pa rnams kyi lam ston pa lags/
They are the guides for those lost in the wilderness of saṃsāra.
a guide to those in the wilderness of the mundane whirl,
de ni/ nyon mongs pa'i nad kyis thebs pa rnams kyi sman par gyur pa lags/
They are physicians for those afflicted by the illness of the kleśas.
a physician for those sick with afflictions,
de ni/ sems can thams cad kyi phul du phyin pa lags/
They are supreme among all beings.
a chief of all beings,
de ni/ 'jig rten gyi dbang po thams cad kyi dbang po lags/
They are lords of all lords of the world.[2041]
a leader,
de ni/ 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad kyi thu bo lags/
They are the most senior among all ārya individuals.
preeminent among all noble people,
de ni/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gtso bo lags;
They are the chief of all śrāvakas and pratyekabuddhas.
highest of all saints,
de ni/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho la rgyu ba rnams kyi skya ba 'dzin pa lags/
They are the sea captains for those who are in the ocean of saṃsāra.
a pilot for those in the sea of the mundane whirl;
des ni/ sems can gdul ba'i thabs kyi rgya mtsho chen po bshal ba lags/
They wash others with the great ocean of methods of guiding beings.[2042]
such a one draws the net of means to guide sentient beings,
de ni/ 'gro ba yongs su smin pa rnams kyi dbang po rnam par gzigs pa lags/
They see the faculties of ripened beings.
observes the faculties of people who have matured,
de ni/ sems can thams cad yongs su bsdu ba la brtson pa lags/
They are dedicated to gathering[2043] all beings.
is united with all sentient beings,
de ni/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad yongs su bskyang ba la brtson pa lags/
They are dedicated to protecting all bodhisattvas.
is engaged in protecting all enlightening beings,
de ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i bya ba thams cad la yang dag par 'gro bar brtson pa lags/
They are dedicated to remaining within the activities of bodhisattvas.
is in concert with all the works of enlightening beings,
de ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhabs kyi drung na gnas pa lags/
They are present at the feet of all the tathāgatas.
is in the circles of all buddhas,
de ni/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad du mngon par 'phags pa lags/
They are superior among all the assemblies of followers.
de ni/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi gnas su gzugs brnyan snang ba lags/
Their image appears within the abodes of all beings.
is reflected in the abodes of all beings,
de ni/ 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad kyis ma gos pa lags/
They are unstained by any worldly quality.
is unstained by the things of the world,
de ni/ bdud kyi yul thams cad las yang dag par 'das pa lags/
They have transcended the scope of all māras.
is beyond the reach of all demons,
de ni/ sangs rgyas kyi yul thams cad kyi rjes su bzhud pa lags/
They follow the scope of all the buddhas.
is in accord with the realm of all buddhas,
de ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i yul thams cad la sgrib pa med pa brnyes pa lags/
They attain without obscuration the scope of all bodhisattvas.
has attained nonobstruction in the sphere of all enlightening beings,
de ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod par brtson pa lags/
They are dedicated to making offerings to all the tathāgatas.
is engaged in the service of all buddhas,
de ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la rgyud kyi tshul gcig tu gyur pa lags/
They unite into one way all the Dharmas of the buddhas.
is one with all enlightened qualities,
de ni/ dbang bskur ba'i thabs thob pa lags/
They have attained the method of consecration.
wears the turban of coronation,
de ni/ chos kyi rgyal srid chen po la gnas par 'gyur ba lags/
They dwell in the great kingdom of the Dharma.
sits on the throne of spiritual sovereignty,
de ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi yul la dbang bskur ba lags/
They are consecrated for the scope of the wisdom of omniscience.
is initiated into the realm of omniscience,
de ni; sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad rab tu byung ba lags/
They are from all the Dharmas of the buddhas.
is a source of all enlightened teachings,
de ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la dbang bsgyur ba'i mthar phyin pa lags na/
They have fully accomplished power over omniscient wisdom.
has attained enlightenment and mastery of omniscience.

'phags pa/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba dang / ji ltar byang chub sems dpas nan tan du bgyis na/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad 'thob par 'gyur ba dang / sems can gyi khams ji ltar gnyer ba'i tshul bzhin du rim gror bgyid par 'gyur ba dang / yi dam ji ltar bcas pa'i tshul bzhin du mthar phyin par 'gyur ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa chen po brtsams pa grub par 'gyur ba dang / lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten dbugs 'byin par 'gyur ba dang / bdag dang / sems can dang / sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun slu bar mi 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi rigs rgyun mi gcod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rigs stong par mi 'byin pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur ba bdag la bka' stsal du gsol/

“Ārya, I pray that you teach me how bodhisattvas should train in bodhisattva conduct, how they should practice it, how practicing bodhisattvas should attain all the Dharmas of the buddhas; serve the realms of beings by taking care of them; correctly reach the conclusion of the commitments that have been made; accomplish the great bodhisattva conduct that has been undertaken; bring relief to worlds and their devas; not deceive[2044] themselves, beings,[2045] the Buddha, the Dharma, and the Saṅgha; not be separated from the family lineage of the buddhas; not make empty the family of the bodhisattvas; and become holders of all the ways of the tathāgatas.”

“So please tell me, noble one, how an enlightening being is to learn and carry out the practice of enlightening beings, by which practice an enlightening being attains enlightenment and understands all enlightened teachings, responds when called upon, rescues sentient beings, fulfills the commitment to carry out the practice of enlightenment, comforts and inspires people, keeps true to one’s word, ascertains all the myriad buddha-teachings, sustains the lineage of buddhas and enlightening beings, and preserves the eye of enlightenment.”
de nas byang chub sems dpa' byams pas 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de thams cad la bltas te tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang la nye bar bstan nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /
The bodhisattva mahāsattva Maitreya looked at all his assembly of followers and, indicating Sudhana, the head merchant’s son, said,
Then the enlightening being Maitreya, looking over the whole crowd, pointed out Sudhana and said,

rigs kyi bu dag /tshong dpon gyi bu 'di 'di ltar nga la byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang / yon tan yongs su sgrub pa 'dri ba la ltos/ bzod pa can dag/ tshong dpon gyi bu 'di ni/ brtson 'grus brtsams pa 'di lta bu dang / don du gnyer ba 'di lta bu dang / mos pa'i yi dam 'di lta bu dang / lhag pa'i bsam pa brtan pa 'di lta bu dang brtson 'grus mi ldog pa 'di lta bu dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos kyis mi ngoms pa 'di lta bu dang / khyad par yongs su btsal ba 'di lta bu dang / mgo'i thod la me 'bar ba lta bur spyod pa 'di lta bu dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen mthong bar 'dod pa 'di lta bu dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsnyen bkur bas skyo ba med pa 'di lta bus dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad yongs su tshol zhing yongs su dri ba dang / bsnyen bkur ba byed cing / 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas btang nas grong khyer dpal gyi 'byung gnas nye bar bzung ba nas lho phyogs kyi rgyud thams cad du rgyus te dge ba'i bshes gnyen brgya rtsa bcu la yongs su dri ba byed cing / tha ma nga'i drung 'di'i bar du skyo ba thams cad dang bral ba'i lhag pa'i bsam pas phyin te/

“Noble ones, regard how this head merchant’s son has asked me about the accomplishment of bodhisattva conduct and qualities. Patient ones, this head merchant’s son, with this kind of diligent undertaking, with this kind of dedication to a goal, with this kind of aspiring commitment, with this kind of firm motivation, with this kind of unflagging diligence, with this kind of unceasing appetite for the Buddha’s Dharma, with this kind of quest for what is superior, with this kind of conduct as if his hair were on fire, with this kind of longing to see kalyāṇamitras, with this kind of unwearying service to the kalyāṇamitras, has sought out all kalyāṇamitras, questioned them, and honored them. Sent by Mañjuśrī Kumārabhūta, starting from the city of Dhanyākara, he has roamed throughout the southern region, asked questions of a hundred and ten kalyāṇamitras, and finally come before me, throughout that time proceeding with a superior motivation free of any kind of weariness.

“Good people, look at this fine young man, who asks me about the perfection of the virtues of enlightening practice. With this diligence, this purposefulness, this zealous commitment, this steadfast will, this unflagging vigor, this thirst for enlightened teaching, this excellent questing, this burning urgency, this desire to meet spiritual friends and benefactors, this indefatigability in attendance on spiritual friends and benefactors, he left his city in search of spiritual benefactors at the direction of Manjushri and traveled south, inquiring of a hundred and ten spiritual benefactors, until finally he has come to me, his mind thoroughly unwearied.

rigs kyi bu dag /rnam pa 'di lta bur theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa; yi dam chen po la yang dag par gnas pa/ bsam pa chen po la rab tu rtul ba'i yid dang ldan pa/ snying rje chen po'i go bgos pa'i ngad dang ldan pa/ byams pa chen pos sems can thams cad yongs su bskyab pa'i blo gros can/ brtson 'grus chen po'i pha rol tu phyin pa la rab tu brtson pa/ sems can gyi lam grogs mang pos yongs su bskyang ba la mngon par brtson pa/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po las sems can bsgral ba la zhugs pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi lam chen po la zhugs pa; chos kyi gru chen po yang dag par bsham pa la brtson pa/ chos chen po dang bsod nams rin po che yongs su bsdu ba la rab tu rtul ba/ chos kyi mchod sbyin chen po'i tshogs bsags pa la brtson pa rnams kyi ming thos pa'am/ gzugs kyi lus mthong ba'am/ gzugs kyi lus mthong ba'am/ spyod yul du 'grogs pa'am/ spyod pa dang skal ba mnyam pa ni/ shin tu dkon no/ /

“Noble ones, it is very rare to hear the name, see the body, accompany the field of activity, or have a conduct equal to that of someone who is, in this way, established in the Mahāyāna, who has maintained a great commitment, who has a mind that is disciplined by a great aspiration, who wears the armor of great compassion, who has the intention to protect all beings with great love, who is dedicated to the perfection of diligence, who is dedicated to protecting the multitude of fellow traveling beings, who is engaged in freeing beings from the great ocean of saṃsāra, who is a follower of the great path to omniscience, who is dedicated to making available the great ship of the Dharma, who is determined to accumulate great Dharma and precious merit, and who is dedicated to gathering the accumulation of a great gift of the Dharma.

“Good people, it is hard even to get to hear of the name of those like this who have set forth on the Great Vehicle of universal enlightenment, who have undertaken the great vow, who are resolute in the great endeavor, who are girt with great compassion, who are intent on saving sentient beings with great love, who act with transcendental energy, who are engaged in protecting the great caravan of beings, who are carrying beings across the ocean of the mundane whirl, who are on the road to omniscience, who are engaged in assembling the spiritual ark, who are determined to assemble the great wealth of the treasures of the Teaching, who are engaged in assembling the preparations for the great spiritual activity—it is hard to even hear their names, to see them in person, to associate with them, or to share in their practice.

de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu/ skyes bu dam pa 'di ni/ 'gro ba thams cad yongs su bskyab pa'i don du byung ba ste/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las yongs su thar par byed pa dang / ngan song thams cad yang dag par bsal ba dang / mi khom pa'i lam thams cad rnam par bzlog pa dang / lam nyam nga ba thams cad yongs su spang ba dang / mi shes pa'i mun pa nag po thams cad rnam par bsal ba dang / 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon pa thams cad las yang dag par bzla ba dang / 'gro ba'i rgyud kyi 'khor lo thams cad rnam par bzlog pa dang / bdud kyi yul thams cad las yang dag par bzla ba dang / gnas kyi rten thams cad las gyen du bskyod pa dang / rten gyi gzhi thams cad las bskul ba dang / 'gro ba'i rgyud thams cad du mi gnas par bya ba dang / 'dod pa'i 'dam nas yang dag par gdon pa dang / dga' ba'i 'dod chags spang ba dang / lta ba'i bcings pa gtub pa dang / 'jig tshogs la mngon par zhen pa rnam par bzlog pa dang / 'du shes kyi zhags pa yang dag pa gcad pa dang / phyin ci log gi lam nas rnam par bzlog pa dang / nga rgyal gyi rgyal mtshan bsnyal ba dang / bag la nyal ba'i zug rdu yang dag par dbyung ba dang / sgrib pa'i sgo glegs gzhom pa dang / sgrib pa'i ri rnam par gtor ba dang / srid pa'i dra ba nas gdon pa dang / ma rig pa'i kun tu sbyor ba las dbye ba dang / sred pa'i chu bo las bsgral ba dang / g.yo dang sgyu spang ba dang / sems kyi rnyog pa dang ba dang / the tshom dang / yid gnyis dang / nem nur bsal ba dang / mi shes pa'i chu po chen po las bsgral ba dang / 'khor ba'i skyon thams cad rnam par smad pa'i phyir rab tu zhugs pa'o/ /

“Why is that? Noble ones, it is because this excellent individual has risen up in order to protect all beings. He has appeared in order to free all beings from suffering; in order to eliminate all lower existences; in order to dispel all inopportune paths; in order that all frightening paths be forsaken; in order to dispel all the darkness of ignorance; in order that all the wildernesses of saṃsāra be left behind; in order to repel all the cycles of the existences of beings; in order to transcend the scope of all māras; in order that all bases of dependency be risen above; in order that there will be no basis in any of the classes of existence; in order that beings will be extracted from the swamp of desire; in order that they forsake desire for pleasures; in order that they cut through the bondage of views; in order that they eliminate attachment to the false view of destructible aggregations; in order that they cut through the noose of conceptualization; in order that they turn away from incorrect paths; in order to bring down the banner of pride; in order to extract the splinters of habits; in order to destroy the door of obscurations; in order to disintegrate the mountain of obscurations; in order to extract beings from the net of craving; in order to separate beings from the conduct of ignorance; in order to bring beings across the great river of existences; in order for beings to forsake deception and deceit; in order to purify minds of pollution; in order to eliminate doubt, uncertainty, and hesitation; in order to bring beings across the great river of ignorance; and in order that beings be revolted by the faults of saṃsāra.

“Why is this? This sincere good person has set out to save all beings, undertaken to liberate all beings from misery, to evaporate all bad tendencies, to put an end to all states that are inopportune for attaining enlightenment, to block off all perilous roads, to dispel all darkness of ignorance, to cross all the wastelands of the mundane whirl, to stop all vicious circles, to get beyond the reach of all demons, to remove all attachment and dependence, to rescue people from the mire of lust, to abandon passion for joy, to remove the fetters of views, stop attachment to the body as real, cut through the snare of conception, stop the pursuit of error, to pluck out the thorns of delusion, to break through obstacles, to shatter the mountains of obstructions, to remove the net of craving, to dissolve the bonds of ignorance, to illuminate existence, to do away with guile and deceit, to clear mental disturbance, to remove doubt and confusion, to get out of the current of ignorance and delusion, to repel all the ills of the mundane whirl.
rigs kyi bu/ skyes bu dam pa 'di ni/ sems can rnams chu bo bzhi las yongs su bsgral ba'i phyir chos kyi gru chen po yang dag par bsham par 'dod pa'o/ /
“Noble ones, this excellent individual wishes to provide beings with the ship of the Dharma in order to take them across the four great rivers.
“Indeed, good people, this worthy wishes to assemble the ship of the Teaching, a precious gift, to rescue beings from the four torrents.
lta ba'i 'dam du bying ba rnams kyi chos kyi rkang stegs chen po dgod par 'dod pa'o; ;
He wishes to bring those who are sinking in the swamp of wrong views onto the raised ground of the Dharma.
He wishes to set up the great bridge of the Teaching for those sunk in the morass of views.
gti mug gi mun par 'thoms pa rnams la ye shes kyi snang ba dbyung bar 'dod pa'o/ /
He wishes to bring the light of wisdom to those enveloped in the darkness of ignorance.
He wishes to produce the light of knowledge for those in the darkness of delusion.
'khor ba'i mya ngan du 'khyams pa rnams la 'phags pa'i lam bstan par 'dod pa'o; ;
He wishes to show the path of the āryas to those wandering in the wilderness of saṃsāra.
He wishes to point out the path of sages to those lost in the wilderness of the mundane whirl.
nyon mongs pa'i nad chen pos gzir ba rnams la chos kyi sman sbyin par 'dod pa'o/ /
He wishes to give the medicine of the Dharma to those tormented by the great illness of the kleśas.
He wishes to dispense the medicine of the teaching to those suffering from the illness of afflictions.
skye ba dang / rga ba dang / 'chi bas gtses pa rnams la 'chi ba med pa'i dbyings sbyin par 'dod pa'o/ /
He wishes to provide the realm of deathlessness to those oppressed by birth, aging, and death.
He wishes to give the element of immortality to those assailed by birth, old age, and death.
me gsum rab tu 'bar ba rnams la zhi gnas kyi chus rab tu zhi bar bya bar 'dod pa'o/ /
He wishes to extinguish the three blazing fires with the water of śamatha.
He wishes to cool those burning with the three fires by means of the water of tranquillity.
mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pas gdungs pa rnams la dbugs phyin pa chen po sbyin par 'dod pa'o/ /
He wishes to bring great relief to those who are distressed by misery, wailing, unhappiness, and tribulation.
He wishes to give great comfort to those suffering from sorrow, grief, misery, and depression.
srid pa'i btson ras 'khor ba rnams la ye shes kyi mtshon cha sbyin par 'dod pa'o/ /
He wishes to give the weapon[2046] of wisdom to those imprisoned in the wheel of existences.[2047]
He wishes to give those bound in the prison of existence the knowledge of how to break out.
lta ba'i bcings pas glags pa rnams la shes rab kyi mtshon chas bstud par 'dod pa'o/ /
He wishes to give the weapon of wisdom to those beings in the bondage of wrong views.
He wishes to give the sword of wisdom to those tied up in the bonds of views.
khams gsum gyi grong khyer gyis 'khor ba rnams la thar pa'i sgo bstan par 'dod pa'o/ /
He wishes to show the gateway to liberation to those imprisoned in the city of the three realms.
He wishes to show the door of liberation to those locked in the city of the triple world.
phyogs mi bde bar mngon par gzhol ba rnams la bde ba'i phyogs bstan par 'dod pa'o/ /
He wishes to reveal the safe direction to those who are going in the direction of danger.
He wishes to show the direction of safety to those headed in dangerous directions.
nyon mongs pa'i chom pos gtses pa rnams la dbugs phyin pa chen po sbyin par 'dod pa'o; ;
He wishes to bring great relief to those being attacked by the bandits of the kleśas.
He wishes to comfort those suffering from the joint operation of afflictions.
ngan song gi g.yang sas 'jigs shing skrag pa rnams la 'ju sa'i lag pa brkyang bar 'dod pa'o/ /
He wishes to take by the hand those who are frightened and terrified by the abyss of the lower realms.
He wishes to lend a hand to those terrorized by the perils of falling into states of woe.
phung po'i gshed mas gtses pa rnams la mya ngan las 'das pa'i grong khyer bstan par 'dod pa'o/ /
He wishes to show the city of nirvāṇa to those who have been seized by the murderers who are the skandhas.
He wishes to show the citadel of nirvana to those struck by the murderous clusters.
khams kyi sprul gyis kun nas 'khor ba rnams la 'phags pa'i lam gyis 'byung ba bstan par 'dod pa'o/ /
He wishes to show escape through the path of the āryas to those encircled by the serpent of the dhātus.
He wishes to tell those surrounded by the serpents of the elements how to escape.
skye mched kyi grong stong pa na gnas pa rnams shes rab kyi snang bas gdon par 'dod pa'o/ /
He wishes to bring the illumination of the light of wisdom to those dwelling in deserted villages.
To those loitering in the ghost town of the sense media, he wishes to show the way out by the light of wisdom.
mu stegs ngan pa la zhugs pa'i sems can rnams yang dag pa'i mu stegs su gzud par 'dod pa'o; ;
He wishes to bring those at bad fording places to the correct fording places.
Those on wrong paths he wishes to lead into the right path.
bshes gnyen ma yin pa'i lag tu lhung ba rnams la yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen bstan par 'dod pa'o/ /
He wishes to show genuine kalyāṇamitras to those who have fallen into the hands of those who are not kalyāṇamitras.
To the friendless he wishes to show true spiritual friends.
byis pa'i chos kyi spyod yul la mngon par mos pa rnams 'phags pa'i chos la rab tu dgod par 'dod pa'o/ /
He wishes to bring to the Dharma of the āryas those who aspire to the field of conduct of foolish Dharma.
Those clinging to the realm of the infantile unenlightened condition he wishes to initiate into the teachings of sages.
'khor ba'i khyim la mngon par dga' ba rnams gyen du bskyod de thams cad mkhyen pa'i pho brang du gzud par 'dod pa'o; ;
He wishes to raise upward those who delight in the house of saṃsāra and bring them into the palace of omniscience.
Those clinging to the city of the mundane whirl he wishes to lead away into the city of omniscience.

rigs kyi bu dag /de ltar skyes bu dam pa 'di ni/ sems can yongs su skyob pa'i blo gros de lta bus byang chub tu sems bskyed pa rnam par dag par bya ba yongs su btsal ba la rgyun mi 'chad pa'o/ / theg pa chen po yongs su bsgrub pa'i phyir yongs su skyo ba med pa'o/ / chos kyi sprin thams cad la 'thung bas mi ngoms pa'o/ / tshogs thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir rtag tu brtson pa'i/ /chos kyi sgo thams cad yongs su sbyang ba'i phyir mi gtong ba la brtson pa'o/ / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad spyad pa'i phyir brtson 'grus mi gtong ba'o/ / smon lam thams cad mngon par bsgrub pa'i phyir mi ldog pa'i sbyor ba dang ldan pa'o/ / dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad mthong bar bya bas mi ngoms pa'o/ / dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad bsnyen bkur bas lus la dub par 'gyur ba med pa'o/ / dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad kyi gdams ngag dang / rjes su bstan pa la mthun par 'dzin pa ste/

“Noble ones, in that way, this excellent individual, with that kind of intention to save beings, continuously seeks to purify the development of the aspiration for enlightenment. He never wearies in accomplishing the Mahāyāna. He is never satisfied in drinking from all the clouds of the Dharma. He is continuously dedicated to completing all accumulations. He is dedicated to never abandoning purifying all the gateways of the Dharma. He never abandons his dedication to performing bodhisattva conduct. He has unswerving application to accomplishing all prayers. He never has enough of seeing all kalyāṇamitras. He is never fatigued in serving all kalyāṇamitras. He correctly holds the teaching of the instructions of all the kalyāṇamitras.

“Thus, for the salvation of sentient beings, this worthy, ceaselessly pursuing the complete purification of the aspiration for enlightenment, is tireless in mastering the Great Vehicle, never complacent in seeking all means of conveying truth, constantly engaged in fulfilling all the provisions for enlightenment, always bearing the responsibility of clarifying all avenues of truth, carrying out all practices of enlightening beings with vigor, not stopping anywhere, carrying out all vows with unbending effort, meeting all spiritual benefactors without complacence, tireless in attendance on all spiritual benefactors, properly following the advice and instruction of all spiritual benefactors.

rigs kyi bu dag /sems can gyi 'jig rten na sems can gang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu smon lam 'debs pa de lta bu'i sems can dkon no/ / de bas kyang gang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par zhugs te brtson 'grus brtsam pa'i tshul 'di lta bus sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su sdud pa dang / mos pa drag po 'di lta bus byang chub sems dpa'i lam yongs su tshol ba dang / don du gnyer ba 'di lta bus byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yongs su dag par byed pa dang / nyon mongs pa 'di lta bus dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / mgo'i thod la me 'bar ba ltar spyod pa 'di lta bus dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi ngag dang 'gal bar mi byed pa dang / lhag pa'i bsam pa brtan pas nan tan du byed pa 'di lta bus dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams ngag la nan tan du byed pa dang / mthun par len pa 'di lta bus byang chub kyi yan lag yongs su sgrub pa dang / khe dang / bkur sti dang rnyed pa don du mi gnyer ba 'di lta bus byang chub sems dpa'i bsam pa'i khams dang 'gal bar mi byed pa dang / khyim dang; longs spyod dang / 'dod pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba dang / pha ma dang / gnyen bshes dang / dngos po thams cad la ltos pa med par yongs su btang ba 'di lta bus byang chub sems dpa'i grogs yongs su tshol ba dang / lus dang / srog la phangs par mi rtsi ba 'di lta bus thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la mngon par mos par byed pa de lta bu'i sems can ni/ chos dkon no/ /

“Noble ones, a being in the world of beings who has that kind of prayer for the highest, complete enlightenment is a rare being. Therefore, someone who, in setting out for the highest, complete enlightenment, accumulates the Dharma of the buddhas with this kind of diligent undertaking; who seeks the path of the bodhisattvas with this kind of intense aspiration; who purifies bodhisattva conduct with this kind of dedication; who serves the kalyāṇamitras through this kind of hardship;[2048] who with this kind of conduct, which is undertaken as if his hair were on fire, never disobeys the kalyāṇamitras; who practices the instructions of the kalyāṇamitras by practicing with this kind of firm, superior motivation; who accomplishes the aspects of enlightenment with this kind of successful acquisition; who with this kind of disinterest in gain, honor, and fame never contradicts the nature of bodhisattva aspiration; who with this kind of renunciation, without attachment to home, possessions, desired delights, happiness, parents, friends, or anything, seeks the company of bodhisattvas; and who with this kind of lack of concern for his own body and life aspires to omniscience‍—such a being is extremely rare.

“In all the world it is hard to find people who aspire to supreme true enlightenment; it is even harder to find those who set out for supreme true enlightenment, who master the teachings of buddhas with such diligent application, seek the path of enlightening beings with such ardor, purify the practice of enlightening beings with such purposefulness, attend spiritual benefactors with such diligence, follow the knowledge of spiritual benefactors with such urgency, carry out the instructions of spiritual benefactors with such unbending determination, assemble the elements of enlightenment with such correct understanding, be so indifferent to gain, honor, and praise as not to ruin the will appropriate to an enlightening being, seek the Great Vehicle of enlightening beings with such detachment from home and family, comforts, enjoyments, and material goods, and seek omniscience with such indifference to joy and life.

rigs kyi bu dag /'dis ji ltar cher skyes pa 'di gcig la ji snyed cig thob pa dang / khong du chud pa de ni/ byang chub sems dpa' de ma yin pa gzhan gyis bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag stong gis kyang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang / smon lam yongs su rdzogs par bya ba thob pa dang / khong du chud pa'am/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu nye bar 'gyur ba'am/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par bya ba'am/ sems can yongs su smin par bya ba dang / gdul ba'am/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes la 'jug pa'am/ pha rol tu phyin pa yang dag par bsgrub pa'am/ spyod pa'i dra ba rgya cher bya ba'am/ smon lam mngon par bsgrub pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'am/ bdud kyi las las yang dag par 'da' bar bya ba'am/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsnyen bkur ba'am/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad mngon par bsgrub par bya ba dang / yongs su dag par bya ba'am/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa mngon par sgrub pa'i stobs yongs su rdzogs par bya ba la yang dag par 'byung ba med do/ /

“Noble ones, no other bodhisattva has appeared in a hundred thousand quintillion kalpas who has attained and realized the perfection of bodhisattva conduct and prayer, or has come close to the enlightenment of buddhahood, or has purified a buddha realm, or has ripened and guided beings, or has entered the knowledge of the realm of phenomena, or has accomplished the perfections, or has spread the net of conduct, or has perfectly accomplished prayers, or has transcended the activities of the māras, or has served the kalyāṇamitras, or has accomplished and purified all bodhisattva conduct, or has perfected the strength of accomplishing completely good bodhisattva conduct in the way that he has attained and realized them in this one lifetime.”

Other enlightening beings will not, in millions of eons, attain the fulfillment of the practice and vows of enlightening beings, abide in enlightenment, purify a buddha-land, guide sentient beings, know the reality realm, attain the transcendent ways, extend the network of practices, fulfill the undertakings of vows, transcend the works of demons, develop rapport with spiritual friends, perfect all the practices of enlightening beings, or accomplish the power to carry out the practice of the universally good enlightening being, to the extent that this Sudhana will achieve these things in one lifetime.”

de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang gi yon tan dang / legs pa yang dag par yongs su brjod pa byas nas de la brten te srog chags brgya phrag stong gi byang chub kyi yan lag gi bsam pa brtan par byas nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang la 'di skad ces smras so/ /

Then, because of the bodhisattva mahāsattva Maitreya having described the qualities and excellences of Sudhana, the head merchant’s son, a hundred thousand beings, having strengthened their aspiration to the aspects of enlightenment, said to Sudhana, the head merchant’s son,
Then Maitreya, having eulogized the true virtues of Sudhana, and thereby strengthened the determination for enlightenment in hundreds of thousands of people, said to Sudhana,

rigs kyi bu/ de ltar khyod kyi 'jig rten thams cad la phan pa dang / bde ba'i phyir sems can gyi khams thams cad yongs su bskyab pa'i don du sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad rab tu thob par bya ba'i phyir bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa legs so legs so/ /

“Noble one, it is excellent, excellent, that you have developed the aspiration for the highest, complete enlightenment in order to bring benefit and happiness to all worlds, in order to save all the realms of beings, and in order to attain all the Dharma of the buddhas.
“It is good that you have set your mind on supreme perfect enlightenment for the welfare and happiness of all worlds, for the salvation of all beings, for the attainment of all enlightened qualities.

rigs kyi bu/ khyod kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu de ltar sems bskyed pa ni; khyod kyis thob par bya ba legs par thob bo/ / khyod kyis mi'i lus legs par thob bo/ / 'tsho ba'i 'jig rten du khyod legs par 'tshos so/ / khyod kyis sangs rgyas byung ba dgyes par byas so/ / khyod kyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'jam dpal legs par mthong ngo/ / khyod kyis bsam pa'i rgyud snod bzang por gyur to/ / khyod ni/ dge ba'i rtsa bas mngon par brlan to/ / khyod ni/ dkar po'i chos kyis legs par brtan no/ / khyod kyis mos pa rlabs chen po dang / dge ba'i bsam pa legs par shin tu sbyangs so/ / khyod ni; sangs rgyas thams cad kyis legs par dgongs so/ / rigs kyi bu/ khyod ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis legs par bzung ngo/ /

“Noble one, it is because you have developed the aspiration for the highest, complete enlightenment that you have perfectly attained what is to be attained, you have the perfect attainment of a human life, you live perfectly in the world of the living, you have pleased the appearance of a buddha, you have perfectly seen the kalyāṇamitra Mañjuśrī, the continuum of your mind is an excellent vessel, you are saturated with roots of merit, you rely perfectly upon good qualities, you have perfectly purified your vast aspiration and your virtuous motivation, you are perfectly regarded by all the buddhas, and, noble one, you have been perfectly accepted by the kalyāṇamitras.

You have made a great gain, and your existence amid humanity is indeed welcome. You live the good life among the living and have satisfied the purpose of the emergence of Buddha in the world. You have met the benefactor Manjushri and have made yourself a worthy vessel of truth. You have been nourished with virtues and stabilized on good qualities. You have purified high resolve and good intention. You are minded by all buddhas, and you are in the care of all spiritual friends. By this intent of yours you have developed the determination for supreme perfect enlightenment.

de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu/ byang chub kyi sems ni; sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi sa bon lta bu'o/ / 'gro ba thams cad kyi chos dkar po rnam par 'phel bar byed pas zhing lta bu'o/ / 'jig rten thams cad rab tu rten pas sa lta bu'o; ; nyon mongs pa'i dri ma thams cad dag par byed pas chu lta bu'o/ /

“Why is that? Noble one, the aspiration to enlightenment is like the seed of all the Dharma of the buddhas. It is like a field because it increases the good qualities of all beings. It is like the earth because it supports all worlds. It is like water because it cleans away the stains of the kleśas.

'jig rten thams cad la rten pa med pas rlung lta bu'o/ / lta ba'i nye bar len pa'i rtsa ba thams cad rab tu sreg pas me lta bu'o/ / sems can thams cad kyi gnas snang bar byed pas nyi ma lta bu'o/ / chos dkar po'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rgyas par byed pas zla ba lta bu'o/ /

It is like air because all worlds lack solidity. It is like fire because it burns all the grass of grasping views. It is like the sun because it illuminates all the abodes of beings. It is like the moon because it enlarges the disk of white qualities.

chos kyi snang ba byed pas sgron ma lta bu'o/ / mnyam pa dang mi mnyam pa yongs su mthong bar byed pas mig lta bu'o/ / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi grong khyer du phyin par byed pas lam lta bu'o; ; mu stegs ngan pa rnam par spong bas mu stegs lta bu'o/ /

It is like a lamp because it brings the light of the Dharma. It is like eyes because it enables one to see those have no equal. It is like a path because it leads to the city of omniscience. It is like a fording place because it shuns teachers who are bad fords.

byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mngon par gnas pas bzhon pa lta bu'o/ / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad kyi sgor 'jug par byed pas sgo lta bu'o/ / ting nge 'dzin gyi khang pa na gnas par byed pas gzhal med khang lta bu'o/ / chos kyi dga' ba dang mos pa nyams su myong bar byed pas bza' shing gi ra ba lta bu'o/ /

It is like a carriage because all bodhisattvas are situated in it. It is like a door because it enables entry through the gateway to all bodhisattva conduct. It is like a divine palace because it enables one to dwell in the mansion of samādhi. It is like a park because it enables one to experience the joy of the Dharma.
'gro ba thams cad yongs su skyob pas gnas lta bu'o/ /
It is like a shelter because it protects all beings.

'jig rten thams cad la phan pa skyed pas rten lta bu'o/ / byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa thams cad spyod par byed pas gzhi lta bu'o/ / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad yongs su srung bas pha lta bu'o/ /

It is like a support because it brings benefit to all worlds. It is like a foundation because it enables the practice of all bodhisattva conduct. It is like a father because it protects all bodhisattvas.

byang chub sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi ma lta bu'o/ / thams cad las yongs su skyong bas ma ma lta bu'o/ / slob pa dang mi slob pa dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sems zil gyis gnon pas rgyal po lta bu'o/ / smon lam thams cad kyis khyad par du 'phags pas dbang po lta bu'o/ /

It is like a mother of all great bodhisattvas.[2049] It is like a nanny because it looks after others thoroughly. It is like a king because it outshines the minds of all training and trained śrāvakas and pratyekabuddhas. It is like a lord because it is superior to all other prayers.
yon tan thams cad yang dag par 'du bas rgya mtsho chen po lta bu'o/ /
It is like a great ocean because it gathers into itself all good qualities.
it is like the ocean, containing all jewels of virtue;

sems can thams cad la sems mnyam pas ri chen po lta bu'o/ / 'jig rten thams cad rten pas khor yug lta bu'o/ / ye shes kyi sman rnam par 'phel bar byed pas gangs kyi ri lta bu'o/ / yon tan gyi spos thams cad kyi gnas su gyur bas spos kyi ngad ldang ba lta bu'o/ /

It is like great Meru[2050] because it has the same motivation toward all beings. It is like the Cakravāla mountain range because it supports the whole world. It is like the Himalayas because it multiplies the herbs of wisdom. It is like Gandhamādana Mountain because from it comes all the aroma of good qualities.

yon tan rgya che bas nam mkha' lta bu'o/ / 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad kyis mi gos pas pad+ma lta bu'o/ / sems dul zhing cang shes pas glang po lta bu'o/ / rgod pa thams cad dang bral bas rta cang shes lta bu'o/ /

It is like the sky because of the vast expanse of good qualities. It is like a lotus because it is unstained by all worldly concerns. It is like an elephant because the mind is disciplined and tamed. It is like a thoroughbred stallion because it is free of all wildness.

theg pa chen po yongs su skyong ba'i sngon du 'gro bas kha lo sgyur ba lta bu'o/ / nyon mongs pa'i nad sos par byed pas sman lta bu'o; ; mi dge ba'i chos thams cad zad par byed pas sa'i 'og lta bu'o/ / chos thams cad nges par khong du chud par byed pas rdo rje lta bu'o/ /

It is like a charioteer because it is the vanguard that protects the Mahāyāna. It is like a physician because it cures the illness of the kleśas. It is like the Pātāla worlds because it causes all bad qualities to vanish. It is like a vajra because it penetrates definitively into all Dharmas.

yon tan gyi dri zhim par byed pas spos kyi snod lta bu'o/ / 'jig rten thams cad kyi blta na mngon par dga' bas me tog dam pa lta bu'o/ / 'dod chags kyi gdung ba bsil bar byed pas kha ba'i tsan+dan lta bu'o/ / chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pas a ga ru nag po lta bu'o/ /

It is like a censer because it creates the lovely aroma of good qualities. It is like an excellent flower because all the world delights to see it. It is like Himalayan sandalwood because it cools the fever of the kleśas.[2051] It is like black agarwood because it pervades the realm of phenomena.

nyon mongs pa'i nad thams cad 'joms pas sman gyi rgyal po blta na sdug pa lta bu'o/ / bag la nyal ba'i zug rngu thams cad yang dag par 'byin pas 'bral bar byed pa'i sman lta bu'o/ / dbang po thams cad la dbang sgyur bas dbang po lta bu'o/ / dbul ba thams cad yongs su sel bas ngal ba so po lta bu'o/ /

It is like the beautiful king of medicines because it defeats all the illnesses of the kleśas. It is like a medicine for extraction, because it perfectly removes all the splinters that are predispositions. It is like Indra because it is sovereign over all the faculties. It is like Vaiśravaṇa because it dispels all poverty.

yon tan thams cad kyi rgyan gyis brgyan par byed pas dpal lta bu'o/ / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mdzes par byed pas lhab lhub lta bu'o/ / nyes byas thams cad sreg pas bskal pa 'tshig pa'i me lta bu'o/ / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad rnam par 'phel bar byed pas rtsa ba ma grugs pa'i sman gyi rgyal po chen po lta bu'o/ /

It is like splendor because it adorns with all good qualities. It is like jewelry because it beautifies all bodhisattvas. It is like the inferno at the kalpa’s end because it burns away all evil. It is like the great king of medicine that has no root, because it increases all the buddha qualities.

nyon mongs pa'i dug thams cad rnam par sel bas klu'i rin po che lta bu'o/ / rnyog pa thams cad sel bas nor bu rin po che chu 'dang lta bu'o/ / don thams cad yongs su grub pas yid bzhin rin po che'i rgyal po lta bu'o/ / bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pas bum pa bzang po lta bu'o/ /

It is like a nāga’s jewel because it eliminates all the poisons of the kleśas. It is like the water-purifying jewel because it dispels all pollution. It is like the king of wish-fulfilling jewels because it accomplishes all goals. It is like the miraculous vase because it fulfills all wishes.

yon tan thams cad kyi rgyan gyi char mngon par 'bebs pas 'dod sbyin gyi shing lta bu'o; ; 'khor ba'i skyon thams cad dang ma 'dres pas gos dang ris can lta bu'o/ / rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bas shing bal gyi rgyud lta bu'o/ / sems can gyi bsam pa'i zhing rnam par spyod pas gshol bu lta bu'o/ /

It is like a wish-fulfilling tree because it sends down a rain of the jewelry of all good qualities. It is like goose-quality[2052] clothing because it is unblended with any of the faults of saṃsāra. It is like cotton cloth because it is naturally bright. It is like a plow because it purifies[2053] the field of the aspirations of beings.
'jig tshogs kyi go cha brtol bas mde'u thung lta bu'o/ /
It is like an arrow because it pierces the armor of the view of the reality of destructible aggregations.
it is like a warrior, striking down the self;
sdug bsngal gyi 'ben nges par 'bigs pas mda' lta bu'o/ /
it is like an arrow, piercing its target of suffering;
nyon mongs pa'i dgra las rnam par rgyal bar byed pas mdung lta bu'o/ /
It is like a spear because it vanquishes the enemy that is the kleśas.
it is like power, overcoming its enemy, afflictions;
tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pa 'gebs pas go cha lta bu'o/ /
It is like armor because it protects from incorrect mental activity.
it is like armor, protecting logical thought;
nyon mongs pa'i klad pa 'gems pas ral gri lta bu'o/ /
It is like a sword because it decapitates the kleśas.
it is like a scimitar, cutting off the head of affliction;

nga rgyal dang dregs pa dang rlom pa'i go cha 'dral bas ral gri'i so lta bu'o/ / bag la nyal gyi go cha gshog pas mda' ste'u kha lta bu'o/ / nga rgyal gyi rgyal mtshan snyol bas dpa' bo'i ru mtshon lta bu'o/ / mi shes pa'i shing sgyel bar byed pas lag cha lta bu'o/ /

It is like a sword’s blade because it cuts through the armor of pride, conceit, and arrogance. It is like an arrowhead because it pierces the armor of predispositions. It is like a military standard because it overthrows the banner of pride. It is like a cutting tool because it brings down the tree of ignorance.

sdug bsngal gyi shing rab tu gcod pas sta re lta bu'o/ / gnod pa thams cad las yongs su skyob pas mtshon cha lta bu'o/ / pha rol tu phyin pa'i lus yongs su srung bas lag pa lta bu'o/ / yon tan thams cad la so sor 'god pas rkang pa lta bu'o/ /

It is like an axe because it cuts down the tree of suffering. It is like a weapon because it protects from all harm. It is like hands because it guards the body of the perfections. It is like feet because it is situated in all qualities.[2054]

ma rig pa'i dri'i ling tog yongs su sel bas mig mkhan lta bu'o/ / 'jig tshogs kyi zug rngu yang dag par 'byin pas skam pa lta bu'o/ / bag la nyal gyi tsher ma 'byin pas tsher zungs lta bu'o/ / 'khor ba'i bcing pa las yongs su 'grel bas mdza' bo lta bu'o/ /

It is like an eye physician because it removes the cataracts of ignorance. It is like tweezers because it removes the splinters of the view of the destructible aggregation as real. It is like a sickle because it clears away the thorns of predispositions. It is like a friend because it frees you from the bondage of saṃsāra.

gnod pa thams cad sel bas nor bu lta bu'o/ / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad kyis 'byung ba'i lam mngon par shes par byed pas gtsug lag lta bu'o/ / bsod nams mi zad pas gter lta bu'o/ / ye shes mi zad pas chu mig lta bu'o/ /

It is like a jewel because it dispels all harm. It is like a text because it enables you to know the path of the arising of bodhisattva conduct. It is like a treasure because of its inexhaustible merit. It is like a spring because of its unceasing wisdom.

chos thams cad kyi gdong gi gzugs brnyan ston pas me long gi dkyil 'khor lta bu'o/ / 'go ba med pas me tog puN+Da rI ka lta bu'o/ / pha rol tu phyin pa dang bsdu ba'i dngos po rgyun du 'bab pas chu klung chen po lta bu'o/ / chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par 'bebs pas klu'i rgyal po chen po lta bu'o/ /

It is like the surface of a mirror because it reveals the image of the face of all the Dharma. It is like a white lotus because it is unstained. It is like a great river because in it there is the unceasing flow of the perfections and the methods of gathering pupils. It is like a great king of the nāgas because it causes rain to fall from the clouds of the Dharma.

byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi snying rje chen po yongs su 'dzin pas 'tsho ba'i dbang po lta bu'o/ / 'chi ba med pa'i dbyings su phyin par byed pas bdud rtsi lta bu'o/ / 'dul ba'i sems can thams cad yongs su sdud cing 'dren pas kun nas 'khor ba'i snying lta bu'o/ /

It is like the power of life because it possesses the great compassion of all bodhisattvas. It is like amrita because it enables one to go to the realm of deathlessness. It is like an all-encompassing net of snares[2055] because it seizes and draws in all beings who are to be guided.
'khor ba'i chu la rgyu ba mngon par 'don pas mchil ba lta bu'o/ /
It is like a fishhook because it pulls out those wandering in the river of saṃsāra.[2056]
yon tan thams cad kyi dri zhim po 'dzin pas spos kyi snod lta bu'o/ /
It is like a small casket of perfume because it possesses the lovely aroma of all good qualities.

shin tu nad med par byed pas dug sman lta bu'o/ / 'dod pas dga' ba'i dug med par byed pas dug gi gnyen po lta bu'o/ / tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i dug thams cad 'byang bar byed pas sngags dang gzungs lta bu'o/ /

It is like healing medicine[2057] because it brings perfect health. It is like an antidote to poison because it eliminates the poison of delight in desires. It is like a mantra and dhāraṇī because it purifies all the poisons of error.

sgrib pa dang bar chad kyi thams cad rnam par 'thor bas rlung gi dkyil 'khor lta bu'o/ / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rin po che thams cad kyi 'byung gnas su gyur pas rin po che'i gling lta bu'o/ / chos dkar po thams cad 'byung bas rigs lta bu'o/ / yon tan gyi chos thams cad skye ba'i sgor gyur pas 'byung gnas lta bu'o/ /

It is like the circle of the wind because it scatters all the grasses of obscurations and obstacles. It is like an island of jewels because it is the source of all the precious Dharma of the aspects of enlightenment. It is like a family because it is the origin of all good qualities. It is like a source because it is the gateway to the birth of all the phenomena of good qualities.

byang chub sems dpa'i tshong pa thams cad kyis spyod pas tshong dus lta bu'o; ; las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang dri ma thams cad yongs su sbyong bas chu'i khams lta bu'o/ / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs par byed pas sbrang rtsi'i gnas lta bu'o/ / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mkhyen pa'i pho brang du phyin par byed pas lam lta bu'o/ /

It is like a market because it is the conduct of all the bodhisattva merchants. It is like the element of water because it washes away all the stains of karma, kleśas, and obscurations. It is like a honeycomb because it completes the accumulation of omniscience. It is like a road because it enables all bodhisattvas to reach the palace of omniscience.

chos dkar po thams cad yongs su 'dzin pas snod lta bu'o/ / nyon mongs pa'i rdul thams cad mi snang bar byed pas char pa lta bu'o/ / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par dgod pa thams cad ston pas gnas lta bu'o/ / nyan thos kyi rnam par grol ba dang mi 'dra bas rdo ba khab len lta bu'o/ /

It is like a vessel because it holds all good qualities. It is like rain because it clears away all the floating dust of the kleśas. It is like a dwelling because it reveals the state in which all bodhisattvas are established. It is like a magnet because it does not become attached to the liberation of the śrāvakas.

rang bzhin gyis dri ma med pas bai DUr+ya lta bu'o/ / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang / 'jig rten gyi shes pa thams cad zil du brlag pa dang zil gyis non par byed pas in+d+ra nI la lta bu'o/ / nyon mongs pa'i gnyid kyis log pa'i sems can sad par byed pas mtho ris kyi rnga lta bu'o; ; rnyog pa med pas chu pa lta bu'o/ /

It is like beryl because it is naturally stainless. It is like sapphire because it overshadows and outshines the knowledge of all śrāvakas and pratyekabuddhas and all worldly knowledge. It is like the dawn[2058] drum because it wakes beings from the sleep of the kleśas. It is like clear water because it is not polluted.

'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas la spyod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba'i tshogs zil du rlag par byed pas dzam+bu chu klung gi gser gyi rgyan lta bu'o; ; 'jig rten gsum las mngon par 'phags pas ri'i rgyal po chen po lta bu'o/ / skyabs tshol ba yongs su mi gtong bas skyabs lta bu'o/ / don ma yin pa 'joms pas don lta bu'o/ /

It is like jewelry made of Jambu River gold, because it overshadows[2059] all accumulations of roots of merit through composite activity.[2060] It is like the great king of mountains because it is higher than the three worlds. It is like a refuge because it does not turn away those seeking refuge. It is like meaning because it overcomes what is meaningless.

snying dga' bar byed pas dbyig lta bu'o/ / 'gro ba thams cad yongs su tshim par byed pas mchod sbyin gyi yo byad lta bu'o/ / 'gro ba thams cad kyi sems kyi gtso bo dang thu bor gyur pas na/ rgan pa lta bu'o/ / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad 'dzin pas gleng gzhi lta bu'o/ /

It is like wealth[2061] because it gladdens the heart. It is like charitable offerings because it brings satisfaction to all beings. It is like a senior person[2062] because it is chief and principal in the minds of all beings. It is like a treasure[2063] because it holds all the Dharma of the buddhas.

byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang smon lam thams cad sdud pas mdo lta bu'o; ; 'jig rten thams cad skyong bas rdzi'u lta bu'o/ / sdig to thams cad rnam par zlog pas srung ma lta bu'o/ / nyon mongs pa'i lha ma yin 'dren pas dbang po'i mig 'phrul lta bu'o/ /

It is like a confluence because all bodhisattva prayer and conduct gather in it. It is like a herder because it protects all worlds. It is like a guard because it repels all evil. It is like Indra’s net of illusions because it draws in the asuras of the kleśas.

'dul ba 'dren pas chu'i zhags pa lta bu'o/ / bag chags dang bag la nyal ba dang nyon mongs pa thams cad gzhob tu rlog pas dbang po'i me lta bu'o/ / lha dang mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten rnams la mchod rten lta bu'o/ /

It is like Varuṇa’s[2064] noose because it draws in those to be guided. It is like Indra’s fire because it incinerates[2065] all propensities, predispositions, and kleśas. It is like a caitya for the world and its humans, devas, and asuras.
